```ts
  attempts: [facts],
  power: { source: 'battery', batteryPercent: 64, lowPowerMode: false },
  disk: { freeBytes: 120_000_000_000, agflowBytes: 3_000_000_000 },
  acceptingUntil: null,
};

const events: Variant<RunnerMessage, 'events'> = {
  t: 'events',
  outboxEpoch: 'f3a9c2d1',
  events: [
    { seq: 58, at, type: 'attempt.first_output', attemptId: 'T-42-a3', fence, data: { text: 'I will add the form.' } },
    { seq: 59, at, type: 'runner.state', data: { state: 'ok', detail: null } },
  ],
};

const runnerMessages: RunnerMessage[] = [
  hello,
  heartbeat,
  events,
  { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-3-17', ok: true, data: { applied: true } },
  { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-3-18', ok: false, error: 'unsupported' },
  { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-3-19', ok: true },
];

const welcome: Variant<HubMessage, 'welcome'> = {
  t: 'welcome',
  runnerId: 'R-3',
  hubEpoch: 1,
  hubTime: at,
  ackedSeq: 40,
  wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow/',
  stop: [{ attemptId: 'T-40-a1', reason: 'the runner lease expired' }],
  timings: { heartbeatMs: 15_000, deadLinkMs: 45_000, handoffMs: 180_000, wipGraceMs: 300_000 },
};

const commandMessage = (command: RunnerCommand, seq = 17): Variant<HubMessage, 'command'> => ({
  t: 'command',
  id: `1-R-3-${seq}`,
  seq,
  command,
});

const hubMessages: HubMessage[] = [
  welcome,
  { t: 'ack', outboxEpoch: 'f3a9c2d1', seq: 57 },
  { t: 'heartbeat_ack', at, hubTime: at + 4 },
  ...RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS.map((kind, i) => commandMessage(commands[kind], i + 1)),
];

const fromRunner = (message: unknown) => parseRunnerMessage(JSON.stringify(message));
const fromHub = (message: unknown) => parseHubMessage(JSON.stringify(message));

function errorOf(result: Parsed<unknown>): string {
  if (result.ok) throw new Error(`expected an error, got ${JSON.stringify(result.value)}`);
  return result.error;
}

function without(value: object, key: string): object {
  const copy = { ...value } as Record<string, unknown>;
  delete copy[key];
  return copy;
}

describe('round trips', () => {
  test('every runner message variant round-trips through parseRunnerMessage', () => {
    for (const message of runnerMessages) expect(fromRunner(message)).toEqual({ ok: true, value: message });
  });

  test('every hub message variant round-trips through parseHubMessage, a command of each kind included', () => {
    for (const message of hubMessages) expect(fromHub(message)).toEqual({ ok: true, value: message });
  });

  test('each of the 17 command kinds round-trips through RunnerCommandSchema', () => {
    expect(RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS).toHaveLength(17);
    expect(new Set(RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS).size).toBe(17);
    for (const kind of RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS) {
      expect([kind, RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(commands[kind]).data]).toEqual([kind, commands[kind]]);
    }
  });

  test('RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS matches the RunnerCommand union', () => {
    expectTypeOf<(typeof RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS)[number]>().toEqualTypeOf<RunnerCommand['kind']>();
    expect(Object.keys(commands).sort()).toEqual([...RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS].sort());
  });

  test('a lead attempt spec round-trips too', () => {
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: leadSpec }).data).toEqual({
      kind: 'start_attempt',
      attempt: leadSpec,
    });
  });
});

describe('strict objects', () => {
  test('an unknown key gives an error result, in a message or deep inside it', () => {
    for (const message of runnerMessages) expect(errorOf(fromRunner({ ...message, bogus: 1 }))).toContain('bogus');
    for (const message of hubMessages) expect(errorOf(fromHub({ ...message, bogus: 1 }))).toContain('bogus');
    expect(errorOf(fromRunner({ ...hello, git: { ...hello.git, bogus: 1 } }))).toContain('bogus');
    expect(errorOf(fromRunner({ ...heartbeat, attempts: [{ ...facts, bogus: 1 }] }))).toContain('bogus');
    const deep = { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: { ...spec, start: { ...spec.start, bogus: 1 } } };
    expect(errorOf(fromHub(commandMessage(deep as never)))).toContain('bogus');
  });

  test('a missing field gives an error result', () => {
    // A result's data and error are the only optional fields.
    for (const message of runnerMessages) {
      for (const key of Object.keys(message).filter((k) => k !== 'data' && k !== 'error')) {
        expect([message.t, key, fromRunner(without(message, key)).ok]).toEqual([message.t, key, false]);
      }
    }
    for (const message of hubMessages) {
      for (const key of Object.keys(message)) {
        expect([message.t, key, fromHub(without(message, key)).ok]).toEqual([message.t, key, false]);
      }
    }
    for (const kind of RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS) {
      const command = commands[kind];
      for (const key of Object.keys(command).filter((k) => k !== 'kind')) {
        expect([kind, key, RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(without(command, key)).success]).toEqual([kind, key, false]);
      }
    }
  });

  test('a wrong or missing discriminator gives an error result', () => {
    expect(fromRunner({ ...heartbeat, t: 'heartbeat_ack' }).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, t: 'welcome' }).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(fromRunner(without(hello, 't')).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(fromHub({ ...welcome, t: 'hello' }).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.interrupt, kind: 'pause' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(without(commands.interrupt, 'kind')).success).toBe(false);
    // A message's discriminator is t, a command's is kind: one is never read as the other.
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.interrupt, t: 'interrupt' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test('invalid JSON and values that are not objects are reported, never thrown', () => {
    for (const text of ['', '{', 'not json', '{"t":"hello",}', '42', 'null', '[]', '"hello"']) {
      expect([text, parseRunnerMessage(text).ok]).toEqual([text, false]);
      expect([text, parseHubMessage(text).ok]).toEqual([text, false]);
    }
    expect(errorOf(parseRunnerMessage('{'))).toContain('JSON');
  });
});

describe('hello', () => {
  test('requires every field of design 6.3', () => {
    for (const key of Object.keys(hello).filter((k) => k !== 't')) {
      expect([key, fromRunner(without(hello, key)).ok]).toEqual([key, false]);
    }
  });

  test('lastSeq is at least firstSeq − 1, which an empty outbox reports', () => {
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, firstSeq: 58, lastSeq: 57 }).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, firstSeq: 1, lastSeq: 0 }).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(errorOf(fromRunner({ ...hello, firstSeq: 59, lastSeq: 57 }))).toContain('lastSeq');
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, firstSeq: 0, lastSeq: 0 }).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  test('carries the confirmed settings with their version', () => {
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, settings: without(settings, 'version') }).ok).toBe(false);
    // 0: settings the hub has not confirmed yet, from a runner it has never seen.
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, settings: { ...settings, version: 0 } }).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, settings: { ...settings, capacity: 0 } }).ok).toBe(false);
    const gemini = { ...settings, ceilings: { gemini: { fiveHour: 1, weekly: 1 } } };
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, settings: gemini }).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  test('any protocol number parses, so the hub can refuse an unsupported one with 4426', () => {
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, protocol: 2 }).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(fromRunner({ ...hello, protocol: 0 }).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a hello the hub cannot read still gives its protocol, key and machine, so a newer runner gets 4426', () => {
    const helloOf = (message: unknown) => {
      const parsed = fromRunner(message);
      if (parsed.ok) throw new Error(`expected an error, got ${JSON.stringify(parsed.value)}`);
      return parsed.hello;
    };
    const newer = { protocol: 2, runnerKey: hello.runnerKey, machineId: hello.machineId };
    // A protocol-2 hello with a field protocol 1 does not know, and one that kept little of protocol 1's shape.
    expect(helloOf({ ...hello, protocol: 2, resumeTokens: ['rt_1'] })).toEqual(newer);
    expect(helloOf({ t: 'hello', ...newer, capabilities: { compaction: true } })).toEqual(newer);
    // An unreadable protocol-1 hello gives them too: the hub supports that version, so it closes the link instead.
    expect(helloOf({ ...hello, git: null })).toEqual({ ...newer, protocol: 1 });
    // Without a usable version, key and machine there is nothing to refuse.
    for (const bad of [
      without(hello, 'protocol'),
      { ...hello, protocol: 0 },
      { ...hello, protocol: '2' },
      without(hello, 'runnerKey'),
      { ...hello, machineId: '' },
      { ...heartbeat, bogus: 1 },
    ]) {
      expect([bad, helloOf(bad)]).toEqual([bad, null]);
    }
    expect(parseRunnerMessage('{')).toMatchObject({ ok: false, hello: null });
  });

  test('LiveAttempt.state is starting, running, idle, stopped or suspended', () => {
    for (const state of ['starting', 'running', 'idle', 'stopped', 'suspended']) {
      const attempt = { attemptId: 'T-42-a3', fence, state, sessionRef: null, clone: false };
      expect([state, LiveAttemptSchema.safeParse(attempt).success]).toEqual([state, true]);
    }
    for (const state of ['ended', 'holding', 'quota_wait', '']) {
      const attempt = { attemptId: 'T-42-a3', fence, state, sessionRef: null, clone: false };
      expect([state, LiveAttemptSchema.safeParse(attempt).success]).toEqual([state, false]);
    }
  });
});

describe('welcome', () => {
  test('requires timings { heartbeatMs, deadLinkMs, handoffMs, wipGraceMs }', () => {
    expect(fromHub(without(welcome, 'timings')).ok).toBe(false);
    for (const key of Object.keys(welcome.timings)) {
      expect([key, fromHub({ ...welcome, timings: without(welcome.timings, key) }).ok]).toEqual([key, false]);
    }
    expect(fromHub({ ...welcome, timings: { ...welcome.timings, wipGraceMs: 0 } }).ok).toBe(false);
  });

  test('names a WIP ref prefix the runner can push under', () => {
    expect(fromHub({ ...welcome, wipRefPrefix: 'refs/heads/agflow-wip/' }).ok).toBe(true);
    for (const prefix of ['refs/agflow', 'agflow/', 'refs/agflow-local/']) {
      expect([prefix, fromHub({ ...welcome, wipRefPrefix: prefix }).ok]).toEqual([prefix, false]);
    }
  });
});

describe('the events envelope', () => {
  test('leaves data, attemptId and fence to parseRunnerEvent', () => {
    const odd = {
      ...events,
      events: [{ seq: 60, at, type: 'attempt.wip', attemptId: 7, fence: 'e1.7', data: 'anything' }],
    };
    expect(fromRunner(odd)).toEqual({ ok: true, value: odd });
    const bare = { ...events, events: [{ seq: 61, at, type: 'attempt.bogus', data: null, extra: true }] };
    expect(fromRunner(bare)).toEqual({ ok: true, value: bare });
  });

  test("checks outboxEpoch and each event's seq, at and type", () => {
    const event = events.events[0];
    expect(fromRunner(without(events, 'outboxEpoch')).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(fromRunner({ ...events, outboxEpoch: '' }).ok).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [
      without(event, 'seq'),
      { ...event, seq: 0 },
      { ...event, seq: 1.5 },
      { ...event, seq: '58' },
      without(event, 'at'),
      { ...event, at: -1 },
      without(event, 'type'),
      { ...event, type: '' },
      { ...event, type: 5 },
    ]) {
      expect([bad, fromRunner({ ...events, events: [bad] }).ok]).toEqual([bad, false]);
    }
  });
});

describe('value schemas', () => {
  test('are typed against the core interfaces', () => {
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof FenceSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<Fence>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof AttemptFactsSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<AttemptFacts>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof RunnerVendorSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<RunnerVendor>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof VendorQuotaSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<VendorQuota>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof ProfileSummarySchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<ProfileSummary>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof RunnerSettingsSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<RunnerSettings>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof AttemptSpecSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<AttemptSpec>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof InjectedMessageSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<InjectedMessage>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof RunnerCommandSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<RunnerCommand>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof RunnerMessageSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<RunnerMessage>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof HubMessageSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<HubMessage>();
    for (const [schema, value] of [
      [FenceSchema, fence],
      [RunnerVendorSchema, vendor],
      [VendorQuotaSchema, quota],
      [ProfileSummarySchema, profile],
      [AccountQuotaReportSchema, { vendor: 'codex', accountId: TEST_ACCOUNT_ID, quota }],
    ] as const) {
      expect(schema.safeParse(value).data).toEqual(value);
    }
  });

  test('fences, account ids and quota windows are checked', () => {
    for (const bad of [{ epoch: 0, counter: 1 }, { epoch: 1, counter: 0 }, { epoch: 1.5, counter: 1 }, { epoch: 1 }]) {
      expect([bad, FenceSchema.safeParse(bad).success]).toEqual([bad, false]);
    }
    expect(RunnerVendorSchema.safeParse({ ...vendor, accountId: null }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(RunnerVendorSchema.safeParse({ ...vendor, accountId: 'timur@example.com' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(VendorQuotaSchema.safeParse({ ...quota, windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: 1 } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(VendorQuotaSchema.safeParse({ ...quota, windows: { fiveHour: 1.2, weekly: 0 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AccountQuotaReportSchema.safeParse({ vendor: 'claude', accountId: null, quota }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test('AttemptFacts ages are non-negative integers and contextUsed is 0..1 or null', () => {
    const ages = ['eventAgeMs', 'fsAgeMs', 'turns', 'turnsWithoutProgress', 'repeatedCalls', 'continuations'] as const;
    for (const key of [...ages, 'vendorErrorMs', 'activeMs'] as const) {
      for (const bad of [-1, 1.5, '3']) {
        expect([key, bad, AttemptFactsSchema.safeParse({ ...facts, [key]: bad }).success]).toEqual([key, bad, false]);
      }
    }
    expect(AttemptFactsSchema.safeParse({ ...facts, tool: { ...tool, ageMs: -5 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AttemptFactsSchema.safeParse({ ...facts, tool: { ...tool, capMs: null } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(AttemptFactsSchema.safeParse({ ...facts, fsAgeMs: null, tool: null }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const used of [0, 0.5, 1, null]) {
      expect([used, AttemptFactsSchema.safeParse({ ...facts, contextUsed: used }).success]).toEqual([used, true]);
    }
    for (const used of [-0.1, 1.01, 70]) {
      expect([used, AttemptFactsSchema.safeParse({ ...facts, contextUsed: used }).success]).toEqual([used, false]);
    }
  });
});

describe('commands', () => {
  test('COMMAND_MIN_PROTOCOL maps all 17 kinds to 1', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(COMMAND_MIN_PROTOCOL).sort()).toEqual([...RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS].sort());
    for (const kind of RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS) expect([kind, COMMAND_MIN_PROTOCOL[kind]]).toEqual([kind, 1]);
    expect(PROTOCOL_VERSION).toBe(1);
  });

  test('start_attempt and resume_attempt carry an agent token', () => {
    const bare = { kind: 'start_attempt', attempt: without(spec, 'agentToken') };
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(bare).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(without(commands.resume_attempt, 'agentToken')).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.resume_attempt, agentToken: 'cli_token' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test('decide_approval carries a fence and the approval id', () => {
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(without(commands.decide_approval, 'fence')).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(without(commands.decide_approval, 'approvalId')).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.decide_approval, decision: 'accept' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("hand_back's source is { kind: 'clone' } or { kind: 'ref', ref, sha } with a full sha", () => {
    const handBack = (source: unknown) => RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.hand_back, source }).success;
    expect(handBack({ kind: 'clone' })).toBe(true);
    expect(handBack({ kind: 'ref', ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur', sha: sha('d') })).toBe(true);
    expect(handBack({ kind: 'ref', ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur', sha: 'ddddddd' })).toBe(false);
    expect(handBack({ kind: 'ref', ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur' })).toBe(false);
    expect(handBack({ kind: 'ref', ref: 'agflow/T-42-x', sha: sha('d') })).toBe(false);
    expect(handBack({ kind: 'clone', ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/a3' })).toBe(false);
    expect(handBack('clone')).toBe(false);
  });

  test('delete_refs expects full shas; start, expected and adoptable shas may be abbreviated M1 values', () => {
    const short = 'abc1234';
    const deleteRefs = (expectedSha: string) =>
      RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.delete_refs, refs: [{ ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/a3', expectedSha }] });
    expect(deleteRefs(sha('c')).success).toBe(true);
    expect(deleteRefs(short).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AttemptSpecSchema.safeParse({ ...spec, start: { ...spec.start, sha: short } }).success).toBe(true);
    const push = { ...commands.push_submission, expectedBranchSha: short, adoptable: [short] };
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(push).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test('deliver carries how many messages did not fit', () => {
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(without(commands.deliver, 'more')).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.deliver, more: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.deliver, more: 0 }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test('update_settings carries changed settings without their version, and the version the hub gave them', () => {
    const update = (changes: unknown) =>
      RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.update_settings, settings: changes }).success;
    expect(update({})).toBe(true);
    expect(update(without(settings, 'version'))).toBe(true);
    expect(update({ version: 4 })).toBe(false);
    expect(update({ capacity: 17 })).toBe(false);
    expect(update({ keepAwake: 'never' })).toBe(false);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse({ ...commands.update_settings, version: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test('restore.base is a ref under refs/ or null', () => {
    const withBase = (base: unknown) => AttemptSpecSchema.safeParse({ ...spec, restore: { ...restore, base } }).success;
    expect(withBase('refs/heads/main')).toBe(true);
    expect(withBase(null)).toBe(true);
    for (const base of ['main', 'heads/main', 'refs/heads/../main', 'refs/heads/main/', '', sha('a')]) {
      expect([base, withBase(base)]).toEqual([base, false]);
    }
    const resume = (base: unknown) => ({ ...commands.resume_attempt, restore: { ...restore, base } });
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(resume('refs/heads/main')).success).toBe(true);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.safeParse(resume('main')).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("an attempt spec's ids agree: a lead has no task, branch or WIP ref, and a worker's id names its task", () => {
    expect(AttemptSpecSchema.safeParse(leadSpec).success).toBe(true);
    for (const bad of [
      { ...spec, attemptId: 'T-41-a3' },
      { ...spec, attemptId: 'lead-a3' },
      { ...spec, role: 'lead' },
      { ...spec, branch: null },
      { ...spec, wipRef: null },
      { ...leadSpec, taskId: 'T-42' },
      { ...leadSpec, role: 'worker' },
      { ...leadSpec, branch: 'agflow/T-42-add-login' },
      { ...leadSpec, wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-42/a3' },
      { ...spec, attemptId: '../T-42-a3' },
    ]) {
      const parsed = AttemptSpecSchema.safeParse(bad).success;
      expect([bad.attemptId, bad.role, parsed]).toEqual([bad.attemptId, bad.role, false]);
    }
  });

  test('a command the runner cannot read still names its id, so the runner can answer it unsupported', () => {
    const pause = { kind: 'pause', attemptId: 'T-42-a3' };
    const unknownKind = fromHub({ ...commandMessage(commands.interrupt), command: pause });
    expect(unknownKind).toMatchObject({ ok: false, commandId: '1-R-3-17' });
    const invalid = fromHub(commandMessage({ ...commands.interrupt, fence: { epoch: 1 } } as never, 18));
    expect(invalid).toMatchObject({ ok: false, commandId: '1-R-3-18' });
    expect(fromHub({ t: 'command', id: '1-R-3-19', seq: 19 })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, commandId: '1-R-3-19' });
    expect(fromHub({ ...welcome, hubEpoch: 0 })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, commandId: null });
    const noId = { t: 'command', seq: 19, command: commands.interrupt };
    expect(fromHub(noId)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, commandId: null });
    expect(parseHubMessage('{')).toMatchObject({ ok: false, commandId: null });
  });
});

describe('injected messages and constants', () => {
  test('InjectedMessage accepts messageId 0 with authority system: hub text with no message row', () => {
    const report = { messageId: 0, authority: 'system', text: 'Situation report' };
    expect(InjectedMessageSchema.safeParse(report).success).toBe(true);
    expect(InjectedMessageSchema.safeParse({ messageId: 0, authority: 'person', text: 'hi' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(InjectedMessageSchema.safeParse({ messageId: -1, authority: 'system', text: 'hi' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(InjectedMessageSchema.safeParse({ messageId: 3, authority: 'lead', text: 'hi' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("TEST_ACCOUNT_ID is the first 16 hex of sha256('agflow-test')", async () => {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode('agflow-test'));
    const hex = [...new Uint8Array(digest)].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    expect(TEST_ACCOUNT_ID).toBe('337c8a0a2e66c1e6');
    expect(TEST_ACCOUNT_ID).toBe(hex.slice(0, 16));
  });

  test('CLOSE_CODES names 4403, 4409 and 4426', () => {
    expect(CLOSE_CODES).toEqual({ refused: 4403, replaced: 4409, incompatible: 4426 });
  });
});
```

```ts
// The runner link, protocol 1 (design 6.3): the messages, commands and attempt specs the hub and runners
// exchange over a runner's WebSocket. Both sides import these schemas, and each schema is pinned to its
// TypeScript type, so the types, the core types and the wire format cannot drift apart.
import { z } from 'zod';
import { isValidWipRefPrefix, parseAttemptId } from './naming';
import { BranchSchema, CommitShaSchema, RoleSchema, TaskIdSchema, VendorSchema } from './schemas';
import type {
  AgentRole,
  AttemptFacts,
  AttemptPhase,
  Fence,
  ProfileSummary,
  Runner,
  RunnerVendor,
  StopCause,
  Vendor,
  VendorQuota,
} from './types';

export const PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1;

/** The WebSocket close codes the hub ends a runner's link with. */
export const CLOSE_CODES = {
  /** The key belongs to another owner or machine, or the runner was retired. */
  refused: 4403,
  /** Another connection with the same key and machine replaced this one. */
  replaced: 4409,
  /** The runner's protocol is outside the range the hub supports. */
  incompatible: 4426,
} as const;

/** The account id every adapter reports in test mode: the first 16 hex of sha256('agflow-test') (design 15.1). */
export const TEST_ACCOUNT_ID = '337c8a0a2e66c1e6';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Types
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** runner.json is the source; only the hub assigns versions (design 6.3, "Settings sync"). */
export interface RunnerSettings {
  capacity: number;
  keepAwake: 'off' | 'ac' | 'always';
  draining: boolean;
  ceilings: Partial<Record<Vendor, { fiveHour: number; weekly: number }>>;
  allowPaidUsage: Partial<Record<Vendor, boolean>>;
  /** 0 until the hub first confirms the settings. */
  version: number;
}

export interface LiveAttempt {
  attemptId: string;
  fence: Fence;
  /**
   * starting: before attempt.spawned; running: the process is alive (a worker, or a lead in a turn); idle: a
   * lead's process waits between wake-ups; stopped: no process; suspended: stopped by a suspend.
   */
  state: 'starting' | 'running' | 'idle' | 'stopped' | 'suspended';
  sessionRef: string | null;
  /** The clone still exists. */
  clone: boolean;
}

/** Runners omit reports for a vendor whose account id is unknown. */
export interface AccountQuotaReport {
  vendor: Vendor;
  accountId: string;
  quota: VendorQuota;
}

/**
 * An event as an events message carries it: { seq, at, type, attemptId?, fence?, data }. The message checks only
 * what the hub needs to apply and acknowledge a batch in order. parseRunnerEvent reads the rest of each event on
 * its own, so a bad event becomes a reject and never fails its batch.
 */
export type RawRunnerEvent = { seq: number; at: number; type: string; [key: string]: unknown };

export type RunnerMessage =
  | {
      t: 'hello';
      protocol: number;
      runnerKey: string;
      machineId: string;
      name: string;
      agflowVersion: string;
      platform: string;
      /** The last hub-confirmed snapshot, never local edits. */
      settings: RunnerSettings;
      vendors: RunnerVendor[];
      quota: AccountQuotaReport[];
      profile: ProfileSummary;
      git: Runner['git'];
      state: 'ok' | 'crash_loop' | 'disk_low';
      stateDetail: string | null;
      /** New whenever runner.db is new. */
      outboxEpoch: string;
      /** The lowest event seq the runner still keeps (acknowledged ones are kept 48 h). */
      firstSeq: number;
      /** The highest event seq the runner holds; firstSeq − 1 when the outbox is empty. */
      lastSeq: number;
      lastHubEpoch: number | null;
      /** Every attempt whose start or resume the runner has recorded. */
      attempts: LiveAttempt[];
    }
  | {
      t: 'heartbeat';
      at: number;
      attempts: AttemptFacts[];
      power: Runner['power'];
      disk: Runner['disk'];
      /** Ms from now during which the runner takes no new attempt (wake, battery, disk). */
      acceptingUntil: number | null;
    }
  | { t: 'events'; outboxEpoch: string; events: RawRunnerEvent[] }
  | { t: 'result'; commandId: string; ok: boolean; data?: unknown; error?: string };

export type HubMessage =
  | {
      t: 'welcome';
      runnerId: string;
      hubEpoch: number;
      hubTime: number;
      ackedSeq: number;
      wipRefPrefix: string;
      stop: { attemptId: string; reason: string }[];
      /** They override runner.json. wipGraceMs, runnerLeaseMs / 3, bounds WIP pushes during a link outage (7.3). */
      timings: { heartbeatMs: number; deadLinkMs: number; handoffMs: number; wipGraceMs: number };
    }
  | { t: 'ack'; outboxEpoch: string; seq: number } // cumulative
  | { t: 'heartbeat_ack'; at: number; hubTime: number }
  | { t: 'command'; id: string; seq: number; command: RunnerCommand };

export type RunnerCommand =
  | { kind: 'start_attempt'; attempt: AttemptSpec }
  | {
      kind: 'resume_attempt';
      attemptId: string;
      fence: Fence;
      agentToken: string;
      /**
       * The quoted review feedback (ladder step 1), the wake-up delivery (a holding lead), or "the runner
       * restarted; continue from your last step" (reconciliation, restore).
       */
      prompt: string;
      messages: InjectedMessage[];
      /** Recomputed by the hub, like restore and acceptanceIds. */
      taskPack: string | null;
      restore: AttemptSpec['restore'];
      acceptanceIds: string[];
    }
  | {
      kind: 'deliver';
      attemptId: string;
      fence: Fence;
      messages: InjectedMessage[];
      /** Messages that did not fit; the runner adds one line about them (design 6.7). */
      more: number;
    }
  | { kind: 'interrupt'; attemptId: string; fence: Fence } // the Agents view's Interrupt action
  | {
      kind: 'stop_attempt';
      attemptId: string;
      fence: Fence;
      cause: StopCause;
      reason: string;
      /** Ask for a handoff note first (design 6.8). */
      handoff: boolean;
      /** Interrupt the turn before asking (stuck tools, quiet agents, loops). */
      interruptFirst: boolean;
      /** True for stop-and-hold, so a person can still take the clone over. */
      keepClone: boolean;
    }
  | { kind: 'hold_attempt'; attemptId: string; fence: Fence }
  | {
      kind: 'push_submission';
      attemptId: string;
      fence: Fence;
      submissionId: string;
      branch: string;
      expectedBranchSha: string | null;
      /** Shas the hub accepts as the remote head (design 6.13). */
      adoptable: string[];
    }
  | { kind: 'prepare_takeover'; attemptId: string; fence: Fence; person: string }
  | {
      kind: 'hand_back';
      attemptId: string;
      /**
       * Protocol-1 hubs send only the clone source; a runner given a ref source fetches the ref into its vault and
       * answers ok, with no event.
       */
      source: { kind: 'clone' } | { kind: 'ref'; ref: string; sha: string };
    }
  | { kind: 'cleanup_attempt'; attemptId: string }
  | {
      kind: 'decide_approval';
      attemptId: string;
      fence: Fence;
      approvalId: string;
      decision: 'approve' | 'decline';
      reason: string | null;
    }
  | { kind: 'upload_transcript'; attemptId: string } // for attempts that ended lost, when their runner says hello
  | { kind: 'prepare_dependencies'; attemptId: string; fence: Fence; requestId: string }
  | { kind: 'refresh_vault'; taskId: string; refs: string[] } // with a late-work message to the current holder
  | { kind: 'preflight'; vendor: Vendor } // after the hub sets a not-ready mark
  | { kind: 'delete_refs'; refs: { ref: string; expectedSha: string }[] }
  | { kind: 'update_settings'; settings: Partial<Omit<RunnerSettings, 'version'>>; version: number };

export type RunnerCommandKind = RunnerCommand['kind'];

export interface InjectedMessage {
  /**
   * 0: hub text with no message row (the lead's situation report); runners never report it as delivered or
   * acknowledged.
   */
  messageId: number;
  authority: 'person' | 'agent' | 'system';
  /** Formatted and quoted by the hub. */
  text: string;
}

export interface AttemptSpec {
  attemptId: string;
  taskId: string | null;
  role: AgentRole;
  vendor: Vendor;
  /** Null: the runner's models[vendor][role]. */
  model: string | null;
  fence: Fence;
  agentToken: string;
  hubUrl: string;
  repo: { url: string; mainBranch: string };
  /** The task's work position, or main. */
  start: { ref: string; sha: string | null };
  /** 'agflow/T-42-<slug>'; from epoch 2 'agflow/T-42-e2-<slug>'; null for leads. */
  branch: string | null;
  wipRef: string | null;
  /**
   * paths: protected-class patterns with this task's exemptions applied, matched only with core's
   * matchesProtectedPattern. base: 'refs/heads/<mainBranch>', which the runner resolves in its vault (design 7.3);
   * null: the start commit.
   */
  restore: { paths: string[]; base: string | null };
  /** For continuation prompts. */
  acceptanceIds: string[];
  /** Computed by the hub; the runner reports the cap it applied in AttemptFacts.tool.capMs. */
  toolCaps: {
    /** toolCapMs */
    defaultMs: number;
    /** longToolCapMs, for commands matching longPatterns (stall.ts). */
    longMs: number;
    /** Per task check: max(longToolCapMs, timeoutS × 1000 + 10 min). */
    checks: { cmd: string; capMs: number }[];
  };
  /** .agflow/run/task.md, composed by the hub; agent text quoted. */
  taskPack: string;
  /** The static brief (Codex developerInstructions, .agflow/run/brief.md). */
  brief: string;
  firstPrompt: string;
  /** Ask for a restatement first. */
  successor: boolean;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Schemas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** True when A and B are the same type under the compiler's identity check: both ways, optional fields included. */
type Same<A, B> = (<X>() => X extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<X>() => X extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;

/**
 * Pins a schema to the type it parses: its output must be exactly T. A field or a value that only one side has
 * fails the typecheck, so a change to a type cannot leave its schema behind, or the other way round.
 */
function schemaFor<T>() {
  return <S extends z.ZodType<T>>(
    schema: S & (Same<z.output<S>, T> extends true ? unknown : 'differs from its type'),
  ): z.ZodType<T> => schema;
}

/** Times (epoch ms), durations, ages, counts, sizes and seqs. */
const NonNegativeInt = z.number().int().min(0);
const PositiveInt = z.number().int().positive();
/** Utilization, a ceiling or a share of the context window. */
const Fraction = z.number().min(0).max(1);
/** Names, versions and ids; free text such as errors and details may be empty. */
const Name = z.string().min(1);

/** 'T-42-a3', 'T-42-e2-a3', 'lead-a5' or 'lead-e2-a5'. Runners name clones, pins and refs after it. */
export const AttemptIdSchema = z
  .string()
  .refine((id) => parseAttemptId(id) !== null, 'expected an attempt id like T-42-a3, T-42-e2-a3 or lead-a5');
export const RunnerIdSchema = z.string().regex(/^R-\d+$/, 'expected a runner id like R-3');
export const SubmissionIdSchema = z.string().regex(/^S-\d+$/, 'expected a submission id like S-9');
/** '<hubEpoch>-<runnerId>-<seq>', so command ids never repeat across restores. */
export const CommandIdSchema = z.string().regex(/^\d+-R-\d+-\d+$/, 'expected a command id like 1-R-3-17');
/** The first 16 hex of the sha256 of the account identity (email or organisation). */
export const AccountIdSchema = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{16}$/, 'expected an account id of 16 hex digits');
/** A full ref name, such as refs/heads/main or refs/agflow/T-42/a3, under git's rules for names. */
export const RefSchema = BranchSchema.refine((ref) => ref.startsWith('refs/'), 'expected a full ref name under refs/');
/**
 * A sha in full, as runners read it from git. The hub records, compares and fetches by these shas, so an abbreviated
 * one could name another commit, or differ from the same commit written in full. Shas that M1's records may hold
 * abbreviated (start shas, branch heads, adoptable shas) keep CommitShaSchema.
 */
export const FullShaSchema = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/, 'expected a full commit sha of 40 hex digits');
/** 'agt_' and 32 random bytes in base64url (design 6.5). */
const AgentTokenSchema = z.string().regex(/^agt_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/, 'expected an agent token');

export const AttemptPhaseSchema = schemaFor<AttemptPhase>()(
  z.enum(['starting', 'preparing', 'turn', 'idle', 'waiting_approval', 'quota_wait', 'vendor_error', 'stopping']),
);

export const StopCauseSchema = schemaFor<StopCause>()(
  z.enum([
    'stall_silent',
    'stall_hung_tool',
    'stall_loop',
    'stall_no_progress',
    'stall_budget',
    'stop',
    'stop_hold',
    'replace',
    'quota',
    'vendor_error',
    'context',
    'policy',
    'auth',
    'cancel',
    'blocked',
    'impossible',
    'released',
    'takeover',
    'rotation',
    'branch_moved',
  ]),
);

export const FenceSchema = schemaFor<Fence>()(z.strictObject({ epoch: PositiveInt, counter: PositiveInt }));

export const AttemptFactsSchema = schemaFor<AttemptFacts>()(
  z.strictObject({
    attemptId: AttemptIdSchema,
    fence: FenceSchema,
    phase: AttemptPhaseSchema,
    eventAgeMs: NonNegativeInt,
    tool: z
      .strictObject({
        name: Name,
        command: z.string().nullable(),
        long: z.boolean(),
        capMs: PositiveInt.nullable(),
        ageMs: NonNegativeInt,
      })
      .nullable(),
    fsAgeMs: NonNegativeInt.nullable(),
    commitAgeMs: NonNegativeInt.nullable(),
    turns: NonNegativeInt,
    turnsWithoutProgress: NonNegativeInt,
    repeatedCalls: NonNegativeInt,
    continuations: NonNegativeInt,
    vendorErrorMs: NonNegativeInt,
    activeMs: NonNegativeInt,
    contextUsed: Fraction.nullable(),
  }),
);

const CeilingsSchema = z.strictObject({ fiveHour: Fraction, weekly: Fraction });

export const RunnerVendorSchema = schemaFor<RunnerVendor>()(
  z.strictObject({
    vendor: VendorSchema,
    cliVersion: Name.nullable(),
    ownerCliVersion: Name.nullable(),
    ready: z.boolean(),
    problem: z.string().nullable(),
    accountId: AccountIdSchema.nullable(),
    plan: z.string().nullable(),
    managedPolicy: z.boolean(),
    models: z.strictObject({ lead: Name, worker: Name }),
    ceilings: CeilingsSchema,
    allowPaidUsage: z.boolean(),
    degraded: z.boolean(),
    preflightAt: NonNegativeInt.nullable(),
  }),
);

export const VendorQuotaSchema = schemaFor<VendorQuota>()(
  z.strictObject({
    state: z.enum(['ok', 'exhausted', 'unknown']),
    resetsAt: NonNegativeInt.nullable(),
    windows: z.strictObject({ fiveHour: Fraction.nullable(), weekly: Fraction.nullable() }),
    paidUsage: z.enum(['disabled', 'enabled', 'in_use', 'unknown']),
    updatedAt: NonNegativeInt,
  }),
);

export const ProfileSummarySchema = schemaFor<ProfileSummary>()(
  z.strictObject({ name: z.enum(['standard', 'auto']), weakened: z.array(Name), dependencyPrep: z.boolean() }),
);

export const AccountQuotaReportSchema = schemaFor<AccountQuotaReport>()(
  z.strictObject({ vendor: VendorSchema, accountId: AccountIdSchema, quota: VendorQuotaSchema }),
);

// update_settings carries any of these without the version; capacity has the bounds of the Runners card.
const settingsFields = {
  capacity: z.number().int().min(1).max(16),
  keepAwake: z.enum(['off', 'ac', 'always']),
  draining: z.boolean(),
  ceilings: z.partialRecord(VendorSchema, CeilingsSchema),
  allowPaidUsage: z.partialRecord(VendorSchema, z.boolean()),
};

export const RunnerSettingsSchema = schemaFor<RunnerSettings>()(
  z.strictObject({ ...settingsFields, version: NonNegativeInt }),
);

export const LiveAttemptSchema = schemaFor<LiveAttempt>()(
  z.strictObject({
    attemptId: AttemptIdSchema,
    fence: FenceSchema,
    state: z.enum(['starting', 'running', 'idle', 'stopped', 'suspended']),
    sessionRef: Name.nullable(),
    clone: z.boolean(),
  }),
);

export const InjectedMessageSchema = schemaFor<InjectedMessage>()(
  z
    .strictObject({ messageId: NonNegativeInt, authority: z.enum(['person', 'agent', 'system']), text: Name })
    .refine(
      (message) => message.messageId !== 0 || message.authority === 'system',
      'message 0 is hub text with no message row, so its authority is system',
    ),
);

const RestoreSchema = z.strictObject({ paths: z.array(Name), base: RefSchema.nullable() });

/**
 * A lead attempt has a lead attempt id and no task, branch or WIP ref; a worker has all three, and its attempt
 * id names its task. The runner builds clone paths and refs from these, so they must agree.
 */
function idsAgree(spec: Pick<AttemptSpec, 'attemptId' | 'taskId' | 'role' | 'branch' | 'wipRef'>): boolean {
  const lead = spec.role === 'lead';
  return (
    parseAttemptId(spec.attemptId)?.taskId === spec.taskId &&
    [spec.taskId, spec.branch, spec.wipRef].every((value) => (value === null) === lead)
  );
}

export const AttemptSpecSchema = schemaFor<AttemptSpec>()(
  z
    .strictObject({
      attemptId: AttemptIdSchema,
      taskId: TaskIdSchema.nullable(),
      role: RoleSchema,
      vendor: VendorSchema,
      model: Name.nullable(),
      fence: FenceSchema,
      agentToken: AgentTokenSchema,
      hubUrl: z.url({ protocol: /^https?$/, error: 'expected the hub URL, http or https' }),
      // Any remote git accepts: a URL, an scp-like address or a local path.
      repo: z.strictObject({ url: Name, mainBranch: BranchSchema }),
      start: z.strictObject({ ref: RefSchema, sha: CommitShaSchema.nullable() }),
      branch: BranchSchema.nullable(),
      wipRef: RefSchema.nullable(),
      restore: RestoreSchema,
      acceptanceIds: z.array(Name),
      toolCaps: z.strictObject({
        defaultMs: PositiveInt,
        longMs: PositiveInt,
        checks: z.array(z.strictObject({ cmd: Name, capMs: PositiveInt })),
      }),
      taskPack: z.string(),
      brief: z.string(),
      firstPrompt: z.string(),
      successor: z.boolean(),
    })
    .refine(
      idsAgree,
      'a lead attempt has no task, branch or WIP ref; a worker has all three, and its id names its task',
    ),
);

const attemptFields = { attemptId: AttemptIdSchema, fence: FenceSchema };

export const RunnerCommandSchema = schemaFor<RunnerCommand>()(
  z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('start_attempt'), attempt: AttemptSpecSchema }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('resume_attempt'),
      ...attemptFields,
      agentToken: AgentTokenSchema,
      prompt: z.string(),
      messages: z.array(InjectedMessageSchema),
      taskPack: z.string().nullable(),
      restore: RestoreSchema,
      acceptanceIds: z.array(Name),
    }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('deliver'),
      ...attemptFields,
      messages: z.array(InjectedMessageSchema),
      more: NonNegativeInt,
    }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('interrupt'), ...attemptFields }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('stop_attempt'),
      ...attemptFields,
      cause: StopCauseSchema,
      reason: z.string(),
      handoff: z.boolean(),
      interruptFirst: z.boolean(),
      keepClone: z.boolean(),
    }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('hold_attempt'), ...attemptFields }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('push_submission'),
      ...attemptFields,
      submissionId: SubmissionIdSchema,
      branch: BranchSchema,
      expectedBranchSha: CommitShaSchema.nullable(),
      adoptable: z.array(CommitShaSchema),
    }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('prepare_takeover'), ...attemptFields, person: Name }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('hand_back'),
      attemptId: AttemptIdSchema,
      source: z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
        z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('clone') }),
        // A full sha, because the next runner may fetch the ref by it (design 6.12).
        z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('ref'), ref: RefSchema, sha: FullShaSchema }),
      ]),
    }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('cleanup_attempt'), attemptId: AttemptIdSchema }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('decide_approval'),
      ...attemptFields,
      // Minted by the runner as a UUID (design 6.10).
      approvalId: z.uuid(),
      decision: z.enum(['approve', 'decline']),
      reason: z.string().nullable(),
    }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('upload_transcript'), attemptId: AttemptIdSchema }),
    // The request id is the prepare_dependencies command's own id (design 7.7).
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('prepare_dependencies'), ...attemptFields, requestId: CommandIdSchema }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('refresh_vault'), taskId: TaskIdSchema, refs: z.array(RefSchema) }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('preflight'), vendor: VendorSchema }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('delete_refs'),
      // Only refs whose sha the hub recorded from a runner or a ref hand-back are deleted, so each sha is full.
      refs: z.array(z.strictObject({ ref: RefSchema, expectedSha: FullShaSchema })),
    }),
    z.strictObject({
      kind: z.literal('update_settings'),
      settings: z.strictObject(settingsFields).partial(),
      version: PositiveInt,
    }),
  ]),
);

/** The 17 command kinds of protocol 1, in the order of design 6.3. */
export const RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS = [
  'start_attempt',
  'resume_attempt',
  'deliver',
  'interrupt',
  'stop_attempt',
  'hold_attempt',
  'push_submission',
  'prepare_takeover',
  'hand_back',
  'cleanup_attempt',
  'decide_approval',
  'upload_transcript',
  'prepare_dependencies',
  'refresh_vault',
  'preflight',
  'delete_refs',
  'update_settings',
] as const satisfies readonly RunnerCommandKind[];

/** The oldest protocol that understands each command kind. The hub never sends a command to an older runner. */
export const COMMAND_MIN_PROTOCOL: Readonly<Record<RunnerCommandKind, number>> = {
  start_attempt: 1,
  resume_attempt: 1,
  deliver: 1,
  interrupt: 1,
  stop_attempt: 1,
  hold_attempt: 1,
  push_submission: 1,
  prepare_takeover: 1,
  hand_back: 1,
  cleanup_attempt: 1,
  decide_approval: 1,
  upload_transcript: 1,
  prepare_dependencies: 1,
  refresh_vault: 1,
  preflight: 1,
  delete_refs: 1,
  update_settings: 1,
};

const HelloSchema = z
  .strictObject({
    t: z.literal('hello'),
    // Any version parses here. A hello this schema cannot read, such as a newer runner's, still gives its version,
    // key and machine through parseRunnerMessage, so the hub can refuse a version outside its range with 4426
    // either way.
    protocol: PositiveInt,
    runnerKey: Name,
    machineId: Name,
    name: Name,
    agflowVersion: Name,
    platform: Name,
    settings: RunnerSettingsSchema,
    vendors: z.array(RunnerVendorSchema),
    quota: z.array(AccountQuotaReportSchema),
    profile: ProfileSummarySchema,
    git: z.strictObject({ ready: z.boolean(), problem: z.string().nullable(), lastPushAt: NonNegativeInt.nullable() }),
    state: z.enum(['ok', 'crash_loop', 'disk_low']),
    stateDetail: z.string().nullable(),
    outboxEpoch: Name,
    firstSeq: PositiveInt,
    lastSeq: NonNegativeInt,
    lastHubEpoch: PositiveInt.nullable(),
    attempts: z.array(LiveAttemptSchema),
  })
  .refine((hello) => hello.lastSeq >= hello.firstSeq - 1, {
    error: 'lastSeq must be at least firstSeq − 1, which an empty outbox reports',
    path: ['lastSeq'],
  });

// Loose on purpose: an event's attemptId, fence, data and any other key are parseRunnerEvent's to judge, so a bad
// one fails only its own event.
const RawRunnerEventSchema = z.looseObject({ seq: PositiveInt, at: NonNegativeInt, type: Name });

export const RunnerMessageSchema = schemaFor<RunnerMessage>()(
  z.discriminatedUnion('t', [
    HelloSchema,
    z.strictObject({
      t: z.literal('heartbeat'),
      at: NonNegativeInt,
      attempts: z.array(AttemptFactsSchema),
      power: z
        .strictObject({
          source: z.enum(['ac', 'battery', 'unknown']),
          batteryPercent: z.number().min(0).max(100).nullable(),
          lowPowerMode: z.boolean(),
        })
        .nullable(),
      disk: z.strictObject({ freeBytes: NonNegativeInt, agflowBytes: NonNegativeInt }).nullable(),
      acceptingUntil: NonNegativeInt.nullable(),
    }),
    z.strictObject({ t: z.literal('events'), outboxEpoch: Name, events: z.array(RawRunnerEventSchema) }),
    z.strictObject({
      t: z.literal('result'),
      commandId: CommandIdSchema,
      ok: z.boolean(),
      data: z.unknown().optional(),
      error: z.string().optional(),
    }),
  ]),
);

export const HubMessageSchema = schemaFor<HubMessage>()(
  z.discriminatedUnion('t', [
    z.strictObject({
      t: z.literal('welcome'),
      runnerId: RunnerIdSchema,
      hubEpoch: PositiveInt,
      hubTime: NonNegativeInt,
      ackedSeq: NonNegativeInt,
      wipRefPrefix: z
        .string()
        .refine(isValidWipRefPrefix, 'expected a WIP ref prefix: a namespace under refs/ that ends with "/"'),
      stop: z.array(z.strictObject({ attemptId: AttemptIdSchema, reason: z.string() })),
      timings: z.strictObject({
        heartbeatMs: PositiveInt,
        deadLinkMs: PositiveInt,
        handoffMs: PositiveInt,
        wipGraceMs: PositiveInt,
      }),
    }),
    z.strictObject({ t: z.literal('ack'), outboxEpoch: Name, seq: NonNegativeInt }),
    z.strictObject({ t: z.literal('heartbeat_ack'), at: NonNegativeInt, hubTime: NonNegativeInt }),
    z.strictObject({ t: z.literal('command'), id: CommandIdSchema, seq: PositiveInt, command: RunnerCommandSchema }),
  ]),
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Parsing
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** What the parsers give instead of throwing: the value, or an error that says what is wrong and where. */
export type Parsed<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };

/** A runner message the hub cannot read still gives a hello's protocol, key and machine, when it has them. */
export type ParsedRunnerMessage =
  | { ok: true; value: RunnerMessage }
  | { ok: false; error: string; hello: { protocol: number; runnerKey: string; machineId: string } | null };

/** A hub message the runner cannot read still names the command it carried, when it has a valid id. */
export type ParsedHubMessage = { ok: true; value: HubMessage } | { ok: false; error: string; commandId: string | null };

function parseJson(text: string): Parsed<unknown> {
  try {
    return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(text) };
  } catch (error) {
    return { ok: false, error: `not JSON: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}` };
  }
}

function parseWith<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, value: unknown): Parsed<T> {
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(value);
  return parsed.success ? { ok: true, value: parsed.data } : { ok: false, error: z.prettifyError(parsed.error) };
}

// Enough of a hello to refuse it: a newer runner's hello may differ from protocol 1's in anything else.
const HelloEnvelopeSchema = z.looseObject({
  t: z.literal('hello'),
  protocol: PositiveInt,
  runnerKey: Name,
  machineId: Name,
});

/**
 * Reads a runner's message on the hub. Events stay raw: parseRunnerEvent reads each one on its own. A hello the hub
 * cannot read fails with its protocol, key and machine, so the hub can still refuse a version outside its range
 * with 4426 and record the runner as incompatible. If the hub closed the link as a bad first message instead, a
 * newer runner would reconnect forever rather than stop.
 */
export function parseRunnerMessage(text: string): ParsedRunnerMessage {
  const json = parseJson(text);
  if (!json.ok) return { ...json, hello: null };
  const parsed = parseWith(RunnerMessageSchema, json.value);
  if (parsed.ok) return parsed;
  const envelope = HelloEnvelopeSchema.safeParse(json.value);
  if (!envelope.success) return { ...parsed, hello: null };
  const { protocol, runnerKey, machineId } = envelope.data;
  return { ...parsed, hello: { protocol, runnerKey, machineId } };
}

// Enough of a command message to answer it.
const CommandEnvelopeSchema = z.looseObject({ t: z.literal('command'), id: CommandIdSchema });

/**
 * Reads the hub's message on a runner. A command the runner cannot read (an unknown kind, an invalid payload)
 * fails with its id, so the runner can answer it { ok: false, error: 'unsupported' } rather than leave the hub
 * resending it after every welcome.
 */
export function parseHubMessage(text: string): ParsedHubMessage {
  const json = parseJson(text);
  if (!json.ok) return { ...json, commandId: null };
  const parsed = parseWith(HubMessageSchema, json.value);
  if (parsed.ok) return parsed;
  const envelope = CommandEnvelopeSchema.safeParse(json.value);
  return { ...parsed, commandId: envelope.success ? envelope.data.id : null };
}
```

### Task 4: Runner protocol: runner events

Runners report 22 event types (design 6.3, Events). This task adds their data schemas, parsed one event at a time so that an invalid event becomes a reject without failing its batch. It also adds the closed code lists that senders import (X-3): `START_REFUSALS`, `SUBMIT_ERRORS`, `VIOLATION_PHASES`, `EXIT_CAUSES`, `STOPPED_BY`, `VENDOR_OUTCOME_KINDS` and `ACTIVITY_KINDS`. Every sha a runner reports must be a full 40-hex sha, and `attempt.submitted` and `attempt.late_work` refuse data that contradicts itself.

**Files:**
- Modify: `packages/core/src/runner-protocol.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/runner-protocol.test.ts`

```diff
+    expect(parsed.value.events.map((event) => parseRunnerEvent(event).ok)).toEqual([...typed.map(() => true), false]);
+  });
+});
```

```diff
+/**
+ * Reads one event of an events message. The hub applies each event on its own, so an invalid one becomes a
+ * reject and never fails its batch. An unknown type or bad data gives an error that names the type; nothing
+ * throws.
+ */
+export function parseRunnerEvent(event: unknown): Parsed<RunnerEvent> {
+  const type = typeof event === 'object' && event !== null && 'type' in event ? event.type : undefined;
+  if (typeof type !== 'string') return { ok: false, error: 'an event needs a type' };
+  const schema = EVENT_SCHEMA_BY_TYPE.get(type);
+  if (!schema) return { ok: false, error: `unknown event type ${JSON.stringify(type)}` };
+  const parsed = parseWith(schema, event);
+  return parsed.ok ? parsed : { ok: false, error: `${type}: ${parsed.error}` };
+}
```

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

The refinements sit on the events, not inside the data shapes, so `RunnerEventData` keeps plain types that plan M2b builds. zod runs refinements only once the base types are valid, so a malformed event is still a plain reject and never throws.

### Task 5: HTTP API schemas, vendor hints and error codes

This task writes the request and response schemas of every route design 6.16 adds, each pinned to its core type, with X-24's bounds and query forms: list filters as comma lists, the runner PATCH bounds, and a full sha for a hand-back from a ref. It adds the agent error codes of design 6.5, the take-over refusal codes of 6.12, and the optional `TaskContract.vendorHint` of 6.1, which the hub stores with the task. An attempt's id must name its task and number. A task attempt records its agent's role, which may be lead, because M1 lets a live lead claim a task. A transcript tail is at most 64 KB of UTF-8.

```ts
describe('request bodies', () => {
  // One minimal valid body per request schema of design 6.16.
  const bodies: Array<[string, z.ZodType, object]> = [
    ['RunnerPatchInputSchema', RunnerPatchInputSchema, { capacity: 3 }],
    ['RunnerRetireInputSchema', RunnerRetireInputSchema, { runnerKey: 'rk_7d3f0b52' }],
    ['TranscriptInputSchema', TranscriptInputSchema, { tail: 'I added the form.' }],
    ['AgentStopInputSchema', AgentStopInputSchema, { reason: 'wrong approach' }],
    ['AgentReplaceInputSchema', AgentReplaceInputSchema, { reason: 'stuck on the same error' }],
    ['HandbackInputSchema', HandbackInputSchema, { source: 'clone' }],
    ['ApprovalDecisionInputSchema', ApprovalDecisionInputSchema, { decision: 'decline' }],
    ['StaffingInputSchema', StaffingInputSchema, { count: 2, reason: 'two tasks are ready' }],
    ['RunnerSubmitInputSchema', RunnerSubmitInputSchema, { summary: 'The login form validates its fields.' }],
    ['PrepareInputSchema', PrepareInputSchema, {}],
    ['LeadHandoffInputSchema', LeadHandoffInputSchema, { note: 'T-42 waits for review.' }],
    ['ProjectPatchInputSchema', ProjectPatchInputSchema, { runnerLeads: false }],
  ];

  for (const [name, schema, body] of bodies) {
    test(`${name} is strict: it refuses a key it does not know`, () => {
      expect(parses(schema, body)).toBe(true);
      expect(parses(schema, { ...body, bogus: 1 })).toBe(false);
    });
  }

  test("a runner agent's submit body is { summary, evidence } only: the runner pushes, so a branch or headSha is refused", () => {
    expect(RunnerSubmitInputSchema.parse({ summary: 's', evidence: ['bun test: 42 pass'] })).toEqual({
      summary: 's',
      evidence: ['bun test: 42 pass'],
    });
    expect(RunnerSubmitInputSchema.parse({ summary: 's' })).toEqual({ summary: 's', evidence: [] });
    expect(parses(RunnerSubmitInputSchema, { summary: 's', branch: 'agflow/T-42-add-login' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(RunnerSubmitInputSchema, { summary: 's', headSha: sha('d') })).toBe(false);
    // The rest are M1's bounds.
    expect(parses(RunnerSubmitInputSchema, { summary: '' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(RunnerSubmitInputSchema, { summary: 's', evidence: [''] })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a hand-back source is 'clone', or a ref under refs/ with a full 40-hex sha", () => {
    const handBack = (source: unknown) => parses(HandbackInputSchema, { source });
    expect(handBack('clone')).toBe(true);
    expect(handBack({ ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur', sha: sha('e') })).toBe(true);
    expect(HandbackInputSchema.parse({ source: { ref: 'refs/heads/fix', sha: sha('e') } })).toEqual({
      source: { ref: 'refs/heads/fix', sha: sha('e') },
    });
    for (const bad of [
      'ref',
      { kind: 'clone' },
      // The next runner may fetch it by sha, so a short or uppercase one is refused.
      { ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur', sha: 'eeeeeee' },
      { ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur', sha: sha('E') },
      { ref: 'agflow/T-42-add-login', sha: sha('e') },
      { ref: 'refs/agflow/../heads/main', sha: sha('e') },
      { ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur' },
      { sha: sha('e') },
      { ref: 'refs/agflow/T-42/takeover-timur', sha: sha('e'), kind: 'ref' },
    ]) {
      expect([bad, handBack(bad)]).toEqual([bad, false]);
    }
    expect(parses(HandbackInputSchema, {})).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a transcript tail is at most 64 KB of UTF-8', () => {
    expect(TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_MAX_BYTES).toBe(65_536);
    expect(parses(TranscriptInputSchema, { tail: 'x'.repeat(65_536) })).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(TranscriptInputSchema, { tail: 'x'.repeat(65_537) })).toBe(false);
    // Bytes, not characters: '中' takes three, so 21,845 of them are 65,535 bytes and 21,846 are 65,538.
    expect(parses(TranscriptInputSchema, { tail: '中'.repeat(21_845) })).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(TranscriptInputSchema, { tail: '中'.repeat(21_846) })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(TranscriptInputSchema, { tail: '' })).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(TranscriptInputSchema, {})).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a staffing count is a non-negative integer, with an optional vendor and a reason', () => {
    const staffing = (body: object) => parses(StaffingInputSchema, { count: 2, reason: 'ready work', ...body });
    for (const count of [0, 1, 40]) expect([count, staffing({ count })]).toEqual([count, true]);
    for (const count of [-1, 1.5, '2', null]) expect([count, staffing({ count })]).toEqual([count, false]);
    expect(staffing({ vendor: 'codex' })).toBe(true);
    expect(staffing({ vendor: 'gemini' })).toBe(false);
    expect(staffing({ reason: '' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(StaffingInputSchema, { count: 2 })).toBe(false);
  });

  test('RunnerPatchInputSchema takes capacity 1..16, ceilings 0..1 per window and the keepAwake values', () => {
    const patch = (body: object) => parses(RunnerPatchInputSchema, body);
    for (const capacity of [1, 8, 16]) expect([capacity, patch({ capacity })]).toEqual([capacity, true]);
    for (const capacity of [0, 17, 2.5, -1]) expect([capacity, patch({ capacity })]).toEqual([capacity, false]);
    // 0 keeps that vendor off the runner.
    for (const ceilings of [{ claude: { fiveHour: 0, weekly: 1 } }, { codex: { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: 0.85 } }]) {
      expect([ceilings, patch({ ceilings })]).toEqual([ceilings, true]);
    }
    for (const ceilings of [
      { claude: { fiveHour: 1.01, weekly: 0.5 } },
      { claude: { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: -0.1 } },
      { claude: { fiveHour: 0.5 } },
      { claude: { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: 0.5, daily: 0.5 } },
      { gemini: { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: 0.5 } },
    ]) {
      expect([ceilings, patch({ ceilings })]).toEqual([ceilings, false]);
    }
    for (const keepAwake of ['off', 'ac', 'always']) expect([keepAwake, patch({ keepAwake })]).toEqual([keepAwake, true]);
    expect(patch({ keepAwake: 'never' })).toBe(false);
    expect(patch({ draining: true, allowPaidUsage: { codex: true } })).toBe(true);
    expect(patch({ allowPaidUsage: { codex: 'yes' } })).toBe(false);
    // Only the hub assigns versions, and an empty patch changes nothing.
    expect(patch({ capacity: 3, version: 5 })).toBe(false);
    expect(patch({})).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the runner patch is the settings without their version, as the web's patch type is", () => {
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof RunnerPatchInputSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<Partial<Omit<RunnerSettings, 'version'>>>();
    const full = {
      capacity: 2,
      keepAwake: 'always',
      draining: true,
      ceilings: { claude: { fiveHour: 0.7, weekly: 0.9 } },
      allowPaidUsage: { claude: false },
    } as const;
    expect(RunnerPatchInputSchema.parse(full)).toEqual(full);
  });

  test('stopping an agent takes a reason and an optional hold, false unless asked', () => {
    expect(AgentStopInputSchema.parse({ reason: 'wrong approach' })).toEqual({ reason: 'wrong approach', hold: false });
    expect(AgentStopInputSchema.parse({ reason: 'let me look', hold: true })).toEqual({ reason: 'let me look', hold: true });
    expect(parses(AgentStopInputSchema, { reason: '' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AgentStopInputSchema, { reason: 'r', hold: 'yes' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AgentStopInputSchema, { hold: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AgentReplaceInputSchema, { reason: 'r', hold: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AgentReplaceInputSchema, {})).toBe(false);
  });

  test('the other bodies check their values', () => {
    expect(parses(ApprovalDecisionInputSchema, { decision: 'approve' })).toBe(true);
    for (const decision of ['accept', 'approved', 'deny', '']) {
      expect([decision, parses(ApprovalDecisionInputSchema, { decision })]).toEqual([decision, false]);
    }
    expect(parses(ProjectPatchInputSchema, { runnerLeads: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(ProjectPatchInputSchema, {})).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(ProjectPatchInputSchema, { runnerLeads: 'off' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(RunnerRetireInputSchema, { runnerKey: '' })).toBe(false);
    // The token names the attempt, so a preparation request carries nothing.
    expect(parses(PrepareInputSchema, { attemptId: 'T-42-a3' })).toBe(false);
    // A lead handoff has the bounds of a task handoff.
    expect(parses(LeadHandoffInputSchema, { note: 'x'.repeat(16_000) })).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(LeadHandoffInputSchema, { note: 'x'.repeat(16_001) })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(LeadHandoffInputSchema, { note: '' })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('queries', () => {
  test('the attempts query takes a task, a role, a comma-separated status list, a runner and a limit', () => {
    const query = { task: 'T-4', role: 'worker', status: 'starting,running', runner: 'R-1', limit: '50' };
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse(query)).toEqual({
      task: 'T-4',
      role: 'worker',
      status: ['starting', 'running'],
      runner: 'R-1',
      limit: 50,
    });
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse({ status: 'ended' })).toEqual({ status: ['ended'], limit: 200 });
    for (const bad of [
      { status: 'running,bogus' },
      { status: 'running,' },
      { task: 'T-x' },
      { task: 'T-4-a1' },
      { role: 'boss' },
      { runner: 'R-x' },
    ]) {
      expect([bad, parses(AttemptsQuerySchema, bad)]).toEqual([bad, false]);
    }
  });

  test('the attempts limit defaults to 200 and caps at 1000', () => {
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse({})).toEqual({ limit: 200 });
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse({ limit: '1' }).limit).toBe(1);
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse({ limit: '1000' }).limit).toBe(1000);
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse({ limit: '5000' }).limit).toBe(1000);
    for (const limit of ['0', '-3', '2.5', 'many']) {
      expect([limit, parses(AttemptsQuerySchema, { limit })]).toEqual([limit, false]);
    }
  });

  test('the approvals query takes a comma-separated status list', () => {
    expect(ApprovalsQuerySchema.parse({ status: 'pending' })).toEqual({ status: ['pending'] });
    expect(ApprovalsQuerySchema.parse({ status: 'approved,declined,expired,void' })).toEqual({
      status: ['approved', 'declined', 'expired', 'void'],
    });
    expect(ApprovalsQuerySchema.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(parses(ApprovalsQuerySchema, { status: 'open' })).toBe(false);
  });

  test('queries stay loose and, like M1, read an empty parameter as absent', () => {
    expect(AttemptsQuerySchema.parse({ task: '', role: '', status: '', runner: '', limit: '', t: '1' })).toEqual({
      limit: 200,
    });
    expect(ApprovalsQuerySchema.parse({ status: '', t: '1' })).toEqual({});
  });
});

describe('responses', () => {
  test('the value schemas are typed against the core interfaces', () => {
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof RunnerSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<Runner>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof AccountQuotaSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<AccountQuota>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof AttemptSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<Attempt>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof AttemptLogEntrySchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<AttemptLogEntry>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof ApprovalSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<Approval>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof SubmissionRecordSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<SubmissionRecord>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof LeadSeatSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<LeadSeat>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof LeadNoteSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<LeadNote>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof PrepareRequestSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<PrepareRequest>();
    expectTypeOf<z.output<typeof ProjectSchema>>().toEqualTypeOf<Project>();
  });

  // Each route's answer: a fixture of its core type in the route's wrapper.
  const answers: Array<[string, z.ZodType, object]> = [
    ['RunnersResponseSchema', RunnersResponseSchema, { runners: [runner, quietRunner], accounts: [account] }],
    ['RunnerResponseSchema', RunnerResponseSchema, { runner: { ...runner, capacity: 4, settingsVersion: 5 } }],
    ['AttemptsResponseSchema', AttemptsResponseSchema, { attempts: [attempt, takenOver, leadAttempt] }],
    ['AttemptDetailResponseSchema', AttemptDetailResponseSchema, { attempt: takenOver, log: [logEntry] }],
    ['AttemptResponseSchema', AttemptResponseSchema, { attempt: { ...attempt, stopRequested: takenOver.stopRequested } }],
    ['ApprovalsResponseSchema', ApprovalsResponseSchema, { approvals: [approval, declined] }],
    ['ApprovalResponseSchema', ApprovalResponseSchema, { approval: declined }],
    ['StaffingResponseSchema', StaffingResponseSchema, { running: 2, target: 4 }],
    ['SubmissionResponseSchema', SubmissionResponseSchema, { submission }],
    ['PrepareResponseSchema', PrepareResponseSchema, { request: prepareRequest }],
    ['TakeoverResponseSchema', TakeoverResponseSchema, { attemptId: 'T-42-a3' }],
    ['LeadNotesResponseSchema', LeadNotesResponseSchema, { notes: [leadNote] }],
    ['WhoamiResponseSchema', WhoamiResponseSchema, { user: 'timur' }],
    ['OkResponseSchema', OkResponseSchema, { ok: true }],
    // PATCH /api/project answers the project itself.
    ['ProjectSchema', ProjectSchema, project],
  ];

  for (const [name, schema, answer] of answers) {
    test(`${name} parses its answer and refuses a key it does not know`, () => {
      expect(schema.safeParse(answer).data).toEqual(answer);
      expect(parses(schema, { ...answer, bogus: 1 })).toBe(false);
      for (const key of Object.keys(answer)) expect([key, parses(schema, without(answer, key))]).toEqual([key, false]);
    });
  }

  test('the values inside an answer are strict and checked too', () => {
    expect(parses(RunnerSchema, { ...runner, bogus: 1 })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(RunnerSchema, { ...runner, state: 'sleeping' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(RunnerSchema, { ...runner, id: 'runner-1' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(RunnerSchema, { ...runner, git: { ...runner.git, bogus: 1 } })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AttemptSchema, { ...attempt, status: 'paused' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AttemptSchema, { ...attempt, wipSha: 'bbbbbbb' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AttemptSchema, { ...takenOver, takeover: { ...takenOver.takeover, ref: 'takeover-timur' } })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(ApprovalSchema, { ...approval, id: 'approval-1' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(ApprovalSchema, { ...approval, status: 'open' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AttemptLogEntrySchema, { ...logEntry, kind: 'warning' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(AccountQuotaSchema, { ...account, accountId: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(PrepareRequestSchema, { ...prepareRequest, id: 'P-1' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(StaffingResponseSchema, { running: -1, target: 4 })).toBe(false);
    // A refusal is an error status with a code, never a 200 that says ok: false.
    expect(parses(OkResponseSchema, { ok: false })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(ProjectSchema, { ...project, runnerLeads: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(LeadSeatSchema, leadSeat)).toBe(true);
    const empty = { kind: 'none', agentId: null, attemptId: null, runnerId: null, since: null, wakeups: 0, runnerLeads: false };
    expect(parses(LeadSeatSchema, empty)).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(LeadSeatSchema, { ...empty, kind: 'chat' })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("an attempt's id names its task and number; a lead attempt has no task and the role lead", () => {
    expect(parses(AttemptSchema, leadAttempt)).toBe(true);
    // A live lead's claim: a task attempt records its agent's role, and M1 lets a lead claim a task.
    expect(parses(AttemptSchema, { ...attempt, role: 'lead', runnerId: null })).toBe(true);
    for (const bad of [
      { ...attempt, taskId: 'T-41' },
      { ...attempt, number: 4 },
      { ...attempt, id: 'lead-a3', taskId: null },
      { ...leadAttempt, taskId: 'T-42' },
      { ...leadAttempt, role: 'worker' },
      { ...attempt, id: 'T-42' },
    ]) {
      expect([bad.id, bad.taskId, bad.role, parses(AttemptSchema, bad)]).toEqual([bad.id, bad.taskId, bad.role, false]);
    }
  });

  test('approvals, submissions and lead notes name the task of their attempt', () => {
    const leadApproval = { ...approval, attemptId: 'lead-a5', taskId: null, agentId: 'A-9' };
    expect(parses(ApprovalSchema, leadApproval)).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(ApprovalSchema, { ...approval, taskId: 'T-41' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(ApprovalSchema, { ...leadApproval, taskId: 'T-42' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(SubmissionRecordSchema, { ...submission, taskId: 'T-41' })).toBe(false);
    expect(parses(SubmissionRecordSchema, { ...submission, attemptId: 'lead-a5' })).toBe(false);
    // A live lead's notes have no attempt; a runner lead's name its lead attempt.
    expect(parses(LeadNoteSchema, { ...leadNote, attemptId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(parses(LeadNoteSchema, { ...leadNote, attemptId: 'T-42-a3' })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('error codes', () => {
  test("AGENT_ERRORS are design 6.5's refusals of agent tokens, TAKEOVER_REFUSALS design 6.12's 409 codes", () => {
    expect([...AGENT_ERRORS]).toEqual(['attempt_ended', 'attempt_refenced', 'agent_not_allowed']);
    expect([...TAKEOVER_REFUSALS]).toEqual(['runner_offline', 'not_running', 'submission_pending']);
  });
});
```
