```ts
describe('fences and numbers', () => {
  test('a fence carries the hub epoch and a counter that only grows', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    expect(issueFence(ctx)).toEqual({ epoch: 1, counter: 1 });
    expect(issueFence(ctx)).toEqual({ epoch: 1, counter: 2 });
    ctx.db.run('UPDATE project SET epoch = 2');
    expect(issueFence(ctx)).toEqual({ epoch: 2, counter: 3 });
  });

  test('task attempts are numbered per task; lead attempts by the lead seat counter', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const [a, b] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask(), newTask()], 'user:alice');
    expect(nextAttemptNumber(ctx, a.id)).toBe(1);
    liveAttempt(ctx, a.id, 'ended');
    liveAttempt(ctx, a.id, 'ended');
    expect(nextAttemptNumber(ctx, a.id)).toBe(3);
    expect(nextAttemptNumber(ctx, b.id)).toBe(1);
    expect(leadAttempt(ctx).id).toBe('lead-a1');
    ctx.db.run('UPDATE project SET epoch = 2');
    expect(leadAttempt(ctx).id).toBe('lead-e2-a2');
    expect(liveAttempt(ctx, b.id).id).toBe('T-2-e2-a1');
  });

  test('openAttemptOf names the task attempt that has not ended', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice');
    expect(openAttemptOf(ctx, task.id)).toBeNull();
    const first = liveAttempt(ctx, task.id);
    expect(openAttemptOf(ctx, task.id)?.id).toBe(first.id);
    updateAttempt(ctx, first.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'released', endedAt: ctx.now() });
    expect(openAttemptOf(ctx, task.id)).toBeNull();
    // The schema keeps a task to one open attempt.
    const second = liveAttempt(ctx, task.id, 'holding');
    expect(() => liveAttempt(ctx, task.id)).toThrow('UNIQUE');
    expect(openAttemptOf(ctx, task.id)?.id).toBe(second.id);
  });
});

describe('listAttempts', () => {
  test('filters by task, role, status and runner, newest first', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const first = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    clock.advance(1_000);
    const second = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: first.runner.id });
    clock.advance(1_000);
    const other = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { owner: 'bob' });
    clock.advance(1_000);
    const lead = leadAttempt(ctx, other.runner.id, 'holding');
    clock.advance(1_000);
    const live = liveAttempt(ctx, createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice')[0].id, 'quota_wait');
    const ids = (filter: Parameters<typeof listAttempts>[1]) => listAttempts(ctx, filter).map((attempt) => attempt.id);
    expect(ids({})).toEqual([live.id, lead.id, other.attempt.id, second.attempt.id, first.attempt.id]);
    expect(ids({ task: second.task.id })).toEqual([second.attempt.id]);
    expect(ids({ role: 'lead' })).toEqual([lead.id]);
    expect(ids({ status: ['holding', 'quota_wait'] })).toEqual([live.id, lead.id]);
    expect(ids({ runner: first.runner.id })).toEqual([second.attempt.id, first.attempt.id]);
    expect(ids({ runner: other.runner.id, role: 'worker' })).toEqual([other.attempt.id]);
    expect(ids({ limit: 2 })).toEqual([live.id, lead.id]);
  });

  test('attempts that start in the same millisecond keep the order they were created in', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const first = leadAttempt(ctx);
    const second = leadAttempt(ctx);
    expect(listAttempts(ctx).map((attempt) => attempt.id)).toEqual([second.id, first.id]);
  });
});

describe('the attempt log', () => {
  test('entries come back oldest first, and each attempt keeps its newest 500', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const other = leadAttempt(ctx);
    appendAttemptLog(ctx, other.id, 'note', 'kept');
    for (let n = 1; n <= 503; n++) {
      appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'tool', `entry ${n}`);
      clock.advance(1);
    }
    const log = attemptLog(ctx, attempt.id);
    expect(log).toHaveLength(500);
    expect(log[0]).toMatchObject({ attemptId: attempt.id, kind: 'tool', summary: 'entry 4' });
    expect(log.at(-1)?.summary).toBe('entry 503');
    expect(log.at(-1)?.ts).toBe(ctx.now() - 1);
    expect(attemptLog(ctx, other.id).map((entry) => entry.summary)).toEqual(['kept']);
  });

  test('a long summary is clipped', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const attempt = leadAttempt(ctx);
    appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'text', 'x'.repeat(5_000));
    expect(attemptLog(ctx, attempt.id)[0]?.summary).toHaveLength(2_000);
  });
});

describe('runner agents', () => {
  test('a runner agent is active while starting or running, idle in quota_wait or holding, gone once ended', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const { agent, attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    // A runner agent's own last_seen_at does not decide: a laptop asleep for hours still holds its attempt.
    clock.advance(3 * 60 * 60_000);
    const expected: [AttemptStatus, AgentStatus][] = [
      ['starting', 'active'],
      ['running', 'active'],
      ['quota_wait', 'idle'],
      ['holding', 'idle'],
      ['ended', 'gone'],
    ];
    for (const [status, agentStatus] of expected) {
      updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status });
      expect([status, getAgent(ctx, agent.id).status]).toEqual([status, agentStatus]);
      // The list reads the same join.
      expect([status, listAgents(ctx).find((entry) => entry.id === agent.id)?.status]).toEqual([status, agentStatus]);
    }
  });

  test('live agents keep the M1 rule', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const live = addAgent(ctx);
    const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice');
    claimTask(ctx, task.id, live);
    expect(getAgent(ctx, live.id).status).toBe('active');
    clock.advance(3 * 60 * 60_000);
    expect(getAgent(ctx, live.id).status).toBe('gone');
  });
});

describe('attempt counts and subjects', () => {
  test('attemptCount counts every attempt of the task, runner and live alike', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const { task, attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).attemptCount).toBe(1);
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'crashed', failureClass: 'infra', endedAt: ctx.now() });
    liveAttempt(ctx, task.id);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).attemptCount).toBe(2);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).currentAttempt).toBe('T-1-a2');
    expect(search(ctx, task.id).tasks[0]?.attemptCount).toBe(2);
    const [fresh] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice');
    expect(fresh.attemptCount).toBe(0);
  });

  test("an attempt's events take the task id as subject, or the attempt id for a lead attempt", () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    expect(attemptSubject(attempt)).toBe('T-1');
    expect(attemptSubject(leadAttempt(ctx))).toBe('lead-a1');
  });

  test('the task detail lists its attempts newest first', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const { task, attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'stalled', failureClass: 'agent', endedAt: ctx.now() });
    clock.advance(1_000);
    const next = liveAttempt(ctx, task.id);
    expect(getTaskDetail(ctx, task.id).attempts.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([next.id, attempt.id]);
  });
});

describe('addRunnerAttempt', () => {
  test('creates a runner, its agent and a running attempt that holds the task', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const { runner, agent, attempt, task } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { owner: 'bob', vendor: 'codex' });
    expect(runner.id).toBe('R-1');
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT owner, state, capacity FROM runners WHERE id = $id').get({ id: runner.id })).toEqual({
      owner: 'bob',
      state: 'online',
      capacity: 2,
    });
    const info = JSON.parse((ctx.db.query('SELECT info FROM runners').get() as { info: string }).info);
    expect(info.vendors).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ vendor: 'codex', ready: true, accountId: TEST_ACCOUNT_ID })]);
    expect(agent).toMatchObject({
      user: 'bob',
      vendor: 'codex',
      role: 'worker',
      origin: 'runner',
      runnerId: runner.id,
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      currentTask: task.id,
      status: 'active',
    });
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({
      id: 'T-1-a1',
      taskId: task.id,
      agentId: agent.id,
      runnerId: runner.id,
      vendor: 'codex',
      status: 'running',
      wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1',
      leaseExpiresAt: ctx.now() + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs,
    });
    expect(task).toMatchObject({
      status: 'claimed',
      assignee: agent.id,
      currentAttempt: attempt.id,
      branch: 'agflow/T-1-do-the-thing',
      // The runner lease is on the attempt; the M1 task lease stays empty for runner attempts.
      leaseExpiresAt: null,
      attemptCount: 1,
    });
  });

  test('takes an existing task and runner', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const [a, b] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'A' }), newTask({ title: 'B' })], 'user:alice');
    const first = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { taskId: b.id });
    const second = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { taskId: a.id, runnerId: first.runner.id });
    expect(first.task.id).toBe(b.id);
    expect(second.runner.id).toBe(first.runner.id);
    expect(second.attempt).toMatchObject({ id: 'T-1-a1', runnerId: first.runner.id });
    expect((ctx.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM runners').get() as { n: number }).n).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

```diff
+    vendor,
+    cliVersion: null,
+    ownerCliVersion: null,
+    ready: true,
+    problem: 'test mode',
+    accountId: TEST_ACCOUNT_ID,
+    plan: 'test mode',
+    managedPolicy: false,
+    models:
+      vendor === 'claude'
+        ? { lead: 'claude-opus-5-5', worker: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' }
+        : { lead: 'gpt-6.1-sol', worker: 'gpt-6.1-sol' },
+    ceilings: { fiveHour: 0.85, weekly: 0.85 },
+    allowPaidUsage: false,
+    degraded: false,
+    preflightAt: null,

+}

+/**
+ * A runner worker holding a task as if its runner had reported attempt.spawned: an online runner, its agent, and a
+ * running attempt with a fence and a runner lease that is the task's current attempt. It mints no agent token and

+export function addRunnerAttempt(ctx: HubContext, options: RunnerAttemptOptions = {}): RunnerAttempt {
+  const owner = options.owner ?? 'alice';
+  const vendor = options.vendor ?? 'claude';

+  if (!taskId) throw new Error('no task to attempt');

+    if (!runnerId) {

+      runnerId = `R-${seq}`;
+      const info = {
+        agflowVersion: AGFLOW_VERSION,
+        platform: 'darwin-arm64',
+        vendors: [testVendor(vendor)],
+        profile: { name: 'standard', weakened: [], dependencyPrep: true },
+        git: { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: null },
+        power: { source: 'ac', batteryPercent: null, lowPowerMode: false },
+        disk: { freeBytes: 100e9, agflowBytes: 0 },

+      .run({ id: agentId, seq: agentSeq, owner, vendor, label: id, now, runnerId, attemptId: id });

+      taskId,
+      number,
+      role: 'worker',

+      runnerId,
+      vendor,
+      fence,
+      status: 'running',
+      wipRef: wipRef(ctx.config.wipRefPrefix, id),

+    const claimed = move(ctx, emit, task, 'claimed', `agent:${agentId}`, {
+      changes: { assignee: agentId, branch: task.branch ?? taskBranchName(taskId, task.title, fence.epoch) },
+    });
+    setAgentTask(ctx, agentId, taskId);
+    return { runner: { id: runnerId }, agent: getAgent(ctx, agentId), attempt, task: claimed };
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { AttemptDetailResponseSchema, AttemptsResponseSchema, leadAttemptId } from '@agflow/core';
import { appendAttemptLog, insertAttempt, issueFence, nextAttemptNumber, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { addRunnerAttempt } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

type Hub = ReturnType<typeof createTestHub>;

function leadAttempts(hub: Hub, count: number): void {
  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
    const number = nextAttemptNumber(hub.ctx, null);
    const fence = issueFence(hub.ctx);
    insertAttempt(hub.ctx, {
      id: leadAttemptId(number, fence.epoch),
      taskId: null,
      number,
      role: 'lead',
      agentId: 'A-99',
      runnerId: null,
      vendor: 'claude',
      fence,
      status: 'ended',
    });
  }
}

describe('attempt routes', () => {
  test('need a signed-in user', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    expect((await hub.call('GET', '/api/attempts')).status).toBe(401);
    expect((await hub.call('GET', `/api/attempts/${attempt.id}`)).status).toBe(401);
  });

  test('GET /api/attempts lists attempts newest first, with filters', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const first = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    hub.clock.advance(1_000);
    const second = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { owner: 'bob' });
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, second.attempt.id, { status: 'holding' });
    const all = await hub.call('GET', '/api/attempts', { user: 'alice', via: 'web' });
    expect(all.status).toBe(200);
    expect(AttemptsResponseSchema.parse(all.json)).toEqual(all.json);
    expect(all.json.attempts.map((attempt: { id: string }) => attempt.id)).toEqual([second.attempt.id, first.attempt.id]);
    const ids = async (query: string) =>
      (await hub.call('GET', `/api/attempts?${query}`, { user: 'alice' })).json.attempts.map(
        (attempt: { id: string }) => attempt.id,
      );
    expect(await ids(`task=${first.task.id}`)).toEqual([first.attempt.id]);
    expect(await ids(`runner=${second.runner.id}`)).toEqual([second.attempt.id]);
    expect(await ids('status=holding,quota_wait')).toEqual([second.attempt.id]);
    expect(await ids('role=lead')).toEqual([]);
    expect(await ids('limit=1')).toEqual([second.attempt.id]);
    expect(await ids('task=&role=&status=&runner=&limit=')).toEqual([second.attempt.id, first.attempt.id]);
    for (const query of ['status=lost', 'role=boss', 'task=42', 'runner=R-x', 'limit=0', 'limit=two']) {
      expect([query, (await hub.call('GET', `/api/attempts?${query}`, { user: 'alice' })).status]).toEqual([query, 400]);
    }
  });

  test('the limit is 200 by default and 1000 at most', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    leadAttempts(hub, 1001);
    const count = async (query: string) =>
      (await hub.call('GET', `/api/attempts${query}`, { user: 'alice' })).json.attempts.length as number;
    expect(await count('')).toBe(200);
    expect(await count('?limit=5000')).toBe(1000);
  });

  test('GET /api/attempts/:id answers the attempt and its log, or 404', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    appendAttemptLog(hub.ctx, attempt.id, 'tool', 'Bash: bun test');
    hub.clock.advance(1_000);
    appendAttemptLog(hub.ctx, attempt.id, 'turn', 'turn ended');
    const detail = await hub.call('GET', `/api/attempts/${attempt.id}`, { user: 'bob', via: 'web' });
    expect(detail.status).toBe(200);
    expect(AttemptDetailResponseSchema.parse(detail.json)).toEqual(detail.json);
    expect(detail.json.attempt.id).toBe(attempt.id);
    expect(detail.json.log.map((entry: { summary: string }) => entry.summary)).toEqual(['Bash: bun test', 'turn ended']);
    const missing = await hub.call('GET', '/api/attempts/T-9-a1', { user: 'bob' });
    expect(missing.status).toBe(404);
    expect(missing.json).toEqual({ error: 'not_found', message: 'attempt T-9-a1 not found' });
  });

  test('GET /api/tasks/:id lists the task attempts newest first', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { task, attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'crashed', failureClass: 'infra' });
    writeTask(hub.ctx, task.id, { status: 'ready', assignee: null });
    hub.clock.advance(1_000);
    const next = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { taskId: task.id, runnerId: attempt.runnerId ?? undefined });
    const detail = await hub.call('GET', `/api/tasks/${task.id}`, { user: 'alice', via: 'web' });
    expect(detail.json.attempts.map((entry: { id: string }) => entry.id)).toEqual([next.attempt.id, attempt.id]);
    expect(detail.json.task).toMatchObject({ currentAttempt: next.attempt.id, attemptCount: 2 });
  });
});
```

```ts
// The attempt rows (design 6.1, 6.4): reads, inserts and updates, fences, numbers and the per-attempt log. The
// modules that start, stop and end attempts build on it.
import type {
  AgentRole,
  Attempt,
  AttemptEndReason,
  AttemptFacts,
  AttemptLogEntry,
  AttemptPhase,
  AttemptStatus,
  FailureClass,
  Fence,
  Vendor,
} from '@agflow/core';
import type { HubContext } from './context';
import { nextId } from './db';
import { notFound } from './errors';
import { hubEpoch } from './hub-state';
import { writeTask } from './task-store';
import { clip } from './text';

/** A resume after a runner restart or a lead's exit; repeated ones within resumeWindowMs or leadExitWindowMs end it. */
export interface ResumeLogEntry {
  at: number;
  cause: 'runner_restart' | 'lead_exit';
}

export interface AttemptRow {
  id: string;
  task_id: string | null;
  number: number;
  role: AgentRole;
  agent_id: string;
  runner_id: string | null;
  vendor: Vendor;
  model: string | null;
  session_ref: string | null;
  fence_epoch: number;
  fence_counter: number;
  status: AttemptStatus;
  end_reason: AttemptEndReason | null;
  failure_class: FailureClass | null;
  failure_signature: string | null;
  start_ref: string | null;
  start_sha: string | null;
  wip_ref: string | null;
  wip_sha: string | null;
  submitted_sha: string | null;
  resumable: number;
  review_rounds: number;
  wakeups: number;
  active_ms: number;
  resume_log: string | null;
  phase: AttemptPhase | null;
  facts: string | null;
  facts_at: number | null;
  stop_requested: string | null;
  takeover: string | null;
  final_sha: string | null;
  compaction_summary: string | null;
  transcript_tail: string | null;
  lease_expires_at: number | null;
  quota_resets_at: number | null;
  started_at: number;
  ended_at: number | null;
  last_activity_at: number;
}

const parseJson = <T>(text: string | null): T | null => (text === null ? null : (JSON.parse(text) as T));

export function rowToAttempt(row: AttemptRow): Attempt {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    taskId: row.task_id,
    number: row.number,
    role: row.role,
    agentId: row.agent_id,
    runnerId: row.runner_id,
    vendor: row.vendor,
    model: row.model,
    sessionRef: row.session_ref,
    fence: { epoch: row.fence_epoch, counter: row.fence_counter },
    status: row.status,
    endReason: row.end_reason,
    failureClass: row.failure_class,
    failureSignature: row.failure_signature,
    startRef: row.start_ref,
    startSha: row.start_sha,
    wipRef: row.wip_ref,
    wipSha: row.wip_sha,
    submittedSha: row.submitted_sha,
    resumable: row.resumable === 1,
    reviewRounds: row.review_rounds,
    wakeups: row.wakeups,
    activeMs: row.active_ms,
    phase: row.phase,
    facts: parseJson<AttemptFacts>(row.facts),
    stopRequested: parseJson<Attempt['stopRequested']>(row.stop_requested),
    takeover: parseJson<Attempt['takeover']>(row.takeover),
    leaseExpiresAt: row.lease_expires_at,
    quotaResetsAt: row.quota_resets_at,
    startedAt: row.started_at,
    endedAt: row.ended_at,
    lastActivityAt: row.last_activity_at,
  };
}

export function findAttempt(ctx: HubContext, id: string): Attempt | null {
  const row = ctx.db.query('SELECT * FROM attempts WHERE id = $id').get({ id }) as AttemptRow | null;
  return row ? rowToAttempt(row) : null;
}

export function getAttempt(ctx: HubContext, id: string): Attempt {
  const attempt = findAttempt(ctx, id);
  if (!attempt) throw notFound(`attempt ${id}`);
  return attempt;
}

export interface AttemptFilter {
  task?: string | undefined;
  role?: AgentRole | undefined;
  status?: AttemptStatus[] | undefined;
  runner?: string | undefined;
  limit?: number | undefined;
}

/** Newest first: by start, then by insertion for attempts started in the same millisecond. */
export function listAttempts(ctx: HubContext, filter: AttemptFilter = {}): Attempt[] {
  const where: string[] = [];
  const params: Record<string, string | number> = {};
  if (filter.task !== undefined) {
    where.push('task_id = $task');
    params.task = filter.task;
  }
  if (filter.role !== undefined) {
    where.push('role = $role');
    params.role = filter.role;
  }
  if (filter.runner !== undefined) {
    where.push('runner_id = $runner');
    params.runner = filter.runner;
  }
  if (filter.status !== undefined) {
    where.push(`status IN (${filter.status.map((_, index) => `$status${index}`).join(', ') || 'NULL'})`);
    filter.status.forEach((status, index) => {
      params[`status${index}`] = status;
    });
  }
  if (filter.limit !== undefined) params.limit = filter.limit;
  const rows = ctx.db
    .query(
      `SELECT * FROM attempts ${where.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}` : ''}
       ORDER BY started_at DESC, rowid DESC ${filter.limit !== undefined ? 'LIMIT $limit' : ''}`,
    )
    .all(params) as AttemptRow[];
  return rows.map(rowToAttempt);
}

/** The task's attempt that has not ended; the attempts_one_open index allows at most one. */
export function openAttemptOf(ctx: HubContext, taskId: string): Attempt | null {
  const row = ctx.db
    .query("SELECT * FROM attempts WHERE task_id = $taskId AND status != 'ended'")
    .get({ taskId }) as AttemptRow | null;
  return row ? rowToAttempt(row) : null;
}

/** A new fence: the hub epoch and the next value of a counter that never goes back, so a later fence is newer. */
export function issueFence(ctx: HubContext): Fence {
  return { epoch: hubEpoch(ctx), counter: nextId(ctx.db, 'fence') };
}

/**
 * The next attempt number: one past the task's highest, or, for the lead seat (taskId null), the next value of the
 * lead_attempt counter. Call it in the transaction that inserts the attempt.
 */
export function nextAttemptNumber(ctx: HubContext, taskId: string | null): number {
  if (taskId === null) return nextId(ctx.db, 'lead_attempt');
  const row = ctx.db.query('SELECT MAX(number) AS n FROM attempts WHERE task_id = $taskId').get({ taskId }) as {
    n: number | null;
  };
  return (row.n ?? 0) + 1;
}

export interface NewAttempt {
  /** From naming.ts: attemptId(taskId, number, fence.epoch), or leadAttemptId(number, fence.epoch). */
  id: string;
  taskId: string | null;
  number: number;
  role: AgentRole;
  agentId: string;
  runnerId: string | null;
  vendor: Vendor;
  fence: Fence;
  status: AttemptStatus;
  startRef?: string | null | undefined;
  startSha?: string | null | undefined;
  wipRef?: string | null | undefined;
  leaseExpiresAt?: number | null | undefined;
}

/** Inserts the attempt, which becomes its task's current attempt (design 6.4). */
export function insertAttempt(ctx: HubContext, input: NewAttempt): Attempt {
  const now = ctx.now();
  ctx.db
    .query(
      `INSERT INTO attempts (id, task_id, number, role, agent_id, runner_id, vendor, fence_epoch, fence_counter, status,
         start_ref, start_sha, wip_ref, lease_expires_at, started_at, last_activity_at)
       VALUES ($id, $taskId, $number, $role, $agentId, $runnerId, $vendor, $fenceEpoch, $fenceCounter, $status,
         $startRef, $startSha, $wipRef, $leaseExpiresAt, $now, $now)`,
    )
    .run({
      id: input.id,
      taskId: input.taskId,
      number: input.number,
      role: input.role,
      agentId: input.agentId,
      runnerId: input.runnerId,
      vendor: input.vendor,
      fenceEpoch: input.fence.epoch,
      fenceCounter: input.fence.counter,
      status: input.status,
      startRef: input.startRef ?? null,
      startSha: input.startSha ?? null,
      wipRef: input.wipRef ?? null,
      leaseExpiresAt: input.leaseExpiresAt ?? null,
      now,
    });
  if (input.taskId !== null) writeTask(ctx, input.taskId, { currentAttempt: input.id });
  return getAttempt(ctx, input.id);
}

/** Fields an update may change; undefined leaves a field as it is, null clears it. */
export interface AttemptChanges {
  model?: string | null;
  sessionRef?: string | null;
  fence?: Fence;
  status?: AttemptStatus;
  endReason?: AttemptEndReason | null;
  failureClass?: FailureClass | null;
  failureSignature?: string | null;
  startRef?: string | null;
  startSha?: string | null;
  wipRef?: string | null;
  wipSha?: string | null;
  submittedSha?: string | null;
  resumable?: boolean;
  reviewRounds?: number;
  wakeups?: number;
  activeMs?: number;
  resumeLog?: ResumeLogEntry[] | null;
  phase?: AttemptPhase | null;
  facts?: AttemptFacts | null;
  factsAt?: number | null;
  stopRequested?: Attempt['stopRequested'];
  takeover?: Attempt['takeover'];
  finalSha?: string | null;
  compactionSummary?: string | null;
  transcriptTail?: string | null;
  leaseExpiresAt?: number | null;
  quotaResetsAt?: number | null;
  endedAt?: number | null;
  lastActivityAt?: number;
}

const COLUMNS: Record<Exclude<keyof AttemptChanges, 'fence'>, keyof AttemptRow> = {
  model: 'model',
  sessionRef: 'session_ref',
  status: 'status',
  endReason: 'end_reason',
  failureClass: 'failure_class',
  failureSignature: 'failure_signature',
  startRef: 'start_ref',
  startSha: 'start_sha',
  wipRef: 'wip_ref',
  wipSha: 'wip_sha',
  submittedSha: 'submitted_sha',
  resumable: 'resumable',
  reviewRounds: 'review_rounds',
  wakeups: 'wakeups',
  activeMs: 'active_ms',
  resumeLog: 'resume_log',
  phase: 'phase',
  facts: 'facts',
  factsAt: 'facts_at',
  stopRequested: 'stop_requested',
  takeover: 'takeover',
  finalSha: 'final_sha',
  compactionSummary: 'compaction_summary',
  transcriptTail: 'transcript_tail',
  leaseExpiresAt: 'lease_expires_at',
  quotaResetsAt: 'quota_resets_at',
  endedAt: 'ended_at',
  lastActivityAt: 'last_activity_at',
};

const JSON_FIELDS = new Set<keyof AttemptChanges>(['resumeLog', 'facts', 'stopRequested', 'takeover']);

export function updateAttempt(ctx: HubContext, id: string, changes: AttemptChanges): void {
  const sets: string[] = [];
  const params: Record<string, string | number | null> = { id };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(changes) as [keyof AttemptChanges, unknown][]) {
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    if (key === 'fence') {
      const fence = value as Fence;
      sets.push('fence_epoch = $fenceEpoch', 'fence_counter = $fenceCounter');
      params.fenceEpoch = fence.epoch;
      params.fenceCounter = fence.counter;
      continue;
    }
    sets.push(`${COLUMNS[key]} = $${key}`);
    if (JSON_FIELDS.has(key)) params[key] = value === null ? null : JSON.stringify(value);
    else if (typeof value === 'boolean') params[key] = value ? 1 : 0;
    else params[key] = value as string | number | null;
  }
  if (sets.length > 0) ctx.db.query(`UPDATE attempts SET ${sets.join(', ')} WHERE id = $id`).run(params);
}

/** Each attempt keeps its newest entries; older ones go as new ones come (design 6.18). */
const LOG_ENTRIES_KEPT = 500;
const LOG_SUMMARY_MAX = 2_000;

export function appendAttemptLog(
  ctx: HubContext,
  attemptId: string,
  kind: AttemptLogEntry['kind'],
  summary: string,
): void {
  ctx.db
    .query('INSERT INTO attempt_log (attempt_id, ts, kind, summary) VALUES ($attemptId, $ts, $kind, $summary)')
    .run({ attemptId, ts: ctx.now(), kind, summary: clip(summary, LOG_SUMMARY_MAX) });
  ctx.db
    .query(
      `DELETE FROM attempt_log WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId AND id <= (
         SELECT id FROM attempt_log WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET $kept)`,
    )
    .run({ attemptId, kept: LOG_ENTRIES_KEPT });
}

/** The attempt's log, oldest first. */
export function attemptLog(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): AttemptLogEntry[] {
  const rows = ctx.db
    .query('SELECT id, attempt_id, ts, kind, summary FROM attempt_log WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId ORDER BY id')
    .all({ attemptId }) as {
    id: number;
    attempt_id: string;
    ts: number;
    kind: AttemptLogEntry['kind'];
    summary: string;
  }[];
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    attemptId: row.attempt_id,
    ts: row.ts,
    kind: row.kind,
    summary: row.summary,
  }));
}

/** The subject of an attempt's events (design 6.17): its task, or for a lead attempt the attempt itself. */
export function attemptSubject(attempt: Pick<Attempt, 'id' | 'taskId'>): string {
  return attempt.taskId ?? attempt.id;
}
```

```ts
import { AttemptsQuerySchema } from '@agflow/core';
import { attemptLog, getAttempt, listAttempts } from '../attempt-store';
import type { HubContext } from '../context';
import type { App } from './app';
import { principal, readQuery } from './util';

export function mountAttemptRoutes(app: App, ctx: HubContext): void {
  app.get('/api/attempts', (c) => {
    principal(c);
    const query = readQuery(c, AttemptsQuerySchema);
    return c.json({
      attempts: listAttempts(ctx, {
        task: query.task,
        role: query.role,
        status: query.status,
        runner: query.runner,
        limit: query.limit,
      }),
    });
  });

  app.get('/api/attempts/:id', (c) => {
    principal(c);
    const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, c.req.param('id'));
    return c.json({ attempt, log: attemptLog(ctx, attempt.id) });
  });
}
```

`insertAttempt` also sets `tasks.current_attempt`, so the rule "the newest attempt is current, and it changes only when one is created" (design 6.4) holds in one place. The caller builds the attempt's id with `attemptId` or `leadAttemptId`, because the WIP ref needs it before the insert.

### Task 15: Agent tokens, agent principals and the holder test

Runner agents authenticate with `agt_` tokens minted per attempt and fence (design 6.5), resolved to an `agent` principal. An invalid token gets 401 `attempt_ended` with `{ error, message, reason }` (X-19), or `attempt_refenced`, which also covers an unknown token just after a restore (X-1). The M1 agent header is refused with an agent token. Task routes apply the holder test of design 6.4, invariant (a): the agent's attempt is open and is the task's current attempt.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { BRIDGE_ANSWERS } from '@agflow/core';
import { issueFence, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import {
  SESSION_TTL,
  createSession,
  hashToken,
  mintAgentToken,
  resolveAgentToken,
  revokeAgentTokens,
  sessionHashOf,
  slideSession,
} from '../src/auth';
import { tx } from '../src/context';
import { getAgent } from '../src/agents';
import { HubError } from '../src/errors';
import { updateHubState } from '../src/hub-state';
import { resolvePrincipal } from '../src/http/app';
import { sendMessage, unreadFor } from '../src/messages';
import { getTask, listTaskNotes, move, writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { reportProgress, submitTask } from '../src/tasks';
import { addAgent, addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

type Hub = ReturnType<typeof createTestHub>;

const bearer = (token: string) => ({ headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });

/** A request with an agent token, the way the bridge sends one. */
async function withToken(hub: Hub, token: string, method: string, path: string, body?: unknown) {
  return hub.call(method, path, { ...bearer(token), body });
}

function refusal(error: () => unknown): HubError {
  try {
    error();
  } catch (caught) {
    if (caught instanceof HubError) return caught;
    throw caught;
  }
  throw new Error('expected a refusal');
}

describe('agent tokens', () => {
  test('a token is agt_ and 43 base64url characters, and only its sha256 is stored', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const { attempt, agent } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(ctx, attempt);
    expect(token).toMatch(/^agt_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
    const rows = ctx.db.query('SELECT * FROM agent_tokens').all();
    expect(rows).toEqual([
      {
        token_hash: hashToken(token),
        agent_id: agent.id,
        attempt_id: attempt.id,
        fence_epoch: attempt.fence.epoch,
        fence_counter: attempt.fence.counter,
        created_at: ctx.now(),
        revoked_at: null,
      },
    ]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(rows)).not.toContain(token.slice(4));
  });

  test('a valid token resolves to the runner owner, via agent, and several tokens of one fence all work', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { attempt, agent } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { owner: 'bob' });
    const first = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt);
    const second = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt);
    expect(first).not.toBe(second);
    const grant = resolveAgentToken(hub.ctx, first);
    expect(grant.user).toBe('bob');
    expect(grant.agent.id).toBe(agent.id);
    expect(grant.attempt.id).toBe(attempt.id);
    expect(resolvePrincipal(hub.ctx, `Bearer ${second}`, undefined, undefined)).toMatchObject({
      user: 'bob',
      via: 'agent',
      agent: { id: agent.id, origin: 'runner' },
      token: second,
    });
    for (const token of [first, second]) {
      const me = await withToken(hub, token, 'GET', '/api/me');
      expect(me.status).toBe(200);
      expect(me.json).toMatchObject({ user: 'bob', via: 'agent', agent: { id: agent.id } });
    }
  });

  test('revoked tokens, ended attempts, older fences and unknown tokens get 401 attempt_ended with the reason', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const ended = (reason: string | null) => ({
      error: 'attempt_ended',
      message: BRIDGE_ANSWERS.attemptEnded(reason),
      reason,
    });

    const revoked = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const revokedToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, revoked.attempt);
    revokeAgentTokens(hub.ctx, revoked.attempt.id);
    const revokedAnswer = await withToken(hub, revokedToken, 'GET', '/api/tasks');
    expect([revokedAnswer.status, revokedAnswer.json]).toEqual([401, ended(null)]);

    const finished = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const finishedToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, finished.attempt);
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, finished.attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'stopped', endedAt: hub.ctx.now() });
    const finishedAnswer = await withToken(hub, finishedToken, 'GET', '/api/tasks');
    expect([finishedAnswer.status, finishedAnswer.json]).toEqual([401, ended('stopped')]);

    const refenced = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const oldToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, refenced.attempt);
    const fence = issueFence(hub.ctx);
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, refenced.attempt.id, { fence });
    const oldAnswer = await withToken(hub, oldToken, 'GET', '/api/tasks');
    expect([oldAnswer.status, oldAnswer.json]).toEqual([401, ended(null)]);
    const newToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, { ...refenced.attempt, fence });
    expect((await withToken(hub, newToken, 'GET', '/api/tasks')).status).toBe(200);

    const unknown = await withToken(hub, `agt_${'A'.repeat(43)}`, 'GET', '/api/tasks');
    expect([unknown.status, unknown.json]).toEqual([401, ended(null)]);

    // An owner who leaves the allowlist takes the runner's agents along, with an answer the bridge knows.
    const removed = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { owner: 'bob' });
    const removedToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, removed.attempt);
    expect((await withToken(hub, removedToken, 'GET', '/api/tasks')).status).toBe(200);
    hub.ctx.config.allowedUsers = ['alice'];
    const removedAnswer = await withToken(hub, removedToken, 'GET', '/api/tasks');
    expect([removedAnswer.status, removedAnswer.json]).toEqual([401, ended(null)]);
  });

  test('an older epoch on an open attempt gets 401 attempt_refenced', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt);
    hub.ctx.db.run('UPDATE project SET epoch = 2');
    const answer = await withToken(hub, token, 'GET', '/api/tasks');
    expect([answer.status, answer.json]).toEqual([
      401,
      { error: 'attempt_refenced', message: BRIDGE_ANSWERS.attemptRefenced },
    ]);
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'superseded' });
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'GET', '/api/tasks')).json.error).toBe('attempt_ended');
  });

  test('an unknown agt_ token gets attempt_refenced while the restore is less than runnerLeaseMs old', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const unknown = `agt_${'B'.repeat(43)}`;
    updateHubState(ctx, { restoredAt: ctx.now() });
    expect(refusal(() => resolveAgentToken(ctx, unknown)).code).toBe('attempt_refenced');
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs - 1);
    expect(refusal(() => resolveAgentToken(ctx, unknown)).code).toBe('attempt_refenced');
    clock.advance(1);
    const ended = refusal(() => resolveAgentToken(ctx, unknown));
    expect([ended.status, ended.code, ended.extra]).toEqual([401, 'attempt_ended', { reason: null }]);
  });

  test('an agt_ bearer is never looked up as a session', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const token = `agt_${'C'.repeat(43)}`;
    ctx.db
      .query("INSERT INTO sessions (token_hash, login, kind, created_at, expires_at) VALUES ($hash, 'alice', 'cli', 0, $expires)")
      .run({ hash: hashToken(token), expires: ctx.now() + SESSION_TTL.cli });
    expect(refusal(() => resolvePrincipal(ctx, `Bearer ${token}`, undefined, undefined)).code).toBe('attempt_ended');
  });

  test('X-Agflow-Agent is refused with an agent token, and with a CLI token naming a runner agent', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { attempt, agent } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt);
    const live = addAgent(hub.ctx, 'alice');
    const named = await hub.call('GET', '/api/tasks', { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, agent: live.id });
    expect([named.status, named.json.error]).toEqual([403, 'agent_not_allowed']);
    const impersonated = await hub.call('GET', '/api/tasks', { user: 'alice', via: 'cli', agent: agent.id });
    expect([impersonated.status, impersonated.json.error]).toEqual([403, 'forbidden']);
    expect((await hub.call('GET', '/api/tasks', { user: 'alice', via: 'cli', agent: live.id })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("the owner's CLI token cannot use a runner agent's session id on the live hook routes", async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { agent, task } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    hub.ctx.db.query("UPDATE agents SET session_id = 'runner-session' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: agent.id });
    const message = sendMessage(hub.ctx, { from: 'user:bob', to: `agent:${agent.id}`, body: 'for the runner agent' });
    const session = 'vendor=claude&sessionId=runner-session';
    for (const [method, path, body] of [
      ['GET', `/api/live/inbox?${session}`, undefined],
      ['GET', `/api/live/peek?${session}`, undefined],
      ['POST', '/api/live/stop-check', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'runner-session', stopHookActive: false }],
    ] as const) {
      const answer = await hub.call(method, path, { user: 'alice', body });
      expect([path, answer.status, answer.json.message]).toEqual([path, 409, 'this session belongs to a runner agent']);
    }
    expect(unreadFor(hub.ctx, getAgent(hub.ctx, agent.id)).map((unread) => unread.id)).toEqual([message.id]);
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, task.id).leaseExpiresAt).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('the holder test for agent tokens', () => {
  function setup() {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const held = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, held.attempt);
    return { hub, held, token, path: (action: string) => `/api/tasks/${held.task.id}/${action}` };
  }

  test('progress and handoff need the current attempt, and carry its id into the notes', async () => {
    const { hub, held, token, path } = setup();
    const progress = await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('progress'), { note: 'tests pass' });
    expect(progress.status).toBe(200);
    expect(progress.json.task).toMatchObject({ status: 'working', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('handoff'), { note: 'next: docs' })).status).toBe(200);
    expect(listTaskNotes(hub.ctx, held.task.id).map((note) => [note.kind, note.attemptId])).toEqual([
      ['progress', held.attempt.id],
      ['handoff', held.attempt.id],
    ]);
  });

  test('progress and handoff work in any task status; submit, block, impossible and release need claimed or working', async () => {
    const { hub, held, token, path } = setup();
    tx(hub.ctx, (emit) =>
      move(hub.ctx, emit, getTask(hub.ctx, held.task.id), 'blocked', 'user:alice', {
        changes: { blockedKind: 'paused', blockedReason: 'held by a person' },
      }),
    );
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('progress'), { note: 'still here' })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('handoff'), { note: 'stopping' })).status).toBe(200);
    for (const [action, body] of [
      ['submit', { summary: 'done', evidence: [] }],
      ['block', { reason: 'stuck' }],
      ['impossible', { evidence: 'cannot' }],
      ['release', { reason: 'bye' }],
    ] as const) {
      const answer = await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path(action), body);
      expect([action, answer.status]).toEqual([action, 409]);
    }
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, held.task.id).status).toBe('blocked');
  });

  test('an ended attempt holds nothing, even for a caller that passes no token', () => {
    const { hub, held } = setup();
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'lost', endedAt: hub.ctx.now() });
    expect(() => reportProgress(hub.ctx, held.task.id, held.agent, 'late')).toThrow(`you do not hold ${held.task.id}`);
  });

  test('the token is checked again once the body has arrived, so a re-fence meanwhile refuses the action', async () => {
    const { hub, held, token, path } = setup();
    const send = (action: string, body: unknown, meanwhile: () => void) => {
      // The stream gives its body only when the route reads it, after the middleware has resolved the token.
      const stream = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>(
        {
          pull(controller) {
            meanwhile();
            controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(body)));
            controller.close();
          },
        },
        { highWaterMark: 0 },
      );
      return hub.app.request(path(action), {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: stream,
      });
    };
    const refenced = await send('progress', { note: 'superseded' }, () => {
      revokeAgentTokens(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id);
      updateAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id, { fence: issueFence(hub.ctx) });
    });
    expect([refenced.status, ((await refenced.json()) as { error: string }).error]).toEqual([401, 'attempt_ended']);
    expect(listTaskNotes(hub.ctx, held.task.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, held.task.id).status).toBe('claimed');
    // A direct call with the stale token is refused the same way.
    expect(refusal(() => submitTask(hub.ctx, held.task.id, held.agent, { summary: 'x', evidence: [] }, token)).code).toBe(
      'attempt_ended',
    );
  });

  test('a recorded stop refuses submit, block, impossible and release but not progress or handoff', async () => {
    const { hub, held, token, path } = setup();
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id, {
      stopRequested: { cause: 'stop', reason: 'a person stopped it', by: 'user:alice', handoff: true, deferred: false, at: 0 },
    });
    for (const [action, body] of [
      ['submit', { summary: 'done', evidence: [] }],
      ['block', { reason: 'stuck' }],
      ['impossible', { evidence: 'cannot' }],
      ['release', { reason: 'bye' }],
    ] as const) {
      const answer = await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path(action), body);
      expect([action, answer.status, answer.json.message]).toEqual([action, 409, expect.stringContaining('being stopped')]);
    }
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('progress'), { note: 'wrapping up' })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('handoff'), { note: 'handoff' })).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test('a claimed task lets its current attempt submit, and no other attempt act on it', async () => {
    const { hub, held, token, path } = setup();
    const other = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    const otherToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, other.attempt);
    const foreign = await withToken(hub, otherToken, 'POST', path('progress'), { note: 'not mine' });
    expect([foreign.status, foreign.json.message]).toEqual([403, `you do not hold ${held.task.id}`]);
    writeTask(hub.ctx, held.task.id, { currentAttempt: other.attempt.id });
    expect((await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('handoff'), { note: 'x' })).status).toBe(403);
    writeTask(hub.ctx, held.task.id, { currentAttempt: held.attempt.id });
    const submitted = await withToken(hub, token, 'POST', path('submit'), { summary: 'done', evidence: ['bun test'] });
    expect([submitted.status, submitted.json.task.status]).toEqual([200, 'submitted']);
  });
});

describe('CLI sessions', () => {
  test('slideSession moves a CLI session expiry forward by the CLI TTL, and never a web session', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const cli = createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli');
    const web = createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'web');
    const expiry = (token: string) =>
      (ctx.db.query('SELECT expires_at FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $hash').get({ hash: sessionHashOf(token) }) as {
        expires_at: number;
      } | null)?.expires_at;
    expect(sessionHashOf(cli)).toBe(hashToken(cli));
    // The web session is still valid here, so only its kind keeps it from sliding.
    clock.advance(24 * 60 * 60_000);
    const webExpiry = expiry(web);
    expect(slideSession(ctx, sessionHashOf(web))).toBe(false);
    expect(expiry(web)).toBe(webExpiry);
    clock.advance(29 * 24 * 60 * 60_000);
    expect(slideSession(ctx, sessionHashOf(cli))).toBe(true);
    expect(expiry(cli)).toBe(ctx.now() + SESSION_TTL.cli);
    clock.advance(SESSION_TTL.cli);
    expect(slideSession(ctx, sessionHashOf(cli))).toBe(false);
    expect(slideSession(ctx, hashToken('unknown'))).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```diff
+ * (design 6.3). False when no unexpired CLI session has this hash.

+export function slideSession(ctx: HubContext, sessionHash: string): boolean {
+  const now = ctx.now();
+  const result = ctx.db
+    .query("UPDATE sessions SET expires_at = $expires WHERE token_hash = $hash AND kind = 'cli' AND expires_at > $now")
+    .run({ hash: sessionHash, now, expires: now + SESSION_TTL.cli });
+  return result.changes > 0;

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Agent tokens (design 6.5)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+export const AGENT_TOKEN_PREFIX = 'agt_';
+
+export function isAgentToken(token: string): boolean {
+  return token.startsWith(AGENT_TOKEN_PREFIX);
+}
+
+/**
+ * A new token for the attempt at the given fence: 'agt_' and 32 random bytes in base64url. Only its hash is stored;
+ * the raw token goes into a wire command and nowhere else.
+ */
+export function mintAgentToken(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Pick<Attempt, 'id' | 'agentId' | 'fence'>): string {
+  const token = `${AGENT_TOKEN_PREFIX}${randomToken(32)}`;
+  ctx.db
+    .query(
+      `INSERT INTO agent_tokens (token_hash, agent_id, attempt_id, fence_epoch, fence_counter, created_at)
+       VALUES ($hash, $agentId, $attemptId, $fenceEpoch, $fenceCounter, $now)`,
+    )
+    .run({
+      hash: hashToken(token),
+      agentId: attempt.agentId,
+      attemptId: attempt.id,
+      fenceEpoch: attempt.fence.epoch,
+      fenceCounter: attempt.fence.counter,
+      now: ctx.now(),
+    });

+}
+
+/** Every token of the attempt stops working: it ended, got a new fence, or the epoch changed. */
+export function revokeAgentTokens(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): void {
+  ctx.db
+    .query('UPDATE agent_tokens SET revoked_at = $now WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId AND revoked_at IS NULL')
+    .run({ attemptId, now: ctx.now() });
+}
+
+export interface AgentGrant {
+  /** The runner's owner, whose user the runner agent belongs to. */
+  user: string;
+  agent: Agent;
+  attempt: Attempt;
+}
+
+interface AgentTokenRow {
+  agent_id: string;
+  attempt_id: string;
+  fence_epoch: number;
+  fence_counter: number;
+  revoked_at: number | null;
+}

+/**
+ * The agent a token acts for. Valid means not revoked, the attempt not ended, and the token's fence the attempt's
+ * current one, at the current hub epoch. Otherwise it throws 401 attempt_refenced when a restore is about to give the
+ * attempt a new fence, and 401 attempt_ended for every other fault.
+ */
+export function resolveAgentToken(ctx: HubContext, token: string): AgentGrant {
+  const row = ctx.db
+    .query('SELECT agent_id, attempt_id, fence_epoch, fence_counter, revoked_at FROM agent_tokens WHERE token_hash = $hash')
+    .get({ hash: hashToken(token) }) as AgentTokenRow | null;
+  if (!row) {

+    const { restoredAt } = getHubState(ctx);

+  const attempt = findAttempt(ctx, row.attempt_id);
+  if (!attempt || attempt.status === 'ended') throw attemptEnded(attempt?.endReason ?? null);
+  const fence = { epoch: row.fence_epoch, counter: row.fence_counter };
+  if (row.revoked_at !== null || !fenceEquals(fence, attempt.fence)) throw attemptEnded(null);
+  // The token's only fault is the epoch, so the attempt is waiting for its re-fence after a restore.
+  if (fence.epoch !== hubEpoch(ctx)) throw attemptRefenced();

+  // the bridge knows (design 6.5), so the agent is told to stop.
+  if (!isAllowed(ctx, agent.user)) throw attemptEnded(null);
+  return { user: agent.user, agent, attempt };
```

### Task 16: The agent-token route allowlist

Agent tokens may reach only the routes their bridge calls (design 6.5, Route allowlist). This task writes the table in `http/agent-routes-allowed.ts`, the design's whole list including routes later tasks mount, and a middleware that answers 403 `agent_not_allowed` everywhere else. The check runs in the principal middleware, before any route, so a route added later is refused unless it joins the table. The test walks every mounted route (design 15, security tests).

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mintAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { AGENT_ROUTES, isAgentRouteAllowed } from '../src/http/agent-routes-allowed';
import { addRunnerAttempt } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

/** Design 6.5's table of the routes an agent token may use, written out so that a wider allowlist fails here. */
const DESIGN_TABLE = [
  'GET /api/brief',
  'GET /api/goal',
  'GET /api/status',
  'GET /api/search',
  'GET /api/events',
  'GET /api/tasks',
  'GET /api/tasks/:id',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/progress',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/handoff',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/submit',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/block',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/impossible',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/release',
  'GET /api/submissions/:id',
  'POST /api/prepare',
  'GET /api/prepare/:id',
  'POST /api/inbox',
  'POST /api/inbox/ack',
  'POST /api/messages',
  'POST /api/tasks',
  'PATCH /api/tasks/:id',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/cancel',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/accept',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/reject',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/unblock',
  'POST /api/tasks/:id/merged',
  'POST /api/goal/notes',
  'POST /api/staffing',
  'POST /api/agents/:id/stop',
  'POST /api/agents/:id/replace',
  'POST /api/lead/handoff',
  'GET /api/lead/notes',
];

/** A path that the route pattern matches: each parameter becomes a sample segment, a wildcard a sample page. */
function concrete(pattern: string): string {
  return pattern.replace(/:[A-Za-z]+/g, 'T-1').replace(/\/\*$/, '/some/page');
}

describe('the agent-token route allowlist', () => {
  test("the allowlist is exactly design 6.5's table", () => {
    expect(DESIGN_TABLE).toHaveLength(32);
    expect(AGENT_ROUTES.map((route) => `${route.method} ${route.path}`).sort()).toEqual([...DESIGN_TABLE].sort());
  });

  test('every mounted route matches an allowlist entry or answers an agent token 403 agent_not_allowed', async () => {
    // A web build directory mounts the static catch-all too, so the walk covers every route the hub can have.
    const hub = createTestHub({ webDist: '/nonexistent/agflow-web-dist' });
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt);
    const routes = hub.app.routes.filter((route) => route.method !== 'ALL');
    expect(routes.length).toBeGreaterThan(40);
    const refused: string[] = [];
    for (const route of routes) {
      const path = concrete(route.path);
      const answer = await hub.call(route.method, path, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, body: {} });
      const label = `${route.method} ${route.path}`;
      // HEAD is answered by the GET route of the same path.
      const listed = DESIGN_TABLE.includes(`${route.method === 'HEAD' ? 'GET' : route.method} ${route.path}`);
      expect([label, isAgentRouteAllowed(route.method, path)]).toEqual([label, listed]);
      if (listed) {
        expect([label, answer.json?.error]).not.toEqual([label, 'agent_not_allowed']);
      } else {
        expect([label, answer.status, answer.json?.error]).toEqual([label, 403, 'agent_not_allowed']);
        refused.push(label);
      }
    }
    expect(refused).toContain('GET /api/attempts');
    expect(refused).toContain('GET /*');
  });

  test('live, CLI sign-in, agent list, claim and resume-claim refuse agent tokens; the reads are allowed', () => {
    const refused: [string, string][] = [
      ['POST', '/api/live/session-start'],

      ['POST', '/api/tasks/T-1/release-claim'],

      ['GET', '/api/runners'],

      ['POST', '/api/tasks/T-1/takeover'],

      ['POST', '/api/project/pause'],
      ['DELETE', '/api/rules/1'],
      ['GET', '/api/events/stream'],

    for (const [method, path] of refused) expect([method, path, isAgentRouteAllowed(method, path)]).toEqual([method, path, false]);
    const reads: [string, string][] = [

      ['GET', '/api/goal'],
      ['GET', '/api/status'],

  test('holder and lead routes carry their access rule', () => {
    const access = (method: string, path: string) =>
      AGENT_ROUTES.find((route) => route.method === method && route.path === path)?.access;
    for (const action of ['progress', 'handoff', 'submit', 'block', 'impossible', 'release']) {

      ['POST', '/api/tasks/:id/reject'],

      ['POST', '/api/staffing'],

      ['POST', '/api/agents/:id/replace'],
      ['POST', '/api/lead/handoff'],
      ['GET', '/api/lead/notes'],
    ];
    for (const [method, path] of lead) expect([method, path, access(method, path)]).toEqual([method, path, 'lead']);
    expect(access('GET', '/api/tasks')).toBe('read');
    expect(access('GET', '/api/submissions/:id')).toBe('own');
    expect(access('POST', '/api/inbox')).toBe('self');
    expect(new Set(AGENT_ROUTES.map((route) => `${route.method} ${route.path}`)).size).toBe(AGENT_ROUTES.length);
  });

  test('a path parameter matches one segment only', () => {
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('GET', '/api/tasks/T-1')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('GET', '/api/tasks/T-1/notes')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('GET', '/api/tasks/')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('POST', '/api/tasks/T-1/progress')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('POST', '/api/tasks/T-1/x/progress')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('POST', '/api/tasks/progress')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('POST', '/api/agents/A-1/stop')).toBe(true);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('POST', '/api/agents/A-1/interrupt')).toBe(false);
    expect(isAgentRouteAllowed('GET', '/api/tasks/T-1/progress')).toBe(false);
  });

  test('an agent token gets 403 agent_not_allowed before the route runs, and the allowed routes still answer it', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const held = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, held.attempt);
    const auth = { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } };
    const agents = await hub.call('GET', '/api/agents', auth);
    expect([agents.status, agents.json.error]).toEqual([403, 'agent_not_allowed']);
    const claim = await hub.call('POST', `/api/tasks/${held.task.id}/claim`, { ...auth, body: {} });
    expect([claim.status, claim.json.error]).toEqual([403, 'agent_not_allowed']);
    expect((await hub.call('GET', `/api/tasks/${held.task.id}`, auth)).status).toBe(200);
    const progress = await hub.call('POST', `/api/tasks/${held.task.id}/progress`, { ...auth, body: { note: 'ok' } });
    expect(progress.status).toBe(200);
    // People and live agents are not affected.
    expect((await hub.call('GET', '/api/agents', { user: 'alice' })).status).toBe(200);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The only routes a runner agent's token may use (design 6.5): the ones its bridge calls. Every other route answers
// 403 agent_not_allowed, whatever it is or whenever it was added, because the check runs before any route.

/**
 * What the route asks of the agent beyond its token; the route's handler enforces it.
 * - read: any agent may read.
 * - self: it acts on the calling agent's own brief, inbox and messages.
 * - holder: the holder test (requireHolder in tasks.ts).
 * - own: only records of the agent's own attempt.
 * - lead: only while the agent holds the lead seat (design 6.11).
 */
export type AgentRouteAccess = 'read' | 'self' | 'holder' | 'own' | 'lead';

export interface AgentRoute {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH';
  /** A Hono pattern; a ':name' parameter matches exactly one path segment. */
  path: string;
  access: AgentRouteAccess;
}

const HOLDER_ACTIONS = ['progress', 'handoff', 'submit', 'block', 'impossible', 'release'];
const LEAD_TASK_ACTIONS = ['cancel', 'accept', 'reject', 'unblock', 'merged'];

export const AGENT_ROUTES: readonly AgentRoute[] = [
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/brief', access: 'self' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/goal', access: 'read' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/status', access: 'read' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/search', access: 'read' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/events', access: 'read' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/tasks', access: 'read' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/tasks/:id', access: 'read' },
  ...HOLDER_ACTIONS.map((action): AgentRoute => ({ method: 'POST', path: `/api/tasks/:id/${action}`, access: 'holder' })),
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/submissions/:id', access: 'own' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/prepare', access: 'own' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/prepare/:id', access: 'own' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/inbox', access: 'self' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/inbox/ack', access: 'self' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/messages', access: 'self' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/tasks', access: 'lead' },
  { method: 'PATCH', path: '/api/tasks/:id', access: 'lead' },
  ...LEAD_TASK_ACTIONS.map((action): AgentRoute => ({ method: 'POST', path: `/api/tasks/:id/${action}`, access: 'lead' })),
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/goal/notes', access: 'lead' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/staffing', access: 'lead' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/agents/:id/stop', access: 'lead' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/agents/:id/replace', access: 'lead' },
  { method: 'POST', path: '/api/lead/handoff', access: 'lead' },
  { method: 'GET', path: '/api/lead/notes', access: 'lead' },
];

const segments = (path: string): string[] => path.split('/');

const COMPILED = AGENT_ROUTES.map((route) => ({ route, segments: segments(route.path) }));

function matches(pattern: string[], path: string[]): boolean {
  if (pattern.length !== path.length) return false;
  return pattern.every((part, index) => {
    const actual = path[index] as string;
    return part.startsWith(':') ? actual !== '' : part === actual;
  });
}

/** The allowlist entry for a request, matched like the router matches it; HEAD is answered by GET routes. */
export function agentRouteFor(method: string, path: string): AgentRoute | null {
  const verb = method.toUpperCase() === 'HEAD' ? 'GET' : method.toUpperCase();
  const parts = segments(path);
  return COMPILED.find((entry) => entry.route.method === verb && matches(entry.segments, parts))?.route ?? null;
}

export function isAgentRouteAllowed(method: string, path: string): boolean {
  return agentRouteFor(method, path) !== null;
}
```

### Task 17: The lead seat

Lead authority comes from the seat, never from an agent's role column (design 5, 6.11). This task makes the seat one `hub_state` record that every lead check reads: `startLiveSession`, `leadOrHuman`, lead messages, messages to all, the brief and `HubStatus`. M1's `currentLead()` and its 15-minute rule go; a live lead keeps the seat while it was seen within `liveLeadGraceMs`. `HubStatus.lead` stays as the seat holder's agent until plan M2f switches the web (X-45), and `HubStatus.epoch` reads the hub epoch (X-22).

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type Agent, type AttemptStatus, leadAttemptId, restoreSet } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent, startLiveSession } from '../src/agents';
import { getAttempt, insertAttempt, issueFence, nextAttemptNumber, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { mintAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { buildBrief } from '../src/brief';
import { type HubContext, tx } from '../src/context';
import { nextId } from '../src/db';
import { HubError } from '../src/errors';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { emptySeat, getHubState, holdsSeat, leadSeat, seatHolderId, takeSeat } from '../src/hub-state';
import { sendMessage, unreadFor } from '../src/messages';
import { getTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { addAgent, addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext, newTask } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

const seatEvents = (ctx: HubContext) =>
  listEvents(ctx.db)
    .filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.seat_changed')
    .map((event) => event.data);

/** A runner lead with a lead attempt in the given status, seated the way the scheduler seats one. */
function seatRunnerLead(ctx: HubContext, status: AttemptStatus = 'running'): Agent {
  const { runner } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
    const seq = nextId(ctx.db, 'agent');
    const agentId = `A-${seq}`;
    const number = nextAttemptNumber(ctx, null);
    const fence = issueFence(ctx);
    const id = leadAttemptId(number, fence.epoch);
    ctx.db
      .query(
        `INSERT INTO agents (id, seq, login, vendor, role, origin, session_id, label, current_task, last_seen_at,
           created_at, runner_id, attempt_id)
         VALUES ($id, $seq, 'alice', 'claude', 'lead', 'runner', $session, $label, NULL, $now, $now, $runnerId, $attemptId)`,
      )
      .run({ id: agentId, seq, session: `runner-session-${seq}`, label: id, now: ctx.now(), runnerId: runner.id, attemptId: id });
    insertAttempt(ctx, {
      id,
      taskId: null,
      number,
      role: 'lead',
      agentId,
      runnerId: runner.id,
      vendor: 'claude',
      fence,
      status,
    });
    takeSeat(ctx, emit, agentId, 'runner', 'system');
    return getAgent(ctx, agentId);
  });
}

describe('the lead seat', () => {
  test('the first live lead request takes the seat and emits lead.seat_changed', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const result = startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'lead', role: 'lead' });
    expect(result.agent.role).toBe('lead');
    expect(result.leadSeatTakenBy).toBeNull();
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(result.agent.id);
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ leadAgentId: result.agent.id, leadKind: 'live', leadSince: ctx.now() });
    expect(seatEvents(ctx)).toEqual([{ kind: 'live', agentId: result.agent.id, attemptId: null, runnerId: null }]);
    // The holder starting its session again keeps the seat without a new event.
    startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'lead', role: 'lead' });
    expect(seatEvents(ctx)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('a second request becomes a worker with leadSeatTakenBy until the live lead is unseen for liveLeadGraceMs', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const lead = startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'lead', role: 'lead' });
    const second = startLiveSession(ctx, 'bob', { vendor: 'codex', sessionId: 'x', role: 'lead' });
    expect(second.agent.role).toBe('worker');
    expect(second.leadSeatTakenBy?.id).toBe(lead.agent.id);
    // M1's 15 minutes no longer free the seat.
    clock.advance(ctx.config.liveLeadGraceMs - 1);
    const third = startLiveSession(ctx, 'bob', { vendor: 'codex', sessionId: 'y', role: 'lead' });
    expect(third.leadSeatTakenBy?.id).toBe(lead.agent.id);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBeNull();
    expect(leadSeat(ctx).kind).toBe('none');
    const next = startLiveSession(ctx, 'bob', { vendor: 'codex', sessionId: 'z', role: 'lead' });
    expect(next.agent.role).toBe('lead');
    expect(next.leadSeatTakenBy).toBeNull();
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(next.agent.id);
    expect(getAgent(ctx, lead.agent.id).role).toBe('worker');
  });

  test('the seat holder starting again as a worker empties the seat', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const lead = startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'lead', role: 'lead' });
    startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'lead', role: 'worker' });
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBeNull();
    expect(getAgent(ctx, lead.agent.id).role).toBe('worker');
    expect(seatEvents(ctx).at(-1)).toEqual({ kind: 'none', agentId: null, attemptId: null, runnerId: null });
  });

  test('a chat asking while a runner lead holds the seat registers as a worker', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(ctx);
    clock.advance(ctx.config.liveLeadGraceMs * 2);
    const chat = startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'chat', role: 'lead' });
    expect(chat.agent.role).toBe('worker');
    expect(chat.leadSeatTakenBy?.id).toBe(runnerLead.id);
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(runnerLead.id);
    expect(getAgent(ctx, runnerLead.id).role).toBe('lead');
  });

  test('a runner lead holds the seat while starting, running, quota_wait or holding', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(ctx, 'starting');
    for (const status of ['starting', 'running', 'quota_wait', 'holding'] as const) {
      updateAttempt(ctx, runnerLead.attemptId as string, { status });
      expect([status, holdsSeat(ctx, runnerLead.id)]).toEqual([status, true]);
    }
    updateAttempt(ctx, runnerLead.attemptId as string, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'lost' });
    expect(holdsSeat(ctx, runnerLead.id)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a session id of a runner agent is refused with 409", () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(ctx);
    let refusal: unknown;
    try {
      startLiveSession(ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: runnerLead.sessionId as string, role: 'lead' });
    } catch (error) {
      refusal = error;
    }
    expect(refusal).toBeInstanceOf(HubError);
    expect((refusal as HubError).status).toBe(409);
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(runnerLead.id);
  });

  test('emptySeat clears the seat, or only when it names the given agent', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(ctx);
    expect(leadSeat(ctx)).toEqual({
      kind: 'runner',
      agentId: runnerLead.id,
      attemptId: runnerLead.attemptId,
      runnerId: runnerLead.runnerId,
      since: ctx.now(),
      wakeups: 0,
      runnerLeads: true,
    });
    expect(seatEvents(ctx).at(-1)).toEqual({
      kind: 'runner',
      agentId: runnerLead.id,
      attemptId: runnerLead.attemptId,
      runnerId: runnerLead.runnerId,
    });
    updateAttempt(ctx, runnerLead.attemptId as string, { wakeups: 3 });
    expect(leadSeat(ctx).wakeups).toBe(3);
    expect(tx(ctx, (emit) => emptySeat(ctx, emit, 'system', 'A-999'))).toBe(false);
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(runnerLead.id);
    expect(tx(ctx, (emit) => emptySeat(ctx, emit, 'system', runnerLead.id))).toBe(true);
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ leadAgentId: null, leadKind: null, leadSince: null });
    expect(seatEvents(ctx).at(-1)).toEqual({ kind: 'none', agentId: null, attemptId: null, runnerId: null });
    expect(tx(ctx, (emit) => emptySeat(ctx, emit, 'system'))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('lead authority comes from the seat', () => {
  test('a role column of lead without the seat is refused on lead routes and messages to all', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const lead = addAgent(hub.ctx, 'alice', 'lead');
    const pretender = addAgent(hub.ctx, 'bob');
    hub.ctx.db.query("UPDATE agents SET role = 'lead' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: pretender.id });
    const task = { tasks: [{ title: 'T', objective: 'O', acceptance: [{ id: 'A1', assertion: 'works' }] }] };
    const refused = await hub.call('POST', '/api/tasks', { user: 'bob', agent: pretender.id, body: task });
    expect([refused.status, refused.json.message]).toEqual([403, 'only the lead or a person can do this']);
    const note = await hub.call('POST', '/api/goal/notes', { user: 'bob', agent: pretender.id, body: { text: 'x' } });
    expect(note.status).toBe(403);
    const all = await hub.call('POST', '/api/messages', { user: 'bob', agent: pretender.id, body: { to: 'all', body: 'hi' } });
    expect(all.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await hub.call('POST', '/api/tasks', { user: 'alice', agent: lead.id, body: task })).status).toBe(201);
    expect(
      (await hub.call('POST', '/api/messages', { user: 'alice', agent: lead.id, body: { to: 'all', body: 'hi' } })).status,
    ).toBe(201);
  });

  test('a runner lead that holds the seat may use lead routes; its role column is not what counts', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(hub.ctx);
    const live = addAgent(hub.ctx, 'alice');
    hub.ctx.db.query("UPDATE agents SET role = 'lead' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: live.id });
    const task = { tasks: [{ title: 'T', objective: 'O', acceptance: [{ id: 'A1', assertion: 'works' }] }] };
    expect((await hub.call('POST', '/api/tasks', { user: 'alice', agent: live.id, body: task })).status).toBe(403);
    const attempt = getAttempt(hub.ctx, runnerLead.attemptId as string);
    const auth = { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt)}` } };
    expect((await hub.call('POST', '/api/tasks', { ...auth, body: task })).status).toBe(201);
    hub.ctx.db.query("UPDATE agents SET role = 'worker' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: runnerLead.id });
    expect((await hub.call('POST', '/api/goal/notes', { ...auth, body: { text: 'v2 means the new API' } })).status).toBe(201);
  });

  test('only a person can give a task people-only paths; the seated runner lead and a live lead are refused', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const [task] = createTasks(hub.ctx, [newTask({ ownedPaths: ['src/parser/**'] })], 'user:alice');
    if (!task) throw new Error('no task');
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(hub.ctx);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, getAttempt(hub.ctx, runnerLead.attemptId as string));
    const auth = { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } };
    const widen = { ownedPaths: ['src/parser/**', '.github/**'] };
    const refused = await hub.call('PATCH', `/api/tasks/${task.id}`, { ...auth, body: widen });
    expect([refused.status, refused.json.message]).toEqual([403, 'only a person can give a task people-only paths']);
    expect(restoreSet(getTask(hub.ctx, task.id))).toContain('.github/workflows/**');
    // Paths outside the class stay the lead's to change.
    const narrow = await hub.call('PATCH', `/api/tasks/${task.id}`, { ...auth, body: { ownedPaths: ['src/**'] } });
    expect(narrow.status).toBe(200);

    tx(hub.ctx, (emit) => emptySeat(hub.ctx, emit, 'system'));
    const live = await hub.liveAgent('alice', 'lead-chat', 'lead');
    const liveRefused = await hub.call('PATCH', `/api/tasks/${task.id}`, { user: 'alice', agent: live, body: widen });
    expect([liveRefused.status, liveRefused.json.message]).toEqual([403, 'only a person can give a task people-only paths']);

    const person = await hub.call('PATCH', `/api/tasks/${task.id}`, { user: 'alice', via: 'web', body: widen });
    expect(person.status).toBe(200);
    expect(restoreSet(getTask(hub.ctx, task.id))).not.toContain('.github/workflows/**');
  });

  test('a lead route checks the seat again once the body has arrived', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const lead = await hub.liveAgent('alice', 'lead-chat', 'lead');
    const body = { tasks: [{ title: 'T', objective: 'O', acceptance: [{ id: 'A1', assertion: 'works' }] }] };
    // The stream gives its body only when the route reads it, after the first seat check.
    const stream = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>(
      {
        pull(controller) {
          tx(hub.ctx, (emit) => emptySeat(hub.ctx, emit, 'user:alice'));
          controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(body)));
          controller.close();
        },
      },
      { highWaterMark: 0 },
    );
    const answer = await hub.app.request('/api/tasks', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        authorization: `Bearer ${hub.tokenFor('alice', 'cli')}`,
        'x-agflow-agent': lead,
        'content-type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: stream,
    });
    expect(answer.status).toBe(403);
    expect(hub.ctx.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });

  test('lead messages are unread only for the seat holder', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const lead = addAgent(ctx, 'alice', 'lead');
    const pretender = addAgent(ctx, 'bob');
    ctx.db.query("UPDATE agents SET role = 'lead' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: pretender.id });
    sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Plan the goal.' });
    expect(unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, pretender.id))).toEqual([]);
    expect(unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, lead.id)).map((message) => message.body)).toEqual(['Plan the goal.']);
  });

  test("the brief's role follows the seat", () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const lead = addAgent(ctx, 'alice', 'lead');
    const pretender = addAgent(ctx, 'bob');
    ctx.db.query("UPDATE agents SET role = 'lead' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: pretender.id });
    expect(buildBrief(ctx, getAgent(ctx, lead.id))).toContain('the lead manager');
    const pretenderBrief = buildBrief(ctx, getAgent(ctx, pretender.id));
    expect(pretenderBrief).toContain(', a worker,');
    expect(pretenderBrief).not.toContain('## Your duties as lead');
    clock.advance(ctx.config.liveLeadGraceMs);
    expect(buildBrief(ctx, getAgent(ctx, lead.id))).toContain(', a worker,');
  });
});

describe('GET /api/status', () => {
  test('reports the seat, the epoch, and the seat holder as the lead', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const empty = await hub.call('GET', '/api/status', { user: 'bob' });
    expect(empty.json).toMatchObject({
      lead: null,
      leadSeat: { kind: 'none', agentId: null, attemptId: null, runnerId: null, since: null, wakeups: 0, runnerLeads: true },
      epoch: 1,
    });
    const runnerLead = seatRunnerLead(hub.ctx);
    hub.ctx.db.run('UPDATE project SET epoch = 2');
    const seated = await hub.call('GET', '/api/status', { user: 'bob' });
    expect(seated.json.lead).toMatchObject({ id: runnerLead.id, origin: 'runner' });
    expect(seated.json.leadSeat).toMatchObject({ kind: 'runner', agentId: runnerLead.id, attemptId: runnerLead.attemptId });
    expect(seated.json.epoch).toBe(2);
  });
});
```
