```ts
// FakeRunner, the one protocol test client (X-25): it speaks protocol 1 like a runner, with an outbox, hello with
// lastSeq, the replay after welcome, heartbeats and an answer for every command kind, but runs no agent. Hooks
// replace answers, react with events, and supply facts and acceptingUntil. Its transport is pluggable: an in-memory
// FakeConnection to a Gateway here, a WebSocket to a real hub server elsewhere.
import {
  type AccountQuotaReport,
  type AttemptFacts,
  type Fence,
  type HubMessage,
  type LiveAttempt,
  PROTOCOL_VERSION,
  type ProfileSummary,
  type RawRunnerEvent,
  type Runner,
  type RunnerCommand,
  type RunnerCommandKind,
  type RunnerEventData,
  type RunnerEventType,
  type RunnerMessage,
  type RunnerSettings,
  type RunnerVendor,
  type Vendor,
  parseHubMessage,
  parseRunnerMessage,
} from '@agflow/core';
import { sessionHashOf, verifySession } from '../src/auth';
import { type CommandResult, KEPT_ON_CANCEL } from '../src/commands';
import type { HubContext } from '../src/context';
import type { Gateway, LinkSocket, RunnerConnection } from '../src/gateway';
import { testVendor } from './helpers';

/** The runner's end of one link. */
export interface FakeRunnerTransport {
  send(text: string): void;
  /** The runner hangs up. */
  close(): void;
}

/** What a transport calls on the runner for its link. */
export interface FakeRunnerEndpoint {
  receive(text: string): void;
  closed(code: number, reason: string): void;
}

/** Opens one link: the transport delivers to the endpoint and gives back the runner's sending side. */
export type FakeRunnerDialer<T extends FakeRunnerTransport> = (endpoint: FakeRunnerEndpoint) => T;

/** Replaces a kind's default answer. It may emit events through the runner, as a real runner would. */
export type AnswerHook<K extends RunnerCommandKind> = (
  command: Extract<RunnerCommand, { kind: K }>,
  runner: FakeRunner,
) => CommandResult;

export type AnswerHooks = { [K in RunnerCommandKind]?: AnswerHook<K> };

export interface FakeRunnerOptions {
  runnerKey?: string;
  machineId?: string;
  name?: string;
  agflowVersion?: string;
  protocol?: number;
  /** darwin-arm64 by default. */
  platform?: string;
  /** The hub-confirmed snapshot hello reports. */
  settings?: Partial<RunnerSettings>;
  /** Ready test-mode vendors by default (design 15.1). */
  vendors?: (Vendor | RunnerVendor)[];
  /** The account quota hello reports; none by default. */
  quota?: () => AccountQuotaReport[];
  /** The standard profile with dependency prep by default. */
  profile?: ProfileSummary;
  /** Ready to push by default. */
  git?: () => Runner['git'];
  state?: 'ok' | 'crash_loop' | 'disk_low';
  stateDetail?: string | null;
  outboxEpoch?: string;
  /** The hub epoch of the last welcome, as runner.json keeps it. */
  lastHubEpoch?: number | null;
  /** The clock of event and heartbeat times. */
  now?: () => number;
  /** auto: a heartbeat every welcome.timings.heartbeatMs; manual (the default): only heartbeat() sends one. */
  heartbeats?: 'auto' | 'manual';
  answers?: AnswerHooks;
  /** The attempts hello reports. */
  attempts?: () => LiveAttempt[];
  /** The facts each heartbeat carries. */
  facts?: () => AttemptFacts[];
  /** Ms from now during which the runner takes no new attempt; null by default. */
  acceptingUntil?: () => number | null;
  power?: () => Runner['power'];
  disk?: () => Runner['disk'];
  /** Called with each agent token a start or resume brings. */
  onToken?: (attemptId: string, token: string) => void;
}

type CommandMessage = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'command' }>;
type Welcome = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'welcome' }>;

/** The answers a runner gives when nothing goes wrong. decide_approval reports the decision applied. */
function defaultAnswer(command: RunnerCommand, runner: FakeRunner): CommandResult {
  switch (command.kind) {
    case 'decide_approval':
      return { ok: true, data: { applied: true } };
    case 'update_settings':
      runner.settings = {
        ...runner.settings,
        ...command.settings,
        ceilings: { ...runner.settings.ceilings, ...command.settings.ceilings },
        allowPaidUsage: { ...runner.settings.allowPaidUsage, ...command.settings.allowPaidUsage },
        version: command.version,
      };
      return { ok: true };
    default:
      return { ok: true };
  }
}

/** The attempt a command is about, for the welcome.stop rule; preflight and the like are about none. */
function attemptOf(command: RunnerCommand): string | null {
  if (command.kind === 'start_attempt') return command.attempt.attemptId;
  return 'attemptId' in command ? command.attemptId : null;
}

export class FakeRunner<T extends FakeRunnerTransport = FakeRunnerTransport> {
  readonly runnerKey: string;
  readonly machineId: string;
  settings: RunnerSettings;
  outboxEpoch: string;
  lastHubEpoch: number | null;
  /** Events not yet acknowledged, oldest first. */
  outbox: RawRunnerEvent[] = [];
  private nextSeq = 1;
  /** The current link's transport, null when the runner is not connected. */
  transport: T | null = null;
  welcome: Welcome | null = null;
  /** Every message the hub sent, over every link. */
  readonly received: HubMessage[] = [];
  /** Each command's result, by command id, as the journal keeps it: a resent command gets the same answer. */
  readonly journal = new Map<string, CommandResult>();
  /** The newest agent token of each attempt. */
  readonly tokens = new Map<string, string>();
  /** Attempts welcome.stop named: their commands are answered attempt_ended, but for the kinds that outlive one. */
  readonly stopped = new Set<string>();
  /** How the last link closed. */
  closedWith: { code: number; reason: string } | null = null;
  private link = 0;
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private waiters: ((message: Welcome | null) => void)[] = [];

  constructor(
    private readonly dial: FakeRunnerDialer<T>,
    readonly options: FakeRunnerOptions = {},
  ) {
    this.runnerKey = options.runnerKey ?? 'runner-key-1';
    this.machineId = options.machineId ?? 'machine-1';
    this.outboxEpoch = options.outboxEpoch ?? 'outbox-1';
    this.lastHubEpoch = options.lastHubEpoch ?? null;
    this.settings = {
      capacity: 2,
      keepAwake: 'ac',
      draining: false,
      ceilings: {},
      allowPaidUsage: {},
      version: 0,
      ...options.settings,
    };
  }

  private now(): number {
    return (this.options.now ?? Date.now)();
  }

  get connected(): boolean {
    return this.transport !== null;
  }

  /** Command messages received, oldest first. */
  get commands(): CommandMessage[] {
    return this.received.filter((message): message is CommandMessage => message.t === 'command');
  }

  /** The lowest seq the outbox keeps, and the highest; firstSeq − 1 when it is empty. */
  get firstSeq(): number {
    return this.outbox[0]?.seq ?? this.nextSeq;
  }

  get lastSeq(): number {
    return this.nextSeq - 1;
  }

  hello(): Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'hello' }> {
    const vendors = (this.options.vendors ?? ['claude', 'codex']).map((entry) =>
      typeof entry === 'string' ? testVendor(entry) : entry,
    );
    return {
      t: 'hello',
      protocol: this.options.protocol ?? PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      runnerKey: this.runnerKey,
      machineId: this.machineId,
      name: this.options.name ?? 'fake-runner',
      agflowVersion: this.options.agflowVersion ?? '0.2.0',
      platform: this.options.platform ?? 'darwin-arm64',
      settings: this.settings,
      vendors,
      quota: this.options.quota?.() ?? [],
      profile: this.options.profile ?? { name: 'standard', weakened: [], dependencyPrep: true },
      git: this.options.git?.() ?? { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: null },
      state: this.options.state ?? 'ok',
      stateDetail: this.options.stateDetail ?? null,
      outboxEpoch: this.outboxEpoch,
      firstSeq: this.firstSeq,
      lastSeq: this.lastSeq,
      lastHubEpoch: this.lastHubEpoch,
      attempts: this.options.attempts?.() ?? [],
    };
  }

  /** Opens a link and sends hello; resolves with the welcome, or null when the hub closes the link instead. */
  connect(): Promise<Welcome | null> {
    if (this.transport) throw new Error('the fake runner is already connected');
    const link = ++this.link;
    this.welcome = null;
    this.closedWith = null;
    const current = () => link === this.link;
    this.transport = this.dial({
      receive: (text) => {
        if (current()) this.receive(text);
      },
      closed: (code, reason) => {
        if (current()) this.linkClosed(code, reason);
      },
    });
    const welcomed = new Promise<Welcome | null>((resolve) => this.waiters.push(resolve));
    this.sendMessage(this.hello());
    return welcomed;
  }

  /** Hangs up, as a runner does when it stops. */
  disconnect(): void {
    const transport = this.transport;
    this.linkClosed(1000, 'runner disconnected');
    transport?.close();
  }

  /** A new link, as after a lost connection: hello again and the replay. */
  reconnect(): Promise<Welcome | null> {
    if (this.transport) this.disconnect();
    return this.connect();
  }

  /** Sends a raw message on the current link, as a broken runner might. */
  sendRaw(text: string): void {
    this.transport?.send(text);
  }

  private sendMessage(message: RunnerMessage): void {
    this.transport?.send(JSON.stringify(message));
  }

  /** Adds an event to the outbox and sends it at once when the link is up. */
  emit<K extends RunnerEventType>(
    type: K,
    data: RunnerEventData[K],
    attempt?: { attemptId: string; fence: Fence },
  ): RawRunnerEvent {
    const event: RawRunnerEvent = { seq: this.nextSeq++, at: this.now(), type, ...attempt, data };
    this.outbox.push(event);
    if (this.welcome) this.sendMessage({ t: 'events', outboxEpoch: this.outboxEpoch, events: [event] });
    return event;
  }

  heartbeat(): void {
    this.sendMessage({
      t: 'heartbeat',
      at: this.now(),
      attempts: this.options.facts?.() ?? [],
      power: this.options.power?.() ?? { source: 'ac', batteryPercent: null, lowPowerMode: false },
      disk: this.options.disk?.() ?? { freeBytes: 100e9, agflowBytes: 0 },
      acceptingUntil: this.options.acceptingUntil?.() ?? null,
    });
  }

  private receive(text: string): void {
    const parsed = parseHubMessage(text);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      // A command the runner cannot read is answered unsupported, as protocol 1 says.
      if (parsed.commandId) this.sendMessage({ t: 'result', commandId: parsed.commandId, ok: false, error: 'unsupported' });
      return;
    }
    const message = parsed.value;
    this.received.push(message);
    switch (message.t) {
      case 'welcome':
        this.welcomed(message);
        return;
      case 'ack':
        if (message.outboxEpoch === this.outboxEpoch) this.dropAcked(message.seq);
        return;
      case 'heartbeat_ack':
        return;
      case 'command':
        this.answer(message);
        return;
    }
  }

  private welcomed(welcome: Welcome): void {
    this.welcome = welcome;
    this.lastHubEpoch = welcome.hubEpoch;
    for (const stop of welcome.stop) this.stopped.add(stop.attemptId);
    this.dropAcked(welcome.ackedSeq);
    if (this.outbox.length > 0) this.sendMessage({ t: 'events', outboxEpoch: this.outboxEpoch, events: this.outbox });
    if (this.options.heartbeats === 'auto') {
      this.timer = setInterval(() => this.heartbeat(), welcome.timings.heartbeatMs);
    }
    for (const resolve of this.waiters.splice(0)) resolve(welcome);
  }

  private dropAcked(seq: number): void {
    this.outbox = this.outbox.filter((event) => event.seq > seq);
  }

  private answer(message: CommandMessage): void {
    const command = message.command;
    let result = this.journal.get(message.id);
    if (!result) {
      if (command.kind === 'start_attempt') this.keepToken(command.attempt.attemptId, command.attempt.agentToken);
      if (command.kind === 'resume_attempt') this.keepToken(command.attemptId, command.agentToken);
      const attemptId = attemptOf(command);
      // welcome.stop ends the fenced lifecycle commands; cleanup, transcript uploads and hand-backs come after an
      // attempt's end on purpose, as the hub keeps them when it cancels the rest.
      if (attemptId !== null && this.stopped.has(attemptId) && !KEPT_ON_CANCEL.includes(command.kind)) {
        result = { ok: false, error: 'attempt_ended' };
      } else {
        const hook = this.options.answers?.[command.kind] as AnswerHook<typeof command.kind> | undefined;
        result = hook ? hook(command as never, this as FakeRunner) : defaultAnswer(command, this as FakeRunner);
      }
      this.journal.set(message.id, result);
    }
    this.sendMessage({ t: 'result', commandId: message.id, ...result });
  }

  private keepToken(attemptId: string, token: string): void {
    this.tokens.set(attemptId, token);
    this.options.onToken?.(attemptId, token);
  }

  private linkClosed(code: number, reason: string): void {
    if (!this.transport) return;
    this.transport = null;
    this.closedWith = { code, reason };
    this.welcome = null;
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
    for (const resolve of this.waiters.splice(0)) resolve(null);
  }
}

/**
 * An in-memory link between a FakeRunner and a Gateway. Each side's messages arrive in order on a later microtask,
 * as over a socket, so neither side runs inside the other's handler.
 */
export class FakeConnection implements FakeRunnerTransport {
  readonly connection: RunnerConnection;
  /** The hub's end, which the gateway sends on. */
  readonly socket: LinkSocket;
  /** Every message each side sent, parsed, oldest first. */
  readonly toHub: RunnerMessage[] = [];
  readonly toRunner: HubMessage[] = [];
  /** How the hub ended the link; terminate reads as 1006. */
  closedBy: { code: number; reason: string } | null = null;
  private down = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly gateway: Gateway,
    session: { user: string; sessionHash: string },
    private readonly endpoint: FakeRunnerEndpoint,
  ) {
    const hubSide: LinkSocket = {
      send: (text) => {
        if (this.down) return;
        const parsed = parseHubMessage(text);
        if (parsed.ok) this.toRunner.push(parsed.value);
        queueMicrotask(() => this.endpoint.receive(text));
      },
      close: (code, reason) => this.hubEnded(code, reason),
      terminate: () => this.hubEnded(1006, ''),
    };
    this.socket = hubSide;
    this.connection = gateway.open(hubSide, session);
  }

  get isDown(): boolean {
    return this.down;
  }

  send(text: string): void {
    if (this.down) return;
    const parsed = parseRunnerMessage(text);
    if (parsed.ok) this.toHub.push(parsed.value);
    queueMicrotask(() => this.gateway.message(this.connection, text));
  }

  close(): void {
    if (this.down) return;
    this.down = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => this.gateway.closed(this.connection));
  }

  private hubEnded(code: number, reason: string): void {
    if (this.down) return;
    this.down = true;
    this.closedBy = { code, reason };
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      this.endpoint.closed(code, reason);
      this.gateway.closed(this.connection);
    });
  }
}

/** Lets every queued delivery of the fake links run. */
export function settle(): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
}

/**
 * A FakeRunner on in-memory links to the gateway, signed in with a CLI token as agflow runner is; it has said hello
 * and heard the hub's answer by the time this resolves.
 */
export async function connectFakeRunner(
  ctx: HubContext,
  gateway: Gateway,
  options: FakeRunnerOptions & { token: string },
): Promise<FakeRunner<FakeConnection>> {
  const session = verifySession(ctx, options.token);
  if (!session || session.kind !== 'cli') throw new Error('connectFakeRunner needs a CLI token');
  const link = { user: session.user, sessionHash: sessionHashOf(options.token) };
  const runner = new FakeRunner<FakeConnection>(
    (endpoint) => new FakeConnection(gateway, link, endpoint),
    { now: ctx.now, ...options },
  );
  await runner.connect();
  await settle();
  return runner;
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, jest, test } from 'bun:test';
import {
  CLOSE_CODES,
  type HubMessage,
  HubMessageSchema,
  PROTOCOL_VERSION,
  RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS,
  type RunnerCommandKind,
} from '@agflow/core';
import { SESSION_TTL, createSession, sessionHashOf } from '../src/auth';
import { type StoredCommand, enqueueCommand, pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { tx } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE, Gateway, type GatewayOptions, HUB_ERROR_CLOSE, type LinkSocket } from '../src/gateway';
import { findRunnerRow, getRunner, identifyRunner, markRetired, markVendorNotReady } from '../src/runners';
import { type AnswerHooks, FakeConnection, FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext, sampleCommands, testVendor } from './helpers';

type Ctx = ReturnType<typeof createTestContext>['ctx'];

function setup(overrides: Parameters<typeof createTestContext>[0] = {}, options: GatewayOptions = {}) {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext(overrides);
  const gateway = new Gateway(ctx, options);
  const token = createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli');
  return { ctx, clock, gateway, token };
}

/** A hub-side socket that records what the gateway does with it. */
function recordingSocket() {
  const sent: HubMessage[] = [];
  const socket: LinkSocket & { closed: { code: number; reason: string } | null; terminated: boolean } = {
    closed: null,
    terminated: false,
    send: (text) => sent.push(JSON.parse(text) as HubMessage),
    close(code, reason) {
      this.closed = { code, reason };
    },
    terminate() {
      this.terminated = true;
    },
  };
  return { socket, sent };
}

const ackedSeq = (ctx: Ctx, runnerId: string, outboxEpoch: string) =>
  (
    ctx.db
      .query('SELECT acked_seq FROM runner_inbox WHERE runner_id = $runnerId AND outbox_epoch = $outboxEpoch')
      .get({ runnerId, outboxEpoch }) as { acked_seq: number } | null
  )?.acked_seq ?? null;

describe('hello and welcome', () => {
  test('hello gets welcome with the runner id, the hub epoch and time, the acked seq and the timings', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup({ heartbeatMs: 10_000, deadLinkMs: 30_000, handoffMs: 120_000 });
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    expect(runner.welcome).toEqual({
      t: 'welcome',
      runnerId: 'R-1',
      hubEpoch: 1,
      hubTime: ctx.now(),
      ackedSeq: 0,
      wipRefPrefix: 'refs/agflow/',
      stop: [],
      timings: { heartbeatMs: 10_000, deadLinkMs: 30_000, handoffMs: 120_000, wipGraceMs: ctx.config.wipGraceMs },
    });
    expect(HubMessageSchema.parse(runner.welcome)).toEqual(runner.welcome as HubMessage);
    expect(gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).toBe(runner.transport?.connection ?? null);
  });

  test('ackedSeq is the larger of the stored position and firstSeq − 1, per outbox epoch', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    expect(ackedSeq(ctx, 'R-1', 'outbox-1')).toBe(0);
    ctx.db.run("UPDATE runner_inbox SET acked_seq = 5 WHERE runner_id = 'R-1'");
    // The runner still keeps events from seq 3: the hub's position stands.
    for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) runner.emit('runner.state', { state: 'ok', detail: null });
    runner.outbox = runner.outbox.filter((event) => event.seq >= 3);
    await runner.reconnect();
    expect(runner.welcome?.ackedSeq).toBe(5);
    // Its outbox now starts at 9: everything before was acknowledged and pruned.
    runner.outbox = [];
    await runner.reconnect();
    expect(runner.welcome?.ackedSeq).toBe(8);
    expect(ackedSeq(ctx, 'R-1', 'outbox-1')).toBe(8);
    // A new runner.db starts a new outbox epoch, with its own row, from seq 1.
    runner.disconnect();
    await settle();
    const fresh = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token, outboxEpoch: 'outbox-2' });
    expect(fresh.welcome?.ackedSeq).toBe(0);
    expect(ackedSeq(ctx, 'R-1', 'outbox-2')).toBe(0);
    expect(ackedSeq(ctx, 'R-1', 'outbox-1')).toBe(8);
  });

  test('hello stores info and vendors, confirms the settings, slides the session and emits runner.online', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, gateway, token } = setup();
    clock.advance(30 * 24 * 60 * 60_000);
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, {
      token,
      name: 'alice-mbp',
      agflowVersion: '0.3.1',
      vendors: ['codex'],
      settings: { capacity: 4 },
    });
    await settle();
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1')).toMatchObject({
      owner: 'alice',
      name: 'alice-mbp',
      state: 'online',
      agflowVersion: '0.3.1',
      capacity: 4,
      settingsVersion: 1,
      vendors: [{ vendor: 'codex', ready: true }],
    });
    // The new runner's settings come back as version 1, after the welcome.
    expect(runner.received.map((message) => message.t)).toEqual(['welcome', 'command']);
    expect(runner.settings).toMatchObject({ capacity: 4, version: 1 });
    const row = findRunnerRow(ctx, 'R-1');
    expect(row?.session_hash).toBe(sessionHashOf(token));
    const { expires_at } = ctx.db
      .query('SELECT expires_at FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $hash')
      .get({ hash: sessionHashOf(token) }) as { expires_at: number };
    expect(expires_at).toBe(ctx.now() + SESSION_TTL.cli);
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'runner.online')).toMatchObject([
      { subject: 'R-1', actor: 'runner:R-1', data: { runnerId: 'R-1', name: 'alice-mbp' } },
    ]);
    // A later hello with the confirmed snapshot queues no settings.
    await runner.reconnect();
    await settle();
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, 'R-1', PROTOCOL_VERSION)).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe('refusals and replacement', () => {
  test('a second connection with the same key and machine replaces the first with 4409', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const first = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    const oldLink = first.transport;
    const second = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    expect(first.closedWith).toEqual({ code: CLOSE_CODES.replaced, reason: 'another connection replaced this one' });
    expect(second.welcome?.runnerId).toBe('R-1');
    expect(gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).toBe(second.transport?.connection ?? null);
    expect(findRunnerRow(ctx, 'R-1')?.connection_id).toBe(second.transport?.connection.id ?? '');
    // A message that still arrives on the replaced link is ignored.
    const before = oldLink?.connection.lastInboundAt;
    gateway.message(oldLink?.connection as NonNullable<typeof oldLink>['connection'], JSON.stringify(first.hello()));
    expect(oldLink?.connection.lastInboundAt).toBe(before as number);
    expect(gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).toBe(second.transport?.connection ?? null);
  });

  test('another owner or machine and a retired runner get 4403; a protocol out of range 4426', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    const bob = createSession(ctx, 'bob', 'cli');
    const stranger = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token: bob });
    expect(stranger.welcome).toBeNull();
    expect(stranger.closedWith).toEqual({
      code: CLOSE_CODES.refused,
      reason: 'this runner belongs to alice on another machine; run agflow runner setup',
    });
    const newer = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token, runnerKey: 'key-2', protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION + 1 });
    expect(newer.closedWith?.code).toBe(CLOSE_CODES.incompatible);
    expect(newer.closedWith?.reason).toContain(`this hub accepts protocol 1 to ${PROTOCOL_VERSION}`);
  });

  test('a hello the hub cannot read is refused with 4426 when its protocol is out of range', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const session = { user: 'alice', sessionHash: sessionHashOf(token) };
    // A runner the hub knows, with no link.
    const known = new FakeRunner<FakeConnection>((endpoint) => new FakeConnection(gateway, session, endpoint));
    expect(identifyRunner(ctx, 'alice', known.hello()).ok).toBe(true);
    const { socket } = recordingSocket();
    const connection = gateway.open(socket, session);
    const unreadable = { t: 'hello', protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION + 1, runnerKey: 'runner-key-1', machineId: 'machine-1' };
    gateway.message(connection, JSON.stringify(unreadable));
    expect(socket.closed?.code).toBe(CLOSE_CODES.incompatible);
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1').state).toBe('incompatible');
  });

  test('a first message that is not a readable hello closes the link', () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const session = { user: 'alice', sessionHash: sessionHashOf(token) };
    for (const text of ['not json', JSON.stringify({ t: 'heartbeat', at: 1 }), JSON.stringify({ t: 'hello' })]) {
      const { socket, sent } = recordingSocket();
      gateway.message(gateway.open(socket, session), text);
      expect(socket.closed?.code).toBe(BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE);
      expect(sent).toEqual([]);
    }
    const { socket } = recordingSocket();
    const heartbeat = { t: 'heartbeat', at: 1, attempts: [], power: null, disk: null, acceptingUntil: null };
    gateway.message(gateway.open(socket, session), JSON.stringify(heartbeat));
    expect(socket.closed).toEqual({ code: BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE, reason: 'the first message must be hello' });
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM runners').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
  });
});

describe('known runners and broken links', () => {
  test("a known runner's hello refreshes its name, version, git and vendors", async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    runner.disconnect();
    await settle();
    // Failed WIP pushes stopped its git, and two failed starts marked codex not ready.
    ctx.db.run(
      `UPDATE runners SET info = json_set(info, '$.git', json('{"ready":false,"problem":"push refused","lastPushAt":null}'))
       WHERE id = 'R-1'`,
    );
    tx(ctx, () => markVendorNotReady(ctx, 'R-1', 'codex'));
    clock.advance(5_000);
    const again = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, {
      token,
      name: 'alice-mbp',
      agflowVersion: '0.3.1',
      vendors: ['claude', { ...testVendor('codex'), preflightAt: ctx.now() - 1_000 }],
    });
    expect(again.welcome?.runnerId).toBe('R-1');
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1')).toMatchObject({
      name: 'alice-mbp',
      agflowVersion: '0.3.1',
      git: { ready: true, problem: null },
      vendors: [
        { vendor: 'claude', ready: true },
        { vendor: 'codex', ready: true },
      ],
      lastSeenAt: ctx.now(),
    });
  });

  test('a hello carries the platform, profile, git and quota the runner reports', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const quota = [
      {
        vendor: 'claude' as const,
        accountId: testVendor('claude').accountId as string,
        quota: {
          state: 'ok' as const,
          resetsAt: null,
          windows: { fiveHour: 0.2, weekly: 0.4 },
          paidUsage: 'disabled' as const,
          updatedAt: ctx.now(),
        },
      },
    ];
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, {
      token,
      platform: 'linux-x64',
      profile: { name: 'auto', weakened: ['network'], dependencyPrep: false },
      git: () => ({ ready: false, problem: 'no push credentials', lastPushAt: null }),
      quota: () => quota,
    });
    expect(runner.transport?.toHub[0]).toMatchObject({ t: 'hello', quota });
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1')).toMatchObject({
      platform: 'linux-x64',
      profile: { name: 'auto', weakened: ['network'], dependencyPrep: false },
      git: { ready: false, problem: 'no push credentials' },
    });
  });

  test('a second hello on a welcomed link closes it', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    runner.sendRaw(JSON.stringify(runner.hello()));
    await settle();
    expect(runner.closedWith).toEqual({ code: BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE, reason: 'hello was already received on this link' });
    expect(gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).toBeNull();
  });

  test('an unreadable message after hello is logged and ignored, so the runner does not reconnect in a loop', async () => {
    const logged: string[] = [];
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup({}, { log: (message) => logged.push(message) });
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    runner.sendRaw('not json');
    await settle();
    expect(runner.connected).toBe(true);
    expect(logged).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('runner R-1 sent a message the hub cannot read')]);
  });

  test('a hello the hub fails to process closes the link with 1011 and registers nothing', async () => {
    const logged: string[] = [];
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup({}, { log: (message) => logged.push(message) });
    ctx.db.run('DROP TABLE runner_inbox');
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    expect(runner.closedWith).toEqual({ code: HUB_ERROR_CLOSE, reason: 'the hub could not process hello' });
    expect(gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).toBeNull();
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM runners').get()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(logged).toEqual(['hello from runner key runner-key-1 failed']);
  });

  test('retiring a connected runner closes its link with 4403, and its next hello is refused', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    const retired = { code: CLOSE_CODES.refused, reason: 'this runner was retired; run agflow runner setup' };
    tx(ctx, (emit) => markRetired(ctx, emit, 'R-1', 'user:alice'));
    await settle();
    expect(runner.closedWith).toEqual(retired);
    expect(gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).toBeNull();
    expect(await runner.connect()).toBeNull();
    expect(runner.closedWith).toEqual(retired);
  });

  test('a command that cannot be built stops the flush there, and the link sends the others later', async () => {
    const logged: string[] = [];
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup({}, { log: (message) => logged.push(message) });
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    const kinds = () => runner.commands.map((message) => message.command.kind);
    const sentAt = (id: string | undefined) =>
      (ctx.db.query('SELECT sent_at FROM runner_commands WHERE id = $id').get({ id: id ?? '' }) as { sent_at: number | null })
        .sent_at;
    // A resume whose attempt the hub cannot find has no token to carry.
    const [preflight, broken] = tx(ctx, () => [
      enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' }),
      enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', {
        kind: 'resume_attempt',
        attemptId: 'T-9-a1',
        fence: { epoch: 1, counter: 1 },
        prompt: 'Continue.',
        messages: [],
        taskPack: null,
        restore: { paths: [], base: 'refs/heads/main' },
        acceptanceIds: [],
      }),
      enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'codex' }),
    ]);
    await settle();
    expect(kinds()).toEqual(['update_settings', 'preflight']);
    expect([sentAt(preflight?.id), sentAt(broken?.id)]).toEqual([ctx.now(), null]);
    expect(logged).toEqual([`building command ${broken?.id} for runner R-1 failed`]);
    // Once the broken command is cancelled, the next flush sends what waited behind it.
    tx(ctx, () => {
      ctx.db.query("UPDATE runner_commands SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: broken?.id ?? '' });
      enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: 'T-1-a1' });
    });
    await settle();
    expect(kinds()).toEqual(['update_settings', 'preflight', 'preflight', 'cleanup_attempt']);
  });
});

describe('commands on the link', () => {
  test('pending commands follow every welcome in seq order; later ones arrive once their transaction commits', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    // The runner answered the settings echo (seq 1).
    ctx.db.run("UPDATE runner_commands SET status = 'done'");
    runner.disconnect();
    await settle();
    tx(ctx, () => {
      enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' });
      enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'codex' });
    });
    await runner.connect();
    await settle();
    const seqs = () => runner.commands.map((message) => message.seq);
    expect(seqs()).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
    // Results are not recorded yet, so the next welcome resends them, and the journal answers the same.
    await runner.reconnect();
    await settle();
    expect(seqs()).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 2, 3]);
    // A command queued while connected goes out after its commit, and never after a rollback.
    expect(() =>
      tx(ctx, () => {
        enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' });
        throw new Error('rolled back');
      }),
    ).toThrow('rolled back');
    tx(ctx, () => enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: 'T-1-a1' }));
    await settle();
    expect(seqs()).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 2, 3, 4]);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, 'R-1', PROTOCOL_VERSION).map((row) => row.sentAt)).toEqual([
      ctx.now(),
      ctx.now(),
      ctx.now(),
    ]);
  });
});

describe('FakeRunner', () => {
  test('replays the events after welcome.ackedSeq and drops acknowledged ones', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    runner.disconnect();
    await settle();
    for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) runner.emit('runner.state', { state: 'ok', detail: `event ${n + 1}` });
    expect(runner.hello()).toMatchObject({ firstSeq: 1, lastSeq: 3 });
    ctx.db.run("UPDATE runner_inbox SET acked_seq = 2 WHERE runner_id = 'R-1'");
    await runner.connect();
    await settle();
    const link = runner.transport;
    expect(link?.toHub.filter((message) => message.t === 'events')).toEqual([
      { t: 'events', outboxEpoch: 'outbox-1', events: [expect.objectContaining({ seq: 3, type: 'runner.state' })] },
    ]);
    expect(runner.outbox.map((event) => event.seq)).toEqual([3]);
    // A cumulative ack drops what it covers; events emitted on a live link go out at once.
    runner.emit('runner.state', { state: 'disk_low', detail: 'low' });
    link?.socket.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'ack', outboxEpoch: 'outbox-1', seq: 3 }));
    await settle();
    expect(runner.outbox.map((event) => event.seq)).toEqual([4]);
    expect(runner.hello()).toMatchObject({ firstSeq: 4, lastSeq: 4 });
    expect(link?.toHub.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ t: 'events', events: [{ seq: 4 }] });
  });

  test('answers each of the 17 kinds by default, unless a hook replaces the answer', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    // The helper's runner has the FakeRunner's default key and machine; its settings are confirmed already.
    const { runner: owner, attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    ctx.db.run(`UPDATE runners SET settings_version = 1 WHERE id = '${owner.id}'`);
    const hooked: RunnerCommandKind[] = [];
    const answers: AnswerHooks = {
      preflight: (command, runner) => {
        hooked.push(command.kind);
        runner.emit('runner.state', { state: 'ok', detail: `preflight ${command.vendor}` });
        return { ok: false, error: 'binary missing' };
      },
    };
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token, answers, settings: { version: 1 } });
    const commands = sampleCommands(attempt);
    tx(ctx, () => {
      for (const kind of RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS) enqueueCommand(ctx, owner.id, commands[kind] as StoredCommand);
    });
    await settle();
    const results = runner.transport?.toHub.filter((message) => message.t === 'result') ?? [];
    const byKind = new Map(
      runner.commands.map((message) => [
        message.command.kind,
        results.find((result) => result.t === 'result' && result.commandId === message.id),
      ]),
    );
    expect([...byKind.keys()]).toEqual([...RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS]);
    for (const kind of RUNNER_COMMAND_KINDS) {
      const expected =
        kind === 'preflight'
          ? { ok: false, error: 'binary missing' }
          : kind === 'decide_approval'
            ? { ok: true, data: { applied: true } }
            : { ok: true };
      expect([kind, byKind.get(kind)]).toEqual([kind, { t: 'result', commandId: expect.any(String), ...expected }]);
    }
    expect(hooked).toEqual(['preflight']);
    // Starts and resumes bring tokens, kept per attempt; settings echoes update the snapshot.
    expect(runner.tokens.get(attempt.id)).toStartWith('agt_');
    expect(runner.settings).toMatchObject({ capacity: 3, version: 2 });
    expect(runner.outbox.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'runner.state', data: { detail: 'preflight codex' } });
  });

  test('with automatic heartbeats it sends one every welcome.timings.heartbeatMs while linked', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup({ heartbeatMs: 15_000 });
    const session = { user: 'alice', sessionHash: sessionHashOf(token) };
    jest.useFakeTimers();
    try {
      const runner = new FakeRunner<FakeConnection>((endpoint) => new FakeConnection(gateway, session, endpoint), {
        now: ctx.now,
        heartbeats: 'auto',
        acceptingUntil: () => 60_000,
      });
      // Connecting takes only microtasks, which fake timers leave alone.
      await runner.connect();
      const link = runner.transport;
      const heartbeats = () => link?.toHub.filter((message) => message.t === 'heartbeat') ?? [];
      jest.advanceTimersByTime(45_000);
      expect(heartbeats()).toHaveLength(3);
      expect(heartbeats()[0]).toMatchObject({ at: ctx.now(), attempts: [], acceptingUntil: 60_000 });
      runner.disconnect();
      jest.advanceTimersByTime(45_000);
      expect(heartbeats()).toHaveLength(3);
    } finally {
      jest.useRealTimers();
    }
  });

  test("welcome.stop ends an attempt's lifecycle commands, but not those that outlive it", async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    const link = runner.transport;
    const welcome = runner.welcome as NonNullable<typeof runner.welcome>;
    link?.socket.send(JSON.stringify({ ...welcome, stop: [{ attemptId: 'T-1-a1', reason: 'lost' }] }));
    const fence = { epoch: 1, counter: 1 };
    const commands = [
      { kind: 'interrupt', attemptId: 'T-1-a1', fence },
      { kind: 'upload_transcript', attemptId: 'T-1-a1' },
      { kind: 'hand_back', attemptId: 'T-1-a1', source: { kind: 'clone' } },
      { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: 'T-1-a1' },
    ];
    commands.forEach((command, n) => {
      link?.socket.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'command', id: `1-R-1-${90 + n}`, seq: 90 + n, command }));
    });
    await settle();
    expect(runner.stopped).toEqual(new Set(['T-1-a1']));
    const results = link?.toHub.filter((message) => message.t === 'result').slice(-4);
    expect(results).toEqual([
      { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-1-90', ok: false, error: 'attempt_ended' },
      { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-1-91', ok: true },
      { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-1-92', ok: true },
      { t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-1-93', ok: true },
    ]);
  });

  test('a command it cannot read is answered unsupported', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token });
    const teleport = { t: 'command', id: '1-R-1-50', seq: 50, command: { kind: 'teleport' } };
    runner.transport?.socket.send(JSON.stringify(teleport));
    await settle();
    expect(runner.transport?.toHub.at(-1)).toEqual({ t: 'result', commandId: '1-R-1-50', ok: false, error: 'unsupported' });
  });

  test('its journal answers a resent command with the first result, and it keeps the hub epoch', async () => {
    const { ctx, gateway, token } = setup();
    let calls = 0;
    const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, {
      token,
      answers: { preflight: () => ({ ok: true, data: { call: ++calls } }) },
    });
    expect(runner.hello().lastHubEpoch).toBe(runner.welcome?.hubEpoch ?? -1);
    const preflight = tx(ctx, () => enqueueCommand(ctx, 'R-1', { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'claude' }));
    await settle();
    // The result was lost with the link: the command is pending again and goes out after the next welcome.
    ctx.db.query("UPDATE runner_commands SET status = 'pending' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: preflight.id });
    await runner.reconnect();
    await settle();
    expect(calls).toBe(1);
    const results = runner.transport?.toHub.filter((message) => message.t === 'result' && message.commandId === preflight.id);
    expect(results).toEqual([{ t: 'result', commandId: preflight.id, ok: true, data: { call: 1 } }]);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The hub side of runner links (design 6.3): one RunnerConnection per link, hello and welcome, the acknowledged
// position, and the commands that follow. The transport is the caller's: Bun's WebSocket handlers or an in-memory
// test connection hand the gateway a LinkSocket and every message and close they see.
import { CLOSE_CODES, type HubMessage, type RunnerMessage, parseRunnerMessage } from '@agflow/core';
import { slideSession } from './auth';
import { markSent, pendingCommands, toWireCommand } from './commands';
import { type HubContext, type RunnerLink, afterCommit, tx } from './context';
import { hubEpoch } from './hub-state';
import {
  type HelloMessage,
  checkRunnerIdentity,
  identifyRunner,
  markLinked,
  reconcileHelloSettings,
  recordHelloInfo,
} from './runners';

/** The close code for a link whose first message is not a readable hello (WebSocket "policy violation"). */
export const BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE = 1008;
/** The close code when the hub fails while handling a hello (WebSocket "internal error"). */
export const HUB_ERROR_CLOSE = 1011;

/** The hub's end of one link, as the gateway uses it. */
export interface LinkSocket {
  send(text: string): void;
  close(code: number, reason: string): void;
  /** Drops the link without a closing handshake, which a dead link would never answer. */
  terminate(): void;
}

/** The CLI session a link authenticated with before it was opened. */
export interface LinkSession {
  user: string;
  sessionHash: string;
}

type Welcome = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'welcome' }>;
type CommandMessage = Extract<HubMessage, { t: 'command' }>;

export class RunnerConnection {
  readonly id = crypto.randomUUID();
  /** The runner this link speaks for, once its hello passed. */
  runnerId: string | null = null;
  /** The protocol its hello spoke; commands newer than it are never sent. */
  protocol = 0;
  /** The welcome went out, so commands may follow. */
  welcomed = false;
  closed = false;
  /** By the context clock: the dead-link check reads it. */
  lastInboundAt: number;
  /** Commands sent on this link: a flush sends only the others. */
  readonly sent = new Set<string>();

  constructor(
    readonly socket: LinkSocket,
    readonly session: LinkSession,
    now: number,
  ) {
    this.lastInboundAt = now;
  }
}

export interface GatewayOptions {
  /** Where the gateway reports what it cannot hand back to a runner; console.error by default. */
  log?: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void;
}

/**
 * Raises the runner's acknowledged position for this outbox epoch to at least firstSeq − 1, creating the row for a
 * new epoch, and returns it: the runner replays every event after it that it still has.
 */
export function acknowledgePosition(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string, outboxEpoch: string, firstSeq: number): number {
  const row = ctx.db
    .query(
      `INSERT INTO runner_inbox (runner_id, outbox_epoch, acked_seq) VALUES ($runnerId, $outboxEpoch, $floor)
       ON CONFLICT (runner_id, outbox_epoch) DO UPDATE SET acked_seq = MAX(acked_seq, excluded.acked_seq)
       RETURNING acked_seq`,
    )
    .get({ runnerId, outboxEpoch, floor: firstSeq - 1 }) as { acked_seq: number };
  return row.acked_seq;
}

/**
 * The runner links of one hub. It installs itself as the context's RunnerLink, so commands queued in a transaction
 * reach a connected runner once that transaction commits.
 */
export class Gateway implements RunnerLink {
  /** Each runner's current link. */
  private readonly links = new Map<string, RunnerConnection>();
  /** Every open link, those still waiting for their hello included. */
  private readonly connections = new Set<RunnerConnection>();
  private readonly log: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void;

  constructor(
    readonly ctx: HubContext,
    options: GatewayOptions = {},
  ) {
    this.log = options.log ?? ((message, error) => console.error(message, error ?? ''));
    ctx.link = this;
  }

  /** A new link, authenticated with a CLI session; its first message must be hello. */
  open(socket: LinkSocket, session: LinkSession): RunnerConnection {
    const connection = new RunnerConnection(socket, session, this.ctx.now());
    this.connections.add(connection);
    return connection;
  }

  /** The runner's current link, if it has one. */
  connectionOf(runnerId: string): RunnerConnection | null {
    return this.links.get(runnerId) ?? null;
  }

  message(connection: RunnerConnection, text: string): void {
    if (connection.closed) return;
    connection.lastInboundAt = this.ctx.now();
    if (connection.runnerId === null) {
      this.firstMessage(connection, text);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parseRunnerMessage(text);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      // Closing would only make the runner reconnect and send it again.
      this.log(`runner ${connection.runnerId} sent a message the hub cannot read: ${parsed.error}`);
      return;
    }
    this.handle(connection, parsed.value);
  }

  /** Every inbound message keeps the link alive; hello is allowed only once. */
  private handle(connection: RunnerConnection, message: RunnerMessage): void {
    if (message.t === 'hello') this.close(connection, BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE, 'hello was already received on this link');
  }

  /** The transport saw the link close. */
  closed(connection: RunnerConnection): void {
    this.drop(connection);
  }

  private firstMessage(connection: RunnerConnection, text: string): void {
    const parsed = parseRunnerMessage(text);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      const envelope = parsed.hello;
      if (envelope) {
        // A newer runner's hello may be unreadable here: it still gets 4426, so it stops instead of retrying.
        const checked = tx(this.ctx, () => checkRunnerIdentity(this.ctx, connection.session.user, envelope));
        if (!checked.ok) {
          this.close(connection, checked.code, checked.reason);
          return;
        }
      }
      this.close(connection, BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE, `expected a hello: ${parsed.error}`);
      return;
    }
    if (parsed.value.t !== 'hello') {
      this.close(connection, BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE, 'the first message must be hello');
      return;
    }
    this.hello(connection, parsed.value);
  }

  /**
   * Identifies the runner and records the hello in one transaction. The welcome goes out once it commits, before any
   * command that transaction queued: the attach step is queued first, so it runs before their flush.
   */
  private hello(connection: RunnerConnection, hello: HelloMessage): void {
    const { ctx } = this;
    const { user, sessionHash } = connection.session;
    let outcome: ReturnType<typeof identifyRunner>;
    try {
      outcome = tx(ctx, (emit) => {
        const identity = identifyRunner(ctx, user, hello);
        if (!identity.ok) return identity;
        const runnerId = identity.runner.id;
        const welcome: { message: Welcome | null } = { message: null };
        afterCommit(ctx, () => this.attach(connection, runnerId, hello.protocol, welcome.message as Welcome));
        recordHelloInfo(ctx, runnerId, hello);
        reconcileHelloSettings(ctx, runnerId, hello.settings);
        slideSession(ctx, sessionHash);
        const ackedSeq = acknowledgePosition(ctx, runnerId, hello.outboxEpoch, hello.firstSeq);
        markLinked(ctx, emit, runnerId, {
          connectionId: connection.id,
          sessionHash,
          state: hello.state,
          stateDetail: hello.stateDetail,
        });
        welcome.message = {
          t: 'welcome',
          runnerId,
          hubEpoch: hubEpoch(ctx),
          hubTime: ctx.now(),
          ackedSeq,
          wipRefPrefix: ctx.config.wipRefPrefix,
          stop: [],
          timings: {
            heartbeatMs: ctx.config.heartbeatMs,
            deadLinkMs: ctx.config.deadLinkMs,
            handoffMs: ctx.config.handoffMs,
            wipGraceMs: ctx.config.wipGraceMs,
          },
        };
        return identity;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.log(`hello from runner key ${hello.runnerKey} failed`, error);
      this.close(connection, HUB_ERROR_CLOSE, 'the hub could not process hello');
      return;
    }
    if (!outcome.ok) this.close(connection, outcome.code, outcome.reason);
  }

  /** Makes the link the runner's current one, replacing an older link with 4409, and sends welcome then commands. */
  private attach(connection: RunnerConnection, runnerId: string, protocol: number, welcome: Welcome): void {
    if (connection.closed) return;
    const previous = this.links.get(runnerId);
    if (previous && previous !== connection) this.close(previous, CLOSE_CODES.replaced, 'another connection replaced this one');
    connection.runnerId = runnerId;
    connection.protocol = protocol;
    this.links.set(runnerId, connection);
    this.send(connection, welcome);
    connection.welcomed = true;
    this.flush(runnerId);
  }

  /**
   * Sends the runner the pending commands its current link has not had yet, in seq order. A command that cannot be
   * built stops the flush there: the ones before it still go out, the ones after it wait, so the order holds.
   */
  flush(runnerId: string): void {
    const connection = this.links.get(runnerId);
    if (!connection || !connection.welcomed || connection.closed) return;
    const { ctx } = this;
    const messages = tx(ctx, () => {
      const built: CommandMessage[] = [];
      for (const row of pendingCommands(ctx, runnerId, connection.protocol)) {
        if (connection.sent.has(row.id)) continue;
        try {
          // A savepoint per command, so a failing one leaves the earlier ones' writes standing.
          built.push(
            tx(ctx, () => {
              markSent(ctx, row.id);
              return toWireCommand(ctx, row);
            }),
          );
        } catch (error) {
          this.log(`building command ${row.id} for runner ${runnerId} failed`, error);
          break;
        }
      }
      return built;
    });
    // Only after the commit: a rolled-back flush must leave its commands to the next one.
    for (const message of messages) connection.sent.add(message.id);
    for (const message of messages) this.send(connection, message);
  }

  /** Ends the runner's current link from the hub's side, as retiring the runner does. */
  closeRunner(runnerId: string, code: number, reason: string): void {
    const connection = this.links.get(runnerId);
    if (connection) this.close(connection, code, reason);
  }

  private send(connection: RunnerConnection, message: HubMessage): void {
    try {
      connection.socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
    } catch (error) {
      this.log(`sending ${message.t} to runner ${connection.runnerId ?? '(no hello yet)'} failed`, error);
    }
  }

  /** Ends the link from the hub's side. */
  close(connection: RunnerConnection, code: number, reason: string): void {
    if (connection.closed) return;
    this.drop(connection);
    try {
      connection.socket.close(code, reason);
    } catch (error) {
      this.log(`closing the link of runner ${connection.runnerId ?? '(no hello yet)'} failed`, error);
    }
  }

  private drop(connection: RunnerConnection): void {
    if (connection.closed) return;
    connection.closed = true;
    this.connections.delete(connection);
    if (connection.runnerId !== null && this.links.get(connection.runnerId) === connection) {
      this.links.delete(connection.runnerId);
    }
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

The hello runs in one transaction; its attach step is queued with `afterCommit` first, so the old link is closed with 4409, `welcome` is sent and only then are pending commands flushed. A first message that is not a readable hello closes the link with 1008; a failure while handling the hello closes it with 1011. FakeRunner's journal never forgets a command id: a test that wants a resend sets the row back to pending. `sampleCommands(attempt)` moves to `helpers.ts`.

### Task 22: The runner gateway: heartbeats, results and dead links

This task completes the link behaviour of design 6.3. Every heartbeat gets `heartbeat_ack` and records power, disk, last seen and `acceptingUntil` in epoch ms (X-22). Command results update their commands. Links silent for `deadLinkMs` are terminated, and a closed link marks its runner offline, or needs_login once its session no longer verifies. A new gateway unlinks every runner an earlier hub process left linked.

```diff
+/** What each heartbeat reports about the runner itself. */
+export type HeartbeatInfo = Pick<Extract<RunnerMessage, { t: 'heartbeat' }>, 'power' | 'disk' | 'acceptingUntil'>;
+
+/**
+ * Records a heartbeat: power, disk and the time it was seen. acceptingUntil comes as ms from now, so clocks need
+ * not agree, and is stored as epoch ms; null clears it.
+ */
+export function recordHeartbeatInfo(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string, heartbeat: HeartbeatInfo): void {
+  const row = findRunnerRow(ctx, runnerId);
+  if (!row) throw notFound(`runner ${runnerId}`);
+  const now = ctx.now();
+  const info: RunnerInfo = { ...runnerInfo(row), power: heartbeat.power, disk: heartbeat.disk };
+  ctx.db
+    .query('UPDATE runners SET info = $info, accepting_until = $acceptingUntil, last_seen_at = $now WHERE id = $id')
+    .run({
+      id: runnerId,
+      info: JSON.stringify(info),
+      acceptingUntil: heartbeat.acceptingUntil === null ? null : now + heartbeat.acceptingUntil,
+      now,
+    });
+}

+/**
+ * A starting hub has no links yet: runners an earlier hub process left linked are unlinked, offline or needs_login.
+ * Returns how many.
+ */
+export function unlinkAll(ctx: HubContext): number {
+  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
+    const rows = ctx.db
+      .query(`${RUNNER_SELECT} WHERE connection_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY seq`)
+      .all() as RunnerRow[];
+    for (const row of rows) markUnlinked(ctx, emit, row.id, row.connection_id as string);
+    return rows.length;
+  });
+}
```

### Task 23: The runner endpoint, startHub and the entry point

Runners open their link at `GET /api/runner/ws` with their owner's CLI token, and call `GET /api/runner/whoami` after a refused upgrade, because a refused WebSocket client sees only "Expected 101" (design 6.3, 6.16). `startHub(ctx, { port, hostname, scheduler, dbLock, timers })` serves the API, the web UI and the link on one port and returns `{ url, gateway, scheduler, stop }` (design 13, X-26). Every option exists now; `scheduler` works from Task 57 and `dbLock` from Task 63. `main.ts` uses `startHub`, and FakeRunner gains a WebSocket transport, `connectFakeRunnerWs`.

```diff
+/**
+ * A FakeRunner's link to a real hub server: a WebSocket to /api/runner/ws with the CLI token, as a runner opens it.
+ * What the runner sends before the socket opens waits for it, so connect() can send hello at once.
+ */
+export class WebSocketTransport implements FakeRunnerTransport {
+  readonly socket: WebSocket;
+  private readonly waiting: string[] = [];
+
+  constructor(url: string, token: string, endpoint: FakeRunnerEndpoint) {
+    const wsUrl = new URL('/api/runner/ws', url);
+    wsUrl.protocol = wsUrl.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
+    this.socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
+    this.socket.addEventListener('open', () => {
+      for (const text of this.waiting.splice(0)) this.socket.send(text);
+    });
+    this.socket.addEventListener('message', (event) => endpoint.receive(String(event.data)));
+    this.socket.addEventListener('close', (event) => endpoint.closed(event.code, event.reason));
+  }
+
+  send(text: string): void {
+    if (this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING) this.waiting.push(text);
+    else if (this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) this.socket.send(text);
+  }
+
+  close(): void {
+    this.socket.close(1000, 'runner disconnected');
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * A FakeRunner linked to a hub server at url (startHub's HubServer.url) over a real WebSocket, signed in with a CLI
+ * token as agflow runner is. It resolves once the runner has its welcome, or once the hub refused or closed the link.
+ */
+export async function connectFakeRunnerWs(
+  url: string,
+  options: FakeRunnerOptions & { token: string },
+): Promise<FakeRunner<WebSocketTransport>> {
+  const runner = new FakeRunner<WebSocketTransport>(
+    (endpoint) => new WebSocketTransport(url, options.token, endpoint),
+    options,
+  );
+  await runner.connect();
+  return runner;
+}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { WhoamiResponseSchema } from '@agflow/core';
import { SESSION_TTL, createSession, deleteSession, mintAgentToken, sessionHashOf } from '../src/auth';
import { findCommand } from '../src/commands';
import { BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE } from '../src/gateway';
import { getRunner } from '../src/runners';
import { type HubServer, startHub } from '../src/server';
import { FakeRunner, connectFakeRunnerWs } from './fake-runner';
import { addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

const servers: HubServer[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const server of servers.splice(0)) await server.stop();
});

function serve(overrides: Parameters<typeof createTestContext>[0] = {}, options: { timers?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext(overrides);
  const timers = options.timers ?? false;
  const hub = startHub(ctx, { port: 0, hostname: '127.0.0.1', scheduler: false, dbLock: false, timers });
  servers.push(hub);
  return { ctx, clock, hub, token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli') };
}

/** The headers of a WebSocket handshake, which fetch sends as they are. */
const HANDSHAKE = {
  connection: 'Upgrade',
  upgrade: 'websocket',
  'sec-websocket-version': '13',
  'sec-websocket-key': 'dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==',
};

/** Polls until the predicate holds, failing at the deadline; for waits on real sockets and timers. */
async function until(predicate: () => boolean, timeoutMs = 2_000): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (!predicate()) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`timed out after ${timeoutMs} ms`);
    await Bun.sleep(5);
  }
}

type Ctx = ReturnType<typeof createTestContext>['ctx'];

const sessionRow = (ctx: Ctx, token: string) =>
  ctx.db.query('SELECT 1 AS found FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $hash').get({ hash: sessionHashOf(token) });

async function answer(response: Response): Promise<[number, string | undefined]> {
  const body = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
  return [response.status, body?.error];
}

describe('the runner link on a real server', () => {
  test('FakeRunner over a WebSocket with a CLI token sends hello and gets welcome', async () => {
    const { ctx, hub, token } = serve();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunnerWs(hub.url, { token, now: ctx.now });
    expect(runner.welcome).toMatchObject({ t: 'welcome', runnerId: 'R-1', hubEpoch: 1, ackedSeq: 0, stop: [] });
    expect(hub.gateway.connectionOf('R-1')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1')).toMatchObject({ owner: 'alice', state: 'online' });
    runner.disconnect();
  });

  test('before an upgrade a cookie gets 401, an agent token 403 agent_not_allowed, a plain GET 426', async () => {
    const { ctx, hub, token } = serve();
    const ws = `${hub.url}/api/runner/ws`;
    const web = createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'web');
    const cookie = await fetch(ws, { headers: { ...HANDSHAKE, cookie: `agflow_session=${web}` } });
    expect(await answer(cookie)).toEqual([401, 'unauthorized']);
    const { attempt } = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const agentToken = mintAgentToken(ctx, attempt);
    const agent = await fetch(ws, { headers: { ...HANDSHAKE, authorization: `Bearer ${agentToken}` } });
    expect(await answer(agent)).toEqual([403, 'agent_not_allowed']);
    const plain = await fetch(ws, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    expect(await answer(plain)).toEqual([426, 'upgrade_required']);
    expect(await answer(await fetch(ws))).toEqual([401, 'unauthorized']);
    // A refused WebSocket client learns nothing but that the upgrade failed.
    const refused = await connectFakeRunnerWs(hub.url, { token: web, now: ctx.now });
    expect([refused.welcome, refused.connected]).toEqual([null, false]);
  });

  test('the app alone refuses the link the same way before any upgrade', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const plain = await hub.call('GET', '/api/runner/ws', { user: 'alice' });
    expect([plain.status, plain.json.error]).toEqual([426, 'upgrade_required']);
    const web = await hub.call('GET', '/api/runner/ws', { user: 'alice', via: 'web', headers: HANDSHAKE });
    expect([web.status, web.json.error]).toEqual([401, 'unauthorized']);
  });

  test('whoami answers { user } for a CLI token, and 401 for an expired one or a cookie', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, hub, token } = serve();
    const whoami = `${hub.url}/api/runner/whoami`;
    const ok = await fetch(whoami, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    expect(ok.status).toBe(200);
    expect(WhoamiResponseSchema.parse(await ok.json())).toEqual({ user: 'alice' });
    const web = createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'web');
    const cookie = await fetch(whoami, { headers: { cookie: `agflow_session=${web}` } });
    expect(await answer(cookie)).toEqual([401, 'unauthorized']);
    clock.advance(SESSION_TTL.cli);
    expect(await answer(await fetch(whoami, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }))).toEqual([
      401,
      'unauthorized',
    ]);
  });

  test('url names the bound port, and stop() closes the runners and the server', async () => {
    const { ctx, hub, token } = serve();
    expect(hub.url).toMatch(/^http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:\d+$/);
    expect(Number(new URL(hub.url).port)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(hub.scheduler).toBeNull();
    const runner = await connectFakeRunnerWs(hub.url, { token, now: ctx.now });
    await hub.stop();
    await until(() => !runner.connected);
    // The hub closes with 1001 (going away); Bun's WebSocket client reports that code as 1000.
    expect(runner.connected).toBe(false);
    expect(runner.closedWith?.reason).toBe('the hub is stopping');
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1').state).toBe('offline');
    expect(await fetch(`${hub.url}/api/status`).catch(() => 'refused')).toBe('refused');
  });

  test('a malformed hello closes with 1008 and a reason cut to 123 bytes at a character boundary', async () => {
    const { hub, token } = serve();
    const url = new URL('/api/runner/ws', hub.url);
    url.protocol = 'ws:';
    const socket = new WebSocket(url, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    const closed = new Promise<CloseEvent>((resolve) => socket.addEventListener('close', resolve));
    await new Promise((resolve) => socket.addEventListener('open', resolve));
    const fake = new FakeRunner(() => {
      throw new Error('unused');
    });
    // zod's message quotes the unknown key: 2-byte characters past byte 123 make a cut fall inside one.
    socket.send(JSON.stringify({ ...fake.hello(), [`x${'é'.repeat(60)}`]: 1 }));
    const event = await closed;
    expect(event.code).toBe(BAD_MESSAGE_CLOSE);
    expect(event.reason).toStartWith('expected a hello: ');
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(event.reason)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(123);
  });
});

describe('timers', () => {
  const timings = { heartbeatMs: 20, deadLinkMs: 60_000 };

  test('with timers on the server sweeps dead links and sign-ins and refreshes needs_login', async () => {

    expect(silent.connected).toBe(true);

    await until(() => getRunner(ctx, 'R-1').state === 'offline');
    deleteSession(ctx, token);
    clock.advance(SESSION_TTL.web);
    await Bun.sleep(100);
    expect(getRunner(ctx, 'R-1').state).toBe('offline');
    expect(sessionRow(ctx, web)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(hub.gateway.sweepDeadLinks()).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The runner link's HTTP side (design 6.3, 6.16): the WebSocket upgrade at /api/runner/ws, and the whoami probe a
// runner calls after a refused upgrade, because a refused WebSocket client sees only "Expected 101".
import { sessionHashOf } from '../auth';
import { unauthorized, upgradeRequired } from '../errors';
import type { LinkSession } from '../gateway';
import type { App, Principal } from './app';
import { type Ctx, principal } from './util';

/** Upgrades the request to a runner link signed in with the session; false when it is no WebSocket handshake. */
export type RunnerLinkUpgrade = (request: Request, session: LinkSession) => boolean;

/**
 * Only a CLI session opens the runner link or passes its probe. A browser's cookie never does, so a page cannot open
 * a link with the cookie the browser attaches; agent tokens never get here (the route allowlist refuses them).
 */
function cliSession(c: Ctx): Principal {
  const p = principal(c);
  if (p.via !== 'cli') throw unauthorized('the runner link needs a CLI token: run agflow login');
  return p;
}

export function mountRunnerRoutes(app: App, upgrade: RunnerLinkUpgrade | undefined): void {
  app.get('/api/runner/whoami', (c) => c.json({ user: cliSession(c).user }));

  app.get('/api/runner/ws', (c) => {
    const p = cliSession(c);
    const handshake = c.req.header('upgrade')?.toLowerCase() === 'websocket';
    if (!handshake || !upgrade?.(c.req.raw, { user: p.user, sessionHash: sessionHashOf(p.token) })) {
      throw upgradeRequired('GET /api/runner/ws opens the runner link: send a WebSocket handshake');
    }
    // Bun answers the handshake itself once the upgrade succeeds, and ignores this response.
    return new Response(null);
  });
}
```

```ts
// startHub (design 13): the HTTP API, the web UI and the runner link on one port, the link through Bun's own
// WebSocket handlers. main.ts serves the hub with it; tests and the demo pass their own context.
import type { Server, ServerWebSocket } from 'bun';
import { sweepAuth } from './auth';
import { type HubContext, NO_RUNNER_LINK } from './context';
import { Gateway, type LinkSession, type LinkSocket, type RunnerConnection } from './gateway';
import { createApp } from './http/app';
import { refreshNeedsLogin } from './runners';

export interface StartHubOptions {
  /** 0, the default, binds a free port; HubServer.url names it. */
  port?: number | undefined;
  /** 127.0.0.1 by default. */
  hostname?: string | undefined;
  /**
   * How the scheduler runs: 'auto' on its own timer, 'manual' only when the caller ticks or starts it, false not at
   * all (the default). This version of the hub has no scheduler yet, so every value runs none.
   */
  scheduler?: 'auto' | 'manual' | false | undefined;
  /** Keep a lock file next to the database while the hub runs; false by default. This version takes no lock yet. */
  dbLock?: boolean | undefined;
  /**
   * The hub's own housekeeping, once per heartbeatMs: dead links are terminated, expired sign-ins removed, and
   * offline runners whose session no longer verifies marked needs_login. True by default; tests that drive the
   * clock themselves turn it off.
   */
  timers?: boolean | undefined;
}

export interface HubServer {
  /** The bound origin, such as http://127.0.0.1:43211. */
  url: string;
  gateway: Gateway;
  /** The scheduler the options asked for; none in this version. */
  scheduler: null;
  /** Closes every runner link, stops the timers and the server. */
  stop(): Promise<void>;
}

/** What each runner link's socket carries: its session from before the upgrade, then its gateway connection. */
interface LinkData {
  session: LinkSession;
  connection: RunnerConnection | null;
}

/** The most bytes a WebSocket close reason may hold (RFC 6455: 125 less the 2-byte code); Bun cuts at 123. */
const CLOSE_REASON_BYTES = 123;

/**
 * A close reason cut to fit, at a character boundary. Bun cuts a longer one by bytes, and a cut inside a multi-byte
 * character makes the client drop the frame as invalid UTF-8 (1003) and lose the hub's code.
 */
function closeReason(text: string): string {
  let out = '';
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const char of text) {
    const size = Buffer.byteLength(char);
    if (bytes + size > CLOSE_REASON_BYTES) break;
    bytes += size;
    out += char;
  }
  return out;
}

function linkSocket(ws: ServerWebSocket<LinkData>): LinkSocket {
  return {
    send: (text) => ws.send(text),
    close: (code, reason) => ws.close(code, closeReason(reason)),
    terminate: () => ws.terminate(),
  };
}

/** Each duty in its own try, so one failing does not skip the others; the next round runs them all again. */
function housekeeping(ctx: HubContext, gateway: Gateway): void {
  const duties: [string, () => unknown][] = [
    ['the dead-link sweep', () => gateway.sweepDeadLinks()],
    ['the auth sweep', () => sweepAuth(ctx)],
    ['the needs_login refresh', () => refreshNeedsLogin(ctx)],
  ];
  for (const [name, duty] of duties) {
    try {
      duty();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`${name} failed`, error);
    }
  }
}

export function startHub(ctx: HubContext, options: StartHubOptions = {}): HubServer {
  const gateway = new Gateway(ctx);
  // The app is made before the server it upgrades links on, so it reaches the server through this binding.
  let upgrader: Server<LinkData> | undefined;
  const upgradeRunnerLink = (request: Request, session: LinkSession) =>
    upgrader?.upgrade(request, { data: { session, connection: null } }) ?? false;
  const app = createApp(ctx, { upgradeRunnerLink });
  const server = Bun.serve<LinkData>({
    hostname: options.hostname ?? '127.0.0.1',
    port: options.port ?? 0,
    idleTimeout: 120,
    fetch: app.fetch,
    websocket: {
      open(ws) {
        ws.data.connection = gateway.open(linkSocket(ws), ws.data.session);
      },
      message(ws, message) {
        const { connection } = ws.data;
        if (connection) gateway.message(connection, typeof message === 'string' ? message : message.toString('utf8'));
      },
      close(ws) {
        if (ws.data.connection) gateway.closed(ws.data.connection);
      },
    },
  });
  upgrader = server;
  const timer = (options.timers ?? true) ? setInterval(() => housekeeping(ctx, gateway), ctx.config.heartbeatMs) : null;
  return {
    url: server.url.origin,
    gateway,
    scheduler: null,
    async stop() {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
      gateway.closeAll();
      if (ctx.link === gateway) ctx.link = NO_RUNNER_LINK;
      // The port closes at once. Its promise is not awaited: in Bun 1.3.11 it never settles once the server has
      // closed a WebSocket itself, as closeAll just did.
      void server.stop(true);
    },
  };
}
```

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

Hono's Bun WebSocket helper has no `terminate()`, so the link uses `Bun.serve`'s own handlers through `server.upgrade`, called from a Hono route so the allowlist still sees it. `app.request()` cannot upgrade: link tests run a real server on port 0 and poll with `until()` rather than sleep. A close reason is cut to at most 123 UTF-8 bytes at a code-point boundary. With `timers` on, housekeeping runs every `heartbeatMs`: dead links, expired sign-ins, and needs_login for offline runners.

### Task 24: Inbound runner events

Runner events apply one at a time, each in its own savepoint, after the checks that decide whether it is current (design 6.3, Events). Invalid, unknown, throwing and out-of-list events become rejects (X-3), and the cumulative acknowledgement advances past every event, rejected or not, so one bad event never blocks a runner's outbox. A message that fails as a whole applies nothing and gets no ack: the store failed outside the per-event savepoints, or its events skip one the runner emitted after its hello. The gateway then closes the link with 1011, and the runner reconnects and replays from the acknowledged position. Events of ended, re-fenced or unknown attempts follow per-type stale rules: WIP and late work are still recorded, submission outcomes and hand-backs always apply, and other types are logged as rejected (the notes give each rule). During the replay after a restore, a newer fence counts as current (X-1). Later tasks register their handlers in `EVENT_HANDLERS`, and the `runner.*` events are handled here.
