```ts
  test('a failure leaves nothing behind', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    const before = counts(ctx);
    ctx.db.run(
      "CREATE TRIGGER no_commands BEFORE INSERT ON runner_commands BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the disk is full'); END",
    );
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      'the disk is full',
    );
    expect(counts(ctx)).toEqual(before);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', assignee: null, currentAttempt: null, branch: null });
  });

  test('a second open attempt is refused, and so is a task that is not ready or a runner that does not exist', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    const first = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      `${task.id} already has an open attempt, ${first.attempt.id}`,
    );
    // Even back at ready, the task's open attempt keeps a new one out until it ends.
    tx(ctx, (emit) => move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, task.id), 'ready', 'system'));
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      'already has an open attempt',
    );
    const [other] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Other' })], 'user:alice');
    if (!other) throw new Error('no task');
    tx(ctx, (emit) => move(ctx, emit, other, 'cancelled', 'user:alice'));
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: other.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      `${other.id} is cancelled, not ready`,
    );
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: 'R-99', taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      'runner R-99 not found',
    );
    expect(listAttempts(ctx)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('ids and names follow naming.ts at epoch 1 and 2', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    const first = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(first.attempt.id).toBe('T-1-a1');
    expect(first.attempt.wipRef).toBe('refs/agflow/T-1/a1');
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).branch).toBe('agflow/T-1-fix-the-parser');

    // After a restore the epoch is 2: new attempts, refs and branches carry it.
    ctx.db.run('UPDATE project SET epoch = 2');
    const [fresh] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Fix the lexer' })], 'user:alice');
    if (!fresh) throw new Error('no task');
    const second = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: fresh.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(second.attempt.id).toBe('T-2-e2-a1');
    expect(second.attempt.fence.epoch).toBe(2);
    expect(second.attempt.wipRef).toBe('refs/agflow/T-2/e2-a1');
    expect(getTask(ctx, fresh.id).branch).toBe('agflow/T-2-e2-fix-the-lexer');
    const spec = (pendingCommands(ctx, runnerId, 1).at(-1)?.command as { attempt: { branch: string } }).attempt;
    expect(spec.branch).toBe('agflow/T-2-e2-fix-the-lexer');

    // A successor numbers on from the task's earlier attempts. Its branch was named at epoch 1, before the restore,
    // so it gets the current epoch's name, and the head recorded for the old name goes with it.
    updateAttempt(ctx, first.attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'stopped', endedAt: ctx.now() });
    tx(ctx, (emit) =>
      move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, task.id), 'ready', 'system', {
        changes: { assignee: null, branchHead: 'd'.repeat(40) },
      }),
    );
    const third = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(third.attempt.id).toBe('T-1-e2-a2');
    expect(third.attempt.wipRef).toBe('refs/agflow/T-1/e2-a2');
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).branch).toBe('agflow/T-1-e2-fix-the-parser');
    expect(branchHead(ctx, task.id)).toBeNull();

    // A branch named at the current epoch is the task's own: the next attempt keeps it and its recorded head.
    updateAttempt(ctx, third.attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'stopped', endedAt: ctx.now() });
    tx(ctx, (emit) =>
      move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, task.id), 'ready', 'system', {
        changes: { assignee: null, branchHead: 'e'.repeat(40) },
      }),
    );
    startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).branch).toBe('agflow/T-1-e2-fix-the-parser');
    expect(branchHead(ctx, task.id)).toBe('e'.repeat(40));
  });

  test("a claim's branch outside the task's namespace is replaced by the task branch", () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    writeTask(ctx, task.id, { branch: 'feature/parser' });
    startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).branch).toBe('agflow/T-1-fix-the-parser');
  });
});

describe('the attempt spec', () => {
  test('starts from main without a work position, and carries the restore set, acceptance ids, caps and texts', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    const { attempt, agent, command } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, {
      runnerId,
      taskId: task.id,
      role: 'worker',
      vendor: 'claude',
      model: 'claude-opus-5-5',
    });
    if (command.command.kind !== 'start_attempt') throw new Error('not a start');
    const spec = command.command.attempt;
    const held = getTask(ctx, task.id);
    expect(spec).toEqual({
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      taskId: task.id,
      role: 'worker',
      vendor: 'claude',
      model: 'claude-opus-5-5',
      fence: attempt.fence,
      hubUrl: 'http://hub.test',
      repo: { url: 'https://github.com/acme/demo', mainBranch: 'main' },
      start: { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null },
      branch: 'agflow/T-1-fix-the-parser',
      wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1',
      restore: { paths: restoreSet(held), base: 'refs/heads/main' },
      acceptanceIds: ['A1', 'A2'],
      toolCaps: computeToolCaps(ctx.config, held.checks),
      taskPack: composeTaskPack(held),
      brief: buildBrief(ctx, getAgent(ctx, agent.id)),
      firstPrompt: firstPrompt({ role: 'worker', taskId: task.id, successor: false }),
      successor: false,
    });
    expect(spec.toolCaps.checks).toEqual([{ cmd: 'bun test', capMs: 7200 * 1000 + 10 * 60_000 }]);
    expect(spec.restore.paths).toContain('.claude/**');
    expect(spec.brief).toContain('the runner pushes for you');
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({ startRef: 'refs/heads/main', startSha: null });
  });

  test('starts from the work position, and a successor restates first', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    const sha = 'c'.repeat(40);
    writeTask(ctx, task.id, { workRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', workSha: sha });
    expect(startPositionFor(ctx, getTask(ctx, task.id))).toEqual({ ref: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', sha });
    expect(startPositionFor(ctx, null)).toEqual({ ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null });
    // An earlier live-chat attempt makes this one a successor.
    ctx.db.run(
      `INSERT INTO attempts (id, task_id, number, role, agent_id, runner_id, vendor, fence_epoch, fence_counter, status,
         end_reason, started_at, ended_at, last_activity_at)
       VALUES ('T-1-a1', 'T-1', 1, 'worker', 'A-9', NULL, 'claude', 1, 1, 'ended', 'released', 0, 0, 0)`,
    );
    const { attempt, command } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    if (command.command.kind !== 'start_attempt') throw new Error('not a start');
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({ id: 'T-1-a2', startRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', startSha: sha });
    expect(command.command.attempt).toMatchObject({
      start: { ref: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', sha },
      successor: true,
      firstPrompt: firstPrompt({ role: 'worker', taskId: task.id, successor: true }),
    });
    expect(command.command.attempt.brief).toContain('## Handoff from the previous attempt');
  });

  test('the stored payload has no token; each wire command mints one for the attempt and its fence', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    const { attempt, command } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    const { payload } = ctx.db.query('SELECT payload FROM runner_commands WHERE id = $id').get({ id: command.id }) as {
      payload: string;
    };
    expect(payload).not.toContain('agt_');
    expect(JSON.parse(payload).attempt).not.toHaveProperty('agentToken');
    const wire = toWireCommand(ctx, command);
    expect(RunnerCommandSchema.parse(wire.command).kind).toBe('start_attempt');
    if (wire.command.kind !== 'start_attempt') throw new Error('not a start');
    expect(AttemptSpecSchema.parse(wire.command.attempt).agentToken).toStartWith('agt_');
    expect(resolveAgentToken(ctx, wire.command.attempt.agentToken).attempt.id).toBe(attempt.id);
  });
});

describe('lead attempts', () => {
  test('have no task, branch or WIP ref, start at main and take the seat', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId } = setup();
    const live = addAgent(ctx, 'alice', 'lead');
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBe(live.id);
    // A live lead holds the seat: no runner lead starts.
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      `${live.id} holds the lead seat`,
    );
    ctx.db.run("UPDATE hub_state SET lead_agent_id = NULL, lead_kind = NULL, lead_since = NULL");
    const { attempt, agent, command } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({
      id: 'lead-a1',
      taskId: null,
      role: 'lead',
      wipRef: null,
      startRef: 'refs/heads/main',
      status: 'starting',
      leaseExpiresAt: ctx.now() + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs,
    });
    expect(agent).toMatchObject({ role: 'lead', currentTask: null, attemptId: 'lead-a1' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ leadAgentId: agent.id, leadKind: 'runner' });
    // The live lead's row is demoted, so only the seat holder reads as lead.
    expect(getAgent(ctx, live.id).role).toBe('worker');
    const wire = toWireCommand(ctx, command).command;
    if (wire.kind !== 'start_attempt') throw new Error('not a start');
    const spec = AttemptSpecSchema.parse(wire.attempt);
    expect(spec).toMatchObject({
      taskId: null,
      branch: null,
      wipRef: null,
      start: { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null },
      restore: { paths: restoreSet(null), base: 'refs/heads/main' },
      acceptanceIds: [],
      taskPack: '',
      successor: false,
      firstPrompt: firstPrompt({ role: 'lead', taskId: null, successor: false }),
    });
    expect(spec.brief).toContain('the lead manager');
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).find((event) => event.type === 'attempt.started')?.subject).toBe('lead-a1');
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.seat_changed').at(-1)?.data).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'runner',
      agentId: agent.id,
      attemptId: 'lead-a1',
    });
    // A second lead while this one holds the seat is refused.
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      'holds the lead seat',
    );
    expect(findAttempt(ctx, 'lead-a2')).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a worker attempt needs a task, and a lead attempt none', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task } = setup();
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      'a worker attempt needs a task',
    );
    expect(() => startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' })).toThrow(
      'a lead attempt takes no task',
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
// Runner attempts (design 6.4): the one transaction that starts one, and the AttemptSpec its start_attempt carries.
import {
  type Agent,
  type AgentRole,
  type Attempt,
  type AttemptSpec,
  type Task,
  type Vendor,
  attemptId,
  branchEpoch,
  computeToolCaps,
  isTaskBranch,
  leadAttemptId,
  restoreSet,
  taskBranchName,
  wipRef,
} from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent } from './agents';
import { attemptSubject, insertAttempt, issueFence, nextAttemptNumber, openAttemptOf } from './attempt-store';
import { buildBrief, composeTaskPack, firstPrompt, isSuccessor } from './brief';
import { type CommandRow, enqueueCommand } from './commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from './context';
import { nextId } from './db';
import { badRequest, conflict, notFound } from './errors';
import type { Emit } from './events';
import { seatHolderId, takeSeat } from './hub-state';
import { getProject } from './project';
import { findRunnerRow } from './runners';
import { findTask, getTask, move, setAgentTask } from './task-store';

export interface StartAttemptInput {
  runnerId: string;
  /** The task a worker takes; null for a lead attempt. */
  taskId: string | null;
  role: AgentRole;
  vendor: Vendor;
  /** Null, the default: the runner's model for the vendor and role. */
  model?: string | null | undefined;
  /** Who starts it: the scheduler by default. */
  actor?: string | undefined;
}

export interface StartedAttempt {
  attempt: Attempt;
  agent: Agent;
  /** The start_attempt queued for the runner. */
  command: CommandRow;
}

/** The base the runner resolves the restore set against: main, by name, because the hub has no git (X-16). */
const restoreBase = (ctx: HubContext): string => `refs/heads/${ctx.config.mainBranch}`;

/**
 * Where an attempt starts (design 6.4, Work position): the task's work position, or main when it has none, as for
 * every lead attempt. The runner fetches the ref and reports the commit it actually used.
 */
export function startPositionFor(ctx: HubContext, task: Task | null): AttemptSpec['start'] {
  if (task?.workRef) return { ref: task.workRef, sha: task.workSha };
  return { ref: restoreBase(ctx), sha: null };
}

/** The restore set and its base, recomputed for every start and resume (X-16). */
function restoreFor(ctx: HubContext, task: Task | null): AttemptSpec['restore'] {
  return { paths: restoreSet(task), base: restoreBase(ctx) };
}

/**
 * The spec of a start_attempt (design 6.3), without the agent token, which is minted for each send. Call it once the
 * attempt, its agent and the claim exist: the brief describes them.
 */
export function buildAttemptSpec(
  ctx: HubContext,
  attempt: Attempt,
  model: string | null = null,
): Omit<AttemptSpec, 'agentToken'> {
  const task = attempt.taskId === null ? null : getTask(ctx, attempt.taskId);
  const successor = isSuccessor(attempt);
  return {
    attemptId: attempt.id,
    taskId: attempt.taskId,
    role: attempt.role,
    vendor: attempt.vendor,
    model,
    fence: attempt.fence,
    hubUrl: ctx.config.publicUrl,
    repo: { url: getProject(ctx).repo, mainBranch: ctx.config.mainBranch },
    start: { ref: attempt.startRef ?? restoreBase(ctx), sha: attempt.startSha },
    branch: task?.branch ?? null,
    wipRef: attempt.wipRef,
    restore: restoreFor(ctx, task),
    acceptanceIds: task?.acceptance.map((criterion) => criterion.id) ?? [],
    toolCaps: computeToolCaps(ctx.config, task?.checks ?? []),
    // A lead holds no task, so its task.md is empty; its brief carries what it needs.
    taskPack: task ? composeTaskPack(task) : '',
    brief: buildBrief(ctx, getAgent(ctx, attempt.agentId)),
    firstPrompt: firstPrompt({ role: attempt.role, taskId: attempt.taskId, successor }),
    successor,
  };
}

/**
 * The branch a task's runner attempts commit on (design 6.14, 10): the one it has, when that lies in its namespace and
 * was named in the current epoch, or a new name. At epoch 1 every recorded branch is current; from epoch 2 a branch
 * named before the restore is left alone, so nothing collides with what existed then.
 */
function branchFor(task: Task, epoch: number): string {
  const current = isTaskBranch(task.id, task.branch) && (epoch === 1 || branchEpoch(task.branch) === epoch);
  return current ? (task.branch as string) : taskBranchName(task.id, task.title, epoch);
}

/** The data every event about one attempt carries (design 6.17). */
export function attemptData(attempt: Attempt): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { attemptId: attempt.id, taskId: attempt.taskId, agentId: attempt.agentId, runnerId: attempt.runnerId };
}

/** Checks that the attempt may start, and returns its task (null for a lead). */
function checkStart(ctx: HubContext, input: StartAttemptInput): Task | null {
  if (input.role === 'lead') {
    if (input.taskId !== null) throw badRequest('a lead attempt takes no task');
    const holder = seatHolderId(ctx);
    if (holder !== null) throw conflict(`${holder} holds the lead seat`);
    return null;
  }
  if (input.taskId === null) throw badRequest('a worker attempt needs a task');
  const task = findTask(ctx, input.taskId);
  if (!task) throw notFound(`task ${input.taskId}`);
  const open = openAttemptOf(ctx, task.id);
  if (open) throw conflict(`${task.id} already has an open attempt, ${open.id}`);
  if (task.status !== 'ready') throw conflict(`${task.id} is ${task.status}, not ready`);
  return task;
}

/**
 * Starts a runner attempt (design 6.4, Creating an attempt). In one transaction: the agent (origin runner, owned by
 * the runner's owner), the attempt (starting, a new fence, a runner lease), the claim on the task, or the lead seat
 * for a lead, and start_attempt. The agent token is minted when the command is sent, so none is stored. A task holds
 * at most one open attempt; a lead starts only while the seat is empty.
 */
export function startRunnerAttempt(ctx: HubContext, input: StartAttemptInput): StartedAttempt {
  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
    const actor = input.actor ?? 'system';
    const runner = findRunnerRow(ctx, input.runnerId);
    if (!runner) throw notFound(`runner ${input.runnerId}`);
    const task = checkStart(ctx, input);
    const now = ctx.now();
    const number = nextAttemptNumber(ctx, task?.id ?? null);
    const fence = issueFence(ctx);
    const id = task ? attemptId(task.id, number, fence.epoch) : leadAttemptId(number, fence.epoch);
    const agentSeq = nextId(ctx.db, 'agent');
    const agentId = `A-${agentSeq}`;
    ctx.db
      .query(
        `INSERT INTO agents (id, seq, login, vendor, role, origin, label, current_task, last_seen_at, created_at,
           runner_id, attempt_id)
         VALUES ($id, $seq, $login, $vendor, $role, 'runner', $label, NULL, $now, $now, $runnerId, $attemptId)`,
      )
      .run({
        id: agentId,
        seq: agentSeq,
        login: runner.owner,
        vendor: input.vendor,
        role: input.role,
        label: id,
        now,
        runnerId: runner.id,
        attemptId: id,
      });
    const start = startPositionFor(ctx, task);
    const attempt = insertAttempt(ctx, {
      id,
      taskId: task?.id ?? null,
      number,
      role: input.role,
      agentId,
      runnerId: runner.id,
      vendor: input.vendor,
      fence,
      status: 'starting',
      startRef: start.ref,
      startSha: start.sha,
      wipRef: task ? wipRef(ctx.config.wipRefPrefix, id) : null,
      leaseExpiresAt: now + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs,
    });
    claim(ctx, emit, task, attempt, actor);
    const command = enqueueCommand(ctx, runner.id, {
      kind: 'start_attempt',
      attempt: buildAttemptSpec(ctx, attempt, input.model ?? null),
    });
    emit({
      type: 'attempt.started',
      actor,
      subject: attemptSubject(attempt),
      data: { ...attemptData(attempt), vendor: attempt.vendor, role: attempt.role },
    });
    return { attempt, agent: getAgent(ctx, agentId), command };
  });
}

/**
 * Gives the attempt its work: the task claimed for its agent on the task branch, with no M1 lease (runner attempts
 * hold a runner lease instead), or the lead seat.
 */
function claim(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, task: Task | null, attempt: Attempt, actor: string): void {
  if (!task) {
    takeSeat(ctx, emit, attempt.agentId, 'runner', actor);
    return;
  }
  const branch = branchFor(task, attempt.fence.epoch);
  // A recorded head is the head of the branch it was recorded for; a new name starts with none (design 6.13).
  const branchHead = branch === task.branch ? undefined : null;
  move(ctx, emit, task, 'claimed', actor, {
    changes: { assignee: attempt.agentId, branch, branchHead, leaseExpiresAt: null },
    data: { assignee: attempt.agentId, attemptId: attempt.id },
  });
  setAgentTask(ctx, attempt.agentId, task.id);
}
```

A task keeps its branch only when it is current: `isTaskBranch(branch) && (epoch === 1 || branchEpoch(branch) === epoch)`; otherwise it gets `taskBranchName(task, title, epoch)` and the claim clears `branch_head`. `attemptData(attempt)` gives the four ids every attempt event carries (X-23). `addRunner` joins the test helpers.

### Task 28: Re-fencing and resuming attempts

A resume gives an attempt a new fence (design 6.4, Resume): it goes back to `starting` with a fresh lease, its old tokens are revoked, and the old fence's commands are cancelled. A pending resume's prompt and messages are carried over, the cause is logged, and `resume_attempt` goes out with a recomputed task pack, restore set and acceptance ids (6.3). A stop that was recorded and not deferred is queued again at the new fence, so a re-fence never drops it.

**Files:**
- Modify: `packages/hub/src/attempts.ts`
- Test: `packages/hub/test/attempts-resume.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type InjectedMessage, compareFence, restoreSet } from '@agflow/core';
import { attemptLog, getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { recentResumes, resumeAttempt, startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { mintAgentToken, resolveAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { composeTaskPack } from '../src/brief';
import { enqueueCommand, findCommand, pendingCommands, toWireCommand } from '../src/commands';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { getTask, writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { addRunner, addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext } from './helpers';

function setup() {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
  return { ctx, clock, held };
}

const note = (messageId: number, text: string): InjectedMessage => ({ messageId, authority: 'person', text });

describe('resuming an attempt', () => {
  test('sets starting with a higher fence and a renewed lease, and emits attempt.resumed', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, held } = setup();
    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    clock.advance(60_000);
    const { attempt, command } = resumeAttempt(ctx, {
      attemptId: held.attempt.id,
      cause: 'review',
      prompt: '> Handle empty lists.',
    });
    expect(compareFence(attempt.fence, held.attempt.fence)).toBe(1);
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({ status: 'starting', leaseExpiresAt: ctx.now() + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs });
    expect(command).toMatchObject({ kind: 'resume_attempt', attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence });
    const resumed = listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.resumed');
    expect(resumed.map((event) => [event.subject, event.data])).toEqual([
      [
        held.task.id,
        {
          attemptId: attempt.id,
          taskId: held.task.id,
          agentId: held.agent.id,
          runnerId: held.runner.id,
          fence: attempt.fence,
          reason: 'the review feedback goes back to its author',
        },
      ],
    ]);
    expect(attemptLog(ctx, attempt.id).map((entry) => [entry.kind, entry.summary])).toEqual([
      ['note', 'resumed at fence e1.2: the review feedback goes back to its author'],
    ]);
  });

  test('old tokens answer attempt_ended, and the new command carries a token that works', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    const old = mintAgentToken(ctx, held.attempt);
    expect(resolveAgentToken(ctx, old).attempt.id).toBe(held.attempt.id);
    const live = () =>
      ctx.db
        .query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM agent_tokens WHERE attempt_id = $id AND revoked_at IS NULL')
        .get({ id: held.attempt.id });
    const { command } = resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'runner_restart', prompt: 'continue' });
    // The old fence's tokens are revoked, not only refused, so retention can delete them.
    expect(live()).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(() => resolveAgentToken(ctx, old)).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'attempt_ended' }));
    const wire = toWireCommand(ctx, command).command;
    expect(live()).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    if (wire.kind !== 'resume_attempt') throw new Error('not a resume');
    expect(resolveAgentToken(ctx, wire.agentToken).attempt.fence).toEqual(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).fence);
    const { payload } = ctx.db.query('SELECT payload FROM runner_commands WHERE id = $id').get({ id: command.id }) as {
      payload: string;
    };
    expect(payload).not.toContain('agt_');
  });

  test("the old fence's pending commands are cancelled; a pending resume's prompt and messages move into the new one", () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    const { attempt } = held;
    const deliver = enqueueCommand(ctx, held.runner.id, {
      kind: 'deliver',
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      fence: attempt.fence,
      messages: [note(3, 'hi')],
      more: 0,
    });
    const cleanup = enqueueCommand(ctx, held.runner.id, { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: attempt.id });
    const first = resumeAttempt(ctx, {
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      cause: 'review',
      prompt: '> Handle empty lists.',
      messages: [note(4, 'also add a test')],
    });
    expect(findCommand(ctx, deliver.id)?.status).toBe('cancelled');
    expect(findCommand(ctx, cleanup.id)?.status).toBe('pending');
    // The first resume never reached the runner; the runner restarts and the hub re-fences again.
    const second = resumeAttempt(ctx, {
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      cause: 'runner_restart',
      prompt: 'the runner restarted; continue from your last step',
      messages: [note(4, 'also add a test'), note(5, 'and docs')],
    });
    expect(findCommand(ctx, first.command.id)?.status).toBe('cancelled');
    expect(second.command.command).toMatchObject({
      prompt: '> Handle empty lists.\n\nthe runner restarted; continue from your last step',
      messages: [note(4, 'also add a test'), note(5, 'and docs')],
    });
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['cleanup_attempt', 'resume_attempt']);
    // A third re-fence for the same reason does not repeat the line the carried prompt already ends with.
    const third = resumeAttempt(ctx, {
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      cause: 'runner_restart',
      prompt: 'the runner restarted; continue from your last step',
    });
    expect(third.command.command).toMatchObject({
      prompt: '> Handle empty lists.\n\nthe runner restarted; continue from your last step',
    });
  });

  test('the command carries a recomputed task pack, restore set and acceptance ids', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    writeTask(ctx, held.task.id, { feedback: 'Handle empty lists.' });
    const { command } = resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'review', prompt: 'fix it' });
    const task = getTask(ctx, held.task.id);
    expect(command.command).toEqual({
      kind: 'resume_attempt',
      attemptId: held.attempt.id,
      fence: getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).fence,
      prompt: 'fix it',
      messages: [],
      taskPack: composeTaskPack(task),
      restore: { paths: restoreSet(task), base: 'refs/heads/main' },
      acceptanceIds: ['A1'],
    });
    expect(composeTaskPack(task)).toContain('> Handle empty lists.');
  });

  test('a recorded stop is sent again at the new fence; a take-over or an ended attempt cannot be resumed', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    const stop = { cause: 'stop' as const, reason: 'a person stopped it', by: 'user:alice', handoff: true };
    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { stopRequested: { ...stop, deferred: false, at: ctx.now() } });
    const { attempt } = resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'restore', prompt: 'continue' });
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1).map((row) => [row.kind, row.fence])).toEqual([
      ['resume_attempt', attempt.fence],
      ['stop_attempt', attempt.fence],
    ]);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1).at(-1)?.command).toEqual({
      kind: 'stop_attempt',
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      fence: attempt.fence,
      cause: 'stop',
      reason: 'a person stopped it',
      handoff: true,
      interruptFirst: false,
      keepClone: false,
    });
    // A deferred stop waits for its submission: the re-fence does not send it.
    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { stopRequested: { ...stop, deferred: true, at: ctx.now() } });
    resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'restore', prompt: 'continue' });
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1).map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['resume_attempt']);

    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { stopRequested: { ...stop, cause: 'takeover', deferred: false, at: 0 } });
    expect(() => resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'restore', prompt: 'continue' })).toThrow(
      'a take-over is in flight',
    );
    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { status: 'ended', endReason: 'stopped', endedAt: ctx.now() });
    expect(() => resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'restore', prompt: 'continue' })).toThrow(
      `attempt ${held.attempt.id} has ended (stopped)`,
    );
  });

  test('a stop sent again at the new fence gets its grace again from the re-fence', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, held } = setup();
    const stop = { cause: 'stop' as const, reason: 'enough', by: 'user:alice', handoff: true, deferred: false };
    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { stopRequested: { ...stop, at: ctx.now() } });
    clock.advance(7 * 60_000);
    resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'restore', prompt: 'continue' });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested).toEqual({ ...stop, at: ctx.now() });
  });
});

describe('the resume log', () => {
  test('records runner_restart and lead_exit resumes, which recentResumes counts in a window', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, held } = setup();
    const resume = (cause: 'runner_restart' | 'lead_exit' | 'review') =>
      resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause, prompt: 'continue' });
    resume('runner_restart');
    clock.advance(10 * 60_000);
    resume('lead_exit');
    resume('review');
    clock.advance(10 * 60_000);
    resume('runner_restart');
    const hour = 60 * 60_000;
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, held.attempt.id, 'runner_restart', hour)).toBe(2);
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, held.attempt.id, 'lead_exit', hour)).toBe(1);
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, held.attempt.id, 'runner_restart', 15 * 60_000)).toBe(1);
    clock.advance(hour);
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, held.attempt.id, 'runner_restart', hour)).toBe(0);
    const { resume_log: log } = ctx.db.query('SELECT resume_log FROM attempts WHERE id = $id').get({
      id: held.attempt.id,
    }) as { resume_log: string };
    expect(JSON.parse(log).map((entry: { cause: string }) => entry.cause)).toEqual([
      'runner_restart',
      'lead_exit',
      'runner_restart',
    ]);
  });

  test("a holding lead's resume on its next delivery counts as a lead exit, as one in a turn does", () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const runnerId = addRunner(ctx);
    const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' });
    // Exited in a turn: resumed at once.
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'lead_exit', prompt: 'You exited; continue.' });
    // Exited while idle: resumed when its next message is delivered.
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'lead_exit', prompt: 'You have new messages.' });
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, attempt.id, 'lead_exit', ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs)).toBe(2);
  });
});
```

```diff
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/**
+ * What a resume is for: ladder step 1 (review feedback back to its author), a runner restart or suspend

+ * delivery after an idle one: design 6.11), or the re-fence after a restore.
+ */
+export type ResumeCause = 'review' | 'runner_restart' | 'lead_exit' | 'restore';
+
+const RESUME_CAUSES: Readonly<Record<ResumeCause, string>> = {
+  review: 'the review feedback goes back to its author',
+  runner_restart: 'the runner restarted',
+  lead_exit: 'the lead exited on its own',
+  restore: 'the hub was restored from a backup',

+
+/** How many resumes of this cause the attempt had within the last windowMs. */
+export function recentResumes(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string, cause: ResumeCause, windowMs: number): number {
+  const since = ctx.now() - windowMs;
+  return resumeLog(ctx, attemptId).filter((entry) => entry.cause === cause && entry.at > since).length;
+}
+
+/** The log with this resume added, keeping only entries a window can still count. */
+function loggedResume(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string, cause: ResumeCause): ResumeLogEntry[] | undefined {
+  if (!isLogged(cause)) return undefined;
+  const now = ctx.now();
+  const kept = Math.max(ctx.config.resumeWindowMs, ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs);
+  return [...resumeLog(ctx, attemptId).filter((entry) => entry.at > now - kept), { at: now, cause }];
+}
+
+/** The prompts and messages of a resume that a re-fence replaced, then this one's; a message once only. */
+function carriedOver(pending: CommandRow | null, input: ResumeInput): { prompt: string; messages: InjectedMessage[] } {
+  const earlier = pending?.command.kind === 'resume_attempt' ? pending.command : null;
+  const messages = [...(earlier?.messages ?? []), ...(input.messages ?? [])];
+  const seen = new Set<number>();
+  const unique = messages.filter((message) => {
+    // Id 0 is hub text with no message row; each copy may differ.
+    if (message.messageId === 0) return true;
+    if (seen.has(message.messageId)) return false;
+    seen.add(message.messageId);
+    return true;
+  });
+  // A prompt the carried one already ends with was carried by an earlier re-fence that never reached the runner.
+  const prompt =
+    earlier === null || earlier.prompt === input.prompt
+      ? input.prompt
+      : earlier.prompt.endsWith(`\n\n${input.prompt}`)
+        ? earlier.prompt
+        : `${earlier.prompt}\n\n${input.prompt}`;
+  return { prompt, messages: unique };
+}
+
+/** The stop_attempt for a recorded stop request, at the attempt's current fence. */
+export function stopCommand(attempt: Attempt): StoredCommand {
+  const stop = attempt.stopRequested;
+  if (!stop) throw new Error(`attempt ${attempt.id} has no stop request`);
+  return {
+    kind: 'stop_attempt',
+    attemptId: attempt.id,
+    fence: attempt.fence,
+    cause: stop.cause,
+    reason: stop.reason,
+    handoff: stop.handoff,
+    interruptFirst: STOP_CAUSES[stop.cause].interruptFirst,
+    keepClone: stop.cause === 'stop_hold',
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Resumes an open runner attempt with a new fence (design 6.4, Resume). In one transaction: the attempt goes to
+ * starting with a fresh runner lease, its tokens are revoked, its old fence's commands cancelled (a pending resume's
+ * prompt and messages carried into this one), the cause logged, and resume_attempt queued with a recomputed task
+ * pack, restore set and acceptance ids. A recorded stop is queued again at the new fence, after the resume, so the
+ * re-fence does not drop it, and its grace starts again. A deferred stop stays held back. A take-over in flight is the take-over's to finish, so it cannot be resumed.
+ */
+export function resumeAttempt(ctx: HubContext, input: ResumeInput): ResumedAttempt {
+  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
+    const before = getAttempt(ctx, input.attemptId);
+    if (before.status === 'ended') {
+      throw conflict(`attempt ${before.id} has ended (${before.endReason ?? 'unknown reason'})`);
+    }
+    if (before.runnerId === null) throw conflict(`attempt ${before.id} runs in a live chat, not on a runner`);
+    if (before.stopRequested?.cause === 'takeover') throw conflict(`a take-over is in flight for attempt ${before.id}`);
+    const pending = pendingResumeOf(ctx, before.id);
+    cancelPendingCommands(ctx, before.id);
+    revokeAgentTokens(ctx, before.id);
+    const fence = issueFence(ctx);
+    const now = ctx.now();
+    updateAttempt(ctx, before.id, {
+      fence,
+      status: 'starting',
+      leaseExpiresAt: now + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs,
+      resumeLog: loggedResume(ctx, before.id, input.cause),
+    });
+    ctx.db.query('UPDATE agents SET last_seen_at = $now WHERE id = $id').run({ now, id: before.agentId });
+    appendAttemptLog(ctx, before.id, 'note', `resumed at fence ${formatFence(fence)}: ${RESUME_CAUSES[input.cause]}`);
+    const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, before.id);
+    const task = attempt.taskId === null ? null : getTask(ctx, attempt.taskId);
+    const { prompt, messages } = carriedOver(pending, input);
+    const command = enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, {
+      kind: 'resume_attempt',
+      attemptId: attempt.id,
+      fence,
+      prompt,
+      messages,
+      taskPack: task ? composeTaskPack(task) : null,
+      restore: restoreFor(ctx, task),
+      acceptanceIds: task?.acceptance.map((criterion) => criterion.id) ?? [],
+    });
+    if (attempt.stopRequested && !attempt.stopRequested.deferred) {
+      // The new process gets the whole grace for its stop: the old one's may have run out before the re-fence.
+      updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { stopRequested: { ...attempt.stopRequested, at: now } });
+      enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, stopCommand(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)));
+    }
+    emit({
+      type: 'attempt.resumed',
+      actor: input.actor ?? 'system',
+      subject: attemptSubject(attempt),
+      data: { ...attemptData(attempt), fence, reason: RESUME_CAUSES[input.cause] },
+    });
+    return { attempt: getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id), command };
+  });
+}
```

### Task 29: Ending attempts

`endAttempt` is the one path every ending takes (design 6.4, Every way an attempt ends). It ends the attempt, revokes its tokens, cancels its commands, queues `cleanup_attempt`, clears the holder fields, and empties the seat for a lead. It makes the trigger table's on-exit move only from claimed or working, while the task still names the attempt, whatever triggered the ending (X-34). When the table asks for one and none was written, it stores an assembled handoff note with the attempt id (Task 26).

- Modify: `packages/hub/src/attempts.ts`
- Test: `packages/hub/test/attempts-end.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type EndingTrigger, type TaskStatus, failureSignature } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent } from '../src/agents';
import { getAttempt, insertAttempt, issueFence, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { endAttempt, startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { mintAgentToken, resolveAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { enqueueCommand, findCommand, pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { tx } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { assembleHandoffNote } from '../src/handoff';
import { getHubState, takeSeat } from '../src/hub-state';
import { addNote, getTask, listTaskNotes, move, writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { addAgent, addRunner, addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext, newTask } from './helpers';

type Ctx = ReturnType<typeof createTestContext>['ctx'];

function setup() {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
  return { ctx, clock, held };
}

const kinds = (ctx: Ctx, runnerId: string) => pendingCommands(ctx, runnerId, 1).map((row) => row.kind);

describe('ending an attempt', () => {
  test('sets the end, emits attempt.ended, revokes its tokens and cancels its commands but three kinds', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, held } = setup();
    const { attempt, runner } = held;
    const token = mintAgentToken(ctx, attempt);
    const queued = (['deliver', 'interrupt', 'cleanup_attempt', 'upload_transcript', 'hand_back'] as const).map((kind) =>
      enqueueCommand(
        ctx,
        runner.id,
        kind === 'deliver'
          ? { kind, attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence, messages: [], more: 0 }
          : kind === 'interrupt'
            ? { kind, attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence }
            : kind === 'hand_back'
              ? { kind, attemptId: attempt.id, source: { kind: 'clone' } }
              : { kind, attemptId: attempt.id },
      ),
    );
    clock.advance(5_000);
    const error = 'git push failed for /Users/bob/.agflow/vaults/demo.git: exit 128';
    const ending = endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'crashed', error });
    expect(ending?.attempt).toMatchObject({
      status: 'ended',
      endReason: 'crashed',
      failureClass: 'infra',
      failureSignature: failureSignature('crashed', error),
      endedAt: ctx.now(),
      leaseExpiresAt: null,
    });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toEqual(ending?.attempt as never);
    expect(() => resolveAgentToken(ctx, token)).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'attempt_ended' }));
    // Revoked, not only refused: retention deletes only revoked tokens.
    expect(
      ctx.db
        .query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM agent_tokens WHERE attempt_id = $id AND revoked_at IS NULL')
        .get({ id: attempt.id }),
    ).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(queued.map((row) => findCommand(ctx, row.id)?.status)).toEqual([
      'cancelled',
      'cancelled',
      'pending',
      'pending',
      'pending',
    ]);
    const ended = listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.ended');
    expect(ended.map((event) => [event.subject, event.data])).toEqual([
      [
        held.task.id,
        {
          attemptId: attempt.id,
          taskId: held.task.id,
          agentId: held.agent.id,
          runnerId: runner.id,
          endReason: 'crashed',
          failureClass: 'infra',
        },
      ],
    ]);
    // An ended attempt ends once.
    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' })).toBeNull();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).endReason).toBe('crashed');
  });

  test('only infra endings record a signature, and a row that ends nothing is refused', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    const ending = endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, trigger: 'stall_loop', error: 'loop' });
    expect(ending?.attempt).toMatchObject({ endReason: 'stalled', failureClass: 'agent', failureSignature: null });
    const lost = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: lost.attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' })?.attempt.failureSignature).toBeNull();
    const kept = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    for (const trigger of ['submission', 'review_resume', 'suspend', 'lead_exit'] as const) {
      expect(() => endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: kept.attempt.id, trigger })).toThrow(`${trigger} does not end an attempt`);
    }
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, kept.attempt.id).status).toBe('running');
  });
});

describe('cleanup', () => {
  test('is queued for every runner attempt but taken_over ones; live attempts queue nothing', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, trigger: 'stop' });
    expect(kinds(ctx, held.runner.id)).toEqual(['cleanup_attempt']);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1)[0]?.command).toEqual({
      kind: 'cleanup_attempt',
      attemptId: held.attempt.id,
    });

    const taken = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: taken.attempt.id, trigger: 'takeover' });
    expect(kinds(ctx, held.runner.id)).toEqual(['cleanup_attempt']);

    // A live chat's attempt has no runner, so nothing is queued and its task is M1's to move.
    const live = addAgent(ctx, 'bob');
    const liveAttempt = tx(ctx, () =>
      insertAttempt(ctx, {
        id: `${taken.task.id}-a2`,
        taskId: taken.task.id,
        number: 2,
        role: 'worker',
        agentId: live.id,
        runnerId: null,
        vendor: 'claude',
        fence: issueFence(ctx),
        status: 'running',
      }),
    );
    const before = ctx.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM runner_commands').get();
    const ending = endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: liveAttempt.id, trigger: 'released' });
    expect(ending?.attempt.endReason).toBe('released');
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM runner_commands').get()).toEqual(before);
    expect(ending?.moved).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('holder fields', () => {
  test("the agent's current task is cleared, and the task's assignee unless it is submitted or accepted", () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    expect(getAgent(ctx, held.agent.id).currentTask).toBe(held.task.id);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, trigger: 'stop' });
    expect(getAgent(ctx, held.agent.id).currentTask).toBeNull();
    expect(getTask(ctx, held.task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', assignee: null });

    // A submitted task keeps its assignee: it names whose work is in review.
    const submitted = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    tx(ctx, (emit) => move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, submitted.task.id), 'submitted', 'system'));
    updateAttempt(ctx, submitted.attempt.id, { status: 'holding' });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: submitted.attempt.id, trigger: 'cancel' });
    expect(getTask(ctx, submitted.task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'submitted', assignee: submitted.agent.id });
    expect(getAgent(ctx, submitted.agent.id).currentTask).toBeNull();

    // A task blocked at request time keeps its status, and loses its holder when the attempt ends.
    const blocked = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    tx(ctx, (emit) =>
      move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, blocked.task.id), 'blocked', 'system', { changes: { blockedKind: 'paused' } }),
    );
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: blocked.attempt.id, trigger: 'stop_hold' });
    expect(getTask(ctx, blocked.task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'paused', assignee: null });

    // An accepted task keeps its assignee too: it names whose work was merged.
    const accepted = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    tx(ctx, (emit) => {
      const submittedTask = move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, accepted.task.id), 'submitted', 'system');
      move(ctx, emit, submittedTask, 'accepted', 'user:alice');
    });
    updateAttempt(ctx, accepted.attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: accepted.attempt.id, trigger: 'accepted' });
    expect(getTask(ctx, accepted.task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'accepted', assignee: accepted.agent.id });
    expect(getAgent(ctx, accepted.agent.id).currentTask).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('task moves on exit', () => {
  const onExit: [EndingTrigger, TaskStatus[]][] = [
    ['stop', ['ready']],
    ['replace', ['ready']],
    ['stall_silent', ['ready']],
    ['quota', ['ready']],
    ['released', ['ready']],
    ['runner_stop', ['ready']],
    ['crashed', ['ready']],
    ['failed_to_start', ['ready']],
    ['refused_start', ['ready']],
    ['lost', ['stale', 'ready']],
    ['cancel', []],
    ['blocked', []],
    ['superseded', []],
  ];

  test('each on-exit row moves a claimed or working task that names the attempt', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    for (const [trigger, path] of onExit) {
      for (const status of ['claimed', 'working'] as const) {
        const one = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
        if (status === 'working') tx(ctx, (emit) => move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, one.task.id), 'working', 'system'));
        const after = listEvents(ctx.db, { latest: true, limit: 1 })[0]?.id ?? 0;
        const ending = endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: one.attempt.id, trigger, actor: 'system' });
        expect([trigger, status, ending?.moved]).toEqual([trigger, status, path]);
        expect([trigger, getTask(ctx, one.task.id).status]).toEqual([trigger, path.at(-1) ?? status]);
        // Each status on the path is its own move, and names the attempt (X-23).
        const moves = listEvents(ctx.db, { after, subject: one.task.id })
          .filter((event) => event.type.startsWith('task.'))
          .map((event) => [event.type, event.data.attemptId]);
        expect([trigger, status, moves]).toEqual([trigger, status, path.map((to) => [`task.${to}`, one.attempt.id])]);
      }
    }
  });

  test('other tasks keep their status: one in another status, or one that names another attempt', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    tx(ctx, (emit) =>
      move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, held.task.id), 'blocked', 'system', { changes: { blockedKind: 'agent' } }),
    );
    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, trigger: 'stop' })?.moved).toEqual([]);
    expect(getTask(ctx, held.task.id).status).toBe('blocked');

    const other = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    writeTask(ctx, other.task.id, { currentAttempt: 'T-9-a9' });
    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: other.attempt.id, trigger: 'crashed' })?.moved).toEqual([]);
    expect(getTask(ctx, other.task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'claimed', assignee: other.agent.id });
  });
});

describe('assembled notes and the seat', () => {
  test('a note with the attempt id is stored when the row asks and the agent wrote none', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    // stop: if none written; the agent wrote none.

    const notes = listTaskNotes(ctx, held.task.id);
    expect(notes.map((note) => [note.kind, note.author, note.attemptId])).toEqual([
      ['handoff', 'system', held.attempt.id],

    expect(notes[0]?.body).toBe(assembleHandoffNote(ctx, getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id)).body);

    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: wrote.attempt.id, trigger: 'stop' })?.noteAdded).toBe(false);
    expect(listTaskNotes(ctx, wrote.task.id).map((note) => note.author)).toEqual([`agent:${wrote.agent.id}`]);

    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: quota.attempt.id, trigger: 'quota' })?.noteAdded).toBe(true);
    expect(listTaskNotes(ctx, quota.task.id).map((note) => note.author)).toEqual([`agent:${quota.agent.id}`, 'system']);

    // cancel: never.
    const cancelled = addRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: held.runner.id });
    expect(endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: cancelled.attempt.id, trigger: 'cancel' })?.noteAdded).toBe(false);
    expect(listTaskNotes(ctx, cancelled.task.id)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('ending the seat holder empties the seat and emits lead.seat_changed', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();

    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBe(agent.id);

    expect(ending).toMatchObject({ task: null, moved: [], noteAdded: false });
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ leadAgentId: null, leadKind: null });
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.seat_changed').at(-1)?.data).toEqual({

    const live = addAgent(ctx, 'alice');

    const changes = listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.seat_changed').length;
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: next.attempt.id, trigger: 'superseded' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ leadAgentId: live.id, leadKind: 'live' });
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.seat_changed')).toHaveLength(changes);
  });

  test("ending a task attempt of the seat holder leaves the seat as it was", () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const lead = addAgent(ctx, 'alice', 'lead');
    const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice');
    if (!task) throw new Error('no task');
    // A live lead may claim a task; its attempt is the lead's, but it holds the task, not the seat.
    const attempt = tx(ctx, () =>
      insertAttempt(ctx, {
        id: `${task.id}-a1`,
        taskId: task.id,
        number: 1,
        role: 'lead',
        agentId: lead.id,
        runnerId: null,
        vendor: 'claude',
        fence: issueFence(ctx),
        status: 'running',
      }),
    );
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'released' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ leadAgentId: lead.id, leadKind: 'live' });
  });
});
```

```diff
+  /** The attempt's task after the ending; null for a lead. */
+  task: Task | null;
+  /** The statuses the task passed through, in order; empty when it kept its status. */
+  moved: TaskStatus[];
+  /** Whether the hub stored an assembled handoff note for the task. */
+  noteAdded: boolean;
+}
+
+/** A task in these statuses keeps its assignee when the attempt ends: it names whose work is in review or merged. */
+const KEEPS_ASSIGNEE: readonly TaskStatus[] = ['submitted', 'accepted'];
+
+/**
+ * Ends an attempt, whatever triggered it (design 6.4): the one path every ending takes, in the caller's transaction or
+ * its own. It sets the end reason, class and failure signature from the trigger's row, revokes the tokens, cancels the
+ * pending commands (cleanup, transcript uploads and hand-backs stay) and queues cleanup_attempt, except for a take-over,
+ * whose cleanup follows its hand-back. It clears the holder fields (invariant e) and makes the row's on-exit move, only
+ * while the task is claimed or working and names this attempt (X-34). It stores an assembled handoff note, with the
+ * attempt's id, when the row asks and the agent wrote none, and empties the seat its lead held. A live chat's attempt
+ * only ends: M1's operations move its task. Null when the attempt had already ended.
+ */
+export function endAttempt(ctx: HubContext, input: EndAttemptInput): Ending | null {
+  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
+    const row = ENDING_MOVES[input.trigger];
+    if (row.endReason === null) throw new Error(`${input.trigger} does not end an attempt`);
+    const before = getAttempt(ctx, input.attemptId);
+    if (before.status === 'ended') return null;
+    const actor = input.actor ?? 'system';
+    const failureClass = endingClass(input.trigger);
+    updateAttempt(ctx, before.id, {
+      status: 'ended',
+      endReason: row.endReason,
+      failureClass,
+      failureSignature: signatureApplies(input.trigger) ? failureSignature(row.endReason, input.error ?? null) : null,
+      leaseExpiresAt: null,
+      endedAt: ctx.now(),
+    });
+    revokeAgentTokens(ctx, before.id);
+    const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, before.id);
+    let task = attempt.taskId === null ? null : getTask(ctx, attempt.taskId);
+    let moved: TaskStatus[] = [];
+    let noteAdded = false;
+    if (attempt.runnerId !== null) {
+      cancelPendingCommands(ctx, attempt.id);
+      if (row.endReason !== 'taken_over') {
+        enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId, { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: attempt.id });
+      }
+      setAgentTask(ctx, attempt.agentId, null);
+      if (task) {
+        ({ task, moved } = moveOnEnd(ctx, emit, task, attempt, input.trigger, actor));
+        noteAdded = addAssembledNote(ctx, attempt, input.trigger);
+      }
+    }
+    // Only a lead attempt with no task holds the seat; a live lead's task attempt leaves it alone.
+    if (attempt.taskId === null) emptySeat(ctx, emit, actor, attempt.agentId);
+    emit({
+      type: 'attempt.ended',
+      actor,
+      subject: attemptSubject(attempt),
+      data: { ...attemptData(attempt), endReason: attempt.endReason, failureClass },
+    });
+    return { attempt, task, moved, noteAdded };
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * The row's on-exit move, and the task's holder cleared unless its status keeps it. A task that names another attempt
+ * by now has another holder, so it keeps its assignee.
+ */
+function moveOnEnd(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  emit: Emit,
+  task: Task,
+  attempt: Attempt,
+  trigger: EndingTrigger,
+  actor: string,
+): { task: Task; moved: TaskStatus[] } {
+  const planned = plannedTaskMove(trigger, 'on_end', task, attempt.id);
+  const path = planned ? [...planned.path] : [];
+  const final = path.at(-1) ?? task.status;
+  const clear =
+    task.currentAttempt === attempt.id && task.assignee === attempt.agentId && !KEEPS_ASSIGNEE.includes(final);
+  if (path.length === 0) {
+    if (clear) writeTask(ctx, task.id, { assignee: null });
+    return { task: getTask(ctx, task.id), moved: [] };
+  }
+  let current = task;
+  for (const [index, status] of path.entries()) {
+    const changes = index === 0 && clear ? { assignee: null } : {};
+    current = move(ctx, emit, current, status, actor, { changes, data: { attemptId: attempt.id } });
+  }
+  return { task: current, moved: path };
+}
+
+/** Stores the assembled handoff note when the trigger's row asks for one (design 6.8). */
+function addAssembledNote(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt, trigger: EndingTrigger): boolean {
+  const { note } = ENDING_MOVES[trigger];
+  if (note === null || (note === 'if_none_written' && handoffWritten(ctx, attempt))) return false;
+  addNote(ctx, attempt.taskId as string, 'handoff', assembleHandoffNote(ctx, attempt).body, 'system', attempt.id);
+  return true;
+}
```

`endAttempt` returns `null` for an attempt that already ended, and throws for a trigger whose row ends nothing. At-once moves belong to the caller. A live-chat attempt only ends: M1's operations move its task (Task 42). `endAttempt` and `requestStop` open their own `tx()`, which nests as a savepoint in a caller's transaction.

### Task 30: Stop requests and stop timeouts

`requestStop` records the cause, makes the cause's at-once move while keeping the holder fields (design 6.4, invariant (e)), and sends `stop_attempt` with the cause's handoff and interrupt flags. An attempt with no live process ends at once. A second request follows X-34: a recorded take-over is never replaced, a deferred stop is replaced by any newer request, and a cause that moves the task at once replaces a plain stop, replace or stall. `expireStops` ends stops older than `stopGraceMs` with their cause.
