```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type Attempt, type RunnerEventData, failureSignature } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent } from '../src/agents';
import { getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import {
  endAttempt,
  expireStops,
  exitedInTurn,
  recentResumes,
  requestStop,
  resumeAttempt,
  startRunnerAttempt,
} from '../src/attempts';
import { createSession } from '../src/auth';
import { enqueueCommand } from '../src/commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { Gateway } from '../src/gateway';
import { getHubState } from '../src/hub-state';
import { ackMessages, listMessages, markDelivered, sendMessage } from '../src/messages';
import { getTask, listTaskNotes } from '../src/task-store';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { type FakeConnection, type FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addRunner, createTestContext, newTask } from './helpers';

const FINAL_SHA = 'c'.repeat(40);

type Exited = RunnerEventData['attempt.exited'];

/** A hub with runner R-1 (the key FakeRunner uses) connected, and a ready task. */
async function setup() {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const runnerId = addRunner(ctx, { vendors: ['claude', 'codex'] });
  const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Fix the parser' })], 'user:alice');
  if (!task) throw new Error('no task');
  const gateway = new Gateway(ctx);
  const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli') });
  return { ctx, clock, runnerId, task, runner };
}

/** An attempt on R-1 whose session is live: a worker at the task, or the lead when taskId is null. */
async function running(ctx: HubContext, runner: FakeRunner<FakeConnection>, runnerId: string, taskId: string | null) {
  const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId, role: taskId ? 'worker' : 'lead', vendor: 'claude' });
  await settle();
  runner.startRunning(attempt.id);
  await settle();
  return getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
}

/** The runner reports the attempt's process gone, at the attempt's fence as the hub has it now. */
async function exit(ctx: HubContext, runner: FakeRunner<FakeConnection>, attemptId: string, data: Partial<Exited> = {}) {
  runner.emit(
    'attempt.exited',
    {
      code: 0,
      signal: null,
      stoppedBy: 'none',
      handoffWritten: false,
      cause: null,
      finalSha: FINAL_SHA,
      finalWip: null,
      pushError: null,
      ...data,
    },
    { attemptId, fence: getAttempt(ctx, attemptId).fence },
  );
  await settle();
  return getAttempt(ctx, attemptId);
}

const rejects = (ctx: HubContext) => ctx.db.query('SELECT type, error FROM runner_event_rejects').all();
const finalSha = (ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt) =>
  (ctx.db.query('SELECT final_sha FROM attempts WHERE id = $id').get({ id: attempt.id }) as { final_sha: string | null })
    .final_sha;

describe('attempt.exited after a stop request', () => {
  test("ends the attempt with the cause's reason and class and makes the on-exit move", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'stall_silent', reason: 'no events for 10 min', by: 'system' });
    await settle();
    const ended = await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { stoppedBy: 'close', code: null, signal: 'SIGTERM' });
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'stalled', failureClass: 'agent', failureSignature: null });
    expect(finalSha(ctx, ended)).toBe(FINAL_SHA);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', assignee: null, nextDispatchAt: null });
    // The agent wrote no handoff, so the hub assembled one.
    expect(listTaskNotes(ctx, task.id).map((note) => [note.kind, note.author, note.attemptId])).toEqual([
      ['handoff', 'system', attempt.id],
    ]);
  });

  test("the hub's own request decides, whatever the runner says caused the exit", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'replace', reason: 'try codex', by: 'user:alice' });
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { cause: 'runner_stop' })).endReason).toBe('replaced');
  });

  test("an infra stop's failure signature names its cause, so only one cause repeated blocks the task", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const replaceFor = async (cause: 'quota' | 'vendor_error' | 'context') => {
      const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
      requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause, reason: `${cause} on ${attempt.id}`, by: 'system' });
      await settle();
      return exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { stoppedBy: 'close' });
    };
    const signatures = [];
    for (const cause of ['quota', 'vendor_error', 'context'] as const) {
      signatures.push((await replaceFor(cause)).failureSignature);
    }
    expect(signatures).toEqual(['replaced: quota', 'replaced: vendor_error', 'replaced: context']);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).status).toBe('ready');
    await replaceFor('quota');
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).status).toBe('ready');
    await replaceFor('quota');
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'replan' });
    const [notice] = listMessages(ctx, {}).filter((message) => message.to === 'lead');
    expect(notice?.body).toContain('> replaced: quota');
  });

  test('a stop that times out gets the same signature', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'auth', reason: 'the claude login expired', by: 'system' });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.stopGraceMs);
    expect(expireStops(ctx)).toBe(1);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ endReason: 'crashed', failureSignature: 'crashed: auth' });
  });
});

describe('attempt.exited without a stop request', () => {
  test("a runner's own stop ends it stopped, infra, without a backoff or a signature", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    const ended = await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { cause: 'runner_stop', stoppedBy: 'interrupt' });
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ endReason: 'stopped', failureClass: 'infra', failureSignature: null });
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', nextDispatchAt: null });
  });

  test('a suspend keeps the attempt open, its lease running without renewal', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    clock.advance(60_000);
    const kept = await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { cause: 'suspend', stoppedBy: 'sigterm', code: null });
    expect(kept).toMatchObject({ status: 'running', endReason: null, leaseExpiresAt: attempt.leaseExpiresAt });
    expect(finalSha(ctx, kept)).toBe(FINAL_SHA);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id).status).toBe('claimed');
  });

  test('an unrequested worker exit ends it crashed, infra, with a backoff and a signature', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    const ended = await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { code: 137 });
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({
      endReason: 'crashed',
      failureClass: 'infra',
      failureSignature: failureSignature('crashed', 'the agent exited with code 137'),
    });
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', nextDispatchAt: ctx.now() + 60_000 });
    const killed = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, killed.id, { code: null, signal: 'SIGKILL' })).failureSignature).toBe(
      'crashed: the agent was killed by SIGKILL',
    );
  });
});

describe('a lead that exits on its own', () => {
  /** The lead resumed, as the next delivery or an exit in a turn resumes it, and its session live again. */
  const resume = async (ctx: HubContext, runner: FakeRunner<FakeConnection>, attemptId: string) => {
    resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId, cause: 'lead_exit', prompt: 'You exited; continue.' });
    await settle();
    runner.startRunning(attemptId);
    await settle();
  };

  test('goes to holding with the seat kept; the third exit within leadExitWindowMs ends it crashed', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const lead = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, null);
    const first = await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id);
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null, endReason: null });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBe(lead.agentId);
    const holding = listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.holding');
    expect(holding.map((event) => [event.subject, event.data])).toEqual([
      [lead.id, { attemptId: lead.id, taskId: null, agentId: lead.agentId, runnerId, submissionId: null }],
    ]);
    // The exit is logged when it happens; the resume that follows adds nothing.
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, lead.id, 'lead_exit', ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs)).toBe(1);
    await resume(ctx, runner, lead.id);
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, lead.id, 'lead_exit', ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs)).toBe(1);
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id, { code: 1 })).status).toBe('holding');
    clock.advance(10 * 60_000);
    await resume(ctx, runner, lead.id);
    const third = await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id, { code: 1 });
    expect(third).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'crashed', failureClass: 'infra' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBeNull();
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.seat_changed').at(-1)?.data).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'none',
    });
  });

  test('exits are counted when they happen, not when the lead is resumed', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const minute = 60_000;
    const lead = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, null);
    // An idle exit at 0, resumed by a delivery at 59 minutes, then exits at 61 and 63: two within the hour.
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id)).status).toBe('holding');
    clock.advance(59 * minute);
    await resume(ctx, runner, lead.id);
    clock.advance(2 * minute);
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id)).status).toBe('holding');
    await resume(ctx, runner, lead.id);
    clock.advance(2 * minute);
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id)).status).toBe('holding');
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBe(lead.agentId);
  });

  test('exits further apart than leadExitWindowMs never add up to a crash', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const lead = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, null);
    await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id);
    for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) {
      clock.advance(ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs / 2 + 1);
      await resume(ctx, runner, lead.id);
      clock.advance(ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs / 2);
      expect((await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id)).status).toBe('holding');
    }
  });

  test("a lead's suspend keeps it running with its seat; the runner's own stop ends it stopped", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const lead = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, null);
    const kept = await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id, { cause: 'suspend', stoppedBy: 'sigterm', code: null });
    expect(kept).toMatchObject({ status: 'running', endReason: null, leaseExpiresAt: lead.leaseExpiresAt });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBe(lead.agentId);
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.holding')).toEqual([]);
    expect(recentResumes(ctx, lead.id, 'lead_exit', ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs)).toBe(0);
    const stopped = await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id, { cause: 'runner_stop', stoppedBy: 'interrupt' });
    expect(stopped).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'stopped', failureClass: 'infra' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBeNull();
  });

  test('exitedInTurn: the last phase was turn, or a message delivered to it is unacknowledged', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const lead = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, null);
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { phase: 'idle' });
    expect(exitedInTurn(ctx, getAttempt(ctx, lead.id))).toBe(false);
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { phase: 'turn' });
    expect(exitedInTurn(ctx, getAttempt(ctx, lead.id))).toBe(true);
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { phase: 'idle' });
    const message = sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:bob', to: 'lead', body: 'Split T-1.' });
    tx(ctx, (emit) => markDelivered(ctx, emit, lead.agentId, [message.id]));
    expect(exitedInTurn(ctx, getAttempt(ctx, lead.id))).toBe(true);
    ackMessages(ctx, getAgent(ctx, lead.agentId), [message.id]);
    expect(exitedInTurn(ctx, getAttempt(ctx, lead.id))).toBe(false);
  });

  test('a stop the hub asked for ends a lead with its cause', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const lead = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, null);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: lead.id, cause: 'rotation', reason: '20 wake-ups', by: 'system' });
    expect(await exit(ctx, runner, lead.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'rotated' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('exits that end nothing', () => {
  test('a holding attempt and one being taken over stay open', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    // A recorded submission moves the attempt to holding as it sends hold_attempt (design 6.13).
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    enqueueCommand(ctx, runnerId, { kind: 'hold_attempt', attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence });
    await settle();
    const holding = await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { stoppedBy: 'close' });
    expect(holding).toMatchObject({ status: 'holding', endReason: null });
    expect(finalSha(ctx, holding)).toBe(FINAL_SHA);

    const [other] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice');
    const taken = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, other?.id as string);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: taken.id, cause: 'takeover', reason: 'alice takes it over', by: 'user:alice' });
    expect((await exit(ctx, runner, taken.id)).status).toBe('running');
    expect(getTask(ctx, other?.id as string)).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'takeover' });
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('an exit of an ended attempt keeps its ending and records the final sha', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    const after = await exit(ctx, runner, attempt.id, { code: 1 });
    expect(after).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'lost', failureClass: 'infra' });
    expect(finalSha(ctx, after)).toBe(FINAL_SHA);
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```diff
+
+/** Unrequested lead exits within leadExitWindowMs: the one that reaches this count ends the attempt crashed. */
+const LEAD_EXITS_LIMIT = 3;
+
+/** How the process went, as the error of an unrequested exit's failure signature. */
+function exitError(data: RunnerEventData['attempt.exited']): string {
+  if (data.signal !== null) return `the agent was killed by ${data.signal}`;
+  return data.code === null ? 'the agent exited' : `the agent exited with code ${data.code}`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a lead was in a turn when its process exited (X-35): its last reported phase was turn, or a message
+ * delivered to it is still unacknowledged. Such a lead resumes at once with its unacknowledged deliveries; an idle one
+ * waits for its next delivery (design 6.11).
+ */
+export function exitedInTurn(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt): boolean {
+  if (attempt.phase === 'turn') return true;
+  return (
+    ctx.db.query('SELECT 1 FROM deliveries WHERE agent_id = $agentId AND acked_at IS NULL LIMIT 1').get({
+      agentId: attempt.agentId,
+    }) !== null
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * attempt.exited: the agent's process is gone, and the trigger table decides what follows (design 6.4). The harvested
+ * head is recorded in every case. An attempt that ended already keeps its ending (design 6.3). A holding attempt stays
+ * holding, and one being taken over waits for attempt.taken_over (invariant c). Otherwise:
+ * - a stop the hub asked for ends it with that cause, whatever the runner says caused the exit;
+ * - the runner's own stop ends it stopped (infra, with no backoff or signature);
+ * - a suspend keeps it open: its lease runs without renewal until the runner says hello again;
+ * - an unrequested worker exit ends it crashed (infra, with a backoff and a signature);
+ * - an unrequested lead exit moves it to holding, with its seat and no lease, unless it is the third within
+ *   leadExitWindowMs, which ends it crashed. Each such exit is logged in resume_log when it happens; the resume
+ *   that follows it, at once for an exit in a turn (exitedInTurn) and on the next delivery otherwise, is not.
+ * Returns the ending, or null when the attempt stays open or had ended.
+ */
+export function onExited(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  emit: Emit,
+  attempt: Attempt,
+  data: RunnerEventData['attempt.exited'],
+): Ending | null {
+  if (data.finalSha !== null) updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { finalSha: data.finalSha });
+  const how = `${exitError(data)}, stopped by ${data.stoppedBy}${data.cause ? ` (${data.cause})` : ''}`;
+  if (attempt.status === 'ended') {
+    appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `${how}, after it ended ${attempt.endReason ?? ''}`.trimEnd());
+    return null;
+  }
+  appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', how);
+  const stop = attempt.stopRequested;
+  if (attempt.status === 'holding' || stop?.cause === 'takeover') return null;
+  const actor = byRunner(attempt);
+  if (stop) return endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: stop.cause, actor });
+  if (data.cause === 'runner_stop') return endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'runner_stop', actor });
+  if (data.cause === 'suspend') return null;
+  const error = exitError(data);
+  if (attempt.role === 'lead') {
+    // The exit is logged as it happens: an idle lead is resumed only on its next delivery, maybe an hour later.
+    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { resumeLog: withLogEntry(ctx, attempt.id, 'lead_exit') });
+    if (recentResumes(ctx, attempt.id, 'lead_exit', ctx.config.leadExitWindowMs) < LEAD_EXITS_LIMIT) {
+      updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
+      emit({
+        type: 'attempt.holding',
+        actor,
+        subject: attemptSubject(attempt),
+        data: { ...attemptData(attempt), submissionId: null },
+      });
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+  return endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'crashed', error, actor });
+}
```

A lead exit is logged in `resume_log` when it happens, so the third-exit rule holds whatever cause the later resume uses. `endAttempt` defaults the error to the recorded stop's cause, so signatures read `replaced: quota` or `crashed: auth`.

### Task 34: Runner leases and heartbeat facts

A runner lease means the laptop is there (design 6.4, Runner lease). Heartbeats renew the leases of the attempts they list at the current fence and store their facts (6.8). A new link marks the facts stale until the next heartbeat, so no stall is judged on old facts. An expired lease ends its attempt lost and sends a held task through stale to ready with an assembled handoff note.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type Attempt, type AttemptFacts, attemptId } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent } from '../src/agents';
import { getAttempt, insertAttempt, issueFence, nextAttemptNumber, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { expireRunnerLeases, expireStops, factsAreFresh, requestStop, startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { createSession, mintAgentToken, resolveAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import type { HubContext } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { Gateway } from '../src/gateway';
import { getHubState } from '../src/hub-state';
import { listMessages } from '../src/messages';
import { getTask, listTaskNotes } from '../src/task-store';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { type FakeConnection, type FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addAgent, addRunner, createTestContext, newTask } from './helpers';

const MINUTE = 60_000;

/** The facts a runner reports for one attempt; the fence is the attempt's unless given. */
function factsOf(attempt: Attempt, overrides: Partial<AttemptFacts> = {}): AttemptFacts {
  return {
    attemptId: attempt.id,
    fence: attempt.fence,
    phase: 'turn',
    eventAgeMs: 5_000,
    tool: null,
    fsAgeMs: 20_000,
    commitAgeMs: null,
    turns: 3,
    turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
    repeatedCalls: 0,
    continuations: 1,
    vendorErrorMs: 0,
    activeMs: 90_000,
    contextUsed: 0.42,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/**
 * A hub with runner R-1 (the key FakeRunner uses) connected; the runner's heartbeats carry whatever facts the test
 * puts in `reported`.
 */
async function setup() {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const runnerId = addRunner(ctx, { vendors: ['claude', 'codex'] });
  const gateway = new Gateway(ctx);
  const reported: { facts: AttemptFacts[] } = { facts: [] };
  const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, {
    token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli'),
    facts: () => reported.facts,
  });
  return { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported, gateway };
}

/** A worker attempt on R-1 at a new task, its session live unless told otherwise. */
async function attemptOn(ctx: HubContext, runner: FakeRunner<FakeConnection>, runnerId: string, spawn = true) {
  const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Fix the parser' })], 'user:alice');
  const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task?.id as string, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
  await settle();
  if (spawn) {
    runner.startRunning(attempt.id);
    await settle();
  }
  return getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
}

async function heartbeat(runner: FakeRunner<FakeConnection>): Promise<void> {
  runner.heartbeat();
  await settle();
}

const factsRow = (ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string) =>
  ctx.db.query('SELECT facts, facts_at, phase, active_ms FROM attempts WHERE id = $id').get({ id: attemptId }) as {
    facts: string | null;
    facts_at: number | null;
    phase: string | null;
    active_ms: number;
  };

describe('heartbeats and runner leases', () => {
  test("renew the leases of listed starting, running and quota_wait attempts at their fence, and their agents' last_seen_at", async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported } = await setup();
    const starting = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId, false);
    const running = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    const waiting = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    updateAttempt(ctx, waiting.id, { status: 'quota_wait' });
    const unlisted = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    const otherFence = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    clock.advance(5 * MINUTE);
    reported.facts = [
      factsOf(starting, { phase: 'starting' }),
      factsOf(running),
      factsOf(waiting, { phase: 'quota_wait' }),
      factsOf(otherFence, { fence: { ...otherFence.fence, counter: otherFence.fence.counter - 1 } }),
    ];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    const renewed = ctx.now() + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs;
    for (const attempt of [starting, running, waiting]) {
      expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).leaseExpiresAt).toBe(renewed);
      expect(getAgent(ctx, attempt.agentId).lastSeenAt).toBe(ctx.now());
    }
    for (const attempt of [unlisted, otherFence]) {
      expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).leaseExpiresAt).toBe(attempt.leaseExpiresAt);
      expect(getAgent(ctx, attempt.agentId).lastSeenAt).toBe(ctx.now() - 5 * MINUTE);
    }
  });

  test('store facts, facts_at, phase, active_ms and contextUsed; facts of another fence are ignored', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt, { phase: 'waiting_approval', activeMs: 120_000, contextUsed: 0.71 })];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    const stored = factsRow(ctx, attempt.id);
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({ facts_at: ctx.now(), phase: 'waiting_approval', active_ms: 120_000 });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({
      phase: 'waiting_approval',
      activeMs: 120_000,
      facts: reported.facts[0],
    });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).facts?.contextUsed).toBe(0.71);
    clock.advance(15_000);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt, { fence: { epoch: attempt.fence.epoch, counter: 9999 }, phase: 'idle' })];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    expect(factsRow(ctx, attempt.id)).toEqual(stored);
  });

  test('facts are fresh for two heartbeat intervals, and only from the current connection', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(false);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt)];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    clock.advance(2 * ctx.config.heartbeatMs);
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(true);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(false);
    await heartbeat(runner);
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(true);
    // A new link: what the old one reported is no longer fresh, though the facts themselves stay for the pages.
    await runner.reconnect();
    await settle();
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(false);
    expect(factsRow(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ facts_at: null, phase: 'turn' });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).facts).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test('a link that closes with no new one leaves the runner unheard: its facts are no longer fresh', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, runner, reported } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt)];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(true);
    runner.disconnect();
    await settle();
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(false);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'running', phase: 'turn' });
  });

  test("another runner's hello and heartbeat leave this runner's attempts alone", async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported, gateway } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt)];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    const before = getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
    addRunner(ctx);
    clock.advance(1_000);
    const other = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, {
      token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli'),
      runnerKey: 'runner-key-2',
      machineId: 'machine-2',
      facts: () => [factsOf(attempt, { phase: 'idle', activeMs: 1 })],
    });
    expect(factsAreFresh(ctx, attempt.id)).toBe(true);
    await heartbeat(other);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({
      leaseExpiresAt: before.leaseExpiresAt,
      phase: 'turn',
      activeMs: 90_000,
      facts: before.facts,
    });
  });

  test('holding, ended and live attempts hold no runner lease', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported } = await setup();
    const holding = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    updateAttempt(ctx, holding.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    const ended = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    expireRunnerLeasesNow(ctx, clock, ended);
    const live = liveAttempt(ctx);
    clock.advance(MINUTE);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(holding, { phase: 'idle' }), factsOf(getAttempt(ctx, ended.id)), factsOf(live)];
    await heartbeat(runner);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, holding.id).leaseExpiresAt).toBeNull();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, ended.id).leaseExpiresAt).toBeNull();
    expect(factsRow(ctx, holding.id).facts_at).toBeNull();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, live.id)).toMatchObject({ leaseExpiresAt: null, facts: null });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs * 2);
    expect(expireRunnerLeases(ctx)).toBe(0);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, holding.id).status).toBe('holding');
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, live.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'running', leaseExpiresAt: null });
  });
});

/** A live chat's attempt: no runner and no runner lease; M1's task lease covers it (design 6.4). */
function liveAttempt(ctx: HubContext): Attempt {
  const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask()], 'user:alice');
  const taskId = task?.id as string;
  const fence = issueFence(ctx);
  return insertAttempt(ctx, {
    id: attemptId(taskId, nextAttemptNumber(ctx, taskId), fence.epoch),
    taskId,
    number: 1,
    role: 'worker',
    agentId: addAgent(ctx).id,
    runnerId: null,
    vendor: 'claude',
    fence,
    status: 'running',
  });
}

/** Ends the attempt by letting its lease run out with nothing renewing it. */
function expireRunnerLeasesNow(ctx: HubContext, clock: { advance(ms: number): void }, attempt: Attempt): void {
  clock.advance((attempt.leaseExpiresAt as number) - ctx.now());
  expect(expireRunnerLeases(ctx)).toBe(1);
}

describe('expireRunnerLeases', () => {
  test('ends attempts lost, revokes their tokens, and sends a held task through stale to ready with a note', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    const token = mintAgentToken(ctx, attempt);
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs - 1);
    expect(expireRunnerLeases(ctx)).toBe(0);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(expireRunnerLeases(ctx)).toBe(1);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'ended',
      endReason: 'lost',
      failureClass: 'infra',
      failureSignature: null,
      leaseExpiresAt: null,
    });
    expect(() => resolveAgentToken(ctx, token)).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'attempt_ended' }));
    const taskId = attempt.taskId as string;
    expect(getTask(ctx, taskId)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', assignee: null, nextDispatchAt: ctx.now() + MINUTE });
    expect(
      listEvents(ctx.db)
        .filter((event) => event.subject === taskId && event.type.startsWith('task.'))
        .map((event) => event.type),
    ).toEqual(['task.created', 'task.claimed', 'task.stale', 'task.ready']);
    const [note] = listTaskNotes(ctx, taskId);
    expect(note).toMatchObject({ kind: 'handoff', author: 'system', attemptId: attempt.id });
    expect(note?.body).toContain('ended lost');
    // The lead learns of it, as M1's lease sweep tells it of a stale task.
    expect(listMessages(ctx, {}).map((message) => [message.from, message.to, message.taskId, message.body])).toEqual([
      [
        'system',
        'lead',
        taskId,
        `${taskId} ("Fix the parser") went stale: its runner attempt ${attempt.id} on ${runnerId} was lost (no ` +
          'heartbeat for the runner lease). It is ready again.',
      ],
    ]);
  });

  test('a lease that runs out before the stop timeout ends the attempt lost, whatever stop was recorded', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs - MINUTE);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'stop', reason: 'enough', by: 'user:alice' });
    clock.advance(MINUTE);
    expect(expireStops(ctx)).toBe(0);

    expect(listEvents(ctx.db, { subject: taskId }).some((event) => event.type === 'task.stale')).toBe(true);
  });

    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);

  });

    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const { attempt: lead } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' });
    const taken = await attemptOn(ctx, runner, runnerId);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: taken.id, cause: 'takeover', reason: 'alice takes it over', by: 'user:alice' });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs);
    expect(expireRunnerLeases(ctx)).toBe(2);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'lost' });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).leadAgentId).toBeNull();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, taken.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'taken_over', failureClass: null });
    expect(getTask(ctx, taken.taskId as string)).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'takeover' });
    // Neither ending sent a task through stale, so the lead is told nothing.
    expect(listMessages(ctx, {}).filter((message) => message.to === 'lead')).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```diff
+/**
+ * A task that went stale wakes the lead, as M1's lease sweep does (design 6.11). Only hub-known fields are named, so
+ * nothing an agent wrote is unquoted.
+ */
+function tellLeadStale(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, task: Task, attempt: Attempt): void {
+  insertMessage(ctx, emit, {
+    from: 'system',
+    to: 'lead',
+    taskId: task.id,
+    body:
+      `${named(task)} went stale: its runner attempt ${attempt.id} on ${attempt.runnerId ?? 'unknown'} was lost (no ` +
+      'heartbeat for the runner lease). It is ready again.',
+  });

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Runner leases and heartbeat facts (design 6.4 Runner lease, Lease expiry; 6.8 Facts, Freshness)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/** The statuses that hold a runner lease: the agent's process is there, or about to be. */
+const LEASED: readonly AttemptStatus[] = ['starting', 'running', 'quota_wait'];
+
+/**
+ * A heartbeat's facts (design 6.4, 6.8). Each attempt listed that runs on this runner, holds a lease and is at its
+ * current fence gets its lease renewed for runnerLeaseMs and its agent seen now, and its facts are stored with the
+ * time they arrived, its phase and its active time. Facts at another fence say nothing about the attempt as the hub
+ * has it, and are ignored. Returns how many attempts it renewed.
+ */
+export function renewLeases(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string, facts: readonly AttemptFacts[]): number {
+  const now = ctx.now();
+  let renewed = 0;
+  for (const fact of facts) {
+    const attempt = findAttempt(ctx, fact.attemptId);
+    if (!attempt || attempt.runnerId !== runnerId || !LEASED.includes(attempt.status)) continue;
+    if (compareFence(fact.fence, attempt.fence) !== 0) continue;
+    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, {
+      leaseExpiresAt: now + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs,
+      facts: fact,
+      factsAt: now,
+      phase: fact.phase,
+      activeMs: fact.activeMs,
+    });
+    ctx.db.query('UPDATE agents SET last_seen_at = $now WHERE id = $id').run({ now, id: attempt.agentId });
+    renewed += 1;
+  }
+  return renewed;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A new link from the runner: the facts its earlier link reported stay for the pages but are no longer fresh, so no
+ * stall rule judges by them (design 6.8, Freshness).
+ */
+export function markFactsStale(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string): void {
+  ctx.db.query('UPDATE attempts SET facts_at = NULL WHERE runner_id = $runnerId').run({ runnerId });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether the attempt's facts may be judged (design 6.8, Freshness): they came on the runner's current link within the
+ * last two heartbeat intervals. Their ages are as of that heartbeat; nothing extrapolates them.
+ */
+export function factsAreFresh(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): boolean {
+  const row = ctx.db.query('SELECT facts_at FROM attempts WHERE id = $id').get({ id: attemptId }) as {
+    facts_at: number | null;
+  } | null;
+  return row?.facts_at != null && ctx.now() - row.facts_at <= 2 * ctx.config.heartbeatMs;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Ends every runner attempt whose lease ran out (design 6.4, Lease expiry), each in its own transaction: lost (infra),
+ * its tokens revoked, and a held task through stale back to ready, with the backoff and an assembled handoff note. A
+ * take-over in flight ends taken_over instead, as its row says. When the runner comes back, welcome.stop names the
+ * attempt. Returns how many ended.
+ */
+export function expireRunnerLeases(ctx: HubContext): number {
+  const now = ctx.now();
+  const due = listAttempts(ctx, { status: [...LEASED] }).filter(
+    (attempt) => attempt.runnerId !== null && attempt.leaseExpiresAt !== null && attempt.leaseExpiresAt <= now,
+  );
+  let ended = 0;
+  for (const attempt of due) {
+    try {
+      const trigger = attempt.stopRequested?.cause === 'takeover' ? 'takeover' : 'lost';
+      if (endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger })) ended += 1;
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error(`ending attempt ${attempt.id} at its lease expiry failed`, error);
+    }
+  }
+  return ended;
+}
```

Facts at another fence are ignored completely. A take-over in flight ends taken_over at lease expiry, as its row in the trigger table says. A dropped link marks its runner's facts stale in the same transaction. The lead gets M1's "went stale" message when a task goes stale.

### Task 35: WIP, the final push, WIP failures and violations

The task's work position follows the current attempt's WIP and its final WIP (design 6.4, Work position). A failed final push holds dispatch for `dispatchHoldMs`; a successor on the same runner starts from the local pin, and one elsewhere from the last pushed position (6.8 step 4, 7.3). `git.ready` follows `attempt.wip_failed`'s own count, with no hub counter (X-3). Violations go to people and the lead.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type Runner, type RunnerEventData, localPinRefs, quoteLines } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { endAttempt, startPositionFor, startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { createSession } from '../src/auth';
import type { HubContext } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { Gateway } from '../src/gateway';
import { listMessages } from '../src/messages';
import { getRunner } from '../src/runners';
import { addNote, getTask, listTaskNotes } from '../src/task-store';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { type FakeConnection, type FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addRunner, createTestContext, newTask } from './helpers';

const WIP_SHA = 'a'.repeat(40);
const FINAL_SHA = 'c'.repeat(40);

type Wip = RunnerEventData['attempt.wip'];
type Exited = RunnerEventData['attempt.exited'];

/** A hub with runner R-1 (the key FakeRunner uses) connected, and a ready task. */
async function setup(options: { git?: () => Runner['git'] } = {}) {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const runnerId = addRunner(ctx, { vendors: ['claude', 'codex'] });
  const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Fix the parser' })], 'user:alice');
  if (!task) throw new Error('no task');
  const gateway = new Gateway(ctx);
  const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli'), ...options });
  return { ctx, clock, runnerId, task, runner };
}

type Link = FakeRunner<FakeConnection>;

/** A worker attempt on R-1 whose session is live. */
async function running(ctx: HubContext, runner: Link, runnerId: string, taskId: string) {
  const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
  await settle();
  runner.startRunning(attempt.id);
  await settle();
  return getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
}

/** Emits an attempt event at the attempt's fence as the hub has it now. */
async function report<K extends 'attempt.wip' | 'attempt.wip_failed' | 'attempt.violation' | 'attempt.exited'>(
  ctx: HubContext,
  runner: Link,
  attemptId: string,
  type: K,
  data: RunnerEventData[K],
) {
  runner.emit(type, data, { attemptId, fence: getAttempt(ctx, attemptId).fence });
  await settle();
}

const wip = (ref: string, sha = WIP_SHA): Wip => ({
  ref,
  sha,
  stripped: ['.github/workflows/ci.yml'],
  skipped: ['big.bin'],
  embedded: ['vendor/lib'],
  logStat: 'abc123 Parse nested lists\n src/parser.ts | 12 ++++++++----',
});

const exited = (data: Partial<Exited> = {}): Exited => ({
  code: 0,
  signal: null,
  stoppedBy: 'none',
  handoffWritten: false,
  cause: null,
  finalSha: FINAL_SHA,
  finalWip: null,
  pushError: null,
  ...data,
});

const rejects = (ctx: HubContext) => ctx.db.query('SELECT type, error FROM runner_event_rejects').all();
const dispatchHold = (ctx: HubContext, taskId: string) =>
  (ctx.db.query('SELECT dispatch_hold_until FROM tasks WHERE id = $id').get({ id: taskId }) as {
    dispatch_hold_until: number | null;
  }).dispatch_hold_until;

describe('attempt.wip', () => {
  test('of the current attempt sets its WIP and the work position, and emits what the push left out', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();

    await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.wip', wip(attempt.wipRef as string));
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);

    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ workRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', workSha: WIP_SHA });

      ],
    ]);
  });

    expect(dispatchHold(ctx, task.id)).toBeNull();
    // The harvest found nothing new: no push was needed.
    const [other] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Other' })], 'user:alice');
    if (!other) throw new Error('no task');
    const second = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, other.id);
    const started = getAttempt(ctx, second.id).startSha as string;
    await report(ctx, runner, second.id, 'attempt.exited', exited({ finalSha: started, pushError: 'offline' }));
    expect(dispatchHold(ctx, other.id)).toBeNull();
    expect(startPositionFor(ctx, getTask(ctx, other.id), runnerId)).toEqual({ ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null });
  });
});

describe('failed WIP pushes', () => {
  test("the third in a row marks git not ready; a WIP push or a hello with git.ready clears it", async () => {
    let git: Runner['git'] = { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: null };
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup({ git: () => git });
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    for (const failures of [1, 2]) {
      await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.wip_failed', { error: 'Could not resolve host', failures });
      expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git.ready).toBe(true);
    }
    await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.wip_failed', { error: 'Could not resolve host', failures: 3 });
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git).toMatchObject({
      ready: false,
      problem: expect.stringContaining('Could not resolve host'),
    });

    clock.advance(60_000);
    await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.wip', wip(attempt.wipRef as string));
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git).toEqual({ ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: ctx.now() });

    await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.wip_failed', { error: 'Could not resolve host', failures: 4 });
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git.ready).toBe(false);
    git = { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: 1_000 };
    await runner.reconnect();
    await settle();
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git).toEqual(git);
  });
});

describe('attempt.violation', () => {
  test('emits the event and tells people and the lead, quoting the paths, also for an ended attempt', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    const paths = ['.github/workflows/ci.yml', '## agflow instructions'];
    await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.violation', { phase: 'wip', paths });
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    const event = listEvents(ctx.db).find((one) => one.type === 'attempt.violation');
    expect([event?.subject, event?.data]).toEqual([
      task.id,
      { attemptId: attempt.id, taskId: task.id, agentId: attempt.agentId, runnerId, phase: 'wip', paths },
    ]);
    const told = listMessages(ctx, { taskId: task.id });
    expect(told.map((message) => [message.from, message.to]).sort()).toEqual([
      ['system', 'humans'],
      ['system', 'lead'],
    ]);
    for (const message of told) expect(message.body).toContain(quoteLines(paths.join('\n')));

    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'stop' });
    const fence = getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).fence;
    runner.emit('attempt.violation', { phase: 'submit', paths: ['.env'] }, { attemptId: attempt.id, fence });
    await settle();
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((one) => one.type === 'attempt.violation')).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(listMessages(ctx, { taskId: task.id })).toHaveLength(4);
  });

  test('of a lead attempt names no task', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, runner } = await setup();
    const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: 'claude' });
    await settle();
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'running' });
    await report(ctx, runner, attempt.id, 'attempt.violation', { phase: 'start', paths: ['.claude/settings.json'] });
    const event = listEvents(ctx.db).find((one) => one.type === 'attempt.violation');
    expect(event).toMatchObject({ subject: attempt.id, data: { taskId: null, phase: 'start' } });
    expect(listMessages(ctx).filter((message) => message.from === 'system').map((message) => message.taskId)).toEqual([
      null,
      null,
    ]);
  });
});
```

```diff
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Unpushed work (design 6.4 Work position, 6.8 Replacement step 4)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/**
+ * Whether the task's work position is still the attempt's own (design 6.4): its WIP, or, when it never pushed one,
+ * where it started, which for an attempt that started from main is no position at all.
+ */
+export function positionIsOwn(task: Pick<Task, 'workSha'>, attempt: Pick<Attempt, 'wipSha' | 'startSha'>): boolean {
+  if (attempt.wipSha !== null) return task.workSha === attempt.wipSha;
+  return task.workSha === null || task.workSha === attempt.startSha;
+}
+
+/** A commit the attempt harvested that is neither its pushed WIP nor where it started: its final push failed. */
+export const isUnpushed = (sha: string | null, attempt: Pick<Attempt, 'wipSha' | 'startSha'>): sha is string =>
+  sha !== null && sha !== attempt.wipSha && sha !== attempt.startSha;
+
+/** The harvested head an attempt reported at its exit, even when its push failed. */
+function finalShaOf(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): string | null {
+  const row = ctx.db.query('SELECT final_sha FROM attempts WHERE id = $id').get({ id: attemptId }) as {
+    final_sha: string | null;
+  } | null;
+  return row?.final_sha ?? null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The runner attempt's harvested head while it is only in its runner's vault: its final push failed, no late work
+ * brought it to the task yet, and the task's work position is still the attempt's own. Null otherwise.
+ */
+export function unpushedHead(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  task: Pick<Task, 'workSha'>,
+  attempt: Attempt,
+): { runnerId: string; sha: string } | null {
+  if (attempt.runnerId === null) return null;
+  const sha = finalShaOf(ctx, attempt.id);
+  if (!isUnpushed(sha, attempt) || sha === task.workSha || !positionIsOwn(task, attempt)) return null;
+  return { runnerId: attempt.runnerId, sha };
+}
```

```diff
+/**
+ * Failed WIP pushes (attempt.wip_failed with 3 or more in a row, X-3): the runner's git is not ready, with the error,
+ * until a later WIP push or a hello with git.ready.
+ */
+export function markGitNotReady(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string, problem: string): void {
+  const info = runnerInfo(existingRow(ctx, runnerId));
+  info.git = { ...info.git, ready: false, problem };
+  ctx.db.query('UPDATE runners SET info = $info WHERE id = $id').run({ id: runnerId, info: JSON.stringify(info) });
+}
+
+/** A WIP push went through (attempt.wip): the runner's git is ready, and pushed last now. */
+export function markGitPushed(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string): void {
+  const info = runnerInfo(existingRow(ctx, runnerId));
+  info.git = { ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: ctx.now() };
+  ctx.db.query('UPDATE runners SET info = $info WHERE id = $id').run({ id: runnerId, info: JSON.stringify(info) });
```

Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

The unpushed final sha is recorded in a system `late_work` note with the attempt id, not in a note of kind handoff, which would push the agent's own handoff out of the brief. The assembled handoff note, when there is one, names the sha and its runner. The successor's brief opens with the hub's own unquoted line saying whether it starts from that commit. `positionIsOwn`, `isUnpushed` and `unpushedHead` live in `attempt-store.ts`, because `handoff.ts` and `brief.ts` cannot import `attempts.ts` without a cycle.

### Task 36: Late work

Work an agent pushed after its attempt ended is never lost (design 6.4, 7.3 Late work). Under the lineage rule it becomes the task's work position while the task has no open attempt and its position is still that attempt's own. Otherwise the hub adds a late-work note with the merge command, sends `refresh_vault` to the holder's runner and messages the holder. Late work of unknown attempts and of ended attempts' exits counts too, and its notes carry the attempt id (X-22). A final WIP or a late push whose sha is the attempt's submitted head (`submittedSha`) is the accepted work and never late work: a person can accept a submission before the runner's `attempt.exited` arrives, and that commit is already on the task branch.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type Fence, type RunnerEventData, lateWorkRef } from '@agflow/core';
import { attemptLog, getAttempt, insertAttempt, issueFence, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { endAttempt, startPositionFor, startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { createSession } from '../src/auth';
import { pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { Gateway } from '../src/gateway';
import { listMessages } from '../src/messages';
import { getRunner, markGitNotReady } from '../src/runners';
import { getTask, listTaskNotes, move, writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { type FakeConnection, type FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addAgent, addRunner, createTestContext, newTask } from './helpers';

const WIP_SHA = 'a'.repeat(40);
const LATE_SHA = 'b'.repeat(40);
const SUBMITTED_SHA = 'c'.repeat(40);

type Link = FakeRunner<FakeConnection>;

/** A hub with runner R-1 (the key FakeRunner uses) connected, and a ready task. */
async function setup() {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const runnerId = addRunner(ctx, { vendors: ['claude', 'codex'] });
  const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Fix the parser' })], 'user:alice');
  if (!task) throw new Error('no task');
  const gateway = new Gateway(ctx);
  const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, gateway, { token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli') });
  return { ctx, clock, runnerId, task, runner };
}

/** A worker attempt on R-1 whose session is live, with a WIP pushed when wip is set. */
async function running(ctx: HubContext, runner: Link, runnerId: string, taskId: string, wip = true) {
  const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
  await settle();
  runner.startRunning(attempt.id);
  await settle();
  if (wip) {
    const data: RunnerEventData['attempt.wip'] = {
      ref: attempt.wipRef as string,
      sha: WIP_SHA,
      stripped: [],
      skipped: [],
      embedded: [],
      logStat: '',
    };
    runner.emit('attempt.wip', data, { attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence });
    await settle();
  }
  return getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
}

/** The runner reports late work of the attempt, at the fence it last knew. */
async function lateWork(runner: Link, attemptId: string, fence: Fence, taskId = 'T-1', n = 1, sha = LATE_SHA) {
  const ref = lateWorkRef('refs/agflow/', attemptId, n);
  runner.emit('attempt.late_work', { taskId, ref, sha }, { attemptId, fence });
  await settle();
  return ref;
}

/**
 * The attempt's submission at SUBMITTED_SHA was recorded, as a runner submission's success records it (the task
 * submitted, on its branch at that head, and the attempt holding), and a person accepted it before the runner reported
 * anything more: the task accepted and the attempt ended accepted.
 */
function acceptedSubmission(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string, taskId: string): void {
  tx(ctx, (emit) => {
    const branch = getTask(ctx, taskId).branch ?? `agflow/${taskId}`;
    const submission = {
      summary: 'Done.',
      evidence: [],
      branch,
      headSha: SUBMITTED_SHA,
      submittedAt: ctx.now(),
      by: getAttempt(ctx, attemptId).agentId,
      attemptId,
      submissionId: 'S-1',
    };
    const changes = { submission, workRef: `refs/heads/${branch}`, workSha: SUBMITTED_SHA };
    move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, taskId), 'submitted', `runner:${getAttempt(ctx, attemptId).runnerId}`, { changes });
    updateAttempt(ctx, attemptId, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null, submittedSha: SUBMITTED_SHA });
    move(ctx, emit, getTask(ctx, taskId), 'accepted', 'user:alice');
  });
  endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId, trigger: 'accepted', actor: 'user:alice' });
}

const rejects = (ctx: HubContext) => ctx.db.query('SELECT type, error FROM runner_event_rejects').all();
const lateNotes = (ctx: HubContext, taskId: string) =>
  listTaskNotes(ctx, taskId).filter((note) => note.kind === 'late_work');
const dispatchHold = (ctx: HubContext, taskId: string) =>
  (ctx.db.query('SELECT dispatch_hold_until FROM tasks WHERE id = $id').get({ id: taskId }) as {
    dispatch_hold_until: number | null;
  }).dispatch_hold_until;

describe('late work under the lineage rule', () => {
  test('becomes the position while the task has no open attempt and its position is the attempt WIP', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    writeTask(ctx, task.id, { dispatchHoldUntil: ctx.now() + ctx.config.dispatchHoldMs });
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ready', workRef: ref, workSha: LATE_SHA });
    // The wait for it is over.
    expect(dispatchHold(ctx, task.id)).toBeNull();
    // The ended attempt's WIP ref is never rewritten, so its record stays.
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ wipRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', wipSha: WIP_SHA });
    expect(lateNotes(ctx, task.id)).toEqual([]);
    const events = listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.late_work');
    expect(events.map((event) => [event.subject, event.actor, event.data])).toEqual([
      [
        task.id,
        `runner:${runnerId}`,
        { attemptId: attempt.id, taskId: task.id, agentId: attempt.agentId, runnerId, ref, sha: LATE_SHA },
      ],
    ]);
  });

  test('of an attempt that never pushed, while the task still has no position', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id, false);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ workRef: ref, workSha: LATE_SHA });
  });

  test('of an attempt that never pushed, while the position is still where it started', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    // A hand-back, say, gave the task its position before the attempt started from it.
    writeTask(ctx, task.id, { workRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/takeover-alice', workSha: 'd'.repeat(40) });
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id, false);
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({ startSha: 'd'.repeat(40), wipSha: null });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ workRef: ref, workSha: LATE_SHA });
    expect(lateNotes(ctx, task.id)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('otherwise a note with the attempt id names the ref; nothing is sent while no one holds the task', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    // A hand-back, say, moved the position on.
    writeTask(ctx, task.id, { workRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/takeover-alice', workSha: 'd'.repeat(40) });
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ workRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/takeover-alice' });
    const notes = lateNotes(ctx, task.id);
    expect(notes.map((note) => [note.author, note.attemptId])).toEqual([['system', attempt.id]]);
    expect(notes[0]?.body).toContain(`git fetch origin ${ref} && git merge FETCH_HEAD`);
    expect(notes[0]?.body).toContain(LATE_SHA);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, runnerId, 1).filter((row) => row.kind === 'refresh_vault')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("with a holder, refresh_vault goes to its runner first and the holder gets the merge command", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    const elsewhere = addRunner(ctx, { owner: 'bob' });
    const next = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: elsewhere, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ workRef: 'refs/agflow/T-1/a1', workSha: WIP_SHA });
    expect(lateNotes(ctx, task.id).map((note) => note.attemptId)).toEqual([attempt.id]);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, elsewhere, 1).map((row) => row.command)).toEqual([
      next.command.command,
      { kind: 'refresh_vault', taskId: task.id, refs: [ref] },
    ]);
    const told = listMessages(ctx, { target: `agent:${next.agent.id}` });
    expect(told.map((message) => [message.from, message.taskId])).toEqual([['system', task.id]]);
    expect(told[0]?.body).toContain(`git fetch origin ${ref} && git merge FETCH_HEAD`);
  });

  test('a live holder gets the merge command; there is no vault to refresh', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    const live = addAgent(ctx, 'bob');
    tx(ctx, () =>
      insertAttempt(ctx, {
        id: 'T-1-a2',
        taskId: task.id,
        number: 2,
        role: 'worker',
        agentId: live.id,
        runnerId: null,
        vendor: 'claude',
        fence: issueFence(ctx),
        status: 'running',
      }),
    );
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(listMessages(ctx, { target: `agent:${live.id}` })[0]?.body).toContain(`git fetch origin ${ref}`);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, runnerId, 1).filter((row) => row.kind === 'refresh_vault')).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('late work of an open attempt at its fence', () => {
  test("is the attempt's own final push: the work position, with no note, and its exit holds nothing", async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    // canPushWip forbade the final push, so it went to a late-work ref while the attempt was still open (X-11).
    const ref = await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence);
    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    expect(getTask(ctx, task.id)).toMatchObject({ workRef: ref, workSha: LATE_SHA });
    expect(lateNotes(ctx, task.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(pendingCommands(ctx, runnerId, 1).filter((row) => row.kind === 'refresh_vault')).toEqual([]);
    expect(listMessages(ctx, { target: `agent:${attempt.agentId}` })).toEqual([]);
    expect(listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'attempt.late_work')).toHaveLength(1);

    const exited: RunnerEventData['attempt.exited'] = {
      code: 0,
      signal: null,
      stoppedBy: 'none',
      handoffWritten: false,
      cause: null,
      finalSha: LATE_SHA,
      finalWip: null,
      pushError: 'no welcome since the last clock gap',
    };
    runner.emit('attempt.exited', exited, { attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence });
    await settle();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).status).toBe('ended');
    // Its late work landed first, so nothing waits for it and nothing says it is only on the runner.
    expect(dispatchHold(ctx, task.id)).toBeNull();
    expect(lateNotes(ctx, task.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(startPositionFor(ctx, getTask(ctx, task.id), runnerId)).toEqual({ ref, sha: LATE_SHA });
  });
});

describe("late work and the runner's git", () => {
  test('a late WIP push or late work sets git.ready back after failed WIP pushes', async () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, task, runner } = await setup();
    const attempt = await running(ctx, runner, runnerId, task.id);
    const at = { attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence };
    runner.emit('attempt.wip_failed', { error: 'Could not resolve host', failures: 3 }, at);
    await settle();
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git.ready).toBe(false);
    // The attempt ends, so no current attempt is left to push a WIP.
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    const data: RunnerEventData['attempt.wip'] = {
      ref: attempt.wipRef as string,
      sha: LATE_SHA,
      stripped: [],
      skipped: [],
      embedded: [],
      logStat: '',
    };
    runner.emit('attempt.wip', data, at);
    await settle();
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git).toEqual({ ready: true, problem: null, lastPushAt: ctx.now() });

    tx(ctx, () => markGitNotReady(ctx, runnerId, 'the last 3 WIP pushes failed'));
    await lateWork(runner, attempt.id, attempt.fence, task.id, 2, 'e'.repeat(40));
    expect(getRunner(ctx, runnerId).git.ready).toBe(true);
  });
});

  test('as late work of an accepted attempt is no late work: logged, with its ref kept for cleanup', async () => {

    expect(rejects(ctx)).toEqual([]);

    expect(lateEvents(ctx)).toEqual([[ref, SUBMITTED_SHA]]);
    expect(lateNotes(ctx, task.id)).toEqual([]);

    // Its WIP ref was not pushed again, so its record stays.
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ wipRef: attempt.wipRef, wipSha: WIP_SHA });
    expect(attemptLog(ctx, attempt.id).at(-1)?.summary).toContain(`${SUBMITTED_SHA} to ${ref}`);
  });
```

```diff
+
+/** Work a runner pushed after the hub ended its attempt, or for an attempt the hub does not know. */
+export interface LateWork {
+  attemptId: string;
+  taskId: string;
+  ref: string;
+  sha: string;
+  /** The runner that pushed it. */
+  runnerId: string;
+}
+
+/** attempt.late_work of a pushed ref, which keeps the ref, at its sha, for its cleanup (design 6.18). */
+function emitLateWork(emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt | null, work: LateWork): void {
+  emit({
+    type: 'attempt.late_work',
+    actor: `runner:${work.runnerId}`,
+    subject: work.taskId,
+    data: {
+      attemptId: work.attemptId,
+      taskId: work.taskId,
+      agentId: attempt?.agentId ?? null,
+      runnerId: work.runnerId,
+      ref: work.ref,
+      sha: work.sha,
+    },
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * A push of the attempt's recorded submission head after it ended (a person accepted it before the runner reported
+ * its final WIP, say): no late work, as its submission put that commit on the task branch, so no late_work note, no
+ * message to a holder and no change of the work position; it is logged on the attempt. Pushed to the attempt's WIP
+ * ref, it is the attempt's WIP sha, which the ref's cleanup expects there; to another ref, a late-work or hand-back
+ * one, attempt.late_work still records that ref, so its cleanup deletes it too.
+ */
+function recordSubmittedHeadPush(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt, work: LateWork): void {
+  if (work.ref === attempt.wipRef) updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { wipSha: work.sha });
+  else emitLateWork(emit, attempt, work);
+  const pushed = `runner ${work.runnerId} pushed the submitted head ${work.sha} to ${work.ref}`;
+  appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `${pushed}: it is on the task branch, not late work`);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Records late work (design 6.4). It becomes the task's work position only while the task has no open attempt and
+ * its position is still the late attempt's own (positionIsOwn), which also ends a dispatch hold waiting for it.
+ * Otherwise a late_work note with the attempt's id names the ref for the next attempt to merge, and a holder, the
+ * task's open attempt, is told how to merge it, after refresh_vault brings the ref to its runner's vault (design
+ * 7.3). Late work for a task the hub does not have goes to people. attempt.late_work keeps the ref for its cleanup.
+ * The attempt's recorded submission head is no late work (recordSubmittedHeadPush).
+ */
+export function recordLateWork(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt | null, work: LateWork): void {
+  if (attempt !== null && work.sha === attempt.submittedSha) {
+    recordSubmittedHeadPush(ctx, emit, attempt, work);
+    return;
+  }
+  emitLateWork(emit, attempt, work);
+  const pushed = `runner ${work.runnerId} pushed ${work.sha} to ${work.ref}`;
+  const task = findTask(ctx, work.taskId);
+  if (!task) {
+    insertMessage(ctx, emit, {
+      from: 'system',
+      to: 'humans',
+      taskId: null,
+      body:
+        `Late work of attempt ${work.attemptId}: ${pushed}, but this hub has no task ${work.taskId}. Look at the ref ` +
+        'and keep what is worth keeping.',
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+  const holder = openAttemptOf(ctx, task.id);
+  if (attempt && holder === null && positionIsOwn(task, attempt)) {
+    writeTask(ctx, task.id, { workRef: work.ref, workSha: work.sha, dispatchHoldUntil: null });
+    appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `late work became the work position: ${work.ref} at ${work.sha}`);
+    return;
+  }
+  const merge = `git fetch origin ${work.ref} && git merge FETCH_HEAD`;
+  addNote(
+    ctx,
+    task.id,
+    'late_work',
+    `Late work of attempt ${work.attemptId}: ${pushed} after the attempt ended. Merge it before going on: ${merge}`,
+    'system',
+    work.attemptId,
+  );
+  if (!holder) return;
+  if (holder.runnerId !== null) {

+  }
+  insertMessage(ctx, emit, {
+    from: 'system',

+    taskId: task.id,
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

Every late push emits `attempt.late_work` with its ref and sha; ref cleanup (Task 65) reads refs from these events and from the attempts' WIP shas. The submitted-head check lives in `recordLateWork` itself, so every path that makes a push late work follows it: the exit of an ended attempt, a WIP push of an ended attempt, an `attempt.late_work` of an ended attempt and, from Task 61, the hand-back fallback. The third is the likely route with a real runner: after an accept during `hold_attempt`, `cleanup_attempt` stops the live process, and its final push goes to a late-work ref. `recordSubmittedHeadPush` writes no `late_work` note, messages no holder, queues no `refresh_vault` and leaves the work position alone; it adds a line to the attempt log. Pushed to the attempt's WIP ref, the sha becomes the attempt's `wipSha`, which that ref's cleanup expects; pushed to any other ref, `attempt.late_work` still records the ref, so its cleanup deletes it too. Adopting late work clears the dispatch hold that waited for it. A late push or WIP of any attempt marks the runner's git as pushed.

### Task 37: Reconciliation when a runner says hello

When a runner says hello, the hub decides every attempt it believes open on that runner from the state the runner reports (design 6.3, Reconciliation on hello; X-36). The rows, in order: a stopped or suspended attempt with a stop requested ends with its cause; a reported live attempt is kept; a stopped or suspended one with a clone resumes, or stays holding; an unreported start still pending is resent; a holding one without a clone can no longer resume; anything else crashes. The hub then builds `welcome.stop`, the attempts the runner must stop before it runs any command. The restore rows come in Task 64.
