```ts
    const { ctx, held, flush } = setup();
    updateAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    const missed = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'While you waited.' });
    expect(flush().commands).toEqual([]);
    resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'review', prompt: 'The review asks for changes.' });
    tx(ctx, (emit) => onSpawned(ctx, emit, getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id), SPAWNED));
    expect(delivers(ctx, held.attempt).map((row) => row.command.messages.map((m) => m.messageId))).toEqual([
      [missed.id],
    ]);
  });

  test('a new fence carries the messages in flight in its resume and re-targets their rows', () => {
    const { ctx, held, flush } = setup();
    const message = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'In flight.' });
    flush();
    const [deliver] = delivers(ctx, held.attempt);
    expect(messagesInFlight(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toEqual([
      { messageId: message.id, authority: 'person', text: formatMessage(message) },
    ]);
    const { command } = resumeAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'runner_restart', prompt: 'Go on.' });
    expect(findCommand(ctx, deliver?.id as string)?.status).toBe('cancelled');
    expect(command.command.kind === 'resume_attempt' && command.command.messages).toEqual([
      { messageId: message.id, authority: 'person', text: formatMessage(message) },
    ]);
    expect(rowsOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toEqual([[message.id, command.id]]);
  });
});

describe('delivered and acknowledged', () => {
  test('attempt.delivered records deliveries and drops the rows; attempt.acknowledged sets acked_at', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, held, flush } = setup();
    const first = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
    const second = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'two' });
    flush();
    const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id);
    // Id 0 is hub text with no message row.
    tx(ctx, (emit) => onDelivered(ctx, emit, attempt, [0, first.id]));
    expect(deliveriesOf(ctx, held.agent.id)).toEqual([{ message_id: first.id, acked_at: null }]);
    expect(rowsOf(ctx, held.attempt.id).map(([id]) => id)).toEqual([second.id]);
    clock.advance(1000);
    // Acknowledged implies delivered.
    tx(ctx, (emit) => onAcknowledged(ctx, emit, attempt, [0, first.id, second.id]));
    expect(deliveriesOf(ctx, held.agent.id)).toEqual([
      { message_id: first.id, acked_at: ctx.now() },
      { message_id: second.id, acked_at: ctx.now() },
    ]);
    expect(rowsOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toEqual([]);
    const types = listEvents(ctx.db).map((event) => event.type);
    expect(types).toContain('message.delivered');
    expect(types).toContain('message.acknowledged');
  });

  test("ids the attempt has no delivery in flight for are ignored, and other agents' deliveries stay", () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    const other = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const message = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${other.agent.id}`, body: 'not yours' });
    takeInbox(ctx, getAgent(ctx, other.agent.id));
    tx(ctx, (emit) => onDelivered(ctx, emit, getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id), [message.id, 12345]));
    tx(ctx, (emit) => onAcknowledged(ctx, emit, getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id), [message.id]));
    expect(deliveriesOf(ctx, held.agent.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(deliveriesOf(ctx, other.agent.id)).toEqual([{ message_id: message.id, acked_at: null }]);
    const acknowledged = listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'message.acknowledged');
    expect(acknowledged).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('the runner reports them as attempt events, an id 0 among them', () => {
    const { ctx, held, flush } = setup();
    const message = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
    flush();
    const { id: attemptId, fence } = held.attempt;
    const events: RawRunnerEvent[] = [
      { seq: 1, at: 0, type: 'attempt.delivered', attemptId, fence, data: { messageIds: [0, message.id] } },
      { seq: 2, at: 0, type: 'attempt.acknowledged', attemptId, fence, data: { messageIds: [message.id, 0] } },
    ];
    applyRunnerEvents(ctx, held.runner.id, { outboxEpoch: 'outbox-1', events }, { restoreReplay: false });
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT type, error FROM runner_event_rejects').all()).toEqual([]);
    expect(deliveriesOf(ctx, held.agent.id)).toEqual([{ message_id: message.id, acked_at: ctx.now() }]);
  });

  test('a cancelled deliver frees its rows, and its messages are unread again', () => {
    const { ctx, held, flush } = setup();
    const message = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
    flush();
    cancelPendingOfKind(ctx, held.attempt.id, 'deliver');
    expect(rowsOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, held.agent.id)).map((unread) => unread.id)).toEqual([message.id]);
  });
});

describe('refused delivers', () => {
  test('a deliver the runner refuses before sending frees its rows; its messages are unread again', () => {
    for (const error of ['not_running', 'stale_fence']) {
      const { ctx, held, flush } = setup();
      const message = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
      flush();
      const [deliver] = delivers(ctx, held.attempt);
      markSent(ctx, deliver?.id as string);
      recordResult(ctx, held.runner.id, { commandId: deliver?.id as string, ok: false, error });
      expect(findCommand(ctx, deliver?.id as string)?.status).toBe('failed');
      expect(rowsOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toEqual([]);
      expect(unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, held.agent.id)).map((unread) => unread.id)).toEqual([message.id]);
    }
  });

  test('other failures keep the rows: the messages may have been injected in part', () => {
    const { ctx, held, flush } = setup();
    const message = send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
    flush();
    const [deliver] = delivers(ctx, held.attempt);
    recordResult(ctx, held.runner.id, { commandId: deliver?.id as string, ok: false, error: 'interrupted' });
    expect(rowsOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toEqual([[message.id, deliver?.id]]);
    expect(unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, held.agent.id))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('watchDeliveries', () => {
  test('a sent message is pushed once its batch window has passed', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext({ deliveryBatchMs: 20 });
    const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const stop = watchDeliveries(ctx);
    try {
      send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${held.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
      expect(delivers(ctx, held.attempt)).toEqual([]);
      clock.advance(20);
      await Bun.sleep(60);
      expect(delivers(ctx, held.attempt)).toHaveLength(1);
    } finally {
      stop();
    }
  });

  test('a batch not yet due is scheduled again, and nothing runs once stopped', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext({ deliveryBatchMs: 20 });
    const first = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const second = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const stop = watchDeliveries(ctx);
    try {
      send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${first.agent.id}`, body: 'one' });
      clock.advance(10);
      send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${second.agent.id}`, body: 'two' });
      clock.advance(10);
      await until(() => delivers(ctx, first.attempt).length === 1);
      expect(delivers(ctx, second.attempt)).toEqual([]);
      clock.advance(10);
      await until(() => delivers(ctx, second.attempt).length === 1);
    } finally {
      stop();
    }
    send(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: `agent:${first.agent.id}`, body: 'three' });
    clock.advance(20);
    await Bun.sleep(60);
    expect(delivers(ctx, first.attempt)).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

**File:** `packages/hub/src/delivery.ts` (new)

```ts
// Message delivery to runner agents (design 6.7). The hub pushes a runner agent's unread messages to its runner in
// deliver commands, and a pending_deliveries row per message keeps each one out of the agent's unreadFor and
// check_inbox while it is in flight. attempt.delivered turns a row into M1's delivery record; attempt.acknowledged
// marks it acknowledged.
import { type Attempt, type AttemptStatus, type InjectedMessage, type Message, formatMessage } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent } from './agents';
import { getAttempt } from './attempt-store';
import { type CommandRow, RESULT_HANDLERS, enqueueCommand } from './commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from './context';
import type { Emit } from './events';
import { type MessageRow, markDelivered, rowToMessage, unreadFor } from './messages';

/** The most characters of message text one deliver command carries (design 6.7, Batching). */
export const DELIVERY_CHAR_LIMIT = 6000;

/** Runner attempts that take deliveries; starting ones wait for attempt.spawned, holding ones for their resume. */
const DELIVERABLE: readonly AttemptStatus[] = ['running', 'quota_wait'];

/** Whether the hub pushes messages to this attempt now. */
function deliverable(attempt: Attempt): boolean {
  return attempt.runnerId !== null && DELIVERABLE.includes(attempt.status);
}

/** Who a message's authority is: people, the hub, or agents (design 6.7, Authority). */
function authorityOf(sender: string): InjectedMessage['authority'] {
  if (sender === 'system') return 'system';
  return sender.startsWith('user:') ? 'person' : 'agent';
}

/** A message as a runner injects it, formatted with M1's quoting rules. */
export function injectedMessage(message: Message): InjectedMessage {
  return { messageId: message.id, authority: authorityOf(message.from), text: formatMessage(message) };
}

/**
 * The messages that fit in one command, in order, and how many are left over. The first always goes, however long:
 * a message the limit alone cannot hold would otherwise never be pushed.
 */
function fitBatch(messages: readonly Message[]): { batch: InjectedMessage[]; more: number } {
  const batch: InjectedMessage[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  for (const message of messages) {
    const injected = injectedMessage(message);
    if (batch.length > 0 && size + injected.text.length > DELIVERY_CHAR_LIMIT) break;
    batch.push(injected);
    size += injected.text.length;
  }
  return { batch, more: messages.length - batch.length };
}

/** Records the messages as in flight to the attempt under the command that carries them. */
function addRows(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string, commandId: string, messages: readonly InjectedMessage[]): void {
  const insert = ctx.db.query(
    `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO pending_deliveries (message_id, attempt_id, command_id, created_at)
     VALUES ($messageId, $attemptId, $commandId, $now)`,
  );
  for (const message of messages) {
    // Id 0 is hub text with no message row.
    if (message.messageId === 0) continue;
    insert.run({ messageId: message.messageId, attemptId, commandId, now: ctx.now() });
  }
}

/** Sends the messages that fit in one deliver command at the attempt's fence; more counts the rest. */
function deliver(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt, unread: readonly Message[]): CommandRow {
  const { batch, more } = fitBatch(unread);
  const command = enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, {
    kind: 'deliver',
    attemptId: attempt.id,
    fence: attempt.fence,
    messages: batch,
    more,
  });
  addRows(ctx, attempt.id, command.id, batch);
  return command;
}

/**
 * Delivers the attempt's whole unread backlog at once, as it enters running (design 6.7, Backlog): what is in flight
 * already, such as the messages its resume carried, is left out by unreadFor. Null when nothing is unread or the
 * attempt takes no deliveries.
 */
export function deliverBacklog(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt): CommandRow | null {
  if (!deliverable(attempt)) return null;
  const unread = unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, attempt.agentId));
  return unread.length === 0 ? null : deliver(ctx, attempt, unread);
}

export interface FlushResult {
  /** The deliver commands queued, one per attempt at most. */
  commands: CommandRow[];
  /** When the earliest batch still waiting is due; null when none waits. */
  dueAt: number | null;
}

/**
 * Pushes unread messages to every runner attempt that takes deliveries, batched (design 6.7, Batching): an attempt's
 * messages wait until the oldest of them is deliveryBatchMs old, and then go together, so a burst is one command.
 * Each attempt's delivery is its own transaction.
 */
export function flushDeliveries(ctx: HubContext): FlushResult {
  const statuses = DELIVERABLE.map((status) => `'${status}'`).join(', ');
  const ids = ctx.db
    .query(`SELECT id FROM attempts WHERE runner_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN (${statuses}) ORDER BY rowid`)
    .all() as { id: string }[];
  const commands: CommandRow[] = [];
  let dueAt: number | null = null;
  for (const { id } of ids) {
    // One attempt failing to take its delivery must not hold up the others.
    try {
      const command = tx(ctx, () => {
        const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, id);
        if (!deliverable(attempt)) return null;
        const unread = unreadFor(ctx, getAgent(ctx, attempt.agentId));
        if (unread.length === 0) return null;
        const due = Math.min(...unread.map((message) => message.createdAt)) + ctx.config.deliveryBatchMs;
        if (due > ctx.now()) {
          dueAt = dueAt === null ? due : Math.min(dueAt, due);
          return null;
        }
        return deliver(ctx, attempt, unread);
      });
      if (command) commands.push(command);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`delivering to attempt ${id} failed`, error);
    }
  }
  return { commands, dueAt };
}

/** Refusals a runner answers before it injects anything: the deliver's messages reached no session. */
const REFUSED_BEFORE_SENDING: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['not_running', 'stale_fence']);

/**
 * A deliver the runner refused before sending frees its rows, so its messages are unread again for the next flush,
 * the next backlog or a holding lead's wake-up. Other failures, such as interrupted, may follow a partial injection
 * and keep their rows until the ending or a new fence settles them.
 */
RESULT_HANDLERS.deliver = (ctx, _emit, command, result) => {
  if (result.ok || result.error === undefined || !REFUSED_BEFORE_SENDING.has(result.error)) return;
  ctx.db.query('DELETE FROM pending_deliveries WHERE command_id = $commandId').run({ commandId: command.id });
};

/**
 * The messages in flight to the attempt, formatted, oldest first: a new fence carries them in its resume_attempt
 * (design 6.7, Backlog), as the runner may never have injected them at the old one.
 */
export function messagesInFlight(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): InjectedMessage[] {
  const rows = ctx.db
    .query(
      `SELECT m.* FROM messages m JOIN pending_deliveries p ON p.message_id = m.id
       WHERE p.attempt_id = $attemptId ORDER BY m.id`,
    )
    .all({ attemptId }) as MessageRow[];
  return rows.map((row) => injectedMessage(rowToMessage(row)));
}

/**
 * Re-targets the attempt's deliveries to the resume_attempt that carries its messages at a new fence: its rows are
 * now exactly those messages, under the resume's command id.
 */
export function retargetDeliveries(
  ctx: HubContext,
  attemptId: string,
  commandId: string,
  messages: readonly InjectedMessage[],
): void {
  ctx.db.query('DELETE FROM pending_deliveries WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId').run({ attemptId });
  addRows(ctx, attemptId, commandId, messages);
}

/** The reported ids that are in flight to the attempt; id 0 and anything else is ignored (X-4). */
function inFlightIds(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string, messageIds: readonly number[]): number[] {
  const inFlight = ctx.db.query('SELECT 1 FROM pending_deliveries WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId AND message_id = $id');
  return [...new Set(messageIds)].filter((id) => id !== 0 && inFlight.get({ attemptId, id }) !== null);
}

/** attempt.delivered: the vendor accepted the input, so M1's delivery record is written and the rows go. */
export function onDelivered(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt, messageIds: readonly number[]): void {
  const ids = inFlightIds(ctx, attempt.id, messageIds);
  if (ids.length === 0) return;
  markDelivered(ctx, emit, attempt.agentId, ids);
  const drop = ctx.db.query('DELETE FROM pending_deliveries WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId AND message_id = $id');
  for (const id of ids) drop.run({ attemptId: attempt.id, id });
}

/**
 * attempt.acknowledged: the turn that consumed the messages ended. An acknowledgement whose delivery report has not
 * been applied counts as one too.
 */
export function onAcknowledged(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt, messageIds: readonly number[]): void {
  onDelivered(ctx, emit, attempt, messageIds);
  const delivered = ctx.db.query('SELECT 1 FROM deliveries WHERE message_id = $id AND agent_id = $agentId');
  const ids = [...new Set(messageIds)].filter(
    (id) => id !== 0 && delivered.get({ id, agentId: attempt.agentId }) !== null,
  );
  if (ids.length === 0) return;
  const ack = ctx.db.query(
    'UPDATE deliveries SET acked_at = $now WHERE message_id = $id AND agent_id = $agentId AND acked_at IS NULL',
  );
  for (const id of ids) ack.run({ now: ctx.now(), id, agentId: attempt.agentId });
  emit({ type: 'message.acknowledged', actor: `agent:${attempt.agentId}`, data: { ids } });
}

/**
 * Runs flushDeliveries when a sent message's batch is due, and again for as long as batches wait. Returns the stop
 * function. startHub runs it with its timers; the hub's housekeeping also flushes, in case a timer's run failed.
 */
export function watchDeliveries(ctx: HubContext): () => void {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let stopped = false;
  const schedule = (delayMs: number) => {
    if (timer !== null || stopped) return;
    timer = setTimeout(run, Math.max(1, delayMs));
  };
  function run(): void {
    timer = null;
    try {
      const { dueAt } = flushDeliveries(ctx);
      if (dueAt !== null) schedule(dueAt - ctx.now());
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('the delivery flush failed', error);
    }
  }
  const unsubscribe = ctx.bus.subscribe((event) => {
    if (event.type === 'message.sent') schedule(ctx.config.deliveryBatchMs);
  });
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    unsubscribe();
    if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = null;
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

The tick runs every 15 s, too slow for a 2 s batch, so `watchDeliveries` flushes on `message.sent` and when a batch is due; `startHub` runs it when timers are on, and housekeeping flushes as a backstop. A batch is held until its oldest message is `deliveryBatchMs` old. The first message always goes, even over the 6,000-character limit, so nothing can get stuck. A refused deliver (`not_running`, `stale_fence`) frees its rows.

### Task 48: Deliveries when attempts end

Stops and endings settle deliveries (design 6.7, Endings; 6.11, Failover). From `stop_requested` on, nothing is pushed, and pending deliver commands are cancelled. At the end, pending rows are dropped and a worker's unacknowledged messages are copied to its task thread for the successor. A runner lead's unacknowledged lead deliveries are deleted, so the next seat holder gets them unread.

```diff
+ */
+export function cancelPendingDeliveries(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): number {
+  const rows = ctx.db
+    .query(
+      `UPDATE runner_commands SET status = 'cancelled', done_at = $now
+       WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId AND kind = 'deliver' AND status = 'pending'
+       RETURNING id, sent_at`,
+    )
+    .all({ attemptId, now: ctx.now() }) as { id: string; sent_at: number | null }[];
+  freeDeliveries(ctx, rows.filter((row) => row.sent_at === null).map((row) => row.id));
+  return rows.length;
+}
```

```diff
+/**
+ * What a worker never acknowledged, oldest first: messages delivered to its agent with no acknowledgement, those in
+ * flight to the attempt, and those it never got that were sent to the agent itself or to everyone since it was made
+ * (unreadFor's rule; a successor is a new agent, so a broadcast it predates would reach nobody). Its task's own
+ * thread is left out: the successor reads that anyway.
+ */
+const UNACKNOWLEDGED_SQL = `
+SELECT m.* FROM messages m
+WHERE m.target != $thread AND m.sender != $self AND (
+  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.message_id = m.id AND d.agent_id = $agentId AND d.acked_at IS NULL)
+  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pending_deliveries p WHERE p.message_id = m.id AND p.attempt_id = $attemptId)
+  OR ((m.target = $self OR (m.target = 'all' AND m.created_at >= $createdAt))
+    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.message_id = m.id AND d.agent_id = $agentId))
+)
+ORDER BY m.id`;
+
+/**
+ * Settles a runner attempt's deliveries as it ends (design 6.7, Endings), before the ending's cancel frees the rows
+ * of its pending commands. A worker's unacknowledged messages are copied, from their sender, to its task's thread
+ * (task:<id>), so the successor reads them. A lead's unacknowledged deliveries of lead messages are deleted, so the
+ * next seat holder gets them unread. Either way the attempt's rows go.
+ */
+export function settleDeliveriesOnEnd(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt): void {
+  if (attempt.runnerId === null) return;
+  const { agentId, taskId } = attempt;
+  if (taskId !== null) {
+    const thread = `task:${taskId}`;
+    const { createdAt } = getAgent(ctx, agentId);
+    const rows = ctx.db
+      .query(UNACKNOWLEDGED_SQL)
+      .all({ thread, self: `agent:${agentId}`, agentId, attemptId: attempt.id, createdAt }) as MessageRow[];
+    for (const row of rows) insertMessage(ctx, emit, { from: row.sender, to: thread, body: row.body, taskId });
+  } else {
+    ctx.db
+      .query(
+        `DELETE FROM deliveries WHERE agent_id = $agentId AND acked_at IS NULL
+           AND message_id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE target = 'lead')`,
+      )
+      .run({ agentId });
+  }
+  ctx.db.query('DELETE FROM pending_deliveries WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId').run({ attemptId: attempt.id });
+}
+
 /**
  * Runs flushDeliveries when a sent message's batch is due, and again for as long as batches wait. Returns the stop
  * function. startHub runs it with its timers; the hub's housekeeping also flushes, in case a timer's run failed.
```

`cancelPendingDeliveries` frees only the rows of delivers never sent, so a deliver already sent keeps its rows and its later report is still recorded. Copies keep their original sender, so a person's authority survives the copy.

### Task 49: quota_wait and the reset probe

An exhausted `attempt.quota` moves a running attempt to `quota_wait`, and `attempt.quota` with state `ok`, or fresh facts in a turn, moves it back (design 6.10; X-14). With a null account id it updates no account (X-21). `probeUnknownResets` sends an exhausted Codex account with an unknown reset one `preflight` per `quotaUnknownMs`, to one online runner of that owner on that account; Claude keeps Task 10's probing start.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type Attempt, type AttemptFacts, TEST_ACCOUNT_ID, type Vendor, type VendorQuota } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { createSession } from '../src/auth';
import type { HubContext } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { Gateway } from '../src/gateway';
import { accountFor, listAccounts, probeUnknownResets } from '../src/quota';
import { createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { type FakeConnection, type FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addRunner, createTestContext, newTask, testVendor } from './helpers';

const HOUR = 60 * 60_000;

type Link = FakeRunner<FakeConnection>;

function quota(ctx: HubContext, overrides: Partial<VendorQuota> = {}): VendorQuota {
  return {
    state: 'ok',
    resetsAt: null,
    windows: { fiveHour: 0.4, weekly: 0.2 },
    paidUsage: 'disabled',
    updatedAt: ctx.now(),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function factsOf(attempt: Attempt, phase: AttemptFacts['phase']): AttemptFacts {
  return {
    attemptId: attempt.id,
    fence: attempt.fence,
    phase,
    eventAgeMs: 5_000,
    tool: null,
    fsAgeMs: 20_000,
    commitAgeMs: null,
    turns: 3,
    turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
    repeatedCalls: 0,
    continuations: 0,
    vendorErrorMs: 0,
    activeMs: 90_000,
    contextUsed: 0.4,
  };
}

/** A hub with runner R-1 connected, whose heartbeats carry the facts in `reported`, and a running worker on it. */
async function setup(vendor: Vendor = 'codex') {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const runnerId = addRunner(ctx, { vendors: ['claude', 'codex'] });
  const reported: { facts: AttemptFacts[] } = { facts: [] };
  const runner = await connectFakeRunner(ctx, new Gateway(ctx), {
    token: createSession(ctx, 'alice', 'cli'),
    facts: () => reported.facts,
  });
  const [task] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Parser' })], 'user:alice');
  const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task?.id as string, role: 'worker', vendor });
  await settle();
  runner.startRunning(attempt.id);
  await settle();
  return { ctx, clock, runnerId, runner, reported, attempt: getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id) };
}

async function reportQuota(
  ctx: HubContext,
  runner: Link,
  attempt: Attempt,
  vendorQuota: VendorQuota,
  accountId: string | null = TEST_ACCOUNT_ID,
): Promise<void> {
  const at = { attemptId: attempt.id, fence: getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).fence };
  runner.emit('attempt.quota', { vendor: attempt.vendor, accountId, quota: vendorQuota }, at);
  await settle();
  expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT type, error FROM runner_event_rejects').all()).toEqual([]);
}

const eventsOf = (ctx: HubContext, type: string) => listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === type);

describe('quota_wait', () => {
  test('an exhausted attempt.quota moves a running attempt to quota_wait, and its lease keeps renewing', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runner, reported, attempt } = await setup();
    const resetsAt = ctx.now() + HOUR;
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt }));
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'quota_wait', quotaResetsAt: resetsAt });
    expect(accountFor(ctx, 'alice', 'codex', TEST_ACCOUNT_ID)?.quota).toMatchObject({ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt });
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.quota_wait').map((event) => [event.subject, event.data])).toEqual([
      [
        attempt.taskId,
        { attemptId: attempt.id, taskId: attempt.taskId, agentId: attempt.agentId, runnerId: attempt.runnerId, resetsAt },
      ],
    ]);

    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs - 1_000);
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt, 'quota_wait')];
    runner.heartbeat();
    await settle();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'quota_wait',
      leaseExpiresAt: ctx.now() + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs,
    });
  });

  test('state ok moves it back to running and emits attempt.running', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runner, attempt } = await setup();
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: ctx.now() + HOUR }));
    const running = eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.running').length;
    clock.advance(HOUR);
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx));
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'running', quotaResetsAt: null });
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.running')).toHaveLength(running + 1);
    // A running attempt's ok report changes nothing more.
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx));
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.running')).toHaveLength(running + 1);
  });

  test('fresh facts with phase turn move it back to running; other phases leave it waiting', async () => {
    const { ctx, runner, reported, attempt } = await setup();
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: null }));
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt, 'idle')];
    runner.heartbeat();
    await settle();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).status).toBe('quota_wait');
    const running = eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.running').length;
    reported.facts = [factsOf(attempt, 'turn')];
    runner.heartbeat();
    await settle();
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'running', quotaResetsAt: null, phase: 'turn' });
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.running')).toHaveLength(running + 1);
  });

  test('a second exhausted report updates the reset time and emits nothing more', async () => {
    const { ctx, runner, attempt } = await setup();
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: ctx.now() + HOUR }));
    const later = ctx.now() + 2 * HOUR;
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: later }));
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'quota_wait', quotaResetsAt: later });
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.quota_wait')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('a report with state unknown leaves a running attempt alone', async () => {
    const { ctx, runner, attempt } = await setup();
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'unknown' }));
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).status).toBe('running');
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'attempt.quota_wait')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a null account id moves the attempt and updates no account', async () => {
    const { ctx, runner, attempt } = await setup();
    const before = listAccounts(ctx);
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: null }), null);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'quota_wait', quotaResetsAt: null });
    expect(listAccounts(ctx)).toEqual(before);
    await reportQuota(ctx, runner, attempt, quota(ctx), null);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id).status).toBe('running');
    expect(listAccounts(ctx)).toEqual(before);
  });
});

describe('probeUnknownResets', () => {
  /** The preflight commands queued so far, as [runner, vendor]. */
  const preflights = (ctx: HubContext) =>

    clock.advance(1);
    expect(probeUnknownResets(ctx)).toBe(1);

    // Once per quotaUnknownMs, timed by the last preflight.
    clock.advance(ctx.config.quotaUnknownMs - 1);
    expect(probeUnknownResets(ctx)).toBe(0);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(probeUnknownResets(ctx)).toBe(1);
    expect(preflights(ctx).slice(before)).toHaveLength(2);

    runner.emit('runner.vendors', {

  });

    addRunner(ctx, { owner: 'bob', vendors: ['codex'] });

    ctx.db
      .query(`UPDATE runners SET info = json_set(info, '$.vendors[0].accountId', 'another-account') WHERE id = $id`)

    offline.run({ id: runnerId });

    clock.advance(ctx.config.quotaUnknownMs);
    expect(probeUnknownResets(ctx)).toBe(1);
    expect(preflights(ctx).slice(before)).toEqual([[spare, 'codex']]);
    // With no online runner on the account, none is asked.

    clock.advance(ctx.config.quotaUnknownMs);

    expect(probeUnknownResets(claude.ctx)).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```diff
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// quota_wait (design 6.10)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/**
+ * attempt.quota (design 6.10, quota_wait; X-14). The account's quota is stored when the event names the account; a
+ * null account id updates no account (X-21). An exhaustion moves a running attempt to quota_wait until its reset, and
+ * state ok, which the runner reports when it resumes the waiting turn, moves it back to running. A waiting attempt
+ * keeps its runner lease, renewed by heartbeats like any other.
+ */
+export function onAttemptQuota(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  emit: Emit,
+  runnerId: string,
+  attempt: Attempt,
+  data: RunnerEventData['attempt.quota'],
+): void {
+  const { vendor, accountId, quota } = data;
+  if (accountId !== null) recordQuotaReports(ctx, emit, runnerId, [{ vendor, accountId, quota }]);
+  if (quota.state === 'ok') {
+    leaveQuotaWait(ctx, emit, attempt);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (quota.state !== 'exhausted') return;
+  if (attempt.status === 'quota_wait') {
+    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { quotaResetsAt: quota.resetsAt });
+    return;
+  }
+  if (attempt.status !== 'running') return;
+  updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'quota_wait', quotaResetsAt: quota.resetsAt });
+  emit({
+    type: 'attempt.quota_wait',
+    actor: byRunner(attempt),
+    subject: attemptSubject(attempt),
+    data: { ...attemptData(attempt), resetsAt: quota.resetsAt },
+  });
+}
+
+/** A waiting attempt whose turn goes on runs again (X-14). */
+function leaveQuotaWait(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attempt: Attempt): void {
+  if (attempt.status !== 'quota_wait') return;
+  updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { status: 'running', quotaResetsAt: null });
+  const subject = attemptSubject(attempt);
+  emit({ type: 'attempt.running', actor: byRunner(attempt), subject, data: attemptData(attempt) });
+}
```

```diff
+  findRunnerRows(ctx).filter(
+    (row) =>
+      row.owner === account.owner &&
+      runnerInfo(row).vendors.some((slot) => slot.vendor === account.vendor && slot.accountId === account.accountId),
+  );

+/** When the hub last sent a Codex preflight to one of the runners, or null. */
+function lastCodexPreflight(ctx: HubContext, runnerIds: readonly string[]): number | null {
+  if (runnerIds.length === 0) return null;
+  const row = ctx.db
+    .query(
+      `SELECT MAX(created_at) AS at FROM runner_commands
+       WHERE kind = 'preflight' AND json_extract(payload, '$.vendor') = 'codex'
+         AND runner_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($runnerIds))`,
+    )
+    .get({ runnerIds: JSON.stringify(runnerIds) }) as { at: number | null };
+  return row.at;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The Codex reset probe (design 6.10, Unknown reset times; X-14). An exhausted Codex account whose reset is unknown
+ * gets one preflight { vendor: 'codex' }, on the first online runner of its owner logged in to it, once quotaUnknownMs
+ * has passed since the report and since the last Codex preflight to those runners: preflight reads the account's rate
+ * limits, and its runner.vendors answer lifts the exhaustion. Claude's probe is its next start (core's usableVendors).
+ * One account's failure is logged and leaves the others probed. Returns how many preflights it sent.
+ */
+export function probeUnknownResets(ctx: HubContext): number {
+  const now = ctx.now();
+  const wait = ctx.config.quotaUnknownMs;
+  let sent = 0;
+  for (const account of listAccounts(ctx)) {
+    const { quota } = account;
+    if (account.vendor !== 'codex' || quota.state !== 'exhausted' || quota.resetsAt !== null) continue;
+    if (now < quota.updatedAt + wait) continue;
+    const runners = runnersOn(ctx, account);
+    const last = lastCodexPreflight(ctx, runners.map((row) => row.id));
+    if (last !== null && now < last + wait) continue;
+    const online = runners.find((row) => row.state === 'online');
+    if (!online) continue;
+    try {
+      tx(ctx, () => enqueueCommand(ctx, online.id, { kind: 'preflight', vendor: 'codex' }));
+      sent += 1;
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error(`probing the reset of ${account.owner}'s codex account ${account.accountId} failed`, error);
+    }
+  }
+  return sent;
+}
```

### Task 50: Approvals: requests, decisions and voiding

Codex escalations are relayed to the agent's owner, who alone answers them, in a browser (design 6.10, Approvals). This task stores each `approval.requested`, accepts decisions only from the owner's web session, and sends `decide_approval` at the approval's fence. Approvals are voided on exit, resume, re-fence, ending and stop request. It mounts `GET /api/approvals` and `POST /api/approvals/:id` (6.16).

```ts
type Hub = ReturnType<typeof createTestHub>;

/** A hub with a running Codex worker of alice's. */

  const hub = createTestHub();
  const held = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { vendor: 'codex' });

/**
 * The runner sends an event about the attempt, at its fence as the hub has it now and stamped with the hub's time,
 * unless they are given.
 */
function send<T extends 'approval.requested' | 'approval.voided' | 'attempt.exited'>(
  hub: Hub,
  held: RunnerAttempt,
  type: T,
  data: RunnerEventData[T],
  fence: Fence = getAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id).fence,
  at: number = hub.ctx.now(),
): void {
  const raw: RawRunnerEvent = { seq: ++seq, at, type, attemptId: held.attempt.id, fence, data };
  applyRunnerEvents(hub.ctx, held.runner.id, { outboxEpoch: 'outbox-1', events: [raw] }, { restoreReplay: false });
  expect(hub.ctx.db.query('SELECT error FROM runner_event_rejects').all()).toEqual([]);
}

const command = { command: 'bun install', cwd: '/clone', reason: 'needs the network' };

/** The runner relays a command approval; returns its id. */
function requested(hub: Hub, held: RunnerAttempt, fence?: Fence, at?: number): string {
  const approvalId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const data = { approvalId, kind: 'command', summary: 'bun install', detail: command } as const;
  send(hub, held, 'approval.requested', data, fence, at);
  return approvalId;
}

describe('voiding', () => {
  test('approval.voided voids one and emits approval.voided', () => {
    const { hub, held } = setup();
    const one = requested(hub, held);
    const other = requested(hub, held);
    send(hub, held, 'approval.voided', { approvalId: one });
    expect([statusOf(hub, one), statusOf(hub, other)]).toEqual(['void', 'pending']);
    expect(findApproval(hub.ctx, one)?.decidedAt).toBe(hub.ctx.now());
    expect(eventsOf(hub, 'approval.voided').map((event) => event.data.approvalId)).toEqual([one]);
  });

    const { hub, held } = setup();
    const theirs = requested(hub, held);
    const other = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { vendor: 'codex', runnerId: held.runner.id });
    send(hub, other, 'approval.voided', { approvalId: theirs });
    expect(statusOf(hub, theirs)).toBe('pending');
    expect(attemptLog(hub.ctx, other.attempt.id).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'rejected' });
    expect(eventsOf(hub, 'approval.voided')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a resume or re-fence, and an ending, void the attempt's pending approvals", () => {
    const { hub, held } = setup();
    const first = requested(hub, held);
    resumeAttempt(hub.ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'runner_restart', prompt: 'Go on.' });
    expect(statusOf(hub, first)).toBe('void');
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id, { status: 'running' });
    const second = requested(hub, held);
    endAttempt(hub.ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, trigger: 'crashed', error: 'boom' });
    expect(statusOf(hub, second)).toBe('void');
    expect(eventsOf(hub, 'approval.voided').map((event) => event.data.approvalId)).toEqual([first, second]);
  });

  test('a stop request voids those pending then; one raised during the handoff turn is relayed as usual', () => {
    const { hub, held } = setup();
    const before = requested(hub, held);
    requestStop(hub.ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'stop', reason: 'enough', by: 'user:alice' });
    expect(statusOf(hub, before)).toBe('void');
    const during = requested(hub, held);
    expect(statusOf(hub, during)).toBe('pending');
  });

  test('a deferred stop voids nothing until it applies', () => {
    const { hub, held } = setup();
    const id = requested(hub, held);
    const stop = { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'stop', reason: 'enough', by: 'user:alice' } as const;
    requestStop(hub.ctx, { ...stop, deferred: true });
    expect(statusOf(hub, id)).toBe('pending');
    // A failed submission applies it by requesting it again, not deferred.
    requestStop(hub.ctx, { ...stop, deferred: false });
    expect(statusOf(hub, id)).toBe('void');
  });

  test('an exit voids its approvals, whether or not it ends the attempt', () => {
    const { hub, held } = setup();
    // A holding attempt's process exits and the attempt holds on.
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id, { status: 'holding' });
    const holding = requested(hub, held);
    send(hub, held, 'attempt.exited', exited);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, held.attempt.id).status).toBe('holding');
    expect(statusOf(hub, holding)).toBe('void');

    const ended = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { vendor: 'codex', runnerId: held.runner.id });
    const late = requested(hub, ended);
    endAttempt(hub.ctx, { attemptId: ended.attempt.id, trigger: 'crashed', error: 'boom' });
    hub.ctx.db.run(`UPDATE approvals SET status = 'pending' WHERE id = '${late}'`);
    send(hub, ended, 'attempt.exited', exited, ended.attempt.fence);
    expect(statusOf(hub, late)).toBe('void');
  });
});

    expect((await list('alice', '?status=maybe')).status).toBe(400);
```

```ts
// Approvals (design 6.10, Approvals): the Codex escalations a runner relays to the agent's owner, who alone answers
// them, in a browser. The hub stores each request, sends the owner's decision back as decide_approval at the
// approval's fence, and voids what no process can take any more: when the runner says so or the process exits, and
// when the attempt is resumed, re-fenced, ended or asked to stop. attempts.ts voids through this module, so it imports
// nothing that ends attempts.
import type { Approval, Attempt, Fence, RunnerEventData } from '@agflow/core';
import { appendAttemptLog, attemptSubject } from './attempt-store';
import { enqueueCommand } from './commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from './context';
import { conflict, forbidden, notFound } from './errors';
import type { Emit } from './events';
import { findRunnerRow } from './runners';

interface ApprovalRow {
  id: string;
  attempt_id: string;
  fence_epoch: number;
  fence_counter: number;
  runner_id: string;
  owner: string;
  task_id: string | null;
  agent_id: string;
  kind: Approval['kind'];
  summary: string;
  detail: string;
  status: Approval['status'];
  decided_by: string | null;
  created_at: number;
  expires_at: number;
  decided_at: number | null;
}

const rowToApproval = (row: ApprovalRow): Approval => ({
  id: row.id,
  attemptId: row.attempt_id,
  fence: { epoch: row.fence_epoch, counter: row.fence_counter },
  runnerId: row.runner_id,
  owner: row.owner,
  taskId: row.task_id,
  agentId: row.agent_id,
  kind: row.kind,
  summary: row.summary,
  detail: JSON.parse(row.detail) as Approval['detail'],
  status: row.status,
  decidedBy: row.decided_by,
  createdAt: row.created_at,
  expiresAt: row.expires_at,
  decidedAt: row.decided_at,
});

export function findApproval(ctx: HubContext, id: string): Approval | null {
  const row = ctx.db.query('SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE id = $id').get({ id }) as ApprovalRow | null;
  return row ? rowToApproval(row) : null;
}

/** The owner's approvals, newest first; statuses narrows them when given. */
export function listApprovals(ctx: HubContext, owner: string, statuses?: readonly Approval['status'][]): Approval[] {
  const rows = ctx.db
    .query(
      `SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE owner = $owner
         AND ($statuses IS NULL OR status IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($statuses)))
       ORDER BY created_at DESC, rowid DESC`,
    )
    .all({ owner, statuses: statuses ? JSON.stringify(statuses) : null }) as ApprovalRow[];
  return rows.map(rowToApproval);
}

/** The data every approval event carries (design 6.17), on the subject of its attempt's events. */
function approvalEvent(approval: Approval): { subject: string; data: Record<string, unknown> } {
  return {
    subject: attemptSubject({ id: approval.attemptId, taskId: approval.taskId }),
    data: {
      approvalId: approval.id,
      attemptId: approval.attemptId,
      taskId: approval.taskId,
      agentId: approval.agentId,
      runnerId: approval.runnerId,
      summary: approval.summary,
    },
  };
}

/** Moves a pending approval to its outcome; returns it as stored, or null when it was no longer pending. */
function settle(
  ctx: HubContext,
  approval: Approval,
  status: Exclude<Approval['status'], 'pending'>,
  decidedBy: string | null,
): Approval | null {
  const changed = ctx.db
    .query(
      `UPDATE approvals SET status = $status, decided_by = $decidedBy, decided_at = $now
       WHERE id = $id AND status = 'pending'`,
    )
    .run({ id: approval.id, status, decidedBy, now: ctx.now() });
  return changed.changes === 0 ? null : findApproval(ctx, approval.id);
}

/** Sends the answer to the runner at the approval's fence; the runner applies it only to that process and request. */
function sendDecision(
  ctx: HubContext,
  approval: Approval,
  decision: 'approve' | 'decline',
  reason: string | null,
): void {
  enqueueCommand(ctx, approval.runnerId, {
    kind: 'decide_approval',
    attemptId: approval.attemptId,
    fence: approval.fence,
    approvalId: approval.id,
    decision,
    reason,
  });
}

/**
 * approval.requested at the attempt's current fence (design 6.10): the request is stored for the runner's owner, as
 * the hub received it, and expires approvalMs later. A second request with an id the hub already has is logged on the
 * attempt and changes nothing.
 */
export function onApprovalRequested(
  ctx: HubContext,
  emit: Emit,
  runnerId: string,
  attempt: Attempt,
  event: { fence: Fence; data: RunnerEventData['approval.requested'] },
): void {
  const { approvalId, kind, summary, detail } = event.data;
  if (findApproval(ctx, approvalId)) {
    appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'rejected', `approval ${approvalId} was already requested`);
    return;
  }
  const runner = findRunnerRow(ctx, runnerId);
  if (!runner) throw notFound(`runner ${runnerId}`);
  const now = ctx.now();
  ctx.db
    .query(
      `INSERT INTO approvals (id, attempt_id, fence_epoch, fence_counter, runner_id, owner, task_id, agent_id, kind,
         summary, detail, status, created_at, expires_at)
       VALUES ($id, $attemptId, $epoch, $counter, $runnerId, $owner, $taskId, $agentId, $kind, $summary, $detail,
         'pending', $now, $expiresAt)`,
    )
    .run({
      id: approvalId,
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      epoch: event.fence.epoch,
      counter: event.fence.counter,
      runnerId,
      owner: runner.owner,
      taskId: attempt.taskId,
      agentId: attempt.agentId,
      kind,
      summary,
      detail: JSON.stringify(detail),
      now,
      expiresAt: now + ctx.config.approvalMs,
    });
  const { subject, data } = approvalEvent(findApproval(ctx, approvalId) as Approval);
  emit({ type: 'approval.requested', actor: `runner:${runnerId}`, subject, data: { ...data, kind } });
}

/** Voids one pending approval and emits approval.voided; false when it was not pending. */
function voidOne(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, approval: Approval, actor: string): boolean {
  const voided = settle(ctx, approval, 'void', null);
  if (!voided) return false;
  const { subject, data } = approvalEvent(voided);
  emit({ type: 'approval.voided', actor, subject, data });
  return true;
}

/** approval.voided: the runner's request is gone, so its approval is void. One of another attempt is logged. */
export function onApprovalVoided(
  ctx: HubContext,
  emit: Emit,
  attempt: Attempt,
  data: RunnerEventData['approval.voided'],
): void {
  const approval = findApproval(ctx, data.approvalId);
  if (!approval || approval.attemptId !== attempt.id) {
    appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'rejected', `approval.voided names approval ${data.approvalId}, not its own`);
    return;
  }
  voidOne(ctx, emit, approval, `runner:${attempt.runnerId}`);
}

/**
 * Voids every pending approval of the attempt, in the caller's transaction (design 6.10, Voiding): its process exited,
 * or the attempt is resumed, re-fenced, ended or asked to stop. Returns how many.
 */
export function voidApprovals(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, attemptId: string, actor = 'system'): number {
  const rows = ctx.db
    .query("SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE attempt_id = $attemptId AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at, rowid")
    .all({ attemptId }) as ApprovalRow[];
  return rows.filter((row) => voidOne(ctx, emit, rowToApproval(row), actor)).length;
}

/**
 * POST /api/approvals/:id (design 6.10, Who may answer): only the owner decides, once, and the decision goes to the
 * runner as decide_approval at the approval's fence. Approve maps only to the vendor's one-time accept, which the
 * runner applies. user is the login of the person in the browser.
 */
export function decideApproval(
  ctx: HubContext,
  id: string,
  user: string,
  decision: 'approve' | 'decline',
): Approval {
  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
    const approval = findApproval(ctx, id);
    if (!approval) throw notFound(`approval ${id}`);
    if (approval.owner !== user) throw forbidden(`approval ${id} is ${approval.owner}'s to answer`);
    const by = `user:${user}`;
    const decided = settle(ctx, approval, decision === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'declined', by);
    if (!decided) throw conflict(`approval ${id} is ${approval.status}`);
    sendDecision(ctx, decided, decision, null);
    const { subject, data } = approvalEvent(decided);
    emit({ type: 'approval.decided', actor: by, subject, data: { ...data, decision } });
    return decided;
  });
}
```

**File:** `packages/hub/src/http/approval-routes.ts` (new)

```ts
// Approvals (design 6.10, 6.16): people list their own, and only the owner, in a browser, answers one. Agent tokens
// never get here (the route allowlist refuses them), and a CLI token or a live agent is no browser.
import { ApprovalDecisionInputSchema, ApprovalsQuerySchema } from '@agflow/core';
import { decideApproval, listApprovals } from '../approvals';
import type { HubContext } from '../context';
import type { App } from './app';
import { human, principal, readBody, readQuery } from './util';

export function mountApprovalRoutes(app: App, ctx: HubContext): void {
  app.get('/api/approvals', (c) => {
    const p = principal(c);
    const { status } = readQuery(c, ApprovalsQuerySchema);
    return c.json({ approvals: listApprovals(ctx, p.user, status) });
  });

  app.post('/api/approvals/:id', async (c) => {
    const p = human(c);
    const { decision } = await readBody(c, ApprovalDecisionInputSchema);
    return c.json({ approval: decideApproval(ctx, c.req.param('id'), p.user, decision) });
  });
}
```

A deferred stop voids nothing: a successful submission may still drop it, and the agent would wait on an approval nobody can answer. When the deferred stop is applied, it is requested again and voids then. `approvals.ts` imports nothing that ends attempts, so `attempts.ts` can call it.

### Task 51: Approvals: expiry and owner away

An approval nobody answers is declined at `approvalMs`, and the owner's account is marked away (design 6.10, Expiry and Owner away). The mark clears on any approval decision by the owner or a PATCH of one of their runners (X-39). While it lasts, core's `usableVendors` refuses that account, so placement stops sending the owner work that may need them.

**Files:**
- Modify: `packages/hub/src/approvals.ts`
- Modify: `packages/hub/src/quota.ts`
- Test: `packages/hub/test/approvals.test.ts`

```diff
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Owner away (design 6.10)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/** The reading of an account no runner has reported yet: older than any report, so the first one replaces it. */
+const UNREPORTED: VendorQuota = {
+  state: 'unknown',
+  resetsAt: null,
+  windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
+  paidUsage: 'unknown',
+  updatedAt: 0,
+};
+
+export interface OwnerAwayInput {
+  owner: string;
+  vendor: Vendor;
+  /** The account the approval's runner reports for the vendor; null marks every account of the owner on the vendor. */
+  accountId: string | null;
+  /** The approval whose expiry marks the owner away. */
+  approvalId: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Marks the owner's account for the vendor away after an approval expired (design 6.10, Owner away; X-39): core's
+ * usableVendors then places no new attempts of that vendor on any of the owner's runners logged in to it. An account
+ * without a quota report is stored with an unknown reading to carry the mark. account.owner_away goes out for each
+ * account newly marked. Returns how many.
+ */
+export function setOwnerAway(ctx: HubContext, emit: Emit, input: OwnerAwayInput): number {
+  const { owner, vendor, accountId, approvalId } = input;
+  const marked = (
+    accountId === null
+      ? ctx.db
+          .query(
+            `UPDATE vendor_accounts SET owner_away = 1 WHERE owner = $owner AND vendor = $vendor AND owner_away = 0
+             RETURNING account_id`,
+          )
+          .all({ owner, vendor })
+      : ctx.db
+          .query(
+            `INSERT INTO vendor_accounts (owner, vendor, account_id, quota, owner_away, updated_at)
+             VALUES ($owner, $vendor, $accountId, $quota, 1, $now)
+             ON CONFLICT (owner, vendor, account_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_away = 1 WHERE vendor_accounts.owner_away = 0
+             RETURNING account_id`,
+          )
+          .all({ owner, vendor, accountId, quota: JSON.stringify(UNREPORTED), now: ctx.now() })
+  ) as { account_id: string }[];
+  for (const row of marked) {
+    emit({
+      type: 'account.owner_away',
+      actor: 'system',
+      subject: owner,
+      data: { vendor, accountId: row.account_id, approvalId },
+    });
+  }
+  return marked.length;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Clears every owner-away mark of the owner, when they act (X-39): any approval decision of theirs, or a PATCH of one
+ * of their runners (task 52). Returns how many accounts it cleared.
+ */
+export function clearOwnerAway(ctx: HubContext, owner: string): number {
+  return ctx.db
+    .query('UPDATE vendor_accounts SET owner_away = 0 WHERE owner = $owner AND owner_away = 1')
+    .run({ owner }).changes;
+}
```

An expired approval gets `decide_approval` with decision `decline` and a reason that tells the agent to continue without it or to call `declare_blocked`. If the owner decided anything since the expiry time, the approval is still declined but the owner is not marked away. When the runner names no account id, every stored account of the owner on that vendor is marked.

### Task 52: Runner routes: list, settings and retire

This task mounts the Runners page's routes (design 6.16) inside Task 23's runner route mount (X-45). `GET /api/runners` lists runners with their accounts. The owner, in a browser, changes a runner's settings with `PATCH /api/runners/:id`, within `RunnerPatchInputSchema`'s bounds; the change goes out as `update_settings` at a new version (X-12) and clears owner away (X-39). `DELETE /api/runners/:id` and `POST /api/runner/retire` retire a runner: its open attempts end lost and its link closes with 4403.

```diff
+/** Attempts that still hold something of their runner's: a process, a clone or a lease. */
+const OPEN_ON_RUNNER: readonly AttemptStatus[] = ['starting', 'running', 'quota_wait', 'holding'];
+
+/**
+ * Ends the runner's open attempts lost as it is retired (design 6.16), in the caller's transaction: a held task goes
+ * stale and back to ready, a submitted one keeps its status for its review, and a lead's seat empties. A take-over in
+ * flight ends taken_over, as at its lease expiry: its clone waits for the hand-back. Returns how many ended.
+ */
+export function retireRunnerAttempts(ctx: HubContext, runnerId: string, actor: string): number {
+  let ended = 0;
+  for (const attempt of listAttempts(ctx, { runner: runnerId, status: [...OPEN_ON_RUNNER] }).reverse()) {
+    const trigger = attempt.stopRequested?.cause === 'takeover' ? 'takeover' : 'lost';
+    if (endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger, error: 'the runner was retired', actor })) ended += 1;
+  }
+  return ended;
+}
```

```diff
+/** The runner row for an action only its owner may take: 404 when unknown, 403 for anyone else. Retired ones too. */
+function ownersRow(row: RunnerRow | null, user: string, name: string): RunnerRow {
```

### Task 53: Agent actions: stop, hold, replace and interrupt

This task mounts the agent actions of design 6.16 for runner agents inside M1's agent route mount (X-45), with X-34's rules. People act on any runner agent. The seat holder stops, holds or replaces workers only. A person stopping or replacing a runner lead ends it and empties the seat; hold is refused for leads. Live chats get 409, and interrupt is for people only.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { AttemptResponseSchema, OkResponseSchema } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { onExited } from '../src/attempts';
import { mintAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { tx } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { seatHolderId } from '../src/hub-state';
import { requestSubmission } from '../src/submissions';
import { getTask, writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { type RunnerAttempt, addRunnerAttempt, addRunnerLead } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

type Hub = ReturnType<typeof createTestHub>;

const bearer = (token: string) => ({ headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
const asPerson = { user: 'alice', via: 'web' } as const;

const commandsOf = (hub: Hub, runnerId: string, kind: string) =>
  pendingCommands(hub.ctx, runnerId, 1)
    .map((row) => row.command)
    .filter((command) => command.kind === kind);

const eventsOf = (hub: Hub, type: string) => listEvents(hub.ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === type);

/** A hub with a running runner worker and a runner lead holding the seat, and the lead's agent token. */
function setup() {
  const hub = createTestHub();
  const worker = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
  const lead = addRunnerLead(hub.ctx);
  const leadToken = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, lead.attempt);
  return { hub, worker, lead, leadToken };
}

/** The runner reports the attempt's process gone, as it does once a stop completes. */
function exited(hub: Hub, attemptId: string): void {
  const attempt = getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId);
  const data = {
    code: 0,
    signal: null,
    stoppedBy: 'close',
    handoffWritten: true,
    cause: null,
    finalSha: null,
    finalWip: null,
    pushError: null,
  } as const;
  tx(hub.ctx, (emit) => onExited(hub.ctx, emit, attempt, data));
}
```

```diff
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Agent actions (design 6.16, X-34): stop, stop and hold, replace and interrupt of a runner agent
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+export interface AgentActionInput {
+  agentId: string;
+  /** The text the agent is given. */
+  reason: string;
+  /** user:<login> for a person, agent:<id> for the agent holding the lead seat. */
+  by: string;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The open runner attempt of the agent an action names. A live chat is refused (409: people release its task), and so
+ * is an agent whose attempt has ended. The lead acts on runner workers only; people act on leads too (X-34).
+ */
+function actionTarget(ctx: HubContext, input: Pick<AgentActionInput, 'agentId' | 'by'>): Attempt {
+  const agent = getAgent(ctx, input.agentId);
+  if (agent.origin !== 'runner' || agent.attemptId === null) {
+    throw conflict(`agent ${agent.id} runs in a live chat; release its task instead`);
+  }
+  const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, agent.attemptId);
+  if (attempt.status === 'ended') {
+    throw conflict(`agent ${agent.id}'s attempt has ended (${attempt.endReason ?? 'unknown reason'})`);
+  }
+  if (attempt.role === 'lead' && !input.by.startsWith('user:')) {
+    throw forbidden('the lead stops and replaces runner workers only; people stop or replace a lead');
+  }
+  return attempt;
+}
+
+/**
+ * POST /api/agents/:id/stop: a stop, or with hold a stop and hold, which pauses the task at once. A lead cannot be
+ * held (409). A person stopping a runner lead ends it stopped on exit, after its handoff turn, and the seat empties.
+ */
+export function stopAgent(ctx: HubContext, input: AgentActionInput & { hold: boolean }): StopRequestResult {
+  return tx(ctx, () => {
+    const attempt = actionTarget(ctx, input);
+    const cause = input.hold ? 'stop_hold' : 'stop';
+    return requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause, reason: input.reason, by: input.by });
+  });
+}
+
+/** POST /api/agents/:id/replace: the attempt ends replaced on exit, and a worker's task goes back to ready. */
+export function replaceAgent(ctx: HubContext, input: AgentActionInput): StopRequestResult {
+  return tx(ctx, () => {
+    const attempt = actionTarget(ctx, input);
+    return requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'replace', reason: input.reason, by: input.by });
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * POST /api/agents/:id/interrupt, a person's: the runner interrupts the agent's current turn, at the attempt's fence.
+ * An attempt with no process has no turn to interrupt (409).
+ */
+export function interruptAgent(ctx: HubContext, agentId: string, by: string): CommandRow {
+  return tx(ctx, () => {
+    const attempt = actionTarget(ctx, { agentId, by });
+    if (!hasLiveProcess(attempt)) {
+      throw conflict(`agent ${agentId} has no running process to interrupt (its attempt is ${attempt.status})`);
+    }
+    return enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, {
+      kind: 'interrupt',
+      attemptId: attempt.id,
+      fence: attempt.fence,
+    });
+  });
+}
+
 /**
  * The cause's at-once move, and the statuses it passed through: cancelled, or blocked with its kind and the request's
  * reason. Its event is the one M1's blockTask and cancelTask make for the same move, with the reason, so readers tell
```

### Task 54: Stall decisions and vendor outcomes

`supervisor.ts` judges stalls from fresh facts only and confirms a suspicion on the next fresh heartbeat before it stops the agent (design 6.8). After an hour of continuous vendor errors it replaces the attempt and marks the vendor degraded. It maps the vendor outcomes a runner reports (`VENDOR_OUTCOME_KINDS`) to the trigger table's stops (6.4). No stall is judged while a submission is pending (6.13).

```ts
import { describe, expect, spyOn, test } from 'bun:test';
import type { Attempt, AttemptFacts, RawRunnerEvent, RunnerEventData, VendorOutcomeKind } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAttempt, issueFence, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { markFactsStale, renewLeases, requestStop } from '../src/attempts';
import { pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { applyRunnerEvents } from '../src/events-in';
import { listMessages } from '../src/messages';
import { findRunnerRow, vendorHolds } from '../src/runners';
import { requestSubmission } from '../src/submissions';
import { getTask, writeTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { judgeStalls, onVendorOutcome, replaceForVendorErrors } from '../src/supervisor';
import { type RunnerAttempt, addRunnerAttempt, addRunnerLead, createTestContext } from './helpers';

/** Facts of a busy, healthy worker; overrides make a rule fire. */
function factsOf(attempt: Attempt, overrides: Partial<AttemptFacts> = {}): AttemptFacts {
  return {
    attemptId: attempt.id,
    fence: attempt.fence,
    phase: 'turn',
    eventAgeMs: 5_000,
    tool: null,
    fsAgeMs: 20_000,
    commitAgeMs: null,
    turns: 3,
    turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
    repeatedCalls: 0,
    continuations: 1,
    vendorErrorMs: 0,
    activeMs: 90_000,
    contextUsed: 0.42,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** A running runner worker, and a heartbeat that reports its facts now. */
function setup() {
  const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
  const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
  const beat = (attempt: Pick<Attempt, 'id'> & { runnerId: string | null }, overrides: Partial<AttemptFacts> = {}) =>
    tx(ctx, (emit) =>
      renewLeases(ctx, emit, attempt.runnerId as string, [factsOf(getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id), overrides)]),
    );
  return { ctx, clock, held, beat };
}

const silent = (ctx: HubContext): Partial<AttemptFacts> => ({ eventAgeMs: ctx.config.stallMs });

    .map((row) => row.command)
    .filter((command) => command.kind === 'stop_attempt');

const eventsOf = (ctx: HubContext, type: string) => listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === type);

describe('vendor errors', () => {
  test('vendorErrorMs past vendorErrorReplaceMs replaces the attempt and marks the vendor degraded there', () => {
    const { ctx, held, beat } = setup();
    beat(held.attempt, { phase: 'vendor_error', vendorErrorMs: ctx.config.vendorErrorReplaceMs - 1 });
    expect(replaceForVendorErrors(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    beat(held.attempt, { phase: 'vendor_error', vendorErrorMs: ctx.config.vendorErrorReplaceMs });
    // No second heartbeat is needed: vendor errors are no stall decision.
    expect(replaceForVendorErrors(ctx)).toEqual([held.attempt.id]);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'vendor_error', handoff: false });
    expect(stops(ctx, held)).toMatchObject([{ cause: 'vendor_error', handoff: false }]);
    const holds = vendorHolds(findRunnerRow(ctx, held.runner.id) as NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof findRunnerRow>>);
    expect(holds.claude?.degradedUntil).toBe(ctx.now() + ctx.config.degradedMs);
    // Once requested, it is not requested again.
    expect(replaceForVendorErrors(ctx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('judgeStalls replaces for vendor errors too, and stale facts replace nothing', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, held, beat } = setup();
    beat(held.attempt, { phase: 'vendor_error', vendorErrorMs: ctx.config.vendorErrorReplaceMs });
    clock.advance(2 * ctx.config.heartbeatMs + 1);
    expect(judgeStalls(ctx)).toEqual({ suspected: [], stopped: [] });
    beat(held.attempt, { phase: 'vendor_error', vendorErrorMs: ctx.config.vendorErrorReplaceMs });
    expect(judgeStalls(ctx)).toEqual({ suspected: [], stopped: [held.attempt.id] });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested?.cause).toBe('vendor_error');
  });
});

describe('vendor outcomes', () => {
  let seq = 0;

  /** The runner reports an attempt event at the attempt's fence. */
  function send<T extends 'attempt.vendor_outcome' | 'attempt.submitted'>(
    ctx: HubContext,
    held: RunnerAttempt,
    type: T,
    data: RunnerEventData[T],
  ) {
    const { id: attemptId, fence } = getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id);
    const events = [{ seq: ++seq, at: 0, type, attemptId, fence, data }] as RawRunnerEvent[];
    applyRunnerEvents(ctx, held.runner.id, { outboxEpoch: 'outbox-1', events }, { restoreReplay: false });
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT type, error FROM runner_event_rejects').all()).toEqual([]);
  }

  const report = (ctx: HubContext, held: RunnerAttempt, kind: VendorOutcomeKind, detail: string | null = null) =>
    send(ctx, held, 'attempt.vendor_outcome', { kind, detail });

  /** The attempt's task with a pending submission S-1. */
  function submitting(ctx: HubContext, held: RunnerAttempt): void {
    writeTask(ctx, held.task.id, { branch: 'agflow/T-1-task' });
    requestSubmission(ctx, held.task.id, held.agent, { summary: 'Done.', evidence: [] });
  }

  const head = 'a'.repeat(40);
  const pushed = { submissionId: 'S-1', ok: true, headSha: head, remoteHead: head, error: null, detail: null };
  const kindsOf = (ctx: HubContext, held: RunnerAttempt) =>
    pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1).map((row) => row.command.kind);

  test('auth stops it crashed, with no handoff, and marks the vendor not ready with a preflight', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    report(ctx, held, 'auth', 'OAuth token expired');
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'auth', handoff: false });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested?.reason).toContain('login expired');
    const holds = vendorHolds(findRunnerRow(ctx, held.runner.id) as NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof findRunnerRow>>);
    expect(holds.claude?.notReadySince).toBe(ctx.now());
    const kinds = pendingCommands(ctx, held.runner.id, 1).map((row) => row.command.kind);
    expect(kinds).toContain('preflight');
  });

  test('context replaces it with a handoff', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    report(ctx, held, 'context');
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'context', handoff: true });
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'agent.replaced')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('policy blocks the task as policy at once and tells people', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    report(ctx, held, 'policy', 'The request was refused under the usage policy.');
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'policy', handoff: false });
    expect(getTask(ctx, held.task.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'policy' });
    const told = listMessages(ctx, { target: 'humans' });
    expect(told.map((message) => [message.from, message.taskId])).toEqual([['system', held.task.id]]);
    expect(told[0]?.body).toContain('The request was refused under the usage policy.');
  });

  test('denials and session_budget stop it as stall_budget', () => {
    for (const kind of ['denials', 'session_budget'] as const) {
      const { ctx, held } = setup();
      report(ctx, held, kind);
      expect([kind, getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested?.cause]).toEqual([kind, 'stall_budget']);
      expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'agent.stalled')).toHaveLength(1);
    }
  });

  test('while a submission is pending, the outcome is held back for it: no stop goes out', () => {
    for (const kind of ['session_budget', 'context', 'policy'] as const) {
      const { ctx, held } = setup();
      submitting(ctx, held);
      const { status } = getTask(ctx, held.task.id);
      report(ctx, held, kind);
      const stop = getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested;
      const cause = kind === 'session_budget' ? 'stall_budget' : kind;
      expect([kind, stop?.cause, stop?.deferred]).toEqual([kind, cause, true]);
      expect(stops(ctx, held)).toEqual([]);
      expect(getTask(ctx, held.task.id).status).toBe(status);
      if (kind === 'policy') {
        const [told] = listMessages(ctx, { target: 'humans' });
        expect(told?.body).toContain('It stops if its pending submission fails');
        expect(told?.body).toContain(`${held.task.id} keeps its status (${status})`);
      }
    }
  });

  test("while a submission is pending, a person's deferred stop and hold stays recorded", () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    submitting(ctx, held);
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'stop_hold', reason: 'pause', by: 'user:alice' });
    for (const kind of ['session_budget', 'auth'] as const) report(ctx, held, kind);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'stop_hold', deferred: true });
    expect(stops(ctx, held)).toEqual([]);
    // The login still expired: the vendor waits for a preflight.
    const holds = vendorHolds(findRunnerRow(ctx, held.runner.id) as NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof findRunnerRow>>);
    expect(holds.claude?.notReadySince).toBe(ctx.now());
  });

  test('a submitted attempt that holds keeps its session and clone for the review, whatever the outcome', () => {
    for (const kind of ['session_budget', 'denials', 'context', 'policy', 'auth'] as const) {
      const { ctx, held } = setup();
      submitting(ctx, held);
      send(ctx, held, 'attempt.submitted', pushed);
      expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).status).toBe('holding');
      report(ctx, held, kind);
      const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id);
      expect([kind, attempt.status, attempt.stopRequested]).toEqual([kind, 'holding', null]);
      expect(getTask(ctx, held.task.id).status).toBe('submitted');
      expect(kindsOf(ctx, held)).not.toContain('cleanup_attempt');
      expect(listMessages(ctx, { target: 'humans' })).toEqual([]);
      expect(kindsOf(ctx, held).includes('preflight')).toBe(kind === 'auth');
    }
  });

  test('an outcome for an attempt with a stop recorded follows the second-request rules', () => {
    const { ctx, held } = setup();
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: held.attempt.id, cause: 'stop', reason: 'enough', by: 'user:alice' });

    expect(getAttempt(ctx, held.attempt.id).stopRequested?.cause).toBe('policy');
  });
});
```
