```ts
    const lead = tickLead(ctx);
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    const hub = startHub(ctx, { scheduler: false, timers: true });
    try {
      sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Wake up.' });
      await until(() => getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).status === 'starting');
    } finally {
      await hub.stop();
    }
  });

  test('one that exited in a turn resumes at once with its unacknowledged deliveries', () => {
    const { ctx, lead } = runningLead();
    const message = sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Plan the parser work.' });
    tx(ctx, (emit) => markDelivered(ctx, emit, lead.agentId, [message.id]));
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { phase: 'turn' });
    exited(ctx, lead);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).status).toBe('starting');
    const [resume] = resumes(ctx, lead);
    if (resume?.command.kind !== 'resume_attempt') throw new Error('no resume');
    expect(resume.command.prompt).toContain('during a turn');
    expect(resume.command.messages.map((one) => one.messageId)).toEqual([message.id]);
  });

  test('one that exited idle holds until its next delivery', () => {
    const { ctx, lead } = runningLead();
    exited(ctx, lead);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).status).toBe('holding');
    expect(resumes(ctx, lead)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('its runner offline for runnerLeaseMs ends it lost and empties the seat', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, lead } = holdingLead();
    ctx.db.query("UPDATE runners SET state = 'offline', last_seen_at = $now WHERE id = $id").run({
      id: runnerId,
      now: ctx.now(),
    });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs - 1);
    expect(checkHoldingLeads(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(checkHoldingLeads(ctx)).toEqual([lead.id]);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'lost', failureClass: 'infra' });
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a delivery that finds its runner offline ends it lost', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, lead } = holdingLead();
    ctx.db.query("UPDATE runners SET state = 'offline' WHERE id = $id").run({ id: runnerId });
    sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Are you there?' });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.deliveryBatchMs);
    expect(flush(ctx).commands).toEqual([]);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).endReason).toBe('lost');
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a runner with no link in any state counts as offline: after runnerLeaseMs, or at a delivery', () => {
    for (const state of ['needs_login', 'incompatible'] as const) {
      const { ctx, clock, runnerId, lead } = holdingLead();
      const unlinked = 'UPDATE runners SET state = $state, connection_id = NULL, last_seen_at = $now WHERE id = $id';
      ctx.db.query(unlinked).run({ id: runnerId, state, now: ctx.now() });
      clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs - 1);
      expect([state, checkHoldingLeads(ctx)]).toEqual([state, []]);
      clock.advance(1);
      expect([state, checkHoldingLeads(ctx)]).toEqual([state, [lead.id]]);
      expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).endReason).toBe('lost');
      expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBeNull();

      const woken = holdingLead();
      woken.ctx.db.query(unlinked).run({ id: woken.runnerId, state, now: woken.ctx.now() });
      sendMessage(woken.ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Are you there?' });
      woken.clock.advance(woken.ctx.config.deliveryBatchMs);
      expect(flush(woken.ctx).commands).toEqual([]);
      expect([state, getAttempt(woken.ctx, woken.lead.id).endReason]).toEqual([state, 'lost']);
      expect(seatHolderId(woken.ctx)).toBeNull();
    }
  });

  test('a linked runner that is not ready keeps it holding through a delivery', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, lead } = holdingLead();
    ctx.db
      .query("UPDATE runners SET state = 'disk_low', connection_id = 'link-1', last_seen_at = $now WHERE id = $id")
      .run({ id: runnerId, now: ctx.now() });
    sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Are you there?' });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs);
    expect(flush(ctx).commands).toEqual([]);
    expect(checkHoldingLeads(ctx)).toEqual([]);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).status).toBe('holding');
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(lead.agentId);
  });

  test('one that is not resumable ends lost', () => {
    const { ctx, lead } = holdingLead();
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { resumable: false });
    expect(checkHoldingLeads(ctx)).toEqual([lead.id]);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).endReason).toBe('lost');
  });

  test('the tick ends one that cannot be resumed before it starts the next lead', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, lead } = holdingLead();
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { resumable: false });
    const result = runTick(ctx);
    expect(result.reconciled.holdingLeads).toEqual([lead.id]);
    expect(result.lead).toMatchObject({ role: 'lead', runnerId });
    expect(result.lead?.id).not.toBe(lead.id);
    expect(seatHolderId(ctx)).toBe(result.lead?.agentId as string);
  });
});

describe('failover', () => {
  test('after crashed or lost the next lead starts on another runner, from the newest lead handoff', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const first = addRunner(ctx);
    const second = addRunner(ctx);
    const one = tickLead(ctx);
    expect(one.runnerId).toBe(first);
    insertLeadNote(ctx, {
      attemptId: one.id,
      kind: 'handoff',
      body: 'Next: review T-3, then plan the CLI.',
      author: `agent:${one.agentId}`,
    });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: one.id, trigger: 'crashed', error: 'the agent exited' });
    // It wrote its handoff, so nothing is assembled.
    expect(leadNotes(ctx)).toHaveLength(1);

    const two = tickLead(ctx);
    expect(two.runnerId).toBe(second);
    expect(briefOn(ctx, second)).toContain('Next: review T-3, then plan the CLI.');

    // Lost without a handoff: one is assembled and stored as a lead note, and the next lead starts from it.
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: two.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    expect(leadNotes(ctx).at(-1)).toEqual({ attempt_id: two.id, kind: 'handoff', author: 'system' });
    const three = tickLead(ctx);
    expect(three.runnerId).toBe(first);
    expect(briefOn(ctx, first)).toContain('Lead handoff assembled by agflow');
  });

  test("an assembled note quotes the lead handoff the lost lead started from, for the next lead's brief", () => {
    const { ctx, lead } = runningLead();
    insertLeadNote(ctx, {
      attemptId: lead.id,
      kind: 'handoff',
      body: 'Plan: parser first, then the CLI.',
      author: `agent:${lead.agentId}`,
    });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: lead.id, trigger: 'rotation' });
    const two = tickLead(ctx);
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: two.id, trigger: 'lost' });
    expect(leadNotes(ctx).at(-1)).toEqual({ attempt_id: two.id, kind: 'handoff', author: 'system' });
    const three = tickLead(ctx);
    const brief = briefOn(ctx, three.runnerId as string);
    expect(brief).toContain('Lead handoff assembled by agflow');
    expect(brief).toContain('Plan: parser first, then the CLI.');
  });

  test('with no other runner, the next lead starts on the same one', () => {
    const { ctx, runnerId, lead } = runningLead();
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: lead.id, trigger: 'crashed', error: 'the agent exited' });
    expect(tickLead(ctx).runnerId).toBe(runnerId);
  });
});

describe('lead endings and liveness', () => {
  test('a lead that ends stopped, replaced or rotated without a lead handoff gets an assembled lead note', () => {
    for (const trigger of ['stop', 'replace', 'rotation'] as const) {
      const { ctx, lead } = runningLead();
      endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: lead.id, trigger });
      const assembled = { attempt_id: lead.id, kind: 'handoff', author: 'system' };
      expect([trigger, leadNotes(ctx)]).toEqual([trigger, [assembled]]);
    }
    const { ctx, lead } = runningLead();
    const author = `agent:${lead.agentId}`;
    insertLeadNote(ctx, { attemptId: lead.id, kind: 'handoff', body: 'Done for now.', author });
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: lead.id, trigger: 'stop' });
    expect(leadNotes(ctx)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('a lead whose resume fails gets an assembled lead note; one that never started gets none', () => {
    const { ctx, clock, lead } = holdingLead();
    updateAttempt(ctx, lead.id, { sessionRef: 'session-1' });
    sendMessage(ctx, { from: 'user:alice', to: 'lead', body: 'Look at T-7.' });
    clock.advance(ctx.config.deliveryBatchMs);
    expect(flush(ctx).commands.map((row) => row.command.kind)).toEqual(['resume_attempt']);
    failedToStart(ctx, lead);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).endReason).toBe('failed_to_start');
    expect(leadNotes(ctx)).toEqual([{ attempt_id: lead.id, kind: 'handoff', author: 'system' }]);

    const fresh = tickLead(ctx);
    failedToStart(ctx, fresh);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, fresh.id).endReason).toBe('failed_to_start');
    expect(leadNotes(ctx)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("the lead agent's last_seen_at follows its lease", () => {
    const { ctx, clock, runnerId, lead } = runningLead();
    clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
    const facts: AttemptFacts = {
      attemptId: lead.id,
      fence: lead.fence,
      phase: 'idle',
      eventAgeMs: 5_000,
      tool: null,
      fsAgeMs: null,
      commitAgeMs: null,
      turns: 2,
      turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
      repeatedCalls: 0,
      continuations: 0,
      vendorErrorMs: 0,
      activeMs: 60_000,
      contextUsed: 0.2,
    };
    tx(ctx, (emit) => renewLeases(ctx, emit, runnerId, [facts]));
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lead.id).leaseExpiresAt).toBe(ctx.now() + ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs);
    expect(ctx.db.query('SELECT last_seen_at FROM agents WHERE id = $id').get({ id: lead.agentId })).toEqual({
      last_seen_at: ctx.now(),
    });
  });
});
```

**File:** `packages/hub/src/lead.ts` (new)

```ts
// The lead on runners (design 6.11): the tick starts a runner lead when the seat is empty, a holding lead is woken by
// its next delivery or ended lost when it cannot be, and a lead that fails over starts on another runner. The seat
// itself is hub-state.ts's; the lead handoff a successor starts from is assembled at the ending (handoff.ts).
import { type Attempt, type Message, type RunnerState, placeLead } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAttempt, listAttempts } from './attempt-store';
import { endAttempt, resumeAttempt, startRunnerAttempt } from './attempts';
import type { CommandRow } from './commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from './context';
import { injectedMessage } from './delivery';
import { seatHolderId } from './hub-state';
import { placementSnapshot } from './placement';
import { getProject } from './project';
import { findRunnerRow } from './runners';

/** The endings after which the next lead avoids the runner the last one ran on (design 6.11, Failover). */
const FAILOVER_ENDINGS: readonly NonNullable<Attempt['endReason']>[] = ['lost', 'crashed'];

/** The runner of the newest runner lead when it ended lost or crashed; null otherwise. */
function failedLeadRunner(ctx: HubContext): string | null {
  const [last] = listAttempts(ctx, { role: 'lead', limit: 1 });
  if (!last || last.status !== 'ended' || last.endReason === null) return null;
  return FAILOVER_ENDINGS.includes(last.endReason) ? last.runnerId : null;
}

/**
 * Step 2 of a tick (design 6.11, Starting a runner lead): with the seat empty and runner leads on, a lead attempt
 * starts on the runner core's placeLead prefers (Claude, then AC power, then the most free slots), and takes the seat,
 * demoting any other lead row, in startRunnerAttempt's transaction. After a lead ended lost or crashed, another runner
 * is preferred, and the same one is used only when no other can take it. Its brief quotes the newest lead handoff.
 * The tick skips this step while the project is paused. Returns the attempt, or null when none started.
 */
export function ensureLead(ctx: HubContext): Attempt | null {
  if (!getProject(ctx).runnerLeads || seatHolderId(ctx) !== null) return null;
  const snapshot = placementSnapshot(ctx);
  const avoid = failedLeadRunner(ctx);
  const others = { ...snapshot, runners: snapshot.runners.filter((runner) => runner.id !== avoid) };
  const elsewhere = avoid === null ? null : placeLead(others, { rotatingFrom: null }).placement;
  const placement = elsewhere ?? placeLead(snapshot, { rotatingFrom: null }).placement;
  if (!placement) return null;
  return startRunnerAttempt(ctx, { runnerId: placement.runnerId, taskId: null, role: 'lead', vendor: placement.vendor })
    .attempt;
}

/**
 * The states of a runner with no link (runners.ts): offline, needs_login when its CLI session no longer verifies, and
 * incompatible after a refused hello. A lead's runner in any of them is offline to it; a linked runner is online,
 * crash_loop or disk_low.
 */
const UNLINKED: readonly RunnerState[] = ['offline', 'needs_login', 'incompatible'];

/** Why a holding lead can no longer be resumed, or null when it still can (design 6.11, Holding the seat). */
function unresumable(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt): string | null {
  if (!attempt.resumable) return 'it can no longer be resumed';
  const runner = attempt.runnerId === null ? null : findRunnerRow(ctx, attempt.runnerId);
  if (!runner) return 'its runner is gone';
  if (UNLINKED.includes(runner.state) && ctx.now() - runner.last_seen_at >= ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs) {
    return `its runner ${runner.id} has been offline for the runner lease`;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Ends every holding runner lead that can no longer be resumed lost (infra), each in its own transaction: its runner
 * has been offline for runnerLeaseMs, or it is not resumable. The seat empties, and the next tick fails over. Part of
 * the tick's reconcile step. Returns the attempts it ended.
 */
export function checkHoldingLeads(ctx: HubContext): string[] {
  const ended: string[] = [];
  for (const attempt of listAttempts(ctx, { role: 'lead', status: ['holding'] })) {
    try {
      const reason = unresumable(ctx, attempt);
      if (reason === null || attempt.runnerId === null) continue;
      if (endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'lost', error: reason })) ended.push(attempt.id);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`ending holding lead ${attempt.id} failed`, error);
    }
  }
  return ended;
}

/** The prompt of a holding lead woken by a delivery; the messages follow it. */
const WAKE_PROMPT =
  'Your process exited while you were idle, and agflow started it again because new messages arrived for you. They ' +
  'follow.';

/**
 * Wakes a holding runner lead for its unread messages (design 6.11): it resumes with the delivery as its prompt, so
 * the messages go with the resume and are in flight from then on. A lead that cannot be resumed, or whose runner the
 * delivery finds offline (with no link, in any state), ends lost, its unacknowledged lead messages unread again for
 * the next lead. A linked runner that is not ready (crash_loop or disk_low) keeps it holding until it is. Returns
 * the resume_attempt, or null. flushDeliveries calls it for each holding lead whose batch is due (HoldingLeadWaker).
 */
export function wakeHoldingLead(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt, unread: readonly Message[]): CommandRow | null {
  return tx(ctx, () => {
    const current = getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
    if (current.status !== 'holding' || current.role !== 'lead' || current.runnerId === null) return null;
    const runner = findRunnerRow(ctx, current.runnerId);
    const offline = runner && UNLINKED.includes(runner.state) ? `a delivery found runner ${runner.id} offline` : null;
    const reason = unresumable(ctx, current) ?? offline;
    if (reason !== null) {
      endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: current.id, trigger: 'lost', error: reason });
      return null;
    }
    if (runner?.state !== 'online') return null;
    return resumeAttempt(ctx, {
      attemptId: current.id,
      cause: 'lead_exit',
      prompt: WAKE_PROMPT,
      messages: unread.map(injectedMessage),
    }).command;
  });
}
```

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

`failoverNote` lives in `handoff.ts`, and `delivery.ts` takes the lead waker as an argument, so the hub keeps no import cycles. A runner counts as offline for a holding lead when its state is `offline`, `needs_login` or `incompatible`. Runner leads are on by default, so the scheduler tests that count workers switch to a context with runner leads off.

### Task 59: Lead wake-ups, review and rotation

Each delivery to a runner lead starts with the situation report: message id 0, authority system, no message row (design 6.11, X-4), and counts as a wake-up. A review message goes out every `leadReviewMs` while work is held or submitted. The lead rotates after `leadRotateWakeups` wake-ups or at 70% of its context, with a handoff, and the next lead prefers the same runner.

```diff
+    const listed = tasks.slice(0, REVIEW_LIST_LIMIT).map((task) => `${task.id} [${task.status}]`);
+    const rest = tasks.length - listed.length;
+    const minutes = Math.round(ctx.config.leadReviewMs / 60_000);
+    return insertMessage(ctx, emit, {
+      from: 'system',
+      to: 'lead',
+      body:
+        `Periodic review (every ${minutes} min while work is held or submitted): ${listed.join(', ')}` +
+        `${rest > 0 ? ` and ${rest} more` : ''}. Check that held work is moving, and review what is submitted.`,
+    });
+  });
+}
+
+/** contextUsed past this rotates the lead (design 6.11, Rotation). */
+const ROTATE_CONTEXT_USED = 0.7;
+
+/** Why the lead is due for rotation, as a clause for its stop reason and lead.rotated, or null when it is not. */
+function rotationDue(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt): string | null {
+  if (attempt.wakeups >= ctx.config.leadRotateWakeups) return `after ${attempt.wakeups} wake-ups`;
+  const used = attempt.facts?.contextUsed ?? 0;
+  return used > ROTATE_CONTEXT_USED ? `with ${Math.round(used * 100)}% of its context used` : null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Asks the runner lead to write a lead handoff and stops it as rotation, in the caller's transaction or its own: it
+ * ends rotated on exit, the seat empties, and the next tick starts a fresh lead, preferring the same runner, from that
+ * handoff (design 6.11, Rotation). The stop is the hub's, its text hub text: one clause, which the runner's handoff
+ * prompt quotes, adding only what the runner cannot know, that this is a lead handoff. lead.rotated names the actor
+ * whose rule or setting asked for it. Only a running lead with no stop recorded is rotated; a lead in another state
+ * is left for a later tick. Whether it was asked.
+ */
+export function rotateLead(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt, why: string, actor: string): boolean {
+  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
+    const current = getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id);
+    if (current.role !== 'lead' || current.status !== 'running' || current.stopRequested !== null) return false;
+    const reason =
+      `the lead rotates ${why}; write your lead handoff with write_handoff and no task id, since a fresh lead starts ` +
+      'from it';
+    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: current.id, cause: 'rotation', reason, by: 'system' });
+    emit({
+      type: 'lead.rotated',
+      actor,
+      data: { attemptId: current.id, agentId: current.agentId, runnerId: current.runnerId, reason: why },
+    });
+    return true;
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Rotates the runner lead holding the seat once it is due (design 6.11, Rotation): after leadRotateWakeups wake-ups,
+ * or when its contextUsed passes 0.7. While the project is paused, rotation waits for the unpause: step 2 could not
+ * start the next lead, and the seat would stay empty. Part of the tick's reconcile step. Returns the attempt asked, or
+ * null.
+ */
+export function rotateLeadIfDue(ctx: HubContext): string | null {
+  if (getProject(ctx).paused) return null;
+  const seat = leadSeat(ctx);
+  if (seat.kind !== 'runner' || seat.attemptId === null) return null;
+  const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, seat.attemptId);
+  const why = rotationDue(ctx, attempt);
+  return why !== null && rotateLead(ctx, attempt, why, 'system') ? attempt.id : null;
+}
```

The report counts toward the 6,000-character limit of a delivery, and the first real message still always goes. A resume during a turn re-sends messages that were already delivered, so it adds no report and counts no wake-up. A due lead is not rotated while the project is paused; turning runner leads off (Task 60) still rotates at once.

### Task 60: Lead routes and the runner-leads switch

The seat holder writes its lead handoff with `POST /api/lead/handoff`, and it and people read the lead notes with `GET /api/lead/notes` (design 6.16). A person in a browser turns runner leads on or off with `PATCH /api/project { runnerLeads }`; off rotates the runner lead out (6.11, Runner leads off). With this task the hub serves everything plan M2b's bridge and live claims need: gate G3b.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { LeadNotesResponseSchema, OkResponseSchema, ProjectSchema, type RawRunnerEvent } from '@agflow/core';
import { startLiveSession } from '../src/agents';
import { getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { mintAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { applyRunnerEvents } from '../src/events-in';
import { seatHolderId } from '../src/hub-state';
import { runTick } from '../src/scheduler';
import { addAgent, addLeadNote, addRunnerAttempt, addRunnerLead } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

type Hub = ReturnType<typeof createTestHub>;

const bearer = (token: string) => ({ headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
const asPerson = { user: 'alice', via: 'web' } as const;

const leadNotes = (hub: Hub) =>
  hub.ctx.db.query('SELECT attempt_id, kind, body, author FROM lead_notes ORDER BY id').all() as {
    attempt_id: string | null;
    kind: string;
    body: string;
    author: string;
  }[];

/** A hub with a runner worker and a runner lead holding the seat, and both agents' tokens. */
function setup() {
  const hub = createTestHub();
  const worker = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx);
  const lead = addRunnerLead(hub.ctx);
  return {
    hub,
    worker,
    lead,
    leadToken: mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, lead.attempt),
    workerToken: mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, worker.attempt),
  };
}

describe('POST /api/lead/handoff', () => {
  test('the seat holder stores a lead handoff with its attempt id', async () => {
    const { hub, lead, leadToken } = setup();
    const answer = await hub.call('POST', '/api/lead/handoff', {
      ...bearer(leadToken),
      body: { note: 'Next: review T-3, then plan the CLI.' },
    });
    expect([answer.status, OkResponseSchema.parse(answer.json)]).toEqual([200, { ok: true }]);
    expect(leadNotes(hub)).toEqual([
      {
        attempt_id: lead.attempt.id,
        kind: 'handoff',
        body: 'Next: review T-3, then plan the CLI.',
        author: `agent:${lead.agent.id}`,
      },
    ]);
  });

  test('a live lead holding the seat stores one with no attempt id', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const live = addAgent(hub.ctx, 'alice', 'lead');
    const body = { note: 'Bye.' };
    const answer = await hub.call('POST', '/api/lead/handoff', { user: 'alice', agent: live.id, body });
    expect(answer.status).toBe(200);
    expect(leadNotes(hub)).toEqual([{ attempt_id: null, kind: 'handoff', body: 'Bye.', author: `agent:${live.id}` }]);
  });

  test('other agents and people are refused; an empty note is a 400', async () => {
    const { hub, leadToken, workerToken } = setup();
    const worker = await hub.call('POST', '/api/lead/handoff', { ...bearer(workerToken), body: { note: 'Me?' } });
    expect(worker.status).toBe(403);
    const person = await hub.call('POST', '/api/lead/handoff', { ...asPerson, body: { note: 'From alice.' } });
    expect(person.status).toBe(403);
    const empty = await hub.call('POST', '/api/lead/handoff', { ...bearer(leadToken), body: { note: '' } });
    expect(empty.status).toBe(400);
    expect(leadNotes(hub)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('GET /api/lead/notes', () => {
  test('answers { notes }, newest first, to the seat holder and to people; other agents are refused', async () => {
    const { hub, lead, leadToken, workerToken } = setup();
    addLeadNote(hub.ctx, { attemptId: 'lead-a7', body: 'The first.', author: 'system' });
    hub.clock.advance(1);
    addLeadNote(hub.ctx, { attemptId: lead.attempt.id, kind: 'restatement', body: 'I lead.', author: 'agent:A-9' });
    for (const options of [bearer(leadToken), asPerson, { user: 'bob' }]) {
      const answer = await hub.call('GET', '/api/lead/notes', options);
      expect(answer.status).toBe(200);
      const { notes } = LeadNotesResponseSchema.parse(answer.json);
      expect(notes.map((note) => [note.kind, note.body, note.attemptId])).toEqual([
        ['restatement', 'I lead.', lead.attempt.id],
        ['handoff', 'The first.', 'lead-a7'],
      ]);
    }
    expect((await hub.call('GET', '/api/lead/notes', bearer(workerToken))).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await hub.call('GET', '/api/lead/notes')).status).toBe(401);
  });

  test('answers the 20 newest only', async () => {
    const { hub } = setup();
    for (let n = 1; n <= 21; n++) {
      addLeadNote(hub.ctx, { attemptId: null, body: `Note ${n}.`, author: 'system' });
      hub.clock.advance(1);
    }
    const { notes } = LeadNotesResponseSchema.parse((await hub.call('GET', '/api/lead/notes', asPerson)).json);
    expect(notes.map((note) => note.body)).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, n) => `Note ${21 - n}.`));
  });
});

describe('PATCH /api/project', () => {
  let seq = 0;

  /** The runner reports the lead's process gone after its handoff turn. */
  function exited(hub: Hub, attemptId: string): void {
    const attempt = getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId);
    const raw = {
      seq: ++seq,
      at: hub.ctx.now(),
      type: 'attempt.exited',
      attemptId,
      fence: attempt.fence,
      data: {
        code: 0,
        signal: null,
        stoppedBy: 'close',
        handoffWritten: true,
        cause: null,
        finalSha: null,
        finalWip: null,
        pushError: null,
      },
    } as RawRunnerEvent;
    const batch = { outboxEpoch: 'outbox-1', events: [raw] };
    applyRunnerEvents(hub.ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, batch, { restoreReplay: false });
    expect(hub.ctx.db.query('SELECT error FROM runner_event_rejects').all()).toEqual([]);
  }

  test('runner leads off rotate the runner lead out, so a live lead can take the seat; on lets one start', async () => {
    const { hub, lead } = setup();
    const off = await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...asPerson, body: { runnerLeads: false } });
    expect(off.status).toBe(200);
    expect(ProjectSchema.parse(off.json).runnerLeads).toBe(false);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, lead.attempt.id).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'rotation', handoff: true });
    const stops = pendingCommands(hub.ctx, lead.attempt.runnerId as string, 1).filter(
      (row) => row.command.kind === 'stop_attempt' && row.command.attemptId === lead.attempt.id,
    );
    expect(stops).toHaveLength(1);
    const [rotated] = listEvents(hub.ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.rotated');
    expect([rotated?.actor, rotated?.data.attemptId]).toEqual(['user:alice', lead.attempt.id]);
    // Turning it off again asks nothing more.
    await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...asPerson, body: { runnerLeads: false } });
    expect(listEvents(hub.ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === 'lead.rotated')).toHaveLength(1);

    exited(hub, lead.attempt.id);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, lead.attempt.id).endReason).toBe('rotated');
    expect(seatHolderId(hub.ctx)).toBeNull();
    // No runner lead starts while they are off, and a person's live lead takes the seat.
    expect(runTick(hub.ctx).lead).toBeNull();
    const live = startLiveSession(hub.ctx, 'alice', { vendor: 'claude', sessionId: 'chat-1', role: 'lead' });
    expect(live.leadSeatTakenBy).toBeNull();
    expect(seatHolderId(hub.ctx)).toBe(live.agent.id);

    const on = await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...asPerson, body: { runnerLeads: true } });
    expect(on.json.runnerLeads).toBe(true);
    // The live lead keeps the seat; once it is empty, the next tick starts a runner lead.
    expect(runTick(hub.ctx).lead).toBeNull();
    hub.clock.advance(hub.ctx.config.liveLeadGraceMs);
    expect(runTick(hub.ctx).lead).toMatchObject({ role: 'lead', status: 'starting' });
  });

  test('a holding runner lead has no process for a handoff turn: it ends rotated at once', async () => {
    const { hub, lead } = setup();
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, lead.attempt.id, { status: 'holding', leaseExpiresAt: null });
    await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...asPerson, body: { runnerLeads: false } });
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, lead.attempt.id)).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'rotated' });
    expect(seatHolderId(hub.ctx)).toBeNull();
    // The hub assembled the lead handoff the next lead starts from.
    expect(leadNotes(hub).map((note) => [note.attempt_id, note.author])).toEqual([[lead.attempt.id, 'system']]);
  });

  test('only a person in a browser may change it; a bad body is a 400', async () => {
    const { hub, lead, leadToken } = setup();
    const body = { runnerLeads: false };
    expect((await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { user: 'alice', body })).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...bearer(leadToken), body })).status).toBe(403);
    const bad = await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...asPerson, body: { runnerLeads: 'no' } });
    expect(bad.status).toBe(400);
    const extra = await hub.call('PATCH', '/api/project', { ...asPerson, body: { runnerLeads: false, name: 'x' } });
    expect(extra.status).toBe(400);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, lead.attempt.id).stopRequested).toBeNull();
    expect((await hub.call('GET', '/api/project', { user: 'bob' })).json.runnerLeads).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```diff
+export function writeLeadHandoff(ctx: HubContext, agent: Agent, note: string): void {

+ * project.

+export function setRunnerLeads(ctx: HubContext, runnerLeads: boolean, actor: string): Project {
```

### Task 61: Take-over

A person takes over a running or `quota_wait` attempt on an online runner with no pending submission and no recorded stop (design 6.12, X-34). One transaction records the stop and the block, `prepare_takeover` goes out, and the attempt ends taken_over with the runner's commands and `Attempt.takeover.ref` (X-22). When the take-over ends without the runner's report (lease expiry, the stop timeout or a retire), the hub builds the "anywhere" command itself with core's `takeoverAnywhereCommand` (Task 2), the builder the runner also calls.

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { type RunnerEventData, TakeoverResponseSchema, takeoverAnywhereCommand } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAgent } from '../src/agents';
import { getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { expireRunnerLeases, expireStops, requestStop, startRunnerAttempt } from '../src/attempts';
import { createSession, mintAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { pendingCommands } from '../src/commands';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { Gateway } from '../src/gateway';
import { requestSubmission } from '../src/submissions';
import { getTask, isPathHolder } from '../src/task-store';
import { cancelTask, createTasks, unblockTask } from '../src/tasks';
import { type AnswerHooks, type FakeConnection, type FakeRunner, connectFakeRunner, settle } from './fake-runner';
import { addRunner, newTask } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

const WIP_SHA = 'a'.repeat(40);
const TAKEN_SHA = 'b'.repeat(40);
const TAKEOVER_REF = 'refs/agflow/T-1/takeover-alice';

type Hub = ReturnType<typeof createTestHub>;
type Link = FakeRunner<FakeConnection>;

const asPerson = (user = 'alice') => ({ user, via: 'web' }) as const;

const LOCAL = 'cd /clone && claude --resume session-1';
const ANYWHERE = 'git fetch origin refs/agflow/T-1/a1 && git switch -c agflow/T-1-fix-the-parser FETCH_HEAD';

/** What a runner reports once it prepared the clone for the person (design 6.12). */
const takenOver = (local: string | null = LOCAL): RunnerEventData['attempt.taken_over'] => ({
  commands: { local, anywhere: ANYWHERE },
  wipSha: TAKEN_SHA,
  error: null,
});

/**
 * A hub with runner R-1 connected and a worker attempt at T-1 running there, which has pushed a WIP. The fake runner
 * answers prepare_takeover with attempt.taken_over when reportTakeover is set, as a runner does once the clone is
 * ready.
 */
async function setup(options: { reportTakeover?: boolean; answers?: AnswerHooks } = {}) {
  const hub = createTestHub();
  const runnerId = addRunner(hub.ctx);
  const gateway = new Gateway(hub.ctx);
  const answers: AnswerHooks = { ...options.answers };
  if (options.reportTakeover) {
    answers.prepare_takeover = (command, runner) => {
      runner.emit('attempt.taken_over', takenOver(), { attemptId: command.attemptId, fence: command.fence });
      return { ok: true };
    };
  }
  const token = createSession(hub.ctx, 'alice', 'cli');
  const runner = await connectFakeRunner(hub.ctx, gateway, { token, answers });
  const [task] = createTasks(hub.ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Fix the parser' })], 'user:alice');
  if (!task) throw new Error('no task');
  const { attempt } = startRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { runnerId, taskId: task.id, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
  await settle();
  runner.startRunning(attempt.id);
  const wip = { ref: attempt.wipRef as string, sha: WIP_SHA, stripped: [], skipped: [], embedded: [], logStat: '' };
  runner.emit('attempt.wip', wip, { attemptId: attempt.id, fence: attempt.fence });
  await settle();
  return { hub, runnerId, runner, task, attemptId: attempt.id };
}

async function takeOver(hub: Hub, taskId = 'T-1', user = 'alice') {
  const answer = await hub.call('POST', `/api/tasks/${taskId}/takeover`, asPerson(user));
  await settle();
  return answer;
}

const sent = (runner: Link, kind: string) =>
  runner.commands.map((message) => message.command).filter((command) => command.kind === kind);
const eventsOf = (hub: Hub, type: string) => listEvents(hub.ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === type);

describe('POST /api/tasks/:id/takeover', () => {
  test('a person in the browser gets 202 { attemptId }: stop and block recorded, prepare_takeover sent', async () => {
    const { hub, runner, attemptId } = await setup();
    const answer = await takeOver(hub);
    expect(answer.status).toBe(202);
    expect(TakeoverResponseSchema.parse(answer.json)).toEqual({ attemptId });
    // X-49: the requester is the actor string of a person.
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'running',
      stopRequested: { cause: 'takeover', reason: 'taken over by alice', by: 'user:alice', deferred: false },
    });
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1')).toMatchObject({
      status: 'blocked',
      blockedKind: 'takeover',
      blockedReason: 'taken over by alice',
    });
    const fence = getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).fence;
    expect(sent(runner, 'prepare_takeover')).toEqual([{ kind: 'prepare_takeover', attemptId, fence, person: 'alice' }]);
    // The take-over asks for the handoff itself: no stop_attempt goes out.
    expect(sent(runner, 'stop_attempt')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('an agent in quota_wait may be taken over too', async () => {
    const { hub, runner, attemptId } = await setup();
    updateAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId, { status: 'quota_wait', quotaResetsAt: null });
    const answer = await takeOver(hub);
    expect(answer.status).toBe(202);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).stopRequested).toMatchObject({ cause: 'takeover', by: 'user:alice' });
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1')).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'takeover' });
    expect(sent(runner, 'prepare_takeover')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('409 submission_pending while a submission is pending', async () => {
    const { hub, attemptId } = await setup();
    const attempt = getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId);
    requestSubmission(hub.ctx, 'T-1', getAgent(hub.ctx, attempt.agentId), { summary: 'Done.', evidence: [] });
    const answer = await takeOver(hub);
    expect([answer.status, answer.json.error]).toEqual([409, 'submission_pending']);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).stopRequested).toBeNull();
  });

  test('409 runner_offline once the runner has no link', async () => {
    const { hub, runner } = await setup();
    runner.disconnect();
    await settle();
    const answer = await takeOver(hub);
    expect([answer.status, answer.json.error]).toEqual([409, 'runner_offline']);
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1').status).toBe('claimed');
  });

  test('409 not_running with no running agent, and while any stop is recorded', async () => {
    const { hub, runnerId, attemptId } = await setup();
    const [ready] = createTasks(hub.ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Nobody works on it' })], 'user:alice');
    expect((await takeOver(hub, ready?.id)).json.error).toBe('not_running');
    // An attempt that has not spawned yet has nothing to hand over.
    const [other] = createTasks(hub.ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Starting' })], 'user:alice');
    startRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { runnerId, taskId: other?.id as string, role: 'worker', vendor: 'claude' });
    expect((await takeOver(hub, other?.id)).json.error).toBe('not_running');
    requestStop(hub.ctx, { attemptId, cause: 'stop', reason: 'enough', by: 'user:bob' });
    const answer = await takeOver(hub);
    expect([answer.status, answer.json.error]).toEqual([409, 'not_running']);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).stopRequested?.cause).toBe('stop');
  });

  test('agents and CLI tokens are refused', async () => {
    const { hub, attemptId } = await setup();
    const cli = await hub.call('POST', '/api/tasks/T-1/takeover', { user: 'alice', via: 'cli' });
    expect(cli.status).toBe(403);
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId));
    const agent = await hub.call('POST', '/api/tasks/T-1/takeover', { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    expect([agent.status, agent.json.error]).toEqual([403, 'agent_not_allowed']);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).stopRequested).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('attempt.taken_over', () => {
  test('ends the attempt taken_over with its commands and ref, the WIP as the position, and no cleanup', async () => {
    const { hub, runner, attemptId } = await setup({ reportTakeover: true });
    await takeOver(hub);
    await settle();
    const attempt = getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId);
    const ofAttempt = { attemptId, taskId: 'T-1', agentId: attempt.agentId, runnerId: 'R-1' };
    expect(attempt).toMatchObject({ status: 'ended', endReason: 'taken_over', wipSha: TAKEN_SHA });
    expect(attempt.takeover).toMatchObject({
      local: LOCAL,
      anywhere: ANYWHERE,
      ref: TAKEOVER_REF,
      error: null,
    });
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1')).toMatchObject({
      status: 'blocked',
      blockedKind: 'takeover',
      workRef: attempt.wipRef,
      workSha: TAKEN_SHA,
    });
    // The clone waits for the hand-back.
    expect(sent(runner, 'cleanup_attempt')).toEqual([]);
    expect(pendingCommands(hub.ctx, 'R-1', 1).filter((row) => row.kind === 'cleanup_attempt')).toEqual([]);
    expect(eventsOf(hub, 'task.taken_over').map((event) => [event.subject, event.data])).toEqual([
      ['T-1', { ...ofAttempt, person: 'alice', ref: TAKEOVER_REF }],
    ]);
  });

  test('a failed take-over stores local null and the error', async () => {
    const failed: AnswerHooks = {
      prepare_takeover: (command, runner) => {
        const data = { ...takenOver(null), error: 'cannot rebuild the git directory' };
        runner.emit('attempt.taken_over', data, { attemptId: command.attemptId, fence: command.fence });
        return { ok: true };
      },
    };
    const { hub, attemptId } = await setup({ answers: failed });
    await takeOver(hub);
    await settle();
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).takeover).toMatchObject({
      local: null,
      ref: TAKEOVER_REF,
      error: 'cannot rebuild the git directory',
    });
  });

  test('a late one, after the stop timeout ended the attempt, still stores its commands', async () => {
    const { hub, runner, attemptId } = await setup();
    await takeOver(hub);
    const { fence } = getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId);
    hub.clock.advance(hub.ctx.config.stopGraceMs);
    expect(expireStops(hub.ctx)).toBe(1);
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId).takeover?.local).toBeNull();
    runner.emit('attempt.taken_over', takenOver(), { attemptId, fence });
    await settle();
    expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId)).toMatchObject({
      endReason: 'taken_over',
      takeover: { local: LOCAL, anywhere: ANYWHERE, ref: TAKEOVER_REF },
    });
    expect(getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1')).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'takeover', workSha: TAKEN_SHA });
    // The ending told the pages once.
    expect(eventsOf(hub, 'task.taken_over')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe('a take-over the runner never completes', () => {
  /** The take-over command the hub builds itself, from the task's work position and the person's take-over ref. */
  const anywhere = (hub: Hub) => {
    const task = getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1');
    const work = { ref: task.workRef as string, branch: task.branch as string };
    return takeoverAnywhereCommand({ ...work, takeoverRef: TAKEOVER_REF });
  };

  for (const [name, expire] of [
    ['the stop timeout', (hub: Hub) => {
      hub.clock.advance(hub.ctx.config.stopGraceMs);
      return expireStops(hub.ctx);
    }],
    ['the lease expiry', (hub: Hub) => {
      hub.clock.advance(hub.ctx.config.runnerLeaseMs);
      return expireRunnerLeases(hub.ctx);
    }],
  ] as const) {
    test(`ends it taken_over at ${name}, with the anywhere command and the ref`, async () => {
      const { hub, attemptId } = await setup();
      await takeOver(hub);
      expect(expire(hub)).toBe(1);
      expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, attemptId)).toMatchObject({
        status: 'ended',
        endReason: 'taken_over',
        takeover: { local: null, anywhere: anywhere(hub), ref: TAKEOVER_REF, error: null },
      });
      // The WIP the attempt pushed, onto the task branch: what the runner's own command fetches.
      expect(anywhere(hub).split('\n')[0]).toBe(ANYWHERE);
      expect(eventsOf(hub, 'task.taken_over').map((event) => event.data.ref)).toEqual([TAKEOVER_REF]);
      // The task holds its paths for the person, and the lead cannot unblock it.
      const task = getTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1');
      expect(task).toMatchObject({ status: 'blocked', blockedKind: 'takeover' });
      expect(isPathHolder(task)).toBe(true);
      expect(() => unblockTask(hub.ctx, 'T-1', 'agent:A-9')).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ status: 409 }));
    });
  }
});

describe('cancelling a taken-over task', () => {
  test('in the middle of the take-over: the ending cleans the clone up and tells no page', async () => {
    const { hub, runner, attemptId } = await setup();
    await takeOver(hub);

    await settle();
```

**File:** `packages/hub/src/takeover.ts` (new)

```ts
// Take-over (design 6.12): a person takes a running agent's work over. The request records the stop and the block in
// one transaction and sends prepare_takeover; the runner stops the agent, readies its clone for the person and reports
// attempt.taken_over with the commands, and the attempt ends taken_over (endAttempt also covers the lease expiry and
// the stop timeout, without the runner's commands).
import { type Attempt, type RunnerEventData, type TakeoverRefusal, takeoverRef } from '@agflow/core';
import { appendAttemptLog, updateAttempt } from './attempt-store';
import { endAttempt, openRunnerAttempt, requestStop, takeoverPerson } from './attempts';
import { enqueueCommand } from './commands';
import { type HubContext, tx } from './context';
import { HubError } from './errors';
import { findRunner } from './runners';
import { pendingSubmissionOf } from './submission-store';
import { getTask, writeTask } from './task-store';

/** A refused take-over: 409 with core's code, after which the page offers Stop and hold instead. */
const refused = (code: TakeoverRefusal, message: string) => new HubError(409, code, message);

/**
 * POST /api/tasks/:id/takeover, a person's in the browser (design 6.12). Only the task's current attempt may be taken
 * over, while it is running or in quota_wait on an online runner, with no submission pending and no stop recorded
 * (X-34). In one transaction the hub records stop_requested (cause takeover) with the person as its requester,
 * blocks the task as takeover, "taken over by <login>", and sends prepare_takeover naming the person.
 */
export function requestTakeover(ctx: HubContext, taskId: string, login: string): { attemptId: string } {
  return tx(ctx, () => {
    const task = getTask(ctx, taskId);
    const attempt = openRunnerAttempt(ctx, task);
    if (!attempt) throw refused('not_running', `${taskId} has no agent running on a runner`);
    if (pendingSubmissionOf(ctx, attempt.id)) {
      throw refused('submission_pending', `a submission of ${taskId} is being pushed; wait for it, or stop and hold`);
    }
    const runner = findRunner(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string);
    if (runner?.state !== 'online') {
      const state = runner?.state ?? 'gone';
      throw refused('runner_offline', `runner ${attempt.runnerId} is ${state}, so nobody can hand over its clone`);
    }
    if ((attempt.status !== 'running' && attempt.status !== 'quota_wait') || attempt.stopRequested) {
      const stop = attempt.stopRequested;
      const why = stop ? `is already stopping (${stop.cause})` : `is ${attempt.status}`;
      throw refused('not_running', `the agent at ${taskId} ${why}`);
    }
    const by = `user:${login}`;
    requestStop(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, cause: 'takeover', reason: `taken over by ${login}`, by });
    enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, {
      kind: 'prepare_takeover',
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      fence: attempt.fence,
      person: login,
    });
    return { attemptId: attempt.id };
  });
}

/**
 * attempt.taken_over (design 6.12): the commands for the person, the error of a take-over that failed after the agent
 * stopped, and the person's take-over ref go to Attempt.takeover (X-22), and the harvested WIP becomes the task's work
 * position while the task is still taken over by this attempt. An open attempt then ends taken_over, with no cleanup:
 * the clone waits for the hand-back. A late one, after the lease expiry or the stop timeout ended the attempt, still
 * stores its commands, which replace the ones the hub built.
 */
export function onTakenOver(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt, data: RunnerEventData['attempt.taken_over']): void {
  const taskId = attempt.taskId as string;
  const person = takeoverPerson(attempt);
  if (person === null) throw new Error(`attempt ${attempt.id} was not taken over by a person`);
  const ref = attempt.takeover?.ref ?? takeoverRef(ctx.config.wipRefPrefix, taskId, person);
  const { local, anywhere } = data.commands;
  updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { takeover: { local, anywhere, ref, error: data.error } });
  if (data.wipSha !== null) {
    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { wipSha: data.wipSha });
    const task = getTask(ctx, taskId);
    if (task.currentAttempt === attempt.id && task.status === 'blocked' && task.blockedKind === 'takeover') {
      writeTask(ctx, taskId, { workRef: attempt.wipRef, workSha: data.wipSha });
    }
  }
  if (attempt.status !== 'ended') {
    endAttempt(ctx, { attemptId: attempt.id, trigger: 'takeover', actor: `runner:${attempt.runnerId}` });
    return;
  }
  appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', 'the take-over commands arrived after the attempt ended');
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

The 409 codes come in this order: `not_running` (no open runner attempt), `submission_pending`, `runner_offline`, then `not_running` again for any other status or a recorded stop. A late `attempt.taken_over` never overwrites a hand-back. Cancelling a task during or after a take-over queues `cleanup_attempt`, so the clone is not leaked.

### Task 62: Hand-back

A person hands the work back from the runner's clone (`hand_back`, then `attempt.handed_back`) or from a ref they pushed, with a full 40-hex sha (design 6.12, X-24). A timeout falls back to the last position. A `process_running` refusal keeps the task blocked and puts the error in `Attempt.takeover.error` (X-37). Anyone may hand back once the runner is not online (X-24). This task also changes a frozen contract under X-49: `Attempt.takeover` gains `handingBack`, and a second hand-back while one is pending gets 409 `handback_pending`.

```diff
+/** The runner's answer to hand_back: refused while a process runs in the clone, else the clone's work handed back. */
+interface Clone {
+  pids: number[] | null;
+  /** Whether the runner reports attempt.handed_back; else it answers ok and is never heard from again. */
+  reports: boolean;
+}
+
+/** A task taken over by alice, whose runner answers hand_back as the clone says. */
+async function takenOverTask(clone: Clone = { pids: null, reports: true }) {
+  const answers: AnswerHooks = {
+    hand_back: (command, runner) => {
+      if (clone.pids) return { ok: false, error: 'process_running', data: { pids: clone.pids } };
+      if (clone.reports) {
+        const ref = lateWorkRef('refs/agflow/', command.attemptId, 1);
+        const { fence } = getAttempt(hub.ctx, command.attemptId);
+        runner.emit('attempt.handed_back', { ref, sha: HANDED_SHA }, { attemptId: command.attemptId, fence });
+      }
+      return { ok: true };
+    },
+  };

+  await takeOver(hub);
+  await settle();
+  expect(getAttempt(hub.ctx, rest.attemptId).endReason).toBe('taken_over');
+  return { hub, clone, ...rest };

+  return answer;
```

```diff
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Hand-back (design 6.12 Hand back, X-24, X-37, X-49)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/** Where the work comes back from: the runner's clone, or a ref the person pushed, with its full sha. */
+export type HandbackSource = 'clone' | { ref: string; sha: string };
+
+/**
+ * The work comes back: { ref, sha } becomes the task's work position (not late work), the task goes ready, the
+ * taken-over attempt's clone is cleaned up, and task.handed_back tells the pages.
+ */
+function handBack(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  emit: Emit,
+  task: Task,
+  attempt: Attempt,
+  actor: string,
+  source: 'clone' | 'ref',
+  position: { ref: string; sha: string },
+): void {
+  move(ctx, emit, task, 'ready', actor, {
+    changes: { blockedKind: null, blockedReason: null, workRef: position.ref, workSha: position.sha },
+    data: { attemptId: attempt.id },
+  });
+  enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: attempt.id });
+  appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `handed back from the ${source}: ${position.ref} at ${position.sha}`);
+  emit({
+    type: 'task.handed_back',
+    actor,
+    subject: task.id,
+    data: { ...attemptData(attempt), source, ref: position.ref, sha: position.sha },
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * The task goes ready from its last recorded position, without the clone's work: its runner is not online, or
+ * nothing came back within handbackTimeoutMs. The pending hand_back stays, so the clone's work arrives as late work
+ * once the runner gets to it, and the cleanup queued after it removes the clone.
+ */
+function readyWithoutClone(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  emit: Emit,
+  task: Task,
+  attempt: Attempt,
+  actor: string,
+  why: string,
+): void {
+  move(ctx, emit, task, 'ready', actor, {
+    changes: { blockedKind: null, blockedReason: null },
+    data: { attemptId: attempt.id, reason: why },
+  });
+  enqueueCommand(ctx, attempt.runnerId as string, { kind: 'cleanup_attempt', attemptId: attempt.id });
+  const position = task.workRef ? `${task.workRef} at ${task.workSha ?? 'its tip'}` : ctx.config.mainBranch;
+  appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `ready again from ${position}, without the clone: ${why}`);
+}
+
+/**
+ * POST /api/tasks/:id/handback, a person's in the browser (design 6.12). The task must be blocked as taken over by an
+ * attempt that has ended, taken_over or otherwise. The person who took over hands back, or anyone once the runner is
+ * not online (X-24); while a hand-back from the clone is on its way, another gets 409 handback_pending (X-49).
+ * - From the clone: hand_back goes to the runner, the task stays blocked until attempt.handed_back, and
+ *   Attempt.takeover.handingBack records who asked and when. With the runner offline (no link) the task goes ready
+ *   from its last position at once.
+ * - From a ref: in this transaction { ref, sha } becomes the work position, the task goes ready and the attempt's
+ *   cleanup is queued; the runner is sent nothing else.
+ */
+export function requestHandback(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  taskId: string,
+  input: { source: HandbackSource; login: string },
+): { attemptId: string } {
+  return tx(ctx, (emit) => {
+    const task = getTask(ctx, taskId);
+    if (task.status !== 'blocked' || task.blockedKind !== 'takeover') throw conflict(`${taskId} is not taken over`);
+    const attempt = task.currentAttempt === null ? null : findAttempt(ctx, task.currentAttempt);
+    if (!attempt || attempt.status !== 'ended') {
+      throw conflict(`the take-over of ${taskId} is still being prepared; hand it back once its commands show`);
+    }
+    // Every ending of a taken-over attempt records the take-over while its task waits (endAttempt).
+    if (!attempt.takeover) throw new Error(`attempt ${attempt.id} ended with no take-over record`);
+    const runnerId = attempt.runnerId as string;
+    const runner = findRunner(ctx, runnerId);
+    const online = runner?.state === 'online';
+    // A runner that reports disk_low or crash_loop still has its link: the hand_back reaches it, so the task waits for
+    // what the clone pushes. Only a runner without a link makes the task go ready at once.
+    const linked = findRunnerRow(ctx, runnerId)?.connection_id != null;
+    const person = takeoverPerson(attempt);
+    if (online && person !== input.login) {
+      const who = person ?? 'the person who took it over';
+      throw forbidden(`only ${who} hands ${taskId} back while runner ${runnerId} is online`);
+    }
+    const pending = attempt.takeover.handingBack;
+    if (pending) {
+      throw new HubError(409, 'handback_pending', `${pending.by} is already handing ${taskId} back from the clone`);
+    }
+    const by = `user:${input.login}`;
+    if (input.source !== 'clone') {
+      handBack(ctx, emit, task, attempt, by, 'ref', input.source);
+      return { attemptId: attempt.id };
+    }
+    enqueueCommand(ctx, runnerId, { kind: 'hand_back', attemptId: attempt.id, source: { kind: 'clone' } });
+    if (!linked) {
+      const why = `runner ${runnerId} is ${runner?.state ?? 'gone'}; its clone comes as late work`;
+      readyWithoutClone(ctx, emit, task, attempt, by, why);
+      return { attemptId: attempt.id };
+    }
+    updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { takeover: { ...attempt.takeover, handingBack: { by, at: ctx.now() } } });
+    appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `${by} hands the work back from the clone`);
+    return { attemptId: attempt.id };
+  });
+}
+
+/** Clears a pending hand-back: the runner answered, or the hub stopped waiting. */
+function clearHandingBack(ctx: HubContext, attempt: Attempt, error?: string): void {
+  if (!attempt.takeover) return;
+  const takeover = { ...attempt.takeover, handingBack: null };
+  updateAttempt(ctx, attempt.id, { takeover: error === undefined ? takeover : { ...takeover, error } });
+}
+
+/**
+ * attempt.handed_back (design 6.12): while the task is still taken over by the attempt, the pushed { ref, sha } is its
+ * work position, not late work, and the task goes ready with the clone cleaned up. Once the task has gone ready
+ * without it (its runner was not online, or the hand-back timed out), the push is late work.
+ */
+export function onHandedBack(
+  ctx: HubContext,
+  emit: Emit,
+  runnerId: string,
+  attempt: Attempt | null,
+  event: { attemptId: string; data: RunnerEventData['attempt.handed_back'] },
+): void {
+  markGitPushed(ctx, runnerId);
+  const taskId = attempt?.taskId ?? parseAttemptId(event.attemptId)?.taskId ?? null;
+  if (taskId === null) return;
+  const { ref, sha } = event.data;
+  if (attempt?.takeover?.handingBack) clearHandingBack(ctx, attempt);
+  const task = findTask(ctx, taskId);
+  if (attempt?.status === 'ended' && task && takenOverBy(task, attempt)) {
+    handBack(ctx, emit, task, getAttempt(ctx, attempt.id), `runner:${runnerId}`, 'clone', { ref, sha });
+    return;
+  }
+  recordLateWork(ctx, emit, attempt, { attemptId: event.attemptId, taskId, ref, sha, runnerId });
+}
+
+/** The text of a refused hand-back in Attempt.takeover.error; process_running names the pids (X-37). */
+function handbackError(result: CommandResult): string {
+  if (result.error !== 'process_running') return clip(result.error ?? 'the runner refused the hand-back', 500);
+  const pids = (result.data as { pids?: unknown } | undefined)?.pids;
+  const named = Array.isArray(pids) && pids.length > 0 && pids.every(Number.isInteger);
+  return `process_running: ${named ? `pids ${pids.join(', ')}` : 'processes'} still run in the clone`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A refused hand_back (X-37): the task stays blocked as taken over, the error goes to Attempt.takeover.error, and the
+ * hand-back is no longer pending, which stops its timer; the person may hand back again.
+ */
+function onHandbackResult(ctx: HubContext, command: CommandRow, result: CommandResult): void {
+  if (result.ok || command.attemptId === null) return;
+  const attempt = findAttempt(ctx, command.attemptId);
+  if (!attempt) return;
+  const error = handbackError(result);
+  appendAttemptLog(ctx, attempt.id, 'note', `the hand-back from the clone was refused: ${error}`);
+  if (attempt.takeover?.handingBack) clearHandingBack(ctx, attempt, error);
+}
+
+RESULT_HANDLERS.hand_back = (ctx, _emit, command, result) => onHandbackResult(ctx, command, result);
+
+/**
+ * Ends every hand-back from the clone that got no answer within handbackTimeoutMs, each in its own transaction: the
+ * task goes ready from its last recorded position, and a later push from the clone is late work. Returns how many.
+ */
+export function expireHandbacks(ctx: HubContext): number {
+  const cutoff = ctx.now() - ctx.config.handbackTimeoutMs;
+  const rows = ctx.db
+    .query(
+      `SELECT id FROM attempts WHERE status = 'ended'
+         AND json_extract(takeover, '$.handingBack.at') <= $cutoff`,
+    )
+    .all({ cutoff }) as { id: string }[];
+  let expired = 0;
+  for (const { id } of rows) {
+    try {
+      tx(ctx, (emit) => {
+        const attempt = getAttempt(ctx, id);
+        clearHandingBack(ctx, attempt);
+        const task = attempt.taskId === null ? null : findTask(ctx, attempt.taskId);
+        if (task && takenOverBy(task, attempt)) {
+          const why = `nothing came back from the clone within ${Math.round(ctx.config.handbackTimeoutMs / 1000)} s`;
+          readyWithoutClone(ctx, emit, task, attempt, 'system', why);
+        }
+      });
+      expired += 1;
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error(`ending the hand-back of attempt ${id} at its timeout failed`, error);
+    }
+  }
+  return expired;
+}
```

Run: `bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: all tests pass (`0 fail`); `tsc` exits 0.

`handingBack` is `{ by: 'user:<login>', at: <epoch ms> } | null`; every importer of `Attempt` is updated in this commit, as X-49 requires. The hub reads the pids of a `process_running` refusal from `result.data.pids`; the doc comment on `hand_back` in `runner-protocol.ts` pins that shape for plan M2b. A task readied by the timeout or without the clone emits `task.ready` with a reason, not `task.handed_back`.

### Task 63: Downtime, clock jumps and the recovery window

Tick step 0 checks the clock (design 6.14, Downtime; 6.6 step 0). A gap of more than three ticks is downtime: leases are extended by the gap, and a recovery window opens in which nothing expires, stalls or dispatches. `startHub` checks the clock at start too. With `dbLock` (X-26) the hub keeps `<db>.pid` and refuses to start while it names a live process, and it closes the database cleanly on SIGTERM and SIGINT. The hub process registers both SIGTERM and SIGINT handlers before printing its readiness banner. Either signal received as soon as that banner appears must checkpoint and close the database, remove the lock and exit 0.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import type { AttemptFacts } from '@agflow/core';
import { getAttempt, updateAttempt } from '../src/attempt-store';
import { mintAgentToken } from '../src/auth';
import { type HubContext, createContext } from '../src/context';
import { listEvents } from '../src/events';
import { getHubState, inRecovery, updateHubState } from '../src/hub-state';
import { acquireDbLock, checkClock, dbLockRecord, releaseDbLock } from '../src/recovery';
import { type TickResult, runTick } from '../src/scheduler';
import { type HubServer, startHub } from '../src/server';
import { getTask } from '../src/task-store';
import { claimTask, createTasks } from '../src/tasks';
import { type TestClock, addAgent, addRunner, addRunnerAttempt, createTestContext, makeConfig, newTask } from './helpers';
import { createTestHub } from './http-helpers';

const MINUTE = 60_000;

const leaseOf = (ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string) => getAttempt(ctx, attemptId).leaseExpiresAt;
const taskLeaseOf = (ctx: HubContext, taskId: string) => getTask(ctx, taskId).leaseExpiresAt;
const eventsOf = (ctx: HubContext, type: string) => listEvents(ctx.db).filter((event) => event.type === type);
/** The pid a lock file names; the boot beside it moves by a second from one reading of the clock to the next. */
const lockPid = (path: string) => readFileSync(path, 'utf8').split(' ')[0];

/** Facts that report an hour of vendor errors: a fresh report makes the tick replace the attempt (design 6.8). */
function erringFacts(ctx: HubContext, attemptId: string): AttemptFacts {
  return {
    attemptId,
    fence: getAttempt(ctx, attemptId).fence,
    phase: 'turn',
    eventAgeMs: 5_000,
    tool: null,
    fsAgeMs: 20_000,
    commitAgeMs: null,
    turns: 3,
    turnsWithoutProgress: 0,
    repeatedCalls: 0,
    continuations: 0,
    vendorErrorMs: ctx.config.vendorErrorReplaceMs,
    activeMs: 90_000,
    contextUsed: 0.4,
  };
}

describe('the clock check', () => {
  test('a gap over 3 ticks extends the leases by it and starts the recovery window; recovery_ended follows it', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const [live] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Live' })], 'user:alice');
    claimTask(ctx, live?.id as string, addAgent(ctx));
    const runnerLease = leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id) as number;
    const taskLease = taskLeaseOf(ctx, live?.id as string) as number;

    // Exactly three ticks is a hub that ran late, not downtime.
    clock.advance(3 * ctx.config.tickMs);
    expect(checkClock(ctx)).toEqual({ gapMs: 3 * ctx.config.tickMs, downtime: false, recoveryEnded: false });
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ lastAliveAt: ctx.now(), recoveryUntil: null });
    expect(leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toBe(runnerLease);

    const gapMs = 3 * ctx.config.tickMs + 1;
    clock.advance(gapMs);
    expect(checkClock(ctx)).toEqual({ gapMs, downtime: true, recoveryEnded: false });
    const until = ctx.now() + ctx.config.recoveryMs;
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ lastAliveAt: ctx.now(), recoveryUntil: until });
    expect(leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toBe(runnerLease + gapMs);
    expect(taskLeaseOf(ctx, live?.id as string)).toBe(taskLease + gapMs);
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'system.recovery_started').map((event) => [event.subject, event.data])).toEqual([
      [null, { gapMs, until }],
    ]);
    expect(inRecovery(ctx)).toBe(true);

    // The ticks go on every tickMs meanwhile; the window ends with the first one at or after recovery_until.
    while (ctx.now() + ctx.config.tickMs < until) {
      clock.advance(ctx.config.tickMs);
      expect(checkClock(ctx)).toMatchObject({ downtime: false, recoveryEnded: false });
    }
    clock.advance(until - ctx.now() - 1);
    expect(checkClock(ctx).recoveryEnded).toBe(false);
    expect(inRecovery(ctx)).toBe(true);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(inRecovery(ctx)).toBe(false);
    expect(checkClock(ctx)).toEqual({ gapMs: 1, downtime: false, recoveryEnded: true });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).recoveryUntil).toBeNull();
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'system.recovery_ended')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(checkClock(ctx).recoveryEnded).toBe(false);
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'system.recovery_ended')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('a backward clock step is not downtime and shortens no lease', () => {
    const { ctx } = createTestContext();
    const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const lease = leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id);
    // The last tick ran ten minutes "later" than now: the clock was stepped back.
    updateHubState(ctx, { lastAliveAt: ctx.now() + 10 * MINUTE });
    expect(checkClock(ctx)).toEqual({ gapMs: -10 * MINUTE, downtime: false, recoveryEnded: false });
    expect(leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toBe(lease);
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ lastAliveAt: ctx.now(), recoveryUntil: null });
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'system.recovery_started')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a backward clock step cuts an open recovery window back to recoveryMs from now', () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
    checkClock(ctx);
    const until = getHubState(ctx).recoveryUntil as number;
    // Thirty seconds into the window the clock steps back an hour: the window ends at most recoveryMs later.
    clock.advance(30_000);
    checkClock(ctx);
    clock.advance(-60 * MINUTE);
    expect(checkClock(ctx)).toMatchObject({ downtime: false, recoveryEnded: false });
    expect(getHubState(ctx).recoveryUntil).toBe(ctx.now() + ctx.config.recoveryMs);
    expect(until - ctx.now()).toBeGreaterThan(ctx.config.recoveryMs);
    // A window that ends sooner than that keeps its end.
    updateHubState(ctx, { recoveryUntil: ctx.now() + 1_000, lastAliveAt: ctx.now() + MINUTE });
    checkClock(ctx);
    expect(getHubState(ctx).recoveryUntil).toBe(ctx.now() + 1_000);
    clock.advance(1_000);
    expect(checkClock(ctx).recoveryEnded).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('the recovery window', () => {
  /** Ticks every tickMs, as the scheduler's timer does, until a tick runs past the window; returns that tick. */
  function tickOut(ctx: HubContext, clock: TestClock, beforeEach: () => void): TickResult {
    for (;;) {
      clock.advance(ctx.config.tickMs);
      beforeEach();
      const result = runTick(ctx);
      if (!result.recovering) return result;
      expect([result.reconciled, result.lead, result.started]).toEqual([null, null, []]);
    }
  }

  test('nothing expires, stalls or dispatches until recovery_until, while bridge calls work', async () => {
    const hub = createTestHub();
    const { ctx, clock } = hub;
    ctx.db.run('UPDATE project SET runner_leads = 0 WHERE id = 1');
    const lost = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const erring = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    addRunner(ctx);
    const [ready] = createTasks(ctx, [newTask({ title: 'Ready' })], 'user:alice');
    const token = mintAgentToken(ctx, lost.attempt);

    clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
    const first = runTick(ctx);
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ clock: { downtime: true }, recovering: true, reconciled: null, started: [] });
    // Within the window: a lease that ran out, facts that call for a replacement, and a ready task with a free slot.
    updateAttempt(ctx, lost.attempt.id, { leaseExpiresAt: ctx.now() - 1 });
    updateAttempt(ctx, erring.attempt.id, { facts: erringFacts(ctx, erring.attempt.id), factsAt: ctx.now() });
    expect(runTick(ctx)).toMatchObject({ recovering: true, reconciled: null, started: [] });
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lost.attempt.id).status).toBe('running');
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, erring.attempt.id).stopRequested).toBeNull();
    expect(getTask(ctx, ready?.id as string).status).toBe('ready');
    const call = await hub.call('GET', '/api/tasks', { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
    expect(call.status).toBe(200);

    const after = tickOut(ctx, clock, () =>
      updateAttempt(ctx, erring.attempt.id, { facts: erringFacts(ctx, erring.attempt.id), factsAt: ctx.now() }),
    );
    expect(after.clock).toMatchObject({ downtime: false, recoveryEnded: true });
    expect(after.reconciled).toMatchObject({ runnerLeases: 1, stalls: { stopped: [erring.attempt.id] } });
    expect(after.started.map((attempt) => attempt.taskId)).toContain(ready?.id);
    expect(getAttempt(ctx, lost.attempt.id).endReason).toBe('lost');
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'system.recovery_ended')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe('startHub', () => {
  const servers: HubServer[] = [];
  const dirs: string[] = [];

  afterEach(async () => {
    for (const server of servers.splice(0)) await server.stop();
    for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  function fileContext(): { ctx: HubContext; dbPath: string; pidPath: string } {
    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-recovery-'));
    dirs.push(dir);
    const dbPath = join(dir, 'agflow.db');
    const ctx = createContext({ dbPath, config: makeConfig() });
    return { ctx, dbPath, pidPath: `${dbPath}.pid` };
  }

  /** The pid of a process that has exited. */
  function deadPid(): number {
    const child = Bun.spawnSync(['true']);
    return child.pid;
  }

  test('checks the clock at start: downtime starts the recovery window', async () => {
    const { ctx, clock } = createTestContext();
    const held = addRunnerAttempt(ctx);
    const lease = leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id) as number;
    clock.advance(20 * MINUTE);
    const hub = startHub(ctx, { timers: false });
    servers.push(hub);
    expect(getHubState(ctx)).toMatchObject({ lastAliveAt: ctx.now(), recoveryUntil: ctx.now() + ctx.config.recoveryMs });
    expect(leaseOf(ctx, held.attempt.id)).toBe(lease + 20 * MINUTE);
    expect(eventsOf(ctx, 'system.recovery_started')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test('with dbLock it keeps <db>.pid, refuses a live holder, replaces a stale one and removes it on stop', async () => {
    const { ctx, dbPath, pidPath } = fileContext();
    const own = String(process.pid);
    const hub = startHub(ctx, { dbLock: true, timers: false });
    expect(lockPid(pidPath)).toBe(own);
    await hub.stop();
    expect(existsSync(pidPath)).toBe(false);

    // Another hub that runs: the file names a live process of this boot.
    const other = Bun.spawn(['sleep', '30']);
    try {
      writeFileSync(pidPath, dbLockRecord(other.pid));
      expect(() => startHub(ctx, { dbLock: true, timers: false })).toThrow(
        `the database ${dbPath} is in use by process ${other.pid}`,
      );
      expect(lockPid(pidPath)).toBe(String(other.pid));
      // The same pid written in an earlier boot names some other process now: the file is stale.
      writeFileSync(pidPath, `${other.pid} 1\n`);
      acquireDbLock(dbPath);
      expect(lockPid(pidPath)).toBe(own);
      releaseDbLock(dbPath);
    } finally {
      other.kill();
      await other.exited;
    }
    // It is gone now, so its file is stale.
    writeFileSync(pidPath, dbLockRecord(other.pid));
    const again = startHub(ctx, { dbLock: true, timers: false });
    expect(lockPid(pidPath)).toBe(own);
    await again.stop();
    // A file that names no pid and boot is stale too; one that names this process is its own lock already.
    for (const text of ['garbage', '', `${other.pid}\n`]) {
      writeFileSync(pidPath, text);
      acquireDbLock(dbPath);
      acquireDbLock(dbPath);
      expect(lockPid(pidPath)).toBe(own);
      releaseDbLock(dbPath);
      expect(existsSync(pidPath)).toBe(false);
    }
    writeFileSync(pidPath, dbLockRecord(deadPid()));
    const third = startHub(ctx, { dbLock: true, timers: false });
    servers.push(third);
    expect(lockPid(pidPath)).toBe(own);
    // Only the lock file is left: the files it was written and replaced through are gone.
    expect(readdirSync(dirname(pidPath)).filter((name) => name.includes('.pid'))).toEqual(['agflow.db.pid']);
  });

  test('of processes racing for one stale lock, exactly one takes it', async () => {
    const { dbPath, pidPath } = fileContext();
    writeFileSync(pidPath, dbLockRecord(deadPid()));
    const script = `
      import { acquireDbLock } from ${JSON.stringify(join(import.meta.dir, '../src/recovery.ts'))};
      await Bun.sleep(Number(process.argv[2]) - Date.now());
      try {
        acquireDbLock(process.argv[1]);
        console.log('took');
        await Bun.sleep(1_000);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(error.message);
      }
    `;
    const at = Date.now() + 500;
    const racers = Array.from({ length: 6 }, () =>
      Bun.spawn(['bun', '--eval', script, dbPath, String(at)], { stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'inherit' }),
    );
    const outputs = await Promise.all(racers.map((racer) => new Response(racer.stdout).text()));
    const took = outputs.filter((output) => output.trim() === 'took');
    expect(took).toHaveLength(1);
    for (const output of outputs.filter((one) => one.trim() !== 'took')) {
      expect(output).toMatch(/is in use by process|another process took it/);
    }
  }, 20_000);

  test('releasing leaves a lock file that names another process alone', () => {
    const { dbPath, pidPath } = fileContext();
    writeFileSync(pidPath, dbLockRecord(deadPid()));
    releaseDbLock(dbPath);
    expect(existsSync(pidPath)).toBe(true);
  });

  test('without dbLock it writes no lock file; an in-memory database cannot be locked', async () => {
    const { ctx, pidPath } = fileContext();
    const hub = startHub(ctx, { timers: false });
    servers.push(hub);
    expect(existsSync(pidPath)).toBe(false);
    const memory = createTestContext().ctx;
    expect(() => startHub(memory, { dbLock: true, timers: false })).toThrow('dbLock needs a database file');
  });
});

describe('the hub process', () => {
  const dirs: string[] = [];

  afterEach(() => {
    for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  /** A port that was free a moment ago. */
  function freePort(): number {
    const probe = Bun.serve({ port: 0, hostname: '127.0.0.1', fetch: () => new Response() });
    const { port } = probe;
    probe.stop(true);
    return port as number;
  }

  /** Reads the stream until its text contains what it waits for. */
  async function readUntil(stream: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, wanted: string): Promise<string> {
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let text = '';
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      text += decoder.decode(chunk);
      if (text.includes(wanted)) return text;
    }
    throw new Error(`the hub exited before printing "${wanted}":\n${text}`);
  }

  function spawnHub(dir: string, args: string[] = []) {
    const dbPath = join(dir, 'agflow.db');
    return Bun.spawn(['bun', ...args, join(import.meta.dir, '../src/main.ts')], {
      env: {
        PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '',
        HOME: dir,
        AGFLOW_AUTH: 'dev',
        AGFLOW_ALLOWED_USERS: 'alice',
        AGFLOW_PROJECT_NAME: 'signals',
        AGFLOW_PROJECT_REPO: 'https://github.com/acme/signals',
        AGFLOW_PORT: String(freePort()),
        AGFLOW_DB: dbPath,
        AGFLOW_BACKUP_DIR: join(dir, 'backups'),
      },
      stdout: 'pipe',
      stderr: 'inherit',
    });
  }

  for (const signal of ['SIGTERM', 'SIGINT'] as const) {
    test(`${signal} at the readiness announcement shuts down cleanly`, async () => {
      const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-signal-ready-'));
      dirs.push(dir);
      const dbPath = join(dir, 'agflow.db');
      const preload = join(dir, 'signal-at-ready.ts');
      // Send the real OS signal before the banner's console.log returns. This pins the earliest moment a reader
      // can signal readiness, without depending on the parent winning a scheduling race or adding a sleep.
      writeFileSync(preload, `
        const log = console.log;
        console.log = (...args) => {
          log(...args);
          if (String(args[0]).startsWith('agflow hub for "signals"')) {
            process.kill(process.pid, ${JSON.stringify(signal)});
          }
        };
      `);
      const hub = spawnHub(dir, ['--preload', preload]);
      try {
        const output = new Response(hub.stdout).text();
        expect(await hub.exited).toBe(0);
        expect(await output).toContain(`${signal}: stopping the hub`);
        expect(existsSync(`${dbPath}.pid`)).toBe(false);
        expect(existsSync(`${dbPath}-wal`) ? statSync(`${dbPath}-wal`).size : 0).toBe(0);
      } finally {
        hub.kill('SIGKILL');
        await hub.exited;
      }
    }, 20_000);

    test(`${signal} closes the database with the WAL checkpointed and removes the lock file`, async () => {
      const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-signal-'));
      dirs.push(dir);
      const dbPath = join(dir, 'agflow.db');
      const hub = spawnHub(dir);
      try {
        await readUntil(hub.stdout, 'agflow hub for "signals"');
        expect(lockPid(`${dbPath}.pid`)).toBe(String(hub.pid));
        expect(existsSync(`${dbPath}-wal`)).toBe(true);
        hub.kill(signal);
        expect(await hub.exited).toBe(0);
      } finally {
        hub.kill('SIGKILL');
      }
      expect(existsSync(`${dbPath}.pid`)).toBe(false);
      expect(existsSync(`${dbPath}-wal`) ? statSync(`${dbPath}-wal`).size : 0).toBe(0);
    }, 20_000);
  }
});
```
